title_en: Workforce management system with fairness scheduling
abstract_en: A workforce management system implements enhanced any-day-of-the-week or holiday fairness processing. The system provides one or more display interfaces indexed by day of week or given holiday dates, and through which a user defines a fairness policy with respect to each such day or dates. In use, the system compares a fairness policy with historical credit data to generate a rank order of agent eligibility to fulfill a contact center schedule for a given day or holiday date. This rank order of agent availability is then provided to a scheduler to enable generation of one or more contact center schedules for the given day or holiday date. The day of week and holiday fairness may be carried out independently or combined. The system also enables fairness days or dates to be processed according to a user-defined priority.

title_en: Supply allocation calculating system
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To solve the conventional problem wherein it is impossible to cope with change of requirement from bases or change of an available amount, so as to optimize an inventory.  <P>SOLUTION: An allocation amount of articles to the bases is calculated based on: an available total amount (including other than "quantity") in a prescribed period; an amount required for shipment from the bases on a distribution channel (required amount including other than "quantity"); and a promise amount for the amount required for shipment. The promise amount is the allocation amount promised with the bases in a promise period as the prescribed period. This invention may compare the available amount and the total amount of the promise, and change the allocation method based on the comparison result.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Disaster control device for elevator
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a disaster control device for an elevator having a storage box for disaster control usable by many and unspecified passengers only in an emergency, without modifying the elevator.  <P>SOLUTION: This disaster control device for an elevator comprises: a monitoring center 4 remotely connected to a plurality of elevators through a communication line including the Internet 5 and performing communication with an interphone disposed in a car 1, notification of occurrence of abnormality of the elevator, and the monitoring of the state of the elevator; an accepting device 6 for transmitting and receiving signals to and from the monitoring center 4 through the communication line; and the storage box 2 for disaster control for storing emergency supplies used in an emergency in the car 1. The monitoring center 4 comprises: a determination means S10 for determining whether the storage box 2 for disaster control is present or not and whether an unlocking method can be notified or not according to elevator information S4, B received from the elevator side through the communication line; and a distribution means S11, C for distributing the unlocking method for the storage box 2 for disaster control to a source when the unlocking method can be notified by the determination means 10.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&INPIT
assignees: HITACHI BUILDING SYS CO LTD;KOKUYO KK

title_en: System and method for optimizing product development portfolios and aligning product, brand, and information technology strategies
abstract_en: Business and software methods are described for cost-effectively optimizing product development portfolios, services development portfolios, and IT (information technology) portfolios, accelerating market entry, and optimizing alignment between product strategy, IT strategy, and brand strategy. Product and service attributes are characterized, categorized, and prioritized with numerical values amenable to statistical analysis of each assessed product development/IT initiative in terms of alignment with ideal customer experience and potential competitive impact relative to the resources and risks required to bring each initiative to market. Methods further include prioritization in the form of applied decision intelligence tools to allow an organization to reach better-informed judgments concerning resource allocation to develop, maintain, or optimize a given product or service portfolio or IT portfolio to improve business performance, increase market impact, and build brand equity.

title_en: Emergency supplies stockpile cabinet for emergency
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide an emergency supplies stockpile cabinet for emergency which is less in the burden of expense, an increase in burden of a building manager and the burden of crime prevention measures for emergency supplies and can successfully distribute the emergency supplies to people who are forced to stay inside a building because of an earthquake by distributing many emergency supplies at conspicuous places.  <P>SOLUTION: An upper part 2a of a box body 2 is made to be a storage space 4 for emergency supplies for emergencies 3, the storage space 4 is provided with a door 5 in a freely openable and closable way, and a lower part 2b of the box body 2 is made to be a different purpose space 6 available for different prescribed purposes, the box body 2 is provided with a quake detection sensor 7, a crime prevention buzzer 8 and a control device 9 for them. When the quake detection sensor 7 detects a quake that is equal to or greater than a prescribed quake, the crime prevention buzzer 8 does not operate even if the door 5 is opened, and when the door 5 is opened even though the quake detection sensor 7 does not detect a quake that is equal to or greater than the prescribed quake, the crime prevention buzzer 8 is operated.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2009,JPO&amp;INPIT

title_en: Aid distribution decision system and method using internet
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To enable Internet-based collection of various donee information and a wider distribution in order to solve the problems wherein, in existing aid activities, donees are decided by donors or foundations and supplies cannot be distributed according to various donee information collected from many unspecified people, and there have been no systems and methods for recognizing and timely aiding many regions in need of aid around the world.  <P>SOLUTION: An aid distribution decision system includes a plurality of terminals 9 for receiving information about donees 5 that users 9p think should receive aid and sending the received information as vote information, and a distribution decision server 18 for receiving the vote information sent from the terminals 9 via the Internet and deciding a distribution ratio of supplies according to the vote information.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: System and method for analyzing effectiveness of distributing emergency supplies in the event of disasters
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method and system in one embodiment estimate the effectiveness of a dispensing plan of emergency supplies during disasters or in like scenarios, by simulating a flow of emergency supplies in a multi-echelon supply chain, dynamics of victims and progression of disaster. The performance metrics estimated in one embodiment include, but not limited to, overall coverage of distribution, inventory of supplies (e.g., shortage and surplus) and utilization of resources (e.g., shortage and surplus).

title_en: System for allocating advertising inventory in a unified marketplace
abstract_en: An advertisement impression distribution system includes a data processing system operable to generate an allocation plan for serving advertisement impressions. The allocation plan allocates a first portion of advertisement impressions to satisfy guaranteed demand and a second portion of advertisement impressions to satisfy non-guaranteed demand. The data processing system includes an optimizer, the optimizer to establish a relationship between the first portion of advertisement impressions and the second portion of advertisement impressions, the relationship defining a range of possible proportions of allocation of the first portion of advertisement impressions and the second portion of advertisement impressions. The optimizer generates an indicia in accordance with maximizing guaranteed demand fairness or representativeness, maximizing non-guaranteed revenue, and minimizing under-delivery penalties, where the indicia indentifies a determined proportion of the first portion of advertisement impressions to serve and a determined proportion of the second portion of advertisement impressions to serve. The data processing system outputs the allocation plan including the indicia to control serving of the advertisement impressions in the determined proportions.

title_en: Inventory allocation with tradeoff between fairness and maximal value of remaining inventory
abstract_en: A method of balancing advertisement inventory allocation includes constructing a flow network of nodes having impressions connected to contracts through corresponding arcs such as to satisfy demand requests of the contracts; normalizing an impression value of each node to a predetermined cost range; setting a cost of each arc to each corresponding normalized value; iteratively performing a plurality of times: (a) sampling the nodes or the arcs to create sample nodes and arcs, each time starting from a different random seed; (b) optimally allocating impressions from the sample nodes to the contracts with a minimum-cost network flow algorithm; (c) separately allocating impressions from sample arcs of lowest cost before allocating those from sample arcs of higher cost; averaging allocations from iterations (b) to create a first allocation; averaging allocations from iterations (c) to produce a second allocation; and computing a weighted solution of the first and second allocations.

title_en: Motivating equitable behavior in calendar events
abstract_en: An event scheduling request is received, and a disruption factor is associated with each of a plurality of invitees. The disruption factor is based upon, at least in part, an event parameter and at least one invitee attribute. An event is scheduled based upon, at least in part, the disruption factors associated with each of the plurality of invitees.
assignees: JU LIN;O'SULLIVAN PATRICK J;STERN EDITH H;WEIR ROBERT C;WILLNER BARRY E;IBM

title_en: Workflow Management System and Method
abstract_en: Systems and methods improve the equitable distribution the processing capacity of a computing device processing work items retrieved from multiple queues in a workflow system. A retrieval priority is determined for each of the plurality of queues and work items are retrieved from each of the multiple queues according to the retrieval priority. The retrieved work items are then stored in a central data structure. Multiple processing components process the work items stored in the central data structure. The number of processing components is selectively adjusted to maximize efficiency.

title_en: Internet of things technology-based relief supply distribution management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an Internet of things technology-based relief supply distribution management system, in particular to a relief supply distribution management system for ocean storm surge disasters. The system mainly comprises a wireless sensor network unit for sensing relief supply environmental data, a radio frequency identification (RFID) unit for identifying and transmitting relief supply basic attribute data, a unit for accurately positioning a moving object through a satellite and a vehicle-mounted global positioning system (GPS) chip, an information transmission unit for transmitting the relief supply environmental data through a wireless communication network, namely a global system for mobile communications (GSM), and a data processing unit for a relief supply information processing system to analyze the relief supply environmental data and make decisions. The system is mainly applied to the distribution management of relief supplies, dynamically monitors conditions such as the distribution quantity of the relief supplies on each shelter, the delivery condition of the supplies, the quality of the supplies in the transportation process and the like to ensure that the relief supplies can safely and timely arrive at each shelter on the premise of guaranteeing the quality and quantity.

title_en: Heuristic cross shipping of disaster relief supplies at points of distribution
abstract_en: Distributing disaster relief supplies, in one aspect, may include determining cross shipping of disaster relief supplies between points of distribution using one or more combinations of information. The information may include one or more of on-hand inventory of each point of distribution, in-transit inventory to each point of distribution, demand queue of disaster victims at each point of distribution, traveling time between supply staging area and points of distribution, traveling time between points of distribution, number of transportation vehicles available for cross shipping, minimum batch size for cross shipping, frequency of cross shipping, and point of distribution activation status, or combinations thereof.

title_en: A system and method for budget-compliant, fair and efficient manpower management
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a method and system for budget-compliant, fair and efficient manpower management primarily for service industries to improve customer service, save costs, improve employee morale and productivity. More particularly the present invention relates to a system and method enabling labour planners and schedulers to rapidly develop a budget-compliant, fair, effective, easy to use and manageable and deployable manpower schedule to optimize and increase effective manpower productivity. Further the system and method of the present invention generates manpower plans and schedules suitable for deployment, on the basis of two novel criteria's a) compliance of allocations to planned labour budgets while also being driven by business forecasts and b) using several fairness" criteria so that the desirable and undesirable features of the schedules are equitably dispersed. Further, the invention provides a system which can be deployed with several optional hardware and network architecture and configuration.

title_en: Modeling distribution of emergency relief supplies for disaster response operations
abstract_en: A method and system to supply multiple items through a network of inventory staging areas and distribution points by determining inventory stocking levels for a staging area and distribution points, and inventory shipments from said staging area to distribution points and between the distribution points, using an optimization formulation whose objective is to cover maximum overall demand at the distribution points in a given period of time, and to minimize total cost of meeting demand.

title_en: Scheduling heterogeneous partitioned resources with sharing constraints
abstract_en: A system and method that provides an automated solution to obtaining quality scheduling for users of computing resources. The system, implemented in an enterprise software test center, collects information from test-shop personnel about test machine features and availability, test jobs, and tester preferences and constraints. The system reformulates this testing information as a system of constraints. An optimizing scheduling engine computes efficient schedules whereby all the jobs are feasibly scheduled while satisfying the users' time preferences to the greatest extent possible. The method and system achieves fairness: if all preferences can not be meet, it is attempted to evenly distribute violations of preferences across the users. The test scheduling is generated according to a first application of a greedy algorithm that finds an initial feasible assignment of jobs. The second is a local search algorithm that improves the initial greedy solution.
assignees: KIMBREL TRACY J;KUMAR TARUN;MCKENZIE KEVIN D;PREWITT JR RICHARD D;SVIRIDENKO MAXIM;TOMKOWID DEBRA;IBM

title_en: Apparatus for eco-friendly waste collection
title_ko: 친환경 배출물 집합 수거장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: An environment-friendly discharge collection apparatus is provided to implement the fairness of the billing system and to perform charge about food waste. CONSTITUTION: A recognition unit(110) recognizes a tag(200). A screen display unit(120) outputs discharger information about recognized information. A measurement unit(130) measures the weight of food waste. A control unit(140) controls the output of billing information or measured weight information. A transmitting unit(150) transmits charging information to a server.
abstract_ko:
본 발명에 의한 친환경 배출물 집합 수거장치는 배출자에 대한 식별정보가 수록된 태그를 인식하는 인식부; 상기 인식된 정보에 해당하는 배출자 정보가 출력되는 화면표시부; 개방된 투입구로 음식물쓰레기가 유입되면 유입된 음식물쓰레기의 중량을 계측하는 계측부; 상기 계측된 중량정보 또는 이에 해당하는 과금정보가 상기 화면표시부로 출력되도록 제어하는 제어부; 및 상기 화면표시부로 출력된 중량정보 또는 과금정보에 기초하여 배출자의 제1확인신호가 입력되면 상기 중량 정보 또는 과금정보를 서버로 전송하는 전송부를 포함하여 구성된다. 
상기 본 발명에 의하면, 음식물 쓰레기 수거에 대한 과금 체계를 더욱 정확하고 객관적이며 개별적으로 운용할 수 있는 인프라를 제공할 수 있어 배출자, 수거업체, 관공서 등의 모든 행위 주체의 업무 처리에 최적화된 음식물 쓰레기 수거 시스템을 구현할 수 있다.
assignees: INFINITY TECHNOLOGY & AMP INFORMATION SYSTEMS;KIM LAE HYUN;KIM TAEK JOONG

title_en: Flow tobacco purchasing system
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a flow tobacco purchasing system, which comprises a tobacco point server arranged in a computer network and a purchasing control center connected with the tobacco point server; the purchase control center is connected with at least one tobacco purchase line used for purchasing the field management system unit and a selected number arranging device; the tobacco leaf purchase line includes: the tobacco delivering and card swiping equipment is used for tobacco grower identity verification; tobacco leaf grading equipment for selling and confirming input tobacco leaf grade by basket; tobacco leaf weighing and stacking equipment for reading the weight of tobacco leaves basket by basket according to a grading sequence; the tobacco grower selling confirmation equipment is used for confirming selling of the tobacco grower on site. The utility model flexibly customizes the management control strategy according to the needs, and realizes the field flow management according to the role distribution function participated in the process; the sale confirmation function is added, so that errors and disputes are not easy to occur; the quality control process has clear vestige record and is convenient for tracing the product quality; the fairness and the objectivity are improved; the tobacco purchasing efficiency is improved, the operation is simple, and the applicability is strong.
assignees: CHENGDU HUINENG INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;SICHUAN TOBACCO CORP LIANGSHANZHOU CORP

title_en: Systems and methods for multi-vehicle resource allocation and routing solutions
abstract_en: A computer system for allocating and routing a plurality of servicing objects within a map of a region such that work load is balanced across the plurality of servicing objects is provided. The system formulates a model for allocating and routing the plurality of servicing objects in the region. The model comprises a distance matrix based upon a first plurality of segments or a second plurality of intersections in the map. The memory stores instructions for partitioning the map into a plurality of disjoint contiguous sub-regions in view of the distance matrix using an equitable convex region partition algorithm. The memory further stores instructions for calculating a corresponding tour graph for each sub-region in the plurality of sub-regions, where, for each respective sub-region in the plurality of sub-regions, a servicing object in the plurality of servicing objects is assigned to the tour graph that corresponds to the respective sub-region.
assignees: CARLSSON JOHN GUNNAR;JIN HOLLY;YE YINYU;CARDINAL OPTIMIZATION INC

title_en: Aircraft crew scheduling method and system realizing the same
abstract_en: The invention discloses an aircraft crew scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: (1) acquiring original data meeting requirements of a user from a user interface and a database, and analyzing, converting and arranging the original data to acquire all essential data meeting required forms; (2) carrying constraint control on the essential data according to a scheduling rule, generating all probably scheduled task combinations for each aircraft crew, namely generating a relative task string LoW for each aircraft crew, and evaluating and correcting the task strings LoW; (3) converting all corrected task strings into a task column and establishing a constraint matrix; (4) solving the constraint matrix by utilizing an algorithm of disassembling a large-scale problem formed by integer programming problems into sub problems; and (5) outputting calculation results. The invention further discloses a system for realizing the aircraft crew scheduling method, wherein the system comprises a data input module, a model generation module, a solving module, a control module, a basic module and the like. According to the system for realizing the aircraft crew scheduling method, disclosed by the invention, requirements on equitable distribution of flight number plane, aircraft crew scheduling and flight task are met through cooperation of all modules.

title_en: Alternate distributing system for intelligent pretreatment of scarce resources by discrete directional broadcasting
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alternate distributing system for the intelligent pretreatment of scarce resources by discrete directional broadcasting, which is used for distributing scarce resources according to a distributing rule of alternate distributing probability by adopting a mode of establishing an exclusive identification code and hand-shaking code data according to an advance requirement and informing a selected person of receiving and selecting the scarce resources by a convenient and rapid communication mode. According to the alternate distributing system for the intelligent pretreatment of the scarce resources by the discrete directional broadcasting, the social cost generated by man-made noise is avoided, and the aim of equitable distribution is realized. According to the alternate distributing system for the intelligent pretreatment of the scarce resources by the discrete directional broadcasting, the system can be greatly simplified; the system has higher safety and lower developing and running cost; and meanwhile, the system also has very extensive application range.

title_en: Determining technology costs associated with a financial product
abstract_en: The present invention provides for methods, apparatus and computer programs for determining technology costs associated with a financial product, and, in specific embodiments, an equity trade. In specific embodiments of the invention the technology application costs may be determined on a per-process basis and subsequently totaled to determine the overall cost. The invention provides for identifying a plurality of processes and a plurality of technology applications each of which are associated with a financial product. Once the processes and technology application have been identified, process allocation percentages are determined for each of the technology applications and identified processes associated with each of the technology applications and a per-financial product technology cost for each of the plurality of technology applications is determined over a predetermined time period. Additionally, the per-process technology cost is determined for the financial product based on the per-financial product technology cost for each of the plurality of technology applications and the process allocation percentages associated with a respective process and a respective technology application.

title_en: Seat distributing system for public reading room
abstract_en: The utility model provides a seat distributing system for a public reading room, which belongs to a computer management system and comprises a seat management server. A seat distributing terminal and a seat managing terminal are connected with the seat management server by a wireless gateway, and a manager terminal, a hall broadcasting device and a door control device are respectively connected with the seat management server by an Ethernet. The seat distributing system for the public reading room automatically distributes seats of the public reading room, a user can use the seat distributing terminal to apply for a seat, the door control device of the system controls entry and exit of the user, accordingly, the seats of the public reading room are distributed more efficiently and speedily, the problem that a person occupies multiple seats of the public reading room is avoided, existing seat resources are sufficiently utilized, and service efficiency and service fairness of the seat resources are improved.

title_en: Custom declaration document information flowing system
abstract_en: The utility discloses a custom declaration document information flowing system, which comprises a document number acquiring unit, a document number processing unit, a document number storage unit, a service request responding and scheduling unit and a service information associating unit, wherein the document number acquiring unit is used for acquiring document numbers, the document number processing unit is used for distinguishing whether the document numbers acquired by the document number acquiring unit are legal or not and destroying illegal document numbers, the document number storage unit is used for storing the legal document numbers, the service request responding and scheduling unit is used for responding and scheduling service requests of users with the legal document numbers, and the service information associating unit is used for providing service information associated with the service requests of the users with the legal document numbers. By the aid of the custom declaration document information flowing system, unnecessary queuing time can be shortened, waste of manpower resources is decreased, the fairness and the efficiency of queuing are ensured, and flowing smoothness of custom declaration document information is guaranteed.

title_en: Business decision support system
title_ko: 경영의사 결정 지원시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A management decision determining supporting system is provided to select an optimized management scenario in a management decision determining process required for company management, thereby implementing reliable company management. CONSTITUTION: An operation decision determining simulation unit(110) analyzes an operation decision determining problem for operation decision determination. The operation decision determining simulation unit simulates a productive capacity and derives the same. A strategic decision determining simulation unit analyzes a strategic decision determining problem for a strategic decision. The strategic decision determining simulation unit simulates and evaluates validity of an individual business. [Reference numerals] (111) Operation order determining unit; (112) Operator number determining unit; (113) Facility determining unit; (114) Productive capacity deriving unit; (115) Work space size determining unit; (116) Distribution characteristic determining unit; (117) Adequate stock determining unit; (121) Capital cost component forming unit; (122) Financial prospect forming unit; (123) Individual business validity evaluating unit; (131) Entire company portfolio generating unit; (132) Entire company portfolio selecting unit; (133) Adequate capital deriving unit; (141) Sensitivity analyzing unit; (142) Risk analyzing unit; (150) Cash flow calculating unit; (160) Company value evaluating unit; (170) Responsibility accounting performance evaluating unit; (AA) Outside capital cost index; (BB) Equity capital cost index; (CC) Exogeneous index; (DD) Endogenous index; (EE) Profit structure; (FF) Evaluation reference index
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 경영의사 결정 지원시스템에 관한 것으로, 운영의사 결정을 위한 운영의사 결정 문제와 전략의사 결정을 위한 전략의사 결정 문제를 분석해 개별사업 타당성을 평가하여 사업 타당성이 있다 평가된 개별사업들이 조합된 다수의 전사사업 포트폴리오들을 생성하고, 이들을 분석해 최적의 전사사업 포트폴리오를 선택하도록 구현함으로써 객관적이고 정형화된 기업 경영 컨설팅을 제공할 수 있으므로 신뢰성을 보장할 수 있고, 급변하는 경영 여건에 효율적으로 대응할 수 있도록 한 것이다.

title_en: System and decision model for optimizing product development portfolios and technology portfolios for building brand equity
abstract_en: A technology platform, software, business system and decision model to build brand equity or improve business performance through more effective product/technology portfolio management and better alignment of product and technology strategy with brand strategy

title_en: Steel management system and method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of storage information management and particularly relates to a steel management system and method. The steel management system comprises a steel management server, a label printer, a communication control module and a volume detection module, wherein the label printer is connected with the steel management server through a serial connecting line, and the communication control module is connected with the steel management server through a serial port connecting line. The volume detection module is connected with the communication control module through a serial port connecting line, and is used for performing scanning detection to acquire storage situations of steel in a storage yard and transmitting the storage information to the steel management server through the communication control module. Delivering and carrying of steel can be achieved accurately as required in a real-time mode, so that the system and method has significance in production efficiency improvement, cost reduction, optimization of supply allocation, displacement and storage, and guarantee of ship delivery.

title_en: Franchise system for realty deal
title_ko: 부동산 거래를 위한 프랜차이즈 시스템
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A franchise system for realty deal real estate transactions is provided to increase the competitiveness of agents and to ensure the fairness and safety in the opening of information. CONSTITUTION: A database (203) is registered with landlord, sale, and contract information to manage. A management server (201) provides real estate brokerage information by registered levels on the basis of franchise registered information and manages franchise fees. Sale information is selectively provided according to franchise registered levels in a homepage using an internet network (207). Points are registered with the registration of new sales or the video information of existing sales. An agent terminal (205) stores sale information in a transaction request person terminal (211) using a wireless network (209). [Reference numerals] (207) Internet network; (209) Wireless network
abstract_ko:
본 발명에서 프랜차이즈 구조를 갖는 부동산 거래 시스템을 개시한다. 
본 발명에 따른 시스템은, 임대인 정보를 포함하여 매물정보 및 계약정보가 등록 관리되는 데이터베이스; 프랜차이즈 등록 정보에 기반하여 등록 레벨별 부동산 중개 정보를 제공하며, 거래 요구자로부터 접속, 방문, 매매에 따른 할인권 발급 및 포인트 관리 운용을 토대로 프랜차이즈 이용료 관리를 수행하는 관리서버; 및 인터넷 통신망을 통해 상기 관리서버로부터 제공되는 홈페이지 또는 웹 페이지에 접속하며, 프랜차이즈 등록 레벨에 따라 매물에 대한 동영상 정보, 매물정보, 계약정보, 임대인 정보가 선별적으로 제공되고, 신규 매물정보에 대한 등록 또는 기존 매물정보에 대한 동영상 정보 등록에 따른 포인트 가산이 이루어지는 적어도 하나 이상의 중개사 단말기로 구성된다. 
따라서, 본 발명은 부동산 중개 시스템을 프랜차이즈 형태로 구현할 뿐만 아니라, 부동산 매물 정보에 대한 중앙 분배식 구조를 구현함으로써, 중개사 간의 경쟁력을 도모하고 정보공개의 형평성과 안전성을 확보할 수 있는 효과가 있다.

title_en: Receiving apparatus for escaping energency of a sufferers
title_ko: 이재민 비상대피 수용장치
abstract_en: PURPOSE: A victim emergency shelter accommodation unit is provided to grasp easily a number of people accommodated in a process of distributing bedclothes and a slogan article etc. to victims. CONSTITUTION: A victim emergency shelter accommodation unit (100) comprises a main body part (110), a recess (110a), and a dotted line part (120). The main body part has a bar shape, and the recess is formed in both sides of a lower part of the main body part. The dotted line part is perpendicularly formed in a center of the main body part. The dotted line part comprises a first cut-out line (120a) for keeping by folding the main body part, and a second cut-out line (120b) for cutting a part of the main body part.
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 자연재해가 발생하여 이재민들이 임시거처인 대피소로 피난할 경우, 이재민들에게 침구류 및 구호물품 등을 분배하는 과정에서 수용할 수 있는 인원을 용이하게 파악하도록, 넓은 대피소 시설에서 다수의 이재민 인원 정리를 단기간에 신속하게 처리하는 이재민 비상대피 수용장치를 제공하는 것을 목적으로 한다.  
상기 목적을 달성하기 위해, 본 발명에 따른 이재민 비상대피 수용장치는, 바 형상을 가진 본체부와 상기 본체부의 하부의 양측에 형성된 오목부 및 상기 본체부의 중심부위에 수직으로 형성된 절취선부를 포함하는 것을 특징으로 한다.

title_en: Multi-gas-channel inflation tent
abstract_en: The utility model provides a multi-gas-channel inflation tent. The multi-gas-channel inflation tent is characterized by mainly comprising a rain-proof fabric layer, a soft gas channel inner tire and a gas pressure distribution station, wherein the rain-proof fabric layer is arranged at the outmost side, and the soft gas channel inner tire is arranged at the inner side of the rain-proof fabric layer and is connected with the gas pressure distribution station. Due to the implement of the multi-gas-channel inflation tent, the tent avoids the problem of the increase of size and weight caused by an original framework supporting mode, and can provide more disaster relief materials under the condition of limited transport capacity in the process of disaster relief.

title_en: Brand Health Measurement - Investment Optimization Model
abstract_en: A system and method are disclosed for optimizing brand equity return on investment (ROI). Original input data associated with a plurality of brand equity variables is processed using a brand equity ROI model to generate a first brand equity value, which in turn is processed to generate a dependent variable. Input data corresponding to an individual brand equity variable is then processed to generate changed input data, which in turn is processed by the brand equity ROI model with the original input data and the dependent variable to generate a second brand equity value. The first and second brand equity values are then processed to determine the effect of the changed data on the first brand equity value.

title_en: Intelligent government affair and innovative social management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent government affair and innovative social management system which comprises a basic data management module for data supporting, a module making government affairs public and used for information disclosure and showing, a government service management module for service and dynamic supervising and management, an interaction module for network communication, a monitoring module and a mobile client-side module for function expansion. The intelligent government affair and innovative social management system can make party building government affair organization to be transparent and public and achieve dynamic control of social significant factors, analysis, studying and judgment of the basic-level popular will situation, joint mediation of disputes among the people, serves as a platform at the service of party building, comprehensive management, plan optimization, politics and law and the like of governmental functional departments and relates to all aspects of social management. The manpower and capital cost for management of the governmental functional departments can be reduced, direct communication among the people, companies, units and the government can be enhanced and social equity and social stability are promoted through the network platform.

title_en: It is a kind of to be directed to more runway flights into the dynamic dispatching method left the theatre
abstract_en: It is as follows into dynamic dispatching method of leaving the theatre, its step that the present invention discloses a kind of more runway flights：Cost of flight delay is analyzed, proposes that more runway flights minimize object function into all cost of flight delay of scheduling of leaving the theatre；The theoretical delay time at stop is calculated, the flight delay time at stop of different type of machines is scaled the delay time at stop of flat delay cost；Analyze the fairness of more runway scheduling and construction considers the object function of fair factor；It is proposed the General Constraint Condition of more runway Scheduled Flight scheduling；Design considers delayed more runway flight schedule constraints conditions；More runway flights are solved into the dynamic scheduling problem left the theatre using genetic algorithm, realize that flight into runway dynamic dispatching of leaving the theatre, realizes the target for improving runway utilization rate and reducing cost of flight delay.The present invention takes into full account influence of the flight delay to the scheduling of more runways, realizes the target for improving more runway utilization rates and the target for reducing cost of flight delay.

title_en: Processing method and system for path selection
abstract_en: The invention discloses a processing method and system for path selection. The processing method comprises the steps that a path optimization model is established, wherein the path optimization model comprises objective functions of journey time, objective functions of transportation cost and objective functions of safe-passing probabilities of all road segments; effectiveness conversion is performed on all the objective functions according to the multi-attribute decision theory, and the maximum values and minimum values of the journey time, the transportation cost and the safe-passing probability of all the road segments are respectively figured out; time utility values, transportation cost utility values and safe-passing probability utility values of all the road segments are determined through linear transformation; the time utility value, the transportation cost utility value and the safe-passing probability utility value are respectively converted into corresponding dimensionless values through dimensionless processing; path optimization is converted into a single-attribute decision by performing weighting on all the dimensionless values; a passing path with the maximum decision utility value is found by the adoption of the shortest-path optimization algorithm. According to the processing method and system for the path selection, the process of the path selection is simplified, and the transportation requirement of emergency relief supplies can be fully met.

title_en: Method for Transparent and Fair Resource Distribution
abstract_en: A computer-implemented system for allocation of a series of picks amongst multiple selectors in a selection process is configured to use total picks data, number of selectors data, and picks per selector data to determine a series of benchmark pick slots for each selector in accordance with a benchmark, for each selector, calculating a pick cost for awarding a pick position to the selector, awarding said pick position to the selector for whom the pick cost would least deviate the system from the benchmark and storing said pick cost of awarding said pick, and then iterating through the remainder of the draft using pick cost to determine who picks next, ensuring maximum fairness in the pick order. The system also manages the draft itself once the pick order is determined. It can assign value to the items chosen. It awards, or deducts, points from participants based upon their receiving picks that are better or worse than they should have, and for the quality of the items they have chosen.

title_en: Workflow task scheduling method, multi-workflow scheduling method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention relates to a workflow task scheduling method, a multi-workflow scheduling method and a system of the multi-workflow scheduling method. The task scheduling method includes the steps that firstly, the upward weight of each task in a workflow is worked out, and the tasks are put into a list of the tasks to be scheduled according to the descending order of the upward weights; secondly, the task with the largest upward weight is selected, the time when the task can be completed fastest on each processing machine is traversed, and task is deployed to the processing machine where the task is fastest completed; thirdly, other tasks are deployed to corresponding processing machines according to the sequence of the tasks in the list of the tasks to be scheduled through the method in the second step. The main principle of the multi-workflow scheduling method includes the steps that the workflow priority received in real time is compared with the priority of a workflow being scheduled, a fairness strategy or a backfill strategy is implemented according to comparison results, and then task scheduling is carried out according to the WSS strategy. Based on the cloud computing environment, multi-priority multi-workflow scheduling can be effectively carried out.

title_en: the equality allocation system of cars

title_en: Management method and system for time-off schedule of delivery worker
abstract_en: The delivery timing of gas containers in LP gas delivery work depends on the state of use of gas by a customer, gas container volume, the number of placed containers, and the like; hence, it is not possible to limit delivery to a specific day. However, upon consideration of the fatigue of the delivery worker and maintaining worker motivation, creating a time-off schedule for a delivery worker in an equitable manner is necessary. This method involves assigning days off intermittently to delivery worker data having an identical delivery base and an identical coverage area, determining whether the number of total assigned days off meets or exceeds a prescribed number, and if the number of total days off is smaller than the prescribed number, assigning additional days off on the basis of a prescribed rule.

abstract_en: The present invention relates to a kind of amphibious calibration package, described system includes: an activity is loaded into the casing on transport facility; One docks at the amphibious ship in above-mentioned casing; The inwall of above-mentioned casing is provided with multiple shelf.Above-mentioned shelf is placed with emergency disaster relief goods and materials and equipment, anxious disaster relief supplies and equipment are including but not limited to fuel oil conservation tank, electrical generator, registration device, communication device, medical treatment device, potable water and grain.A kind of amphibious calibration package of the present invention, has the advantageous effect that scheduling is convenient, emergency ability is strong.

title_en: A kind of wireless cognition network frequency spectrum access method based on two-stage poll
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of wireless cognition network frequency spectrum access method based on two-stage poll, the present invention is using two-stage polling system technology as core, to improve the availability of frequency spectrum, it is starting point to reduce user's frequency spectrum access delay, provide in cognition network after user access authorization frequency range, the preferential multiuser channel sharing policy of authorized user.Roll-call access control mode based on reservation can be prevented effectively from collision, for delay sensitive business in emergency communication, on the premise of authorized user's proper communication is ensured, only to there is the user of business demand to distribute channel, it is that cognitive user and authorized user provide QoS and ensured in terms of propagation delay time, network throughput.And sent using the information of the Method of Scheduling Parallel control cognitive user based on reservation, it can avoid conflicting and improving channel utilization, in addition, the fairness in channel between authorized user's priority and cognitive user can be effectively ensured using two-stage roll-call access control method.

title_en: Relief supplies reserve management and distribution system based on Internet of Things technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a relief supplies reserve management and distribution system based on an Internet of Things technology. The relief supplies reserve management and distribution system comprises a vehicle positioning management subsystem, wherein the vehicle positioning management subsystem is used for tracking and positioning a vehicle proceeding position, collecting the vehicle positioning data of the vehicle, the article information of cargoes and surveillance video information and sending the vehicle positioning data of the vehicle, the article information of cargoes and the surveillance video information to a monitoring center, and the vehicle positioning data of the vehicle, the article information of cargoes and surveillance video information are stored and processed by the monitoring center. The vehicle positioning management subsystem comprises a vehicle-mounted terminal, an RFID (Radio Frequency Identification) module, a visual supervision module and a warehouse management subsystem, wherein the warehouse management subsystem is communicated with the RFID module and is used for managing the receiving, the delivery, the ordering, the checking and the operation of the cargoes according to the article information read by an RFID information reading unit. Relief working efficiency and quality can be improved, relief supplies distribution is especially monitored and managed, and blindness and disorder in a traditional emergency relief process are avoided so as to ensure that emergency relief and security work can be successfully carried out.

title_en: Optimized operation control method for wind turbine generators
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimized operation control method for wind turbine generators. The method is characterized in that the power margins of the wind turbine generators are calculated based on real-time measured wind data and ultra-short-period wind power predicted data, the operation time and the shutdown time of the wind turbine generators are counted in real time, and the operation constraint conditions of the wind turbine generators and the influence of the environmental factors are taken into full account, and therefore, the alternate operation of the wind turbine generators in the wind power plant can be guaranteed under the premise of meeting the requirement of dispatching on the power output of the wind power plant by virtue of coordination between the operation queue and the shutdown queue of the wind turbine generators, and meanwhile, frequent start and stop of the wind turbine generators are avoided and the fairness of operation for each wind turbine generator is improved.

title_en: Ship piloting and scheduling method based on forest model and improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship piloting and scheduling method based on a forest model and an improved genetic algorithm. According to the method, the piloting task forest model is established according to piloting task linkage conditions, and the improved breadth-first search algorithm is adopted for traversing a piloting task forest to obtain an initial piloting task set; according to the initial piloting task set, the improved genetic algorithm is adopted for obtaining the optimal piloting and scheduling plan. Various written scheduling rules and unwritten scheduling habits adopted during piloting and scheduling are considered, meanwhile, constraint conditions involved in piloting and scheduling problems are converted into a cost model, and the ship piloting and scheduling method is worked out from the three aspects of feasibility, fairness and benefits.

title_en: Micro grid energy storage device design method based on capacity limit value constrain
abstract_en: A micro grid energy storage device design method based on capacity limit value constrain includes 1, inputting the planning area distribution-type power supply allocation capacity and the type and distribution situation of an energy storage device; 2, inputting the planning area load and historical weather data; 3, establishing a distribution-type power supply force model and an energy storage charging and discharging module; 4, calculating the lower limit of the energy storage device allocation capacity; 5, calculating the upper limit of the energy storage device allocation capacity; 6, calculating the optimal value of the energy storage device allocation capacity in the range of the limit value. By the aid of the method, on the basis that the energy storage device capacity limit value of a connected-type micro grid is met, the optimal energy storage device capacity allocation matching with distribution type power generation is calculated, the requirements on reliability and economy of the micro grid can be met through the energy storage device capacity to the utmost extent, and clean, safe and reliable power is provided for loading.

title_en: A kind of flood season water power enrichment power network saves balancing power plant electric quantity of power supply distribution method
abstract_en: The present invention relates to Electric Power Network Planning and management and running field, disclose a kind of flood season water power enrichment power network and save balancing power plant electric quantity of power supply distribution method, dispatching of power netwoks fairness and economy objectives can be taken into account, for the problem that flood season rich water electricity grid generation ability is increased sharply, realize flood season each power supply, the reasonable distribution of power station electricity volume, it is ensured that desalinate benefits of different parties contradiction on the basis of power grid electric balance.Its solution is：Using the fairness and economy of dispatching of power netwoks as Optimized Operation target, the generation schedule for reporting is adjusted to determine each power plants generating electricity ability and same day actual load demand by various regions, it is determined that plan day the whole network electric quantity balancing situation, processed according to different situations classification, and the electricity volume of each power supply and station is distributed based on this, weight coefficient is introduced in assigning process and embodies preference of the policymaker between each sub-goal, finally provide the multiobjective decision-making collection based on different weight coefficients.The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows prediction power network future development, take into account the factors such as fairness, economy, operability, it is ensured that flood season dispatching of power netwoks it is reasonable effectively, with the important meaning of setting an example that takes the lead in.

title_en: Method and system for implementing a cloud based email distribution fairness algorithm
abstract_en: Disclosed is an approach for implementing a system, method, and computer program product for a marketing automation tool that implements an advanced fairness scheme for resources. The order that work items are deployed is carefully managed to ensure that customers are treated fairly. This prevents and/or minimizes any customer from being adversely affected by other customers.

title_en: Intelligent vehicle scheduling method based on time satisfaction degree algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to an intelligent vehicle scheduling method based on a time satisfaction degree algorithm, and belongs to the technical field of computers. In the conventional manual vehicle scheduling operation, vehicle scheduling personnel needs to manually fill up the names of a large quantity of transport products, the queue number of a current transport vehicle is memorized accurately by means of an Excel table or the conventional office tools, and vehicle transport products cannot be arranged in real time according to the characteristics of industrial enterprises, leading to poor instantaneity and poor flexibility. According to the method, assembly operation numbers are intelligently allocated to scheduling vehicles by setting important information such as product names and reservation numbers, and the transport sequence and quantity are adjusted in real time according to the current vehicle running situation, so that the fairness is ensured, and the efficiency is increased.
assignees: ZHENJIANG JINRUAN COMP TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Method and system to assess, diagnose, and optimize leadership and other performance skill development
abstract_en: A method and system of assessing, diagnosing, and optimizing leadership and other performance skills of an individual within an organization is realized through ratings of various leadership and/or other performance skills within a tired dimensions and sub-dimensions framework by raters of various constituencies within the organization. The ratings may be based on a quantitative score for each dimensions and sub-dimensions as well as a equity on-the-margin qualitative evaluation of the rated score. A developmental recommendation follows from the analysis identifying key areas of improvement needs for the leadership or other performance skills. Further analysis may be conducted with respect to comparisons and identifying discrepancies between the ratings by groups of the constituencies such as the self, superordinates, peers, and subordinates of the individual. The individual may also be assessed relative to norms by organization types, organizational roles, and positions within the organization.

title_en: A kind of daily postitallation evaluation method of power network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of daily postitallation evaluation method of power network, belongs to electric power system dispatching operation control technology field.This method includes：Daily dispatching of power netwoks postitallation evaluation index set is built, the index set includes four security, economy, fairness and the feature of environmental protection index aspects of operation；Each index is calculated according to corresponding data of the evaluation index collection power network of structure per day operation；The index result of calculating is integrated, result of the power network per day operation is evaluated.The evaluation of operation of power networks is defined in daily scope by the present invention, and the evaluation to operation of power networks effect is more targeted, can be formulated management and running strategy for power grid operation personnel and be provided reference, improve security, economy, fairness and the feature of environmental protection of operation of power networks.

title_en: Equitable shift rotation and efficient assignment mechanisms for contact center agents
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for facilitating equitable assignment of rotating shifts to agents in a contact center. In one embodiment, points are allocated to agents indicating their frequency of receiving undesirable shift assignments. Based on the previously allocated points, future undesirable shifts are assigned to agents. The point allocation scheme accommodates various exceptions scheduling periodic rotating shifts, such as skipping assignment of an agent from an upcoming undesirable shift, agents leaving, swapping a shift, and agents being added. In another embodiments, agents are assigned to rotating shifts using constructs of a cycle and a rotation template, which facilitates assigning agents to a work schedule with a calendar in a repetitious manner, and where certain shifts are non-rotational in nature and other shifts are rotational in nature.

title_en: Automatic order sending module
abstract_en: The invention relates to an automatic order sensing module, and particularly relates to an optimal operation model for production reality. Through multivariable analysis, an inventor finds out the relationship and inherent regularity of similar things, and the built structural system simplified optimal operation model has excellent performance such as stability, reliability, universality, interworking and the like in productive practice. In actual production, a working scene exists: the task of each employee is dispatched in a unified mode by a central console, and in order to ensure equity and justice, the central console needs a rule approved by people.

title_en: Common resource distributing method based on labor, law, capability, morality bottom line principle
abstract_en: The invention provides a common resource distributing method based on a labor, law, capability, morality bottom line principle. The common resource distributing method based on the labor, law, capability, morality bottom line principle is suitable for distribution according to work in a market orientated economy environment and directly links with legal compliance, work achievements and the like; factors such as social morality are considered; the common resource distributing method can be widely used for distributing various resources of companies, enterprises and public institutions and government agencies and organizations; objectivity and fairness can be embodied sufficiently; working enthusiasm of people is aroused; and the common resource distributing method has high reference and application value and serves for rules by law. According to the distributing scheme, preconditions are preset, and resources of people to be distributed are distributed according to the preset preconditions and a classifying type. The resources are distributed reasonably by the common resource distributing method, the labor amount bottom line is guaranteed, common resources are distributed under the condition that factors such as law, capability and social morality are considered, and the common resource distributing method based on the labor, law, capability, morality bottom line principle is suitable for distributing resources such as currencies (generally meaning cashes) and countable articles divided equally.

title_en: System of testing the influence of income distribution and social security system on personal sense of fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a system of testing the influence of income distribution and a social security system on personal sense of fairness for solving the problem that personal subjective sense of fairness is difficult to test through a social survey method in the prior art and relates to data processing methods. The technical scheme includes the steps of S10, respectively calculating first income of all tested users according to a preset simple topic set; S20, respectively calculating second income of all of the tested users according to a random topic set randomly selected from a preset test bank; S30, respectively calculating third income of all of the tested users according to the test bank and difficulty factors of user purchase; S40, obtaining all income of every tested user; S50, obtaining subjective feelings for the gap of income of all of the tested users; S60, obtaining and analyzing physiological indicators of every user to obtain objective feelings for the gap of income of all of the tested users; S70, obtaining personal sense of fairness for the gap of income of all of the tested users.

title_en: Big data-based emergency supplies data storage and circulation monitoring method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a big data-based emergency supplies data storage and circulation monitoring method. The method comprises the following steps: setting a task node, and forming a calculation ring by calculation nodes in a physical distribution network; extracting corresponding warehouse-in/out supplies record data from a database by the task node according to a received task request; separating warehouse objects serving as analysis objects in the corresponding warehouse-in/out supplies record data from a data set; performing Hash processing on the calculation nodes in the calculation ring through the task node, mapping the Hash-processed calculation nodes with the analysis objects, and assigning an analysis object split set to each calculation node; extracting analysis objects needing to be processed from the received analysis object split set by the calculation nodes, and acquiring other warehouse supplies record data having a supplies transfer relation in the analysis objects and the physical distribution network; and performing abnormity check on the warehouse supplies record data according to a received task object, and transmitting a check result to the task node. Through adoption of the big data-based emergency supplies data storage and circulation monitoring method, rapid analysis and monitoring can be performed on data.

In one embodiment, points are allocated to agents indicating their frequency of receiving undesirable shift assignments. Based on the previously allocated points, future undesirable shifts are assigned to agents. title_en: Gis-based integrated emergency supplies visualisation system and method
abstract_en: A GIS-based integrated emergency supplies visualisation system and method, comprising a comprehensive supplies data storage module, used for collecting comprehensive emergency supplies data, categorising said data, and storing the categorised data in a supplies allocation database; a GIS display module, used for marking on a GIS map the comprehensive emergency supplies data in the supplies allocation database; and a bidirectional service interaction module; when an emergency incident occurs, visualised distribution information of the supplies surrounding the emergency incident point on the GIS map, on the basis of information including the allocated supplies type, amount, and contact person, is rapidly formed into an emergency supplies allocation plan, and using a word file to establish a standard template, a standard word file is generated. In disaster incidents, comprehensive emergency supplies are immediately and effectively allocated, and by combining the GIS visualisation display principle, the present invention plays a role in preventing and reducing loss during a disaster, and making disaster prevention and mitigation outcomes more intuitive and real, and is beneficial for disaster monitoring and decision-making units.
assignees: STATE GRID CORP CHINA;EMERGENCY MAN CT OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;SHANDONG LUNENG SOFT TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Economic cascade load distribution method based on full-featured space curved face modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an economic cascade load distribution method based on full-featured space curved face modeling, and belongs to the technical field of hydroelectric energy optimizing operation. The method comprises: building a cascade load distribution module with a goal of maximum grade total energy storage; constructing full-featured space curved faces of hydropower stations according to the power characteristics of all units of the hydropower stations; applying a combined theory and ascertaining combined vibrating areas of the hydropower stations according to the vibrating areas of all units of the hydropower stations; applying a differential evolutionary algorithm to solve a cascade load distribution model according to the full-featured space curved faces and the combined vibrating areas of the hydropower stations; and issuing the optimal cascade load distribution scheme to all hydropower stations. According to the economic cascade load distribution method provided by the invention, output feasible regions of the hydropower stations can be directly ascertained through the combined vibrating areas by taking the hydropower stations as calculating units of the cascade load distribution; and furthermore, one the premise of taking the solving precision into account, the calculating efficiency can be effectively improved, the equitable distribution of the cascade total load can be realized among all the hydropower stations, and the safe, stable and economic operation of the cascade hydropower station groups can be ensured.

title_en: State grid geographic information system (GIS) based emergency real-time monitor system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a state grid geographic information system (GIS) based emergency real-time monitor system and method. The system comprises a digital individual soldier device module, an emergency monitor module, a GIS emergency situation module and an Ethernet switch. The digital individual soldier device module is used for collecting live videos and is connected with the Ethernet switch through the network. The emergency monitor module is used for controlling a digital individual soldier device, controlling a monitor device, and displaying the videos collected by the digital individual soldier device and the monitor device. The GIS emergency situation module is used for enabling emergency resource data to realize display of an emergency resource situation graph on a GIS map through a GIS platform so as to display emergency resource distribution and detailed information. The Ethernet switch is used for data transmission. According to the system, the real-time picture of the emergency site and emergency supplies are distributed on the GIS map so as to be showed uniformly, and a decision basis is provided for resource allocation by leaders in emergency disposal.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY EMERGENCY MAN CT

title_en: Warning and analyzing method for power facility damage based on meteorological data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a warning and analyzing method for power facility damage based on meteorological data, comprising the following steps: collecting meteorological, geological and hydrological information of an area where grid equipment is located in real time; matching the monitored meteorological, geological and hydrological data information with grid lines or the grid equipment and storing the monitored meteorological, geological and hydrological data information; extracting meteorological data, power facility data and facility damage historical data; setting a warning threshold, and carrying out warning for and evaluating and displaying major meteorological disasters in the area where the grid equipment is located; integrating the extracted data, and analyzing the probability of facility damage based on the data after integration; comparing the result of analysis with the warning threshold, and issuing a warning instruction if the result of power facility analysis exceeds the threshold; and allocating, deploying and commanding emergency personnel, emergency vehicles and emergency supplies online according to the warning content, the level of warning and the level of emergencies.
assignees: JIANGSU LIWEIXUN ELECTRICAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: A kind of flight airdrome scene running optimizatin method considering runway mouth waiting time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of flight airdrome scene running optimizatin methods considering runway mouth waiting time, belong to airport scene optimisation technique field.The optimization method initially sets up MAGMO models, while optimizing coasting time and the runway mouth waiting departure time；Then design RSS strategies are all flight distribution paths, and release the time to flight distribution of taking off；Simultaneously according to waiting for node allocation strategy HNAS to select the node in path for flight and distribute the stand-by period, to acquire optimal solution to the optimization of Bi-objective airdrome scene.The present invention has fully considered fairness between the priority of flight, flight, the influence to environment, it is ensured that scene flight stream it is safe, orderly and efficient；The present invention can improve entire flight stream safety, effectively avoid flight conflict to a certain extent；It prevents simultaneously since a large amount of flights fall into a long wait and bring security risk, fuel consumption, environmental pollution.

title_en: Earthquake rescue equipment material storage information system and material storage and distribution control method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an earthquake rescue equipment material storage information system and a material storage and distribution control method. The information system comprises a system setting module, a basic data management module, a daily in and out of warehouse management module, an integrated query module, an earthquake rescue operation response module, an earthquake emergency rescue basic database module, a rescue equipment material distribution algorithm module, an earthquake site rescue target carrying rescue equipment expert decision module and an earthquake site rescue team operation base equipment material management module; and intelligent identification and allocation and dispatching of earthquake relief materials are achieved. According to the earthquake rescue equipment material storage information system and the material storage and distribution control method, dynamic management of earthquake rescue equipment material information can be achieved; the timeliness of counting, storing and dispatching the rescue equipment materials is improved; the management efficiency on the earthquake rescue equipment material information is improved; and a data support and a guarantee of equipment materials are provided for the rescue team.
assignees: HU WEIJIAN;NAT EARTHQUAKE RESPONSE SUPPORT SERVICE;BEIJING CHUANGYIXINGSHENG TECHNOLOGY DEV CO LTD

title_en: Agricultural material allocation method based on large data and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an agricultural material allocation method based on large data and a device. The method comprises the steps that supplied first agricultural material data and first impact factor data are received, wherein the supplied first agricultural material data and the first impact factor data are by collected by a client in past preset time; the first agricultural material data and the first impact factor data are put into a distributed database; a large data mining algorithm is used to acquire the relationship function between the first agricultural material data and the first impact factor data; second impact factor data in future preset time are acquired and put into the distributed database; the first agricultural material data, the first impact factor data, the relationship function and the second impact factor data are used for calculation to acquire second agricultural material data in future preset time; and the second agricultural material data are used as agricultural material supply in future preset time. According to the method, overall agricultural materials are reasonably allocated; the accuracy and the efficiency of agricultural material supply allocation are improved; and labor cost is saved.

title_en: Emergency material distribution and dispatching decision support method and system thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency material distribution and dispatching decision support method and a system thereof. In the invention, according to a post-disaster emergency material dispatching decision requirement, a decision system demand is analyzed; aiming at an emergency material distribution and dispatching and transport route selection problem, a geographical information system and a decision support system are combined and an emergency material distribution and dispatching decision support system based on the geographical information system is designed. The system takes a man-machine interaction system as a principal portion and takes a traditional database, a space database, a model database, a knowledge base and a method base as supports. A man-machine interaction subsystem is provided with submodules of demand prediction, emergency material deploying scheme analysis, an emergency material transport path analysis and material management. A GPS global positioning system, a GSM global mobile communication system and the GIS geographical information system are integrated. Integration management and a distribution and dispatching decision analysis are performed on disaster relief materials.

title_en: Emergency logistic route optimizing method based on improved ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency logistic route optimization method based on an improved ant colony algorithm. The method comprises the steps of: constructing a multi-target static route optimizing model with minimum delivery time and minimum delivery cost serving as a target, and determining constraint conditions of the optimizing model, such as the emergency supply flows of temporary transfer stations, the fairness, and the vehicle-mounted capacity; using the ant colony algorithm to search for all routes, ordering the routes according to the lengths of the found routes after that all ants complete once searching, attaching a corresponding pheromone increment to each ant finding each route according to the route lengths; and setting upper and lower bounds of the pheromone, updating the pheromone of each route, completing traversal of all disaster points, determining a total target function value of each route and determining the optimal route and the optimal target function value. According to the invention, the ant colony algorithm is improved on the aspects of pheromone updating, pheromone limiting and the like, the convergence rate and the solving quality are increased and a theoretical basis is provided for the optimizing of the emergency route.
assignees: TAIHUA WISDOM IND GROUP HOLDINGS LTD

title_en: Calculating units and determining method for electric power system carbon emission flow distribution indexes
abstract_en: The invention provides calculating units and a determining method for electric power system carbon emission flow distribution indexes. The calculating units collect the active power flow in a local area and the direct carbon emission concerned information. The neighboring two calculating units, through iteration communications, conduct calculations on the carbon emission flow distribution of an entire system. The determining method comprises the following steps: making calculating units available in all carbon emission flow distribution equipment in a targeted electric power system; collecting active power flow in a local area and the direct carbon emission concerned information by the calculating units; and performing iteration communications between two adjacent calculating units so as to calculate the carbon emission flow distribution of an entire system. According to the invention, the calculating units and the determining method can rapidly figure out the accurate distribution of carbon emission flow of an entire system while not weighing much on a central server. By providing an accurate and reliable carbon emission flow of an electric system to the users, the method makes the responsibility of carbon emission cut shared more equitably, helps prevent the occurrence of carbon leakage, and encourages an active part in cutting carbon emission of an electric system from the user's side.

title_en: Three-public scheduling model construction method based on kini coefficient
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-member scheduling model construction method based on a kini coefficient, which comprises the following steps: step 1, collecting various optimized data such as unit characteristic parameters and system loads, and determining a scheduling plan space. Step 2: according to the actual demand of a power grid, constructing a scheduling plan model with the aim of minimizing the total cost including the unit operation cost and the start-stop cost; and step 3: and characterizing the electric quantity balance condition of each power plant by using a Gini coefficient G, and adding the electric quantity balance condition serving as a constraint condition into the constructed scheduling plan model. And 4, step 4: and obtaining a scheduling plan scheme through an optimization technology and security check. The scheduling plan model established in the method disclosed by the invention can consider the aspects of safety, economy, fairness and the like of the system, and can effectively improve the optimal configuration of power resources.

title_en: Unit combination method based on variable frequency air conditioner virtual unit modeling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a unit combination method based on variable frequency air conditioner virtual unit modeling, which comprises the following steps: (1) establishing a thermodynamic model and an electrical model of a single air conditioner; (2) carrying out centralized scheduling and control on the air conditioner group through a load aggregator, and establishing an aggregation model of the air conditioner group; (3) modeling a virtual unit according to the characteristics of the traditional unit, and establishing a cost function of the virtual unit under the condition that the user response is uncertain; (4) in the day-ahead market, a combined unit combination model of a traditional unit and a virtual unit is established according to the next day load and temperature prediction, and a next day scheduling plan is arranged; (5) in the actual scheduling process, the economic benefit of the load aggregator and the fairness and comfort of the users participating in the virtual machine set modeling are comprehensively considered, and the optimal distribution of the load adjustment amount among the users is realized. The invention realizes the centralized scheduling control of the air conditioner cluster and reduces the calculated amount and the control difficulty of related scheduling departments.

title_en: A kind of method for allocating tasks based on setting loss person's free time
abstract_en: A kind of method for allocating tasks based on setting loss person's free time, comprises the following steps: CU client calculates the free time of corresponding setting loss person；Server arranges and sends idle time threshold；If free time reaches this threshold value, then this CU user end to server sends task requests；Server receives task requests and records the time；Server generates task requests table；Server generates work distribution chart；Task in work distribution chart is sequentially allocated to the setting loss person in task requests table by server in order；Server update task requests table and work distribution chart；The CU client of acquisition task resets and stops calculating corresponding setting loss person's free time, and task terminates rear CU client and restarts to calculate its free time.The present invention, based on setting loss person's free time, sets up task requests table by setting threshold value, it is achieved that more efficient and rational autotask distribution, adds the work incentive of setting loss person, is greatly enhanced setting loss efficiency and fairness simultaneously.
