title_en: Electric automobile charging management method based on network constraint
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile charging management method based on network constraint. The method comprises the following steps: S1, establishing an optimal charging allocation plan taking furthest allocating charging flow for electric automobile as a target, including power grid safety operation constraint; S2, designing a direct charging mechanism framework taking charging behavioral preferences of electric automobile users into account; S3, introducing fairness constraint. The method takes electric automobile user behaviors and charging preferences into full account while taking basic power distribution network constraint into account, forms a novel electric automobile charging market mechanism, can guarantee the equal charging opportunity for each electric automobile user and efficient charging, and can further effectively prevent the electric automobile users from cheating during charging. The method can be applied to the formulating of multi-layered user charging plans according to aggregation demand response, and is beneficial to the enhancement of the interactive level of electric automobiles and electric systems.

title_en: Fixed frequency air-conditioner aggregation modeling and frequency modulation service method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fixed frequency air-conditioner aggregation modeling and frequency modulation service method. The method comprises the following steps that (1) a single fixed frequency air-conditioner basic model is established; (2) the on/off state of a fixed frequency air-conditioner is considered, an indoor set temperature dead zone [Tmax,Tmin] is divided into OFF subsequences and ON subsequences according to the equitime principle, the state number of the OFF subsequences is Noff, the state number of the ON subsequences is Non, and an air-conditioner group equitime state aggregation model is established; (3) an air-conditioner group aggregation control model considering external control signals and air-conditioner compressor locking time is established; and (4) a frequency modulation service is provided for the system on the basis of the air-conditioner group aggregation control model, and an air-conditioner group priority stack control strategy is put forward. The fixed frequency air-conditioner aggregation model is established so that unified scheduling and control of large-scale air-conditioner load can be realized, and the relevant departments are facilitated.

title_en: Resource unified scheduling test system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource unified scheduling test system and method. abstract_en: The present invention relates to an integrated management system and method for administration information. More specifically, the present invention relates to an integrated management system for integrally managing administration information that is distributed and processed by each administration system, and efficiently managing evaded and missed tax sources, and a method thereof. Also, the present invention includes an administration information collection part for collecting spatial information including administration information for each address and a cadastral-based cadastral map, a topical map generation part for generating a topical map by matching a lot on the cadastral map with the administration information, a target lot extraction part for extracting a target lot which requires taxation and maintenance, or is inconsistent with a usage condition, by comparing the topical map with an aerial photograph, and a taxation processing part for calculating and imposing taxation on the target lot. 또한, 본 발명은 행정 시스템들로부터 주소별로 저장된 행정 정보와 지번 코드 기반의 지적도를 포함하는 공간 정보를 수집하는 행정 정보 수집부와, 지적도 상의 필지에 행정 정보를 매칭하여 주제도를 생성하는 주제도 생성부와, 주제도와 항공사진을 중첩비교하여 사용 현황이 불일치하거나 정비가 필요한 과세 대상필지를 추출하는 대상필지 추출부 및 과세 대상필지의 과세를 산정하여 부과하는 과세 처리부를 구비하므로, 행정 시스템별로 분산 처리되고 있는 각종 행정 정보들을 수집하여 효율적으로 통합 관리할 수 있고, 탈루되거나 누락된 필지에 대한 과세 산정 및 부과를 통해 공평과세를 실현할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of task weight pricing method in mass-rent express system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of weight pricing method of the task in mass-rent express system, the selection to influence and change courier is shifted by the numerical value of the price between task, so as to optimize system overall efficiency, mainly included the following steps that：(1) data prepare and model construction；(2) price transfer is selected with goal task；(3) maximum transfer calculation of price；(4) conditional test is set up in price transfer.The present invention has advantages below compared with prior art：1) the going after profit or gain property feature of courier in mass-rent express system is directed to, by resetting valency and reduce the biasing of task choosing to mass-rent express delivery task, and then optimizes the overall efficiency of system, meanwhile, take into account and consider fairness；2) system is without extraneous expense fund, but is realized by price transfer adjustment between task；3) algorithm is simply clear and definite, it is adaptable to large-scale practical problem scene.

title_en: Multi-energy complementary micro-grid energy management method containing multiagent
abstract_en: The invention belongs to power system micro-capacitance sensor technical field, more particularly to a kind of multi-energy complementary micro-grid energy management method containing multiagent.To coordinate each decision-maker in energy internet, balance and optimization each side concerned interests, the present invention provides a kind of multi-energy complementary micro-grid energy management method containing multiagent.This method utilizes co-generation unit and heat-storing device, the response of electric demand response and heat demand and renewable energy power generation with reference to user side, consider the factors such as users'comfort, optimization cost, the cooperative game being made up of in micro-capacitance sensor each member is constructed, and income is allocated according to the contribution degree of each member using Shapley values method.The present invention is to maximize alliance's income as target, distributional equity is ensure that while maximum revenue is realized, the income of each member in alliance is effectively improved, the optimization method that a kind of cost is lower, fairness is higher is provided for the economical operation of multi-energy complementary micro-grid.

title_en: A kind of resource allocation methods based on parallel batching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of resource allocation methods based on parallel batching, step：(1) M group is set, N number of member, the number of group is N/M；(2) it is divided into several batches, the member of each batch reports the group of favorite, if this lot portion member reports identical group, the member of conflict is remained, and carries out next batch；If all members of this batch report identical group, equiprobability selects a member to add, and remaining member remains, and carries out next batch；(3) when encumbrance is equal to 0, algorithm terminates, or when being retained less than N/M, N/M member has conflict, and equiprobability selects a member to add, and loser adds a group having vacant position, and algorithm terminates when encumbrance is equal to 0；Otherwise repeat (2) (3).Policymaker's allocative efficiency is improved using technical scheme；By batch processing set of preferences, not only solves large-scale resource allocation problem, and there is good practicality and fairness.

title_en: A kind of net of trip in time about car order allocation method and system
abstract_en: The present invention relates to net about car technical field, more particularly to a kind of net of trip in time about car order allocation method and system.A kind of net of trip in time about car order allocation method, vehicle predetermined information including receiving user, screening has turned on the net about car of direct route car mode, calculate and use car distance difference, calculating destination distance difference between car destination and vehicle destination between car place and vehicular seat, vehicle selects, Order splitting.A kind of trip net about car order distribution system, including order generation module, direct route car setting module, distance difference computing module, the first net about car searching modul, the second net about car searching modul, Order splitting module in time.The invention provides a kind of compatibility timely trip net about car order allocation method and system that normally automatic order and direct route car pattern, empty wagons can obtain an equitable breakdown, and solving the problems, such as to net can not be high to order progress order of going on a journey in time, vehicle empty wagons rate when Yue Che driver itself has destination.
assignees: LESHAN YITONG TIANXIA NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Anti-ticket-swiping method, server and client
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for preventing a bill from being refreshed, a server and a client, wherein the method is applied to the server and comprises the following steps: counting according to login information of a user, and storing an account or equipment with a non-one-to-one relationship between a login account and login equipment into a sensitive library; acquiring peripheral equipment scanning information acquired by logged-in equipment according to a preset period, and matching the peripheral equipment scanning information with the account and the equipment in the sensitive library; according to the matching result, if the following account numbers or equipment exist, the account numbers or the equipment are forbidden: and the account number or the equipment is matched with the account number or the equipment in the sensitive library within the preset period of the preset number. The invention solves the problem that the distributor carries out order grabbing through multiple devices, ensures fairness and simultaneously improves customer experience.

title_en: A kind of business model of photovoltaic generation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of business model of photovoltaic generation, it is included in the company of county-level city's establishment, the company signs roof according to enterprise and village peasant household scale and uses agreement, individually project verification is put on record, power purchase agreement is signed with national grid, the at village level booster stations of investment construction, opens up income of electricity charge account, the management work such as construction O＆M, the granting of the electricity charge of the company to power station；Including being guarded to the power station of peasant household, income of electricity charge provides the cooperative society of related service sex work, and the company signs equity cooperation agreement with cooperative society；Include the peasant household for Specialty Co-operative Organization of becoming a shareholder, the peasant household provides funds to power station, the monitoring to Built hydropower station.The present invention provides a reasonable development, rational deployment, a finance model clearly business model, power helps the development in distributed roof power station, from national policy, overall situation situation, property model calculates, and corporate boss and peasant household's degree of recognition, this business model is implemented feasible, in the sharing economy epoch, win-win cooperation is realized.

title_en: Complex task distribution method based on community network
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the complex task distribution method based on community network.Community network SN of the present invention is by worker A, syntople E and weight D compositions, task requester submits a task R to platform, technical ability request and valuation including task, the worker formed in the A of community network submits possessed technical ability and corresponding cost to platform, after being collected into community network, task requester and the information of worker, platform is responsible for the running of whole assigning process as auctioneer, the main work for including two stages of winner's decision-making and pricing strategy.Instant invention overcomes community network, the cohesion of addition team and technical ability between not considering worker to contribute, and the defects of fairness.The present invention use auction technique, between consideration worker, team, technical ability etc., be a kind of distribution mechanism of anti-tactic.

title_en: A method, a system and computer programs, for electrical energy distribution in a peer-to-peer distributed energy network
abstract_en: The method comprises receiving, by an energy controller (100) located in a site remote from a plurality of nodes, from each partner node (200) that request to be part of a distribution of electrical energy within a network, a list including a predicted energy generation, storage and demand over a period of time, actual price for supplying and/or demanding energy, including prices to traverse an intermediary node, and energy losses that would be incurred in transferring energy to/from each partner node (200), including losses to traverse an intermediary node; and calculating, by the energy controller (100), the distribution of the energy using the information of said lists and a predefined function including maximizing a ratio of energy distributed to cost, allocating energy resources in a balanced manner based on needs of different partner nodes (200) or a combination of cost and equity.

title_en: A kind of logistics company equity management method and system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of logistics company equity management method and system based on block chain technology, it is related to logistics company equity administrative skill field.Including logistics company equity management platform；Logistics company equity management platform includes company information search system, enterprise's credit investigation system, block catenary system, registration unit and clearance unit；Block catenary system carries out information exchange with company information search system, enterprise's credit investigation system respectively by data transfer and memory module；Block catenary system is carried out data transmission with registration unit, clearance unit respectively by data transmission module；Logistics company equity management platform raises platform with equity crowd respectively, region exchange is connected.The present invention solves lack of standardization, inefficient in existing equity management by the effect of logistics company equity management platform；Can not effectively management company's equity establishment, distribution；Lack a kind of equity management platform that is credible, can checking in real time and lack effective means and realize the problem of merchandising at any time.
assignees: HEFEI WEITIAN YUNTONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Worker based on big data algorithm assesses labor service resource allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses the worker based on big data algorithm to assess labor service resource allocation method and system, comprises the following steps：A：The quality evaluation data of work amount are completed in collection management to several construction teams and groups daily, gather the attendance data of each worker in each construction teams and groups, and wherein quality evaluation data include a work post quality evaluation grade；B：Establish the quality evaluation of work amount and worker's attendance data statistical model；C：The rate of attendance that each work post quality evaluation grade corresponds to worker in statistical model is ranked up, rate of attendance sequence is worker's ability rating order corresponding to the work post.The present invention realizes one kind and worker's labour skill level can be tested and assessed, and can improve the fairness of evaluating result, helps enterprise to find the purpose that corresponding work post is adapted to the mode of the talent.
assignees: SICHUAN MIGRANT WORKER NETWORK TECH CO LTD;WANG CHENGRONG

title_en: System and Method for Fair Employee Scheduling
abstract_en: A method for scheduling servers within a food-serving establishment or other business environment using a point-of-sale system based on a fairness processing module. The system includes a tablet, configured to receive a food order, and a computer having a transceiver, memory, and processor. The transceiver receives information about the food order from the tablet including payment and gratuity information. The memory stores payment and gratuity information along with information related to tables statistics and server-table assignments. The computer uses the fairness processing module to provide a preliminary recommendation of a first server from a group of servers for a non-routine scheduling assignment. The fairness processing module is based on a total amount of gratuities the first server has earned during a relevant period of time as compared to a total amount of gratuities earned by other servers in the group of servers.

title_en: Fourth logistics information platform management method and system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain technology-based fourth logistics information platform management method and system, and relates to the technical field of fourth logistics information platforms. The system comprises a block chain fourth logistics information platform and a third-party logistics information platform; the block chain fourth logistics information platform carries out logistics information interaction with the third-party logistics information platform through the data transmission and storage module; and the third-party logistics information platform respectively transmits data with the shipper, each branch company and each client of each department of the enterprise through the data transmission module. The invention solves the problems that when a plurality of platform resources of a logistics company are distributed, the reasonability and fairness are difficult to guarantee, linear and planar information flow cannot be formed, the distribution efficiency is low, the management is difficult, the coordination is difficult and the data safety exists through the block chain fourth logistics information platform.

title_en: A kind of prioritization scheme and device based on the distribution of shared bicycle resource fairness
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of prioritization scheme and device based on the distribution of shared bicycle resource fairness, belongs to shared bicycle and uses field.Present invention is generally directed to user during shared bicycle use, shared bicycle resource is maliciously forcibly occupied, provides corresponding solution and clear and definite punitive measures.The wasting of resources can be effectively reduced, and it is really shared to realize shared bicycle.
assignees: ZHENGZHOU YUNHAI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rescue system using drone and method thereof
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 재난구조시스템 및 재난구조방법
abstract_en: The present invention introduces a disaster rescue system using a drone, capable of automatically sensing the occurrence of a disaster by using a sensor, performing disaster broadcasting, controlling the disaster, saving a human life, and evacuating humans by using situation information of a disaster area transmitted from the drone by flying the drone in the disaster area, and a method thereof. The disaster rescue system includes an IoT sensor node and a control unit and further includes a drone operating unit. The disaster rescue method using the drone includes a disaster accident sensing step, a drone dispatch step, a disaster broadcasting performing step, a relief material airlifting step, an accident site control step, and an evacuation guidance step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 재난의 발생을 센서를 이용하여 자동으로 감지하고, 재난 발생 지역에 드론을 띄워 드론으로부터 전송되는 재난 지역의 상황 정보를 이용한 재난방송, 재난의 통제, 인명의 구조 및 인명을 대피하도록 하는 드론을 이용한 재난구조시스템 및 재난구조방법을 개시(introduce)한다. 상기 재난구조시스템은, 사물인터넷 센서노드 및 관제부를 포함하거나, 드론운용부를 더 포함한다. 상기 드론을 이용한 재난구조방법은, 재난사고감지단계, 드론 파송단계, 재난방송 수행단계, 구호물자 공수단계, 사고현장 통제단계 및 대피유도 단계 중 적어도 하나를 수행한다.

title_en: Method, server and system for managing distribution assign for each chute
title_ko: 슈트별 물류 배정을 관리하기 위한 방법, 서버 및 시스템
abstract_en: Embodiments of the present invention provide a mechanism which matches and stores a chute according to a classification code of an article, transmits chute information assigned for assigning the chute according to the classification code of the article to a direction switching device, and stops the assignment of the article to the corresponding chute if the loading amount or volume of the article of a specific chute exceeds a preset value based on received information if the loading amount or volume information of the article for each assigned chute information is received. Accordingly, the embodiment of the present invention can equally assign the article for each delivery man through article assignment stop based on the loading amount and/or volume and can reassign the article for each chute, thereby preventing the delay of logistic (article) assignment in a logistic collection process.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 실시예들은 물품의 분류코드별로 슈트를 매칭시켜 저장하고, 저장된 정보를 이용하여, 물품의 분류코드에 따라 슈트를 배정하기 위해 배정된 슈트 정보를 방향전환장치로 전달하며, 상기 배정된 슈트 정보별로 물품 적재량 또는 체적 정보를 수신할 경우, 상기 수신된 정보를 토대로, 특정 슈트의 물품 적재량 또는 체적이 기설정된 수치를 초과할 경우 해당 슈트로의 물품 배정을 중지하는 메카니즘을 제공한다. 
이에, 본 발명의 실시예들은 적재량 또는/및 체적에 기반하여 물품 배정 중지를 통해 공평하게 배송기사별로 물품 배정이 이루어질 수 있고, 슈트별 물품 재배정이 이루어져, 물류 집하 과정에서 물류(물품) 배정이 지체되는 것을 방지할 수 있다.

title_en: A kind of ticket processing method and device
abstract_en: This application discloses a kind of ticket processing method and device, this method includes：Obtain the ticket purchasing request that terminal is sent, the identification information of booking user which carries billing information to be purchased and ask for a ticket；Based on the identification information of booking user, the credit standing for reflecting behavioural characteristic of the booking user in booking service platform is obtained；When the credit standing shows that booking user has first kind behavioural characteristic, according to the billing information, generation bill locking voucher；Bill locking voucher is returned into the terminal.The scheme of the application can realize more rational distribution bill, reduce the situation of bill waste, and be conducive to improve the fairness of bill purchase.

title_en: Optimization algorithm and system for distribution of rails
title_ko: 선로 배분 방법 및 선로 배분 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention provides a rail distribution optimized algorithm enabling fair and efficient rail use among rail users and distributing rails in consideration of safety and fairness of rail use and efficiency and suitability of rail works while satisfying rail distribution constraints based on a train operation plan and a rail work plan submitted by a rail user. The rail distribution optimized algorithm performs a basic train arrangement generating step and an optimal train arrangement generation step.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 선로사용자가 제출한 열차운행계획 및 선로작업계획을 근거로 선로배분 제약조건을 충족하는 상태에서, 선로사용자 간의 공정하고 효율적인 선로사용이 가능하도록 하며, 선로사용의 안전성과 공정성, 선로작업의 효율성 및 적정성을 고려하여 선로의 배분을 수행하는 선로배분 최적화 알고리즘을 제안한다. 상기 선로배분 최적화 알고리즘은, 기초열차배열 생성단계 및 최적열차배열 생성단계를 수행한다.

title_en: A kind of evaluation method of transit trip fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of evaluation methods of transit trip fairness, and by proposing the concept of equivalent walking time and combining some basic datas of public transport, sameization processing is carried out to different trip mode the time it takes.The present invention is plugged into equivalent walking time, road mileage, both ends, and this five quantification of targets evaluation residents of train number ratio and bus departure frequency take the fairness of transit trip on schedule for percentage of time, public transport, and data are more easy to obtain, and have higher feasibility.After calculating two-level index, the present invention is classified index with reference to actual conditions, sameization processing is carried out, and the weight of each index is determined with Delphi method, in order to intuitively calculate the fairness of a region transit trip, preferably for urban public transport service, to promote social benefit.

title_en: Work order distribution method based on internet
abstract_en: This application discloses the work order distribution methods based on internet.One specific embodiment of the method includes：The work order allocation request message that work order promoter sends is received, wherein, the work order assignment request message includes：Work order content, working region range, ability to work requirement and priority；The information of all objects is obtained, the information of the object includes：Job site, ability to work, ongoing work order, scoring；Choose object of the job site in the range of the working region of work order；Selection ability to work meets the object of the ability to work requirement of work order as candidate allocation object from the object；The work order is sent to the candidate allocation object that the quantity of ongoing work order is zero.The embodiment realizes real-time work order and preengages the distribution of work order, not only ensure that distributional equity but also had improved the completion quality of work order and complete speed, be conducive to transfer the work incentive of object and improve work efficiency.
assignees: BEIJING SAGA CLOUD TECH CO LTD

title_en: Real-time Sharing Method of Cargo Transportation Information through Cargo Information Sharing Community centered on Cloud Hub with the Enforced Dynamic Routing and State Change Adaptability
title_ko: 강화된 동적 라우팅 기능과 상태 변화 적응성을 구비한 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time sharing method of cargo transportation information through a cargo information sharing community centered on a cloud hub. More specifically, by using a cargo information sharing community centered on a cloud hub, the members of a cargo transportation system such as shippers, brokers, transportation business operators, truck drivers, and the like share cargo information in the community in real time to increase the efficiency of dispatching cargo vehicles using a location-based service and increase adaptability to a real time state change while increasing dispatch fairness. The real-time sharing method includes: a step of providing cargo information to a plurality of cargo information sharing communities through a cloud hub; a step of transmitting the logistics information to the terminals of the members belonging to the cargo information sharing communities; and a step of establishing a transportation schedule in a logistics information management server.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법에 관한 것으로서, 보다 상세하게는 클라우드 허브를 중심으로 구성되는 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 활용하여 커뮤니티 내의 화물 정보 등을 화물운송체계를 구성하는 구성원이 되는 화주, 주선사업자, 운송업자, 화물차 기사 등이 실시간으로 상호 공유하여 위치기반서비스를 이용한 화물 운송 차량의 배차 효율을 향상시키고 배차 공정성을 제고하면서 실시간으로 변화되는 상태 변화에 대한 적응성을 높이도록 하는 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법으로서 강화된 동적 라우팅 기능을 구비한 방법에 관한 것이다.

title_en: Real-time Sharing Method of Cargo Transportation Information through Cargo Information Sharing Community centered on Cloud Hub with the Enforced State Change Adaptability and Allocation Stability
title_ko: 강화된 상태 변화 적응성 및 안정성을 구비한 클라우드 허브 중심의 화물정보 공유 커뮤니티를 통한 화물 운송 정보의 실시간 공유 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a real-time freight transportation information sharing method through a freight information sharing community centered on a cloud hub and, more particularly, to a real-time freight transportation information sharing method through a freight information sharing community, capable of increasing the dispatch efficiency of freight transportation vehicles using location-based services by enabling shippers, freight forwarders, carriers, and drivers of freight vehicles, who are members constituting a freight transportation system, to mutually share the freight information or the like in real time in the sharing community centered on the cloud hub, and obtaining dispatch fairness and stability while increasing adaptability for a state which is changed in real time.

title_en: Clinical care Performance Evaluation System and method based on data mining analysis platform

title_en: Cooperative game method for cost sharing and income distribution of comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative game method for cost allocation and income allocation of an integrated energy system, which can analyze the fairness of cooperative results of all participating bodies and comprises the following steps: acquiring participation subject information in the comprehensive energy system; establishing a first alliance matrix according to the number of participating bodies; converting the first alliance matrix according to the type of the participating subject and the corresponding relation between any comprehensive energy system and the participating subject to obtain a second alliance matrix; establishing a marginal contribution column vector according to the controllable capacity of the integrated energy system participating main body; calculating the cooperation surplus according to the increased total cost and the increased total income of the integrated energy system participating in the main cooperation mode; establishing a profit model of each participating subject according to a Shapley distribution rule, the second union matrix, the marginal contribution column vector and the cooperation residue; calculating net profits according to the cost and the income of each participating subject; and finally, carrying out key parameter sensitivity analysis on the net profit.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle route distribution system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle route distribution system based on a block chain technology, which comprises an unmanned aerial vehicle company and flight routes, wherein the difficulty coefficient of the calculation puzzle is adjustable for each node aiming at the calculation puzzle of any flight route; the node solves the computational puzzle of the flight route, firstly obtains an answer, broadcasts the answer to all nodes, verifies the answer by a plurality of nodes to obtain a verified answer, generates a new block by taking identity hash of the unmanned aerial vehicle company and the flight route as transaction information, and simultaneously obtains the use right of the flight route. The freight unmanned aerial vehicle group path planning method based on the block chains realizes the decentralization of path planning by using the design mode of the block chains, simultaneously considers the principle of fairness and avoids the relative fairness and reasonableness of participants on the right of acquiring the lines.

title_en: Generating capacity distribution method and device for plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to a generating capacity distribution method and device of a station, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the evaluation score of each station according to the theoretical power prediction accuracy and the management level coefficient of the station; determining the instantaneous power generation power distributed by each station according to the evaluation score of each station; the power generation amount distributed by each station is determined according to the instantaneous power generation power distributed by each station, and the technical scheme provided by the invention fully embodies the fairness and fairness of scheduling, stimulates each station to accelerate the improvement of the power prediction accuracy and the management level, and ensures the safe and stable operation of a power grid.

title_en: Order allocation method, device, medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides an order distribution method, an order distribution device, an order distribution medium and electronic equipment, wherein the order distribution method comprises the following steps: acquiring a target order of a service person to be distributed; determining historical service personnel allocated to the historical order of the user according to the information of the user contained in the target order; and distributing the target order to the history service personnel. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can effectively avoid malicious competition among service personnel and is beneficial to ensuring the objectivity and fairness of order allocation.

title_en: Food transaction optimization matching method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a food transaction optimization matching method based on a block chain technology, which is used for solving the problems of transaction configuration dislocation caused by information asymmetry, easy malicious tampering of transaction records and the like in the traditional food transaction. The method comprises the following steps: according to the information sets of the supply and demand parties, a scheduling node in the alliance block chain runs a transaction optimization matching algorithm to select an optimized transaction combination scheme for the two transaction parties, and an online bidirectional auction mechanism is used for eliminating the competition relationship of different buyers for the same seller combination, so that the transaction efficiency is improved and the fairness is ensured; for actually achieved transaction intention, automatic transaction of both transaction parties is achieved through the intelligent contract, after the transaction is completed, the intelligent contract and transaction information are encrypted by both transaction parties and then uploaded to the scheduling node for auditing, the improved PBFT consensus algorithm is adopted, inconsistency of the transaction information is avoided through comparing the actual transaction information with a transaction combination scheme in a cache table built in the scheduling node, and effectiveness of the transaction information recorded into a block chain is guaranteed.

title_en: Accelerating data-driven scientific discovery
abstract_en: Techniques facilitating using a distribution system for incentivizing and accelerating data driven scientific research are described herein. The distribution system can track the input of various parties involved in scientific research, and when a reward, monetary or otherwise, is realized for one or more outcomes of the scientific research, the distribution system can distribute the reward among the parties that provided the input. The relative levels and contributions of the parties can be tracked to ensure that an equitable portioning of the reward is realized. A directed graph can be formed based on the transactions, wherein the nodes correspond to entities, researchers, publications, and the edges correspond to relationships between the entities. The directed graph can be analyzed to determine the relative or absolute levels of contributions from each of the entities, and the rewards can be distributed based on the contribution levels.

abstract_en: Each staff-side intelligent terminal reports an attendance card punching instruction carrying staff identity information to an attendance terminal (S10); the attendance terminal searches the scheduling date and the workplace which establish a mapping relation with the employee identity information from a preset mapping relation of the scheduling date, the employee identity information and the workplace according to the employee identity information carried by the attendance card punching instruction (S20); acquiring a current date, and judging whether the current date is within the range of the shift schedule date (S30); if the current date is within the range of the shift schedule date, issuing a current position acquisition instruction to the corresponding staff-side intelligent terminal (S40); the corresponding staff-side intelligent terminal starts a GPS positioning function according to a current position acquisition instruction issued by the attendance checking terminal to acquire a current position; reporting the current position to the attendance checking terminal in real time (S50); the attendance checking terminal matches the current position reported by the corresponding staff-side intelligent terminal with the position of the searched work place (S60); and when the position matching is successful, recording the receiving time of the corresponding attendance card punching instruction, and defining the receiving time as the attendance card punching time of the corresponding employee (S70). The method and the system ensure that the attendance checking of the staff at any position of the workplace can be realized without influencing other staff, and ensure the fairness of the attendance checking of the staff.

title_en: Meter and the electric grid operating task optimization method for changing maintenance risk and waiting time
abstract_en: The invention discloses meter and the electric grid operating task optimization methods of variation maintenance risk and waiting time, belong to electric power network field.This method realizes the optimization to electric grid operating task execution sequence to reduce the expectation of grid maintenance risk of loss and operator's waiting time cost as target according to the equipment operation task and power grid real-time traffic information obtained in automated system.The present invention considers the constraint conditions such as power grid security and manpower, materials and equipment resources, can provide conductive suggestion for the operation decision of dispatcher, help to improve operation of power networks reliability and scheduling fairness, is suitable for scheduling institutions at different levels.

title_en: Multiple target water resource equilibrium allocation method based on Conditional Lyapunov ExponentP constraint
abstract_en: The present invention relates to water resource assignment technology, it discloses a kind of multiple target water resource equilibrium allocation method based on Conditional Lyapunov ExponentP constraint, quantification fairness and the controllable water resource assignment of risk are realized.This method comprises: a. determines the objective function of multiple target water resource assignment；B. the constraint condition of multiple target water resource assignment is determined；C. according to the world model of objective function and constraint condition building multiple target water resource assignment；D. the world model of multiple target water resource assignment is optimized.The present invention establishes objective linear water resource assignment model, the water resource in basin is liberally assigned to industry, agricultural, family, ecological water by the water resource assignment strategy aid decision making person of optimization, while controlling economic loss risk.

title_en: Rescue material distribution device and distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a delivery device for rescue goods and materials, which comprises a delivery box main body consisting of two rotationally connected box bodies, it is characterized in that a placing bin for placing materials is arranged in the box body, a protective layer is arranged on the inner wall of the placing bin, the box bodies are provided with wireless communication devices for communication, and the box body locks are arranged on the sides of the two box bodies far away from the rotary connection, so that the method changes the original centralized distribution mode of substances into a distributed self-replacing or substituted distribution mode, the substance distribution time is more dispersed, disaster-stricken personnel can arrange to carefully take or replace the disaster relief material distribution box by other people according to the self time, thereby avoiding the possible situation of robbing by centralized distribution and being capable of quantitative distribution, thereby ensuring that each person can take enough substances and avoiding the phenomena of uneven distribution and waste.

title_en: Annual water quantity scheduling plan compilation method considering water use fairness and importance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for compiling an annual water quantity scheduling plan considering fairness and importance of water use, which comprises the following steps: constructing a watershed water supply benefit function evaluation index system comprehensively considering water supply social benefits, water supply economic benefits and water supply ecological benefits; generating corresponding single-factor distribution standards for each evaluation index, constructing a first objective function with the minimum difference between each single-factor distribution standard and the target optimal scheme distribution standard, and solving the first objective function to obtain the normalized water supply benefit coefficient of each water unit; determining total watershed water supply benefit according to the normalized water supply benefit coefficients of all the water using units, and constructing a second objective function with the maximum total watershed water supply benefit as a target and a third objective function with the maximum sum of the current reservoir end water levels as the target; and solving the second objective function and the third objective function to obtain a basin annual water quantity scheduling scheme. The invention constructs a watershed water supply benefit function evaluation index system and provides theoretical support for the water quantity scheduling optimization distribution problem.

title_en: A kind of new energy station is rationed the power supply period active distribution method

title_en: Water distribution balancing method and system for regional economic department
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water distribution balancing method and system for regional economic departments. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring supply and demand analysis data of each water main body; constructing a regional value objective function according to supply and demand analysis data; constructing a region water use fairness objective function according to supply and demand analysis data and a region value objective function; adopting a regional value objective function and a regional water use fairness objective function to construct a regional economic department water distribution balance optimization model; optimizing and solving a water distribution balance optimization model of a regional economic department by adopting a non-dominated sorting genetic algorithm with an elite strategy to obtain an optimal strategy; and realizing the space distribution of the water resource configuration result of the regional economic department according to the optimal strategy. The invention can optimize and coordinate the water consumption among industries, realize the water consumption balance among industries, reasonably allocate water quantity and provide important support for water management departments to reasonably arrange water consumption plans.

title_en: A method and system for monitoring accountability and fairness for an enterprises
abstract_en: An automated system & method for real time monitoring and enhancing performance for an enterprise is disclosed herein. The present invention measures the performance objectively, instead of subjective measurement. The system comprises of plurality of electronic devices (1), a remote server (3), and an interface (2) providing link between the electronic devices (1) and the remote server (3), The system of the present invention facilitates time scheduling, parameter setting, progress updation, resource planning, task initiation, survey management and feedback, leave of absence and loss of pay management for the enterprise, day planning and management for the task executor, automated recovery in case of collapse of schedule and such.

title_en: A kind of task distributing method and system

title_en: Drone for a tent with a tripod, and first aid
title_ko: 삼각대가 부착된 천막 및 구급용 드론
abstract_en: The present invention provides a drone, to solve a problem of being used only for taking pictures in the conventional art. The present invention provides the drone, comprising: three step support rods capable of adjusting length and supporting a vinyl tent to be installed; a controller having a general joystick shape to be capable of controlling the drone; an emergency kit made of a light material to hold lactated Ringer′s solution, emergency rescue articles and other necessary articles and adopting a slider manner to be attachable to and detachable from the drone; a transceiver, commercially distributed, enabling the controller to wirelessly control a drone body; and vinyl forming a tent structure when the tripod is fully unfolded to install the tent by being connected to the tripod, such that the drone generates lifting force for flight via a propeller to overcome gravity and to maintain a non-contact state from the ground for smoothly sending rescue articles to a disaster spot.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 삼각대가 부착된 천막 및 구급용 드론에 관한 것으로서 재난지역에 물자를 조달할때 헬기로 후송하면 많은 먼지와 비용이 들고 좁은 위치에 착륙하지 못하기 때문에 지지봉이 부착된 구급용 드론을 이용하여 비용절감 및 카메라를 이용하여 재난현장을 실시간으로 모니터링이 가능하고 지지봉을 길게 펼치고 부착된 비닐로 지지봉에 고정하여 천막으로 임시 보호소를 설치가 가능하고 드론에 비상용구급용품과 수액을 보충해 재난상황에서 신속하게 응급처치를 받을 수 있게하도록 함으로써 기존의 찰영용도로 밖에 쓰지 못 하는 문제점을 해소 하도록 한 것이다. 즉 본 발명은, 드론에 있어서 비닐천막을 설치 할 수 있도록 지지 할 수 있게 지지봉이 3단봉 형태로 길이를 조절 할 수 있게한 3단 지지봉, 드론을 컨트롤 할 수 있게 일반 조이트론 형태로한 컨트롤러, 수액 및 응급구조용품을 담을 수 있게 가벼운 소재로 만들어지고 응급키트에 필수적인 용품이 들어 갈 수 있고 슬라이더 형식으로 드론의 탈부탁이 가능한 탈부착이 가능한 응급키트, 드론본체와 컨트롤러의 무선 조정이 가능 할 수 있게 시중에 판매되는 송수신기한 송수신기, 삼각대에 연결하여 천막을 설치 할 수 있게 삼발이를 최대로 펼쳤을 때의 텐트구조한 비닐, 재난현장으로 구호물품을 원활히 보낼 수 있게 프로펠러를 통하여 양력을 발생시켜 중력을 극복하고 지면과의 비접촉상태를 유지함으로서 비행이 가능하도록 구성한 드론으로 구성한 것이다. 따라서, 본 발명은 재난지역에 물자를 조달할때 헬기로 후송하면 많은 먼지와 비용이 들고 좁은 위치에 착륙하지 못하기 때문에 지지봉이 부착된 구급용 드론을 이용하여 비용절감 및 카메라를 이용하여 재난현장을 실시간으로 모니터링이 가능하고 지지봉을 길게 펼치고 부착된 비닐로 지지봉에 고정하여 천막으로 임시 보호소를 설치가 가능하고 드론에 비상용구급용품과 수액을 보충해 재난상황에서 신속하게 응급처치를 받을 수 있게하도록 함으로써 기존의 찰영용도로 밖에 쓰지 못 하는 문제점을 해소하도록 한 효과를 갖는 것이다.

title_en: Enforcing compute equity models in distributed blockchain
abstract_en: An example operation may include one or more of identifying a blockchain transaction submitted from a requestor member of the blockchain, identifying one or more task requests associated with the blockchain transaction, determining one or more blockchain members having resources available for completing the one or more task requests, wherein the resources are identified via known computing parameters associated with each of the one or more blockchain members, and assigning the one or more task requests to the one or more blockchain members based on the resources available.

title_en: A kind of water pollution load Equity Assessment and distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of water pollution load Equity Assessment and distribution method, include the following steps: to evaluate the blowdown status fairness of survey region using single-factor environment Gini Coefficient analysis；Total amount of pollutant reduction target and pollutant original allocation scheme are formulated according to evaluation result；It realizes that environment Gini coefficient minimizes based on Information Entropy, determines pollutant optimal distributing scheme.The present invention establishes a set of completely new totalizing method system, on the one hand it avoids and only economically considers that cost minimization causes the unfairness of distribution, on the other hand Environmental Equity theory is applied to conscientiously in pollutant distribution, fair allocat scheme is determined after the many-sided objective factor of comprehensive consideration, and the fair combination with efficiency is realized in water pollutant totalizing method.

title_en: Collaborative cost task allocation method and system based on concept lattice in social network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a concept lattice-based collaborative cost task allocation method and a concept lattice-based collaborative cost task allocation system in a social network. The method comprises the steps of modeling a social network, tasks in the social network, participants in the social network and skills possessed by the participants to obtain a task distribution system model; the small groups in the social network are obtained through formal concept analysis, participants meeting skill requirements of the small groups are recruited for the tasks based on internal strong contact attributes of the small groups, strong contact teams enough for completing the tasks are obtained quickly, and the completion efficiency of the collaborative tasks is improved. By utilizing the close connection characteristic among the members of the small groups in the social network, namely, any member can represent the whole small group, and the experts are selected from different small groups to construct a weak connection group, so that the groups are constructed in an all-round and multi-level manner, and the fairness of competitive tasks is ensured. Compared with the existing task allocation algorithm, the method provided by the invention has remarkable improvement on the performances such as cooperation cost, team scale, running time and the like.

title_en: Comprehensive distribution method for local emergency mass storage materials
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive distribution method of belonged emergency mass storage materials. The method comprises the following steps: after a disaster occurs and before rear rescue goods and materials do not arrive, a target function is established based on the shortest emergency time, and a first-stage centralized many-storage-point emergency goods and materials distribution operation is carried out by utilizing a property-first-stage centralized many-storage goods and materials distribution model; collecting the emergency materials and the transport tools of all the dispersed mass storage points to the concentrated mass storage points, combining the remaining emergency materials and transport tools after the first-stage concentrated mass storage point distribution, constructing a target function based on mass storage material distribution fairness and loss minimum, and performing distribution operation of the second-stage dispersed mass storage point emergency materials by using a local two-stage dispersed mass storage material distribution model. According to the method, various practical constraints are considered, the comprehensive distribution model of the local emergency mass storage resources is constructed, a scientific and reasonable distribution scheme is generated, the rapidness and the accuracy of the comprehensive distribution of the local emergency mass storage resources are ensured, and the emergency rescue effect is improved.

title_en: It is a kind of meter and various energy resources monthly power trade plan time stimulatiom method
abstract_en: It is a kind of meter and various energy resources monthly power trade plan time stimulatiom method, belong to the monthly power trade plan technical field of electric system, step are as follows: first according to monthly power trade plan actual demand, establish monthly power trade plan modeling strategy: proposing the modeling method of monthly power trade plan and constructs the model structure of monthly power trade plan.Secondly, according to the monthly power trade plan modeling strategy of foundation, model each section is modeled: plan moon model cost function part, plan moon model constraint condition part, subsequent moon model cost function part, subsequent moon model constraint condition part and annual generated energy fairness constraints part；Finally, solving to model optimization, final monthly power trade plan is obtained.Time stimulatiom method is introduced into monthly power trade plan by the present invention, and is modeled stage by stage the moon and the subsequent moon according to plan, and the monthly power trade planning model that can ensure feasibility and fairness is finally obtained.

title_en: Engineering project performance appraisal method and system
abstract_en: The present invention provides a kind of engineering project performance appraisal method and system.This method comprises: obtaining the examination node of current project, corresponding schedule parameter is obtained according to examination node；Project process score is calculated according to schedule parameter；Project cruising score is calculated according to the quality cruising result of project；Project is obtained according to examination node to apply for checking and examination parameter, is calculated project according to project parameter of applying for checking and examination and is applied for checking and examination integrity degree score；According to project process score, project cruising score and project apply for checking and examination integrity degree score carry out respectively project leader's performance float calculate and quality supervisor's performance float calculate, to obtain the performance appraisal result of current project.The present invention is by based on applying for checking and examination the calculating of integrity degree score to project process score, project cruising score and project, so as to carry out performance appraisal to project leader and quality supervisor automatically, it is therefore prevented that the problem using fairness and accuracy difference caused by manually marking assessment.
assignees: ZHANGZHOU HEYONG SOFTWARE DEV CO LTD

title_en: Data acquisition optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium of multi-parameter monitoring device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data acquisition optimization method, a data acquisition optimization device, data acquisition optimization equipment and a storage medium of a multi-parameter monitoring device, and belongs to the field of online monitoring of power transmission lines. The invention provides a calculation method for simultaneously ensuring the service life requirement of the monitoring device and the maximum interval requirement of data acquisition for the minimum battery capacity from the aspect of probability statistical distribution, and the calculation method has low complexity and strong practicability in the engineering field; a data acquisition interval optimization strategy is provided for the actual battery capacity, so that the real-time performance of data monitoring is further guaranteed, and time slot conflicts of different parameter acquisition can be reduced; in order to deal with the monitoring of abnormal parameters, the invention also provides a time slot allocation strategy of the processor, which respectively carries out different processing aiming at the conventional conditions and the abnormal data conditions, ensures the continuous tracking feedback of the abnormal parameters, and simultaneously provides a sensor priority setting method which gives consideration to fairness and improves the instantaneity of abnormal data monitoring, thereby being easy to be applied in engineering.

title_en: Equity recommended method, device and equipment
abstract_en: This specification provides a kind of equity recommended method, device and equipment, the described method includes: the amount range to equity has divided multiple sections, the input of recommended models includes each section of all kinds of equity, estimates the rate of checking and writing off so as to obtain user for each section of every class equity.And, income and cost of the present embodiment in view of each section of each equity, under conditions of with cost constraint, with user gather in the provisional profit maximum of all users turn to optimization problem, cost control coefficient is solved using Optimization Solution algorithm, final recommendation decision is carried out based on cost control coefficient, the optimization aim of the present embodiment is to maximize whole promotion effect, solves the problems, such as the cost constraint of different equity.

title_en: A kind of medical aid point site selecting method considering disaster-stricken demand urgency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a kind of medical aid point site selecting methods for considering disaster-stricken demand urgency, actually devastated nearby has several alternative rescue points, the present invention has comprehensively considered rescue point resource finiteness, disaster-stricken demand urgency, rescue efficiency high efficiency and medical material fairness in distribution, several rescue points are selected from alternative rescue point, to help to carry out the rescue after calamity.The present invention selectes injury to personnel degree, damage of building degree, the road extent of damage, index of disaster prepareaness capability and disaster derivation possibility as demand urgency evaluation index by the way of Empirical rules, and each index weight shared in demand urgency has been determined with analytic hierarchy process (AHP).An optimal site selection model is constructed by transporting to minimize total time the maximization of the sum of each disaster-stricken satisfactory rate of information demand, medical material, and centainly has goods and materials output, goods and materials aggregate supply to be less than aggregate demand etc. with the alternative rescue point chosen and uses restraint to objective function.

title_en: Resource allocation method based on mMTC service classification
abstract_en: The invention provides a resource allocation method based on mMTC service classification, which comprises the following steps: initializing variables; reordering the MTCG set according to the MTC service classification table; performing priority processing on each emergency alert service type MTCG until the residual data volume of all the emergency alert type MTCGs is less than or equal to 0; then processing other service MTCGs until the residual data volume of the other service MTCGs is less than or equal to 0; according to the occupancy matrix O N×K The MTCG total sum rate is obtained. The method comprehensively considers the characteristics of different service types in actual life, thereby establishing the priority of different services, optimizing the sum rate of MTCG, ensuring the communication quality of LTE users and the emergency alarm type MTCG, ensuring the service quality of the emergency alarm type service with the highest priority while ensuring the capacity of the MTCG system, improving the effectiveness and reliability of a communication system and synchronously improving the fairness and effectiveness of the network.

title_en: Device, method and storage medium for predicting scoring of question-answer content
abstract_en: The application relates to a big data technology, and discloses a device, a method and a storage medium for predicting scoring of question-answer content, wherein the method comprises the following steps: collecting the question-answer content of the history of the pen test link and the actual score corresponding to each question-answer content; constructing a word segmentation library, a corpus, a word frequency inverse text frequency index model and an implicit dirichlet allocation model based on the question-answer content, and storing the word frequency inverse text frequency index model and the implicit dirichlet allocation model in a database; the word segmentation library, the corpus, the word frequency inverse text frequency index model and the implicit dirichlet allocation model are imported into the database, after word segmentation and word segmentation statistics are carried out, the word frequency is input into the word frequency inverse text frequency index model and the implicit dirichlet allocation model, and a queue with the highest probability of outputting the question-answer content which belongs to the same history of a theme as the question-answer content to be scored is obtained; and calculating the predictive score of the question-answer content to be scored based on the actual score corresponding to the queue with the highest probability. The application can ensure the objective fairness of scoring.

title_en: Authorization for auction-competition for orders all-win control method, electric terminal and medium
abstract_en: The present invention provides all-win control method, electric terminal and the medium of a kind of authorization for auction-competition for orders, applied to a logistics platform, the described method includes: according to reverse auction mechanism supplier success competition for orders after or according to positive auction mechanism demander success competition for orders after, platform freezes the auction target volume M1 that demander provides, after the confirmation order taking responsibility for receiving demander or the transmission of demander affiliated party completes information, the psychological M2 that offers of supplier is paid from the auction target volume that demander pays；Obtain the auction target volume of demander's payment and the psychology quotation of supplier, the two profit difference d is obtained according to the psychology quotation of the auction target volume of demander's payment and supplier, and the profit difference is assigned to by the demander, the supplier and the platform according to the default method of salary distribution.In the present invention, by the way that commission platform is reversed or positive auction and client's competition for orders realize the sharing of profits of supplier, demander and platform to reach the all-win that market and competitive mechanisms are combined with social equity benefit.
assignees: SHANGHAI RUNTING ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: A kind of agricultural product whole-round supply chain logistics platform and allocator
abstract_en: The invention belongs to agricultural product logistics technical fields, a kind of agricultural product whole-round supply chain logistics platform and allocator are disclosed, the agricultural product whole-round supply chain logistics platform includes: temperature collecting module, humidity collection module, station acquisition module, main control module, lower single module, distribution route planning module, Logistic Scheduling module, sorting module, time prediction module, payment module, display module.The present invention obtains the location information of vehicle and cargo by Logistic Scheduling module in real time, vehicle quantity and vehicle list out are determined according to vehicle and goods matching scheme, worksheet processing is carried out according to worksheet processing rule, carry out logistics on-line scheduling, online, the Auto-matching of realization task and vehicle, thus the fairness of high overall operation efficiency and vehicle scheduling；Meanwhile sub-material is carried out by information to order cargo by sorting module, it is sorted, is improved work efficiency by sub-material label, reduce error rate；Different zones are set, goods in bad order is prevented, improve cargo security.

title_en: Scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling method and a scheduling device, and relates to the technical field of computers. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: selecting an object with the smallest virtual driving accumulation value in the selectable queue for operation, and moving the object to the non-selectable queue; and updating the virtual driving accumulated value and moving the virtual driving accumulated value to an optional queue after the object operation is completed. The method and the device can solve the problems that the existing scheduling mode lacks of intelligence and fairness and brings dangerous driving side effects for a long time.

title_en: Cross-region water resource allocation method based on two-stage asymmetric Nash-master-slave game model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-region water resource allocation method based on a two-stage asymmetric Nash-master-slave game model, which comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information data of water resource distribution; constructing a model of the upper leader; providing an improved lower-layer follower conservative income calculation method based on a yield-breaking theory principle; providing a comprehensive negotiation weight determination method comprehensively considering fairness and high efficiency principles; an asymmetric Nash-Haishani negotiation model for the lower tier followers was constructed. The cross-regional water resource allocation method based on the two-stage asymmetric Nash-master-slave game model, which considers the priority among participants and the direct and indirect interaction, can provide a reasonable and feasible water resource allocation result, the improved participant conservative income calculation method based on the bankruptcy theory principle can guarantee the basic water demand requirement of the lower-layer followers, and the proposed negotiation weight balances the economic and social development level among the lower-layer followers.

title_en: Emergency management and rescue platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses emergency management and rescue platforms, comprising: monitoring system, for acquiring the information in monitored environmental area；Communication system, for sending and receiving the information of monitoring system acquisition；Command system receives the information that communication system is sent, is handled, and send order command；Article dispatches system, receives the order command that command system is sent, and relief supplies are transported to the environmental area of monitoring；Rescue system receives the order command that command system is sent, and is rescued.The present invention can greatly reduce the casualties and reduction property loss when disaster and accident generation, improve rescue efficiency when disaster and accident occur.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN SCIENCE & TECH;TIANJIN DUOZHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mutual-help project expense settlement system, method and device
abstract_en: The application provides a system, a method and a device for settling the expense of mutual-aid projects, wherein the system comprises the following components: the rights and interests grading subsystem is configured to determine the correspondence between rights and interests grading and normal distribution intervals; the fee junction subsystem includes: a risk equity calculation module configured to calculate a risk equity value from the participation period of the item member and the risk occurrence of the item member; the normal distribution conversion module is configured to perform normal distribution conversion on the risk equity value; the rights and interests grading retrieval module is configured to retrieve rights and interests grading corresponding to normal distribution intervals in which the normal distribution rights and interests values are located in the corresponding relation between the rights and interests grading and the normal distribution intervals; and the fee settlement module is configured to carry out fee settlement on the project members according to the searched fee payment amount classified by the rights and interests. The system sets more reasonable and fair payment amounts aiming at project members with different risk rights and interests, guarantees the interests of the project members, and improves the mutual project participation experience of the project members.

title_en: More scientific workflows based on cloud environment concurrently execute dispatching method
abstract_en: More scientific workflows based on cloud environment concurrently execute dispatching method.So-called Multi-workflow, which concurrently executes, refers to that multiple workflows are performed simultaneously, and the task in each workflow is interspersed to be executed.List workflow execution scheduling research at present is more, has ignored the waiting time of server, not only causes the waste of resource, and increases the waiting time of follow-up work stream.The method of the present invention includes the following steps: that reduction scheduling length achievees the effect that shorten task completion time firstly, passing through the calculative strategy of task order.Then, in order to guarantee to dispatch the fairness in implementation procedure, the strategy of building task pool is proposed；Secondly, the task in task pool is according to priority passed through resource selection strategy, reduce task completion time, improves the utilization rate of resource；Finally, reaching reduces the target for executing energy consumption to there are the resources of free time section to carry out voltage adjustment in such a way that dynamic voltage frequency adjusts.The present invention concurrently executes scheduling for more scientific workflows based on cloud environment.

title_en: A kind of negotiation of equitable efficiency equilibrium and negotiate suggesting system for wearing and method
abstract_en: The present invention is claimed a kind of negotiation of equitable efficiency equilibrium and negotiates suggesting system for wearing and method; it solves in more subjects under discussion negotiation more than two sides and the thousands of possible schemes in negotiation space; seek by participating in the customized equitable efficiency equilibrium solution of each side, as negotiation scheme or suggestion of resolving through consultation；Also creatively solve the problems, such as that baseline exaggerates control problem, rigid boundary condition, the fair convergence problem with efficiency optimization solution in method simultaneously；It is that negotiating decision is supported, negotiates preparation, analysis, and a kind of intelligent method of training；Its technical solution are as follows: determine limited number of going back on one's word first, data are collected by negotiation template, it executes baseline and exaggerates controlling mechanism, News Search is executed in effective baseline collection basis that system is accepted, be pushed forward with equality or equality retreat step equitable efficiency convergence process, limited bout is gone back on one's word revision or iterative calculation again, is repeated above step, is obtained the proposed projects with equitable efficiency equilibrium characteristic.

title_en: Omni-channel multi-level demand prioritization and allocation
abstract_en: A system and method are multi-level replenishment planning with independent channel demand prioritization that initiates production of a product by a first supply chain entity that receives orders for the product from a second supply chain entity and supplies the product to a third supply chain entity that receives orders for the product from a fourth supply chain entity. Embodiments further disclose calculating the supply of the product for the first supply chain entity for a supply allocation duration time period, receiving demand orders high priority demand orders from the fourth supply chain entity, allocating supplies within the supply allocation duration time period to firm plan arrivals based on a location priority and a demand date, and generating a shipment recommendation for each allocated supply that meets a firmed planned arrival.

title_en: A kind of commodity panic buying request distribution method
abstract_en: Commodity panic buying request distribution method disclosed by the invention, it is related to technical field of electronic commerce, pass through the SKU according to commodity, by commodity stocks be split as multiple commodity singletons and by multiple commodity it is single-row respectively in the form of key-value store, the quantity of server is obtained from redis database, the stockpile number of each commodity singleton, calculate the commodity panic buying number of requests of each server process, number of requests is rushed to purchase according to commodity and server responds thread weight, server is redistributed for commodity panic buying request, the case where avoiding oversold and tie-in sale, it ensure that the fairness of commodity panic buying, the user experience is improved.
assignees: BEIJING SHOUQI ZHIXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Watershed water environment capacity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a watershed water environment capacity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of water environment monitoring. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a watershed to be distributed, which needs to perform water environment capacity distribution; acquiring each control unit related to the watershed to be distributed and river reach corresponding to each control unit one by one; acquiring the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged by each river reach; determining the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach based on the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged by each river reach; and correcting the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach. In the embodiment of the application, the control units in the distribution domain are divided, the catchment range of each control unit is determined, then the maximum water environment capacity allowed to be discharged of each river reach is obtained, and then the water environment capacity allowed by the control unit corresponding to each river reach is determined and corrected, so that the objectivity and fairness of the distribution result are guaranteed.

title_en: Distributed power transaction contract consensus method based on energy block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed power transaction contract consensus method based on an energy block chain, which specifically comprises the following steps: constructing a alliance energy block chain; and designating a master node; formulating a distributed power transaction intelligent contract; formulating constraint conditions of distributed power transaction intelligent contract consensus, and determining effective power contract transaction; the block consensus is completed in five stages of request, preparation, submission and response of the effective power contract transaction, and the block consensus is recorded in a block chain; executing the distributed power transaction smart contract. The invention can realize the optimal allocation of energy resources and the efficient and reasonable utilization of the resources on the basis of ensuring fairness, safety and reliability of transactions.

title_en: A kind of right of drainage configuration method based on double plating layer
abstract_en: The right of drainage configuration method based on double plating layer that the invention discloses a kind of, efficiency principle is taken into account on the basis of considering regional economy development degree, the fairness doctrine of history displacement including (1), constructs and double plating layer is configured based on fair and efficiency right of drainage；(2) right of drainage allocation models is solved with the leader follower strategy interactive mode iterative algorithm based on satisfaction, right of drainage configuration is carried out according to solving result.The present invention is on the basis of considering influence that the factors such as social environment, economic environment, ecological environment and dewatering needs, drainage efficiency distribute right of drainage, it constructs fair weigh with area sewerage under Efficiency Perspective and configures double plating layer, realization basin comprehensive benefit is maximized and optimized, it reduces flood, promote each department balanced development, the distribution for carrying out area sewerage power is of great significance.

title_en: Micro-capacitance sensor group energy amount game dispatching method based on multi-agent system
abstract_en: Micro-capacitance sensor group energy amount game dispatching method based on multi-agent system, the following steps are included: step 1, establish the more proxy topologies of microgrid group, complete the modules agencyization to each subnet, dealing Proxy aggregates device SAA and BAA is set up on subnet upper layer, completes negotiation communication process by central processing unit EMO；Step 2, new microgrid energy pricing mechanism is used based on buyer MG, proposes that priority factors to the leading role of process of exchange, are found out based on best trading strategies in buyer's MG process of exchange；Step 3, new scheduling mechanism is introduced, central processing unit EMO is after receiving all buyer MG about the strategy of energy requirement, according to the superfluous energy demand of buyer MG and priority factors, by an appropriate number of energy EA i Distribute to single buyer MG；Shared weight is determined according to self-energy total surplus amount, and the strategy of buyer MG submission is verified using Energy distribution algorithm, reduces the burden of mass communication expense, improves energy is dispatched between each subnet in microgrid group fairness and stability.

title_en: Method is influenced based on the newly-increased high-speed rail hinge accessibility for improving two moved further search methods
