The invention designs a daily electric quantity decomposition method based on a standard load curve by considering the fairness of electric quantity decomposition and different power supply characteristics; on the basis of the decomposition curve, an optimization model for planning decomposition electric quantity completion degree relative deviation maximum value minimum is provided, and a practical solving method for coupling limit area checking and electric quantity correction strategies is constructed so as to quickly determine a daily power generation plan of the power station. Verification is carried out by taking the formulation of the daily power generation plan of the Yunnan power grid as an example, and the example result shows that: the method can effectively reduce the execution deviation of the trading plan and quickly obtain the daily operation plan of the large-scale power station meeting the complex hydraulic and electric power dispatching operation constraint.
assignees: KUNMING ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD;UNIV DALIAN TECH

title_en: Automatic case distribution system and method, storage medium and computing device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a case automatic allocation system and method, a storage medium and a computing device, wherein the system respectively receives an auditing request of a case to be audited through a receiving module and acquires case attribute information of the case to be audited; then, a queue selection module selects a target case queue from a plurality of project case queues based on the case attribute information, and the case to be audited is added to the target case queue; and finally, acquiring a first target auditor matched with the target case queue through an allocation module, and allocating the case to be audited to the first target auditor for auditing. Based on the case automatic system provided by the invention, when the audit request is received, the auditor matched with the audit request is selected to automatically dispatch the case, so that the case distribution time is saved. Moreover, the fairness of case distribution is ensured by combining the auditing role of auditors, the distributed case quantity, the online state and the like in the case distribution process.
assignees: BEIJING JIANKANG ZHIJIA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Case allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a case distribution method, which comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of case labels of a plurality of cases; acquiring a plurality of personnel tags corresponding to a plurality of processing personnel, and determining the distribution priority of each processing personnel according to the plurality of personnel tags corresponding to the plurality of processing personnel; determining target processing personnel correspondingly matched with the plurality of cases from the plurality of processing personnel according to case priorities corresponding to the plurality of cases and distribution priorities of the plurality of processing personnel, and distributing the plurality of cases to the corresponding target processing personnel. The invention generates the matching degree of the cases and the treating personnel through the case priority of the cases and the distribution priority of the treating personnel, ensures the fairness of case distribution and the timeliness of treatment, and improves the efficiency of case distribution. The invention can be applied to the field of medical claims, and is distributed to corresponding processing personnel according to the case priority of medical claims, so that the claim settlement efficiency of medical claims is improved, and the customer satisfaction is improved.
assignees: PING AN PENSION INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Investment and financing docking and equity value evaluation system for regional equity market
abstract_en: A investment and financing docking and equity value evaluation system for a regional equity market belongs to the technical field of enterprise valuation. The enterprise value evaluation system comprises a basic information management unit, an enterprise value evaluation unit, a value evaluation information output unit and a subsequent service unit, wherein an enterprise is in butt joint with the basic information management unit, the data output end of a data unit is connected with the input end of the enterprise value evaluation unit, the enterprise value is evaluated by using the enterprise value evaluation unit, the enterprise value evaluation unit outputs an enterprise value evaluation result, and the subsequent service unit is connected with the output end of the value evaluation information output unit; the subsequent service unit is simultaneously connected with the basic information management unit and the enterprise. The value of small and medium enterprises is evaluated through the investment and financing butt joint and the equity value evaluation system of the equity market in the region, the subsequent service of the enterprises is realized, and evaluation and valuation results are fed back to machine learning after the subsequent service, so that the model is continuously optimized, and valuation and service are more accurate.
assignees: QILU EQUITY EXCHANGE CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Ant colony algorithm-based emergency medical material distribution optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to an ant colony algorithm-based emergency medical material distribution optimization method based on an area-group concept, k-means clustering, an ant colony algorithm, a fair algorithm and a binary expression mode. Firstly, classifying by adopting k-means clustering according to coordinates of distribution points; secondly, further classifying the load capacity of the distribution vehicle by utilizing binary full traversal; then, determining a group distribution path by adopting an ant colony algorithm; the calculation amount is reduced by sequentially returning and judging the satisfied condition and setting the parameter; and finally, giving out a specific distribution scheme by adopting a fairness algorithm according to the emergency. The whole steps are simple and clear, and the method has great application value in the field of emergency medical logistics distribution.

title_en: Data evacuation method and system suitable for cloud data center network
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a data evacuation method and system suitable for a cloud data center network, including: dividing time slots according to disaster diffusion characteristics, and switching the time slots according to state changes of the data center; optimizing in two stages in each time slot, selecting a safety data center and performing bandwidth time-varying scheduling on a plurality of parallel sparse streams to obtain a data evacuation scheme; when the safety data center selects, the sum of the products of the routing hop count of all evacuation tasks and evacuation data is minimized as a target; the bandwidth time-varying scheduling of multiple parallel sparse streams aims at maximizing the sum of the bandwidth allocated to all the sparse tasks. Factors such as routing hop number, evacuation data volume and the like are considered in the selection stage of the safety data center, so that the time delay of data evacuation can be better reduced; the sign-based sparse route time-varying searching method is utilized to improve the fairness of bandwidth allocation and can better support bandwidth allocation with personalized proportion.

title_en: New wholesale mode and rural fresh electricity merchant platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic commerce, in particular to a new wholesale mode and a rural fresh electric commerce platform, wherein the platform comprises: the transaction module consists of a supply issuing system and a demand issuing system; the order module is used for matching supply and demand data in the supply and distribution system and the demand distribution system and generating order data; and the logistics module is used for generating a distribution task list according to the order data. The invention provides a new wholesale mode which is the assistance of poverty-deprivation, attack and stiffness, serves vast farmers, perfects a new retail process through the new wholesale mode and finally realizes real new retail in the whole society.

title_en: Cooperative game theory-based intelligent community household electricity consumption cooperative income allocation method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of cost allocation, and particularly relates to a method for allocating household power consumption cooperative income of an intelligent community based on cooperative game theory, which comprises the following steps: establishing an intelligent community family cooperative electricity utilization optimization model, and quantifying the income of each family electricity utilization cooperation; the method comprises the following steps of adopting a proportion allocation method and a method based on a cooperative game theory to allocate the income of each household power utilization cooperation; and comparing and analyzing the apportionment results obtained by the proportion apportionment method and the method based on the cooperative game theory to determine the applicable scene of each method. The method realizes the quantification of the distributed power generation resource benefits brought by the cooperation of all household electricity, obtains the applicability of the cooperation game method in the intelligent community cooperation electricity utilization environment according to the characteristic difference of the method, realizes the fair allocation of the income brought by all household cooperation electricity utilization according to different fairness definitions, stimulates the household users to participate in the cooperation electricity utilization, and promotes the high-efficiency utilization of the electricity utilization resources in the community and the improvement of the electricity utilization benefits of the household users.

title_en: Computer implemented blockchain-based system for agricultural products
abstract_en: This specification discloses a platform built on blockchain that is designed to help increase traceability, efficiency and fairness in agricultural supply chains, such as the coffee, cocoa, tea, sugar, grains and fruit supply chains. The platform includes a Self-Sovereign Identity solution, a new form of digital identity built on distributed ledger technology. Farmers, wholesalers, traders and retailers can interact more efficiently using comprehensive, near real-time access to this data, and consumers can have new insights about the origins of the products they consume. The platform includes a consumer-facing application that pulls information directly from the blockchain and connects the final consumer, e.g. a coffee drinker, to farmers, traders, roasters and brands. The information is presented on an interactive map, allowing each product to tell a story in a simple and scalable way. The app also presents sustainability projects in coffee communities and an opportunity for consumers to directly support them. Consumers now can play an active role in sustainability governance by directly supporting coffee farmers in developing nations.

title_en: Prior investment type performer support system
abstract_en: To provide a prior investment type performer support system which enables prior investment targeting at obtaining continuous dividends at a later date regarding a performance presented by a performer, and in which revenues are continuously distributed also to the performer.SOLUTION: A prior investment type performer support system 100 constituted communicably with viewer terminals 302 includes: an investment receiving section 12 for receiving purchase applications for dividend rights regarding revenues that are disclosed in a mode where a performance distributed ad hoc generates revenues later; and a dividend determining section 15 for determining dividends for purchasers of the dividend rights, from the revenues. The dividend determining section 15 determines a dividend on the basis of an equity rate of the dividend rights of each purchaser, in the case that a plurality of purchasers of the dividend rights exist. The equity rate of the dividend rights is determined according to a purchase counter price of the dividend rights.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Systems and methods for managing physical assets across territorial boundaries
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for the transfer of legal control of a physical asset when the physical asset is transported across a territorial boundary. Such systems and methods facilitate the transfer of assets within a network between network participants associated with and having control over territories when an asset crosses a territorial boundary. Such a transfer allows for efficient and equitable distribution of costs, revenues, and other elements associated with movable assets among network participants in a region of control.

title_en: Power distribution network difference characteristic diagnosis and analysis method based on power enterprise big data technology
abstract_en: The application discloses a power distribution network difference characteristic diagnosis and analysis method based on a big data technology of an electric power enterprise, a big data platform is used as a data source, so that the data acquisition source range is larger, the analysis angle is more comprehensive, meanwhile, a diagnosis index set is established by preset key index information extracted from the data source, so that the diagnosis index information is quantitatively determined, seed samples are obtained according to pre-acquired development state information of a plurality of target electric power enterprises, the seed samples are compared with the quantitative diagnosis index set, so that difference characteristics of the electric power enterprises in development construction are accurately obtained, the problem of insufficient fairness of difference diagnosis and analysis conclusions of the power distribution network is solved, the development direction of the electric power enterprises is guided in the development process, and the difference characteristics of different types of power distribution networks can be found.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Power grid investment allocation decision method and system based on comprehensive evaluation of power distribution network
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power grid investment allocation decision method and a system based on comprehensive evaluation of a power distribution network, which comprises the following steps of: s1, constructing a county power distribution network comprehensive evaluation system, determining evaluation indexes, calculating the weights of the indexes, and calculating the scores of the evaluation indexes; s2, constructing a power grid investment distribution model for investment distribution; the method specifically comprises the steps of S2, under the premise that county scale, load increase, power supply capacity, economic benefits and social benefits of investment are considered, establishing a systematic power distribution network investment allocation decision model, distributing total capital of power distribution network construction and reconstruction to each county, and finally optimizing the generated power distribution network investment decision model by taking risk factors and allocation fairness as optimization targets to obtain an optimal decision model. According to the method, the investment area is evaluated, and the capital constraint condition is introduced through the optional factors of the comprehensive power grid construction level, so that the optimal combination of power grid investment projects is obtained, and decision support is provided for the investment capital allocation of the power distribution network construction.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Power wireless private network resource allocation method based on service priority
abstract_en: A wireless private network resource allocation method of electric power based on business priority, the said method is according to the business priority of the electric power user, minimum requirement of user rate, fairness criterion and QoS demand at first, regard total utility of the coexistence system of maximization as the objective function and construct the optimization and assign the model; and solving an optimal solution to an inequality constraint problem of the optimal distribution model by using an improved Lagrange multiplier method considering a KKT condition to obtain an optimal distribution scheme of an authorized frequency band and an unauthorized frequency band, so that the power users with all priorities select the optimal carrier frequency band and resource units for information transmission on the premise of meeting the requirements of speed, bandwidth, throughput and time delay. The invention aggregates the authorized frequency band and the unauthorized frequency band, provides broadband wireless access service by utilizing the idle frequency band, optimizes the carrier aggregation system through the resource allocation algorithm, ensures that the limited frequency spectrum resources can meet the requirement of power emergency communication, and provides powerful information transmission support for the emergency communication of power production.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION COMPANY;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban rail transit passenger flow control optimization method based on arrival proportion
abstract_en: The invention provides an urban rail transit passenger flow control optimization method based on an arrival proportion. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring urban rail transit network data, and designing a parallel straight line train schedule according to the minimum departure interval of the train; according to the parallel straight line train schedule and urban rail transit network data, a passenger flow control strategy optimization model based on the incoming proportion is established based on set constraint conditions and an objective function; and solving the passenger flow control strategy optimization model based on the arrival proportion by adopting an approximate dynamic programming algorithm based on heuristic decomposition to obtain the arrival quantity of each train at each station under the optimal passenger flow control strategy. From the aspect of passenger arrival fairness, the urban rail transit station arrival flow optimization method under the condition of equal proportion arrival is provided, and the passenger flow fine management and control under the condition of early and late peak crowding is realized.

title_en: Scheduling method, system, medium and electronic device for keeping long-term fairness
abstract_en: The present disclosure provides a scheduling method, system, medium and electronic device for maintaining long-term fairness, the method comprising the steps of: acquiring the number information of the shifts of all employees in a preset time period; obtaining the accumulated deviation of the number of any employee for a certain shift and the total employee for the shift number according to the obtained shift number information; adding the sum of the accumulated deviation of each employee and the target shift value serving as the compensated target shift value into a constraint for describing the number of the employee shifts, and obtaining an optimal shift result according to a preset shift model; according to the scheduling optimization method, the accumulated workload of the staff is used as the offset and is included in the scheduling optimization model, and long-term scheduling fairness optimization is achieved through the optimization function.

title_en: Power generation scheduling evaluation method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a power generation scheduling evaluation method, a device and equipment, belonging to the technical field of power scheduling.A maximum power generation capacity of a target power generation enterprise in a target power grid is calculated based on a preset rule; determining the power generation margin of a target power generation enterprise according to the maximum power generation capacity and the power generation scheduling scheme; calculating expected risks of a target power generation enterprise based on a distribution structure of power generation margins; acquiring an expected risk Lorentz curve according to the expected risk; and obtaining an expected risk Gini coefficient based on the expected risk Lorentz curve, evaluating power generation dispatching and obtaining a power generation dispatching evaluation result. Compared with the traditional result-oriented power generation scheduling fairness evaluation method, the power generation scheduling fairness evaluation method based on the expected execution risk provided by the invention essentially belongs to a process evaluation method, can evaluate fairness in a power generation scheduling service execution process more accurately, and is more beneficial to service promotion and normalized management.

title_en: Resource allocation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, relates to the technical field of resource allocation, and can be applied to an artificial intelligence service platform based on an artificial intelligence technology, and comprises the following steps: acquiring resource conversion data and user use data in a service platform; determining model parameters of a resource conversion distribution model according to the resource conversion data, and determining model parameters of a resource use distribution model according to the user use data; and performing target resource allocation on the content resource provider according to the resource conversion allocation model and the resource use allocation model. The method and the device can improve fairness and rationality of target resource allocation.

title_en: Evaluation system and method for green space service level of city park
abstract_en: The invention discloses an evaluation system and method for urban park green space service level, wherein the system comprises a basic data entry module, an index analysis module and an evaluation result generation module; the basic data entry module is used for entering factors influencing the service level of the park greenbelt, wherein the factors comprise the supply quality of the park greenbelt service, the fairness of the park greenbelt service and the satisfaction degree of urban residents; the index analysis module is used for analyzing factors influencing the service level of the park green space to obtain an analysis result; and the evaluation result generation module is used for generating an evaluation result according to the analysis result. The method generates the evaluation result of the park green space service level according to the evaluation of three dimensions of the park green space service supply quality, the park green space service fairness and the urban resident satisfaction degree, obtains the service level of the target park green space, provides a theoretical basis for planning the urban park green space, and has important significance for the fair sense of the urban resident living quality and the social resource distribution.

title_en: Intelligent scheduling and attendance management method for hospital departments
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of internal management of hospital departments, and discloses an intelligent scheduling and attendance management method for hospital departments, which solves the problem that the traditional manual scheduling management mode and the traditional attendance mode no longer meet the management requirements of modern large enterprises. The invention can automatically generate a fair and fair scheduling list which meets the requirements of staff, reduces the complexity of manual scheduling and the situations of insufficient and excessive personnel allocation, avoids the phenomenon of vacant posts caused by disordered allocation, introduces face recognition attendance and avoids the defects of 'no identity of recognized cards' of substitute card punching and traditional attendance; the condition that 'must be pressed by hand' of fingerprint attendance is eliminated, the table is directly perceived and friendly, and the multi-dimensional table of checking up is promoted to the cognitive degree and the degree of obedience to the table, makes the scheduling more humanized, avoids manpower repetition and waste to a great extent, has improved the fairness and the exactness of scheduling, has reduced the loaded down with trivial details nature of scheduling, makes intelligent scheduling system obtain extensive application gradually.
assignees: SHANGHAI REDNOBLE INFORMATION TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy system scheduling method considering section safety constraint and scheduling fairness
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-energy system scheduling method considering section safety constraint and scheduling fairness, aiming at a nested and layered section structure, priority sequences from an inner layer to an outer layer are gradually searched, the maximum space of the output of a new energy station is calculated under the condition that the section does not exceed a stability limit, meanwhile, a fairness calculation method is constructed on the basis of scheduling fairness indexes, the output limited distribution scores of all power plants related under an out-of-limit section are calculated, and the fair distribution of the output limits of all wind power plants and photovoltaic power plants is guaranteed.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Multi-path multi-target emergency material distribution path selection method based on SHADE algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential evolution (SHADE) algorithm based on success history adaptive parameters, which is used for searching emergency rescue paths of emergency supplies and mainly comprises the following steps: by learning the cross rate and the variation rate of successful individuals in the differential evolution algorithm, the method can find a more superior path. In order to search more equivalent emergency material rescue scheduling paths, the fitness sharing mechanism is simultaneously used in a target space and a decision space to ensure the diversity of the paths, provide various feasible paths for a user to select, and avoid the condition that a single path cannot pass due to some sudden reason. The invention not only can search the optimal emergency goods and materials rescue scheduling path meeting the target condition, but also can provide a plurality of equivalent paths, thereby providing guarantee for sending emergency goods and materials to the destination for rescue at the first time.

title_en: Data processing system and method for idle article poverty alleviation platform
abstract_en: A data processing system of an idle article poverty-relieving platform comprises a poverty-relieving object information data storage and conversion module, an article donation object recommendation module, an idle article sorting calibration module, a fund distribution module of a fund donation object, a cash change processing module and a poverty-relieving information encryption module. The data processing method of the idle article poverty alleviation platform comprises the steps of updating stored poverty alleviation object information data in real time, analyzing poverty alleviation states of poverty alleviation objects and generating corresponding demand article sets through calling of a database; the idle article are sorted and calibrated, the articles meeting the donation specification are donated, algorithm selection is carried out on donated objects, other articles are changed in the currency, and the changed idle articles are distributed based on the poverty relief distribution model and then fund distribution. According to the system and the data processing method, the processing of idle articles and the poverty alleviation problem are perfectly combined, so that the accurate poverty alleviation work of the platform can be well operated, and the use feeling of the platform is improved.
assignees: GOODFULL BEIJING TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy system transaction plan making method under double-track system operation
abstract_en: A multi-energy system transaction plan making method under double-track system operation belongs to the technical field of multi-energy system transaction plan making, and comprises the following steps: s1: according to the actual requirements of the trading plan of the multi-energy system, a modeling method of the trading plan of the multi-energy system is provided, and the modeling method specifically comprises the following steps: analyzing the current medium and long term electricity trading plan situation of China and providing a multi-energy system trading plan modeling scheme; s2: modeling each part of the model according to the multi-energy system trading plan modeling method formulated in the step S1, specifically including: based on a target function with lowest operation energy consumption and emission comprehensive cost and a constraint condition of considering a damping coefficient fairness constraint set; s3: and carrying out model optimization solving by using Matlab-Cplex to obtain a final multi-energy system trading plan. According to the method, based on the parallel electricity price double-track system, monthly electricity balance constraint, monthly market electricity capacity reduction and introduction of a Kini coefficient fairness constraint set are added, and the optimal distribution of the multi-energy system trading plan in a double-track system operation mode can be more finely realized.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;SHENYANG POWER SUPPLY CO STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER TRADING CENTER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Emergency resource allocation method, system and application in sudden public health event
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of resource allocation, and discloses an emergency resource allocation method, system and application in a sudden public health event, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining the medical resource amount consumed by medical health institutions at all levels in quarantine, isolation observation, suspected case diagnosis and treatment and confirmed case treatment by adopting a data collection and management method, a questionnaire survey and interview survey method, a group discussion method, a Delphi method and a data statistical analysis method; constructing a sudden infectious disease epidemic situation prediction model based on different prevention and control measures and regional and time-interval division, and determining an optimized prediction model of intervention measures with minimum medical resource consumption; and formulating a medical resource supply and configuration mode based on the SEIAPHR optimization model prediction value. The invention predicts the demand of medical resources in different regions and time periods based on different intervention measures, and provides a reasonable supply mode to realize an emergency medical material configuration mode which gives consideration to both 'benefit' and 'fairness'.
assignees: CHILDRENS HOSPITAL OF CHONGQING MEDICAL UNIV

title_en: Local area multi-microgrid power transaction pairing method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses a local multi-microgrid power transaction pairing method based on a block chain technology, wherein a multi-microgrid is used as a novel distributed power generation system and is an important component of an energy internet. The selection of the power generation resources and the electric energy transaction have a series of problems of obvious centralization, low fairness and reliability and the like. Aiming at the defects of the micro-grid in real-time power transaction, a multi-micro-grid power transaction pairing method based on a block chain technology is provided, a competitive power spot market with a transaction part centralized in multi-seller-multi-buyer is constructed, and source-sale integration is realized. The settlement process is automatically achieved through transaction information uploading, matching, encryption and intelligent contracts, random quotation and random pairing of all main bodies are achieved through the ant colony algorithm, and multi-objective optimization is achieved. The whole process realizes the unification of the energy flow, the information flow and the currency flow of the electric power transaction, and ensures the reasonable distribution of electric energy resources and the open transparency of the electric power transaction.

title_en: Network vehicle dispatching method and system for introducing satisfaction degree of passenger receiving driving time
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network appointment vehicle dispatching method for introducing satisfaction degree of passenger receiving driving time, which comprises the following steps: estimating the expected receiving driving time and the actual receiving driving time of the passengers in different time space states by utilizing historical order information of the network taxi, and calculating to obtain the satisfaction degree of the receiving driving time of the passengers; according to the space-time distribution, type division is carried out on a driver group and a passenger group, a point bipartite graph with weight is constructed based on the driver type group and the passenger type group, a connecting edge exists on a passenger in a driving range of the driver, and the weight of the point is the cost required by the passenger to drive; respectively establishing linear programming for maximizing the total profits Profit of a driver and maximizing the satisfaction fairness PTSF of the passenger receiving driving time; and obtaining the fractional solutions of the two targets through offline calculation, and carrying out online order assignment by using a KIID model. The invention can effectively balance the two different targets by considering the fairness of the satisfaction degree of the receiving driving time of the passengers while considering the requirement of a driver on higher order income.

title_en: Method, system, equipment and medium for dynamically analyzing reserves of multi-type ore storage yard
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for dynamically analyzing reserves of a multi-type ore yard, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring multi-type ore yard images of an open mine acquired by unmanned aerial vehicle aerial photography; analyzing various types of ore yard images through an aerial triangular analysis method, converting the images into various types of three-dimensional dense point cloud data of the ore yards, and processing the three-dimensional dense point cloud data to obtain various types of three-dimensional models of the ore yards; extracting elevation point information of the ore yard based on three-dimensional models of various ore yards; and (3) extracting elevation point information of the multi-type ore yards in different periods by loop iteration, carrying out reserve dynamic analysis to obtain multi-type ore yard reserve data in different periods, and analyzing change conditions of the multi-type ore yard reserve data in different periods. The invention lays a foundation for scientifically optimizing the ore mining design of the stope, further establishes a scientific plan of stope ore allocation and ore supply, and is favorable for reasonably establishing stope ore supply allocation indexes.

title_en: Sample plate-based fairness automatic scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention provides a sample plate-based fairness automatic scheduling method, which is applied to a scheduling system, wherein the scheduling system comprises a server and a client, and the server is in communication connection with the client, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, acquiring a scheduling basic information set value, a shift template and shift number information, wherein the shift template comprises one or more of an individual priority shift template, an overall prohibited shift template and an individual prohibited shift template; s2, acquiring scheduling period information and staff information participating in scheduling in a corresponding period; s3, acquiring the scheduling data of the previous period and calculating the under-supplement value of the personal rest days; s4, performing automatic shift scheduling through iterative computation based on the data acquired in the steps S1-S3; and S5, generating a scheduling list according to the automatic scheduling result. The method is beneficial to reducing the labor cost required to be input during the shift arrangement and improving the efficiency of the shift arrangement management of the staff.
assignees: HAINAN NEW CONCEPT INFORMATION SYSTEM CO LTD

title_en: Case allocation method, system, medium and electronic device based on knowledge graph
abstract_en: The invention provides a case distribution method, a case distribution system, a case distribution medium and electronic equipment based on a knowledge graph, wherein the court case balanced distribution method comprises the following steps: acquiring basic information required by case distribution, and extracting judge information and case information from the basic information; constructing a knowledge graph based on the judge information and the case information; the knowledge graph comprises a plurality of nodes influencing case division and node relations; and constructing a matching function of the judge and the case based on the knowledge graph, acquiring an optimal solution of the matching function, and distributing the case based on the optimal solution. The invention optimizes case allocation in the court by constructing the knowledge map and combining integer planning, visually displays the relationship among elements influencing case allocation, improves the working quality and the working efficiency of the court, can intelligently assist and guide data processing personnel to more accurately provide main information of judges and cases, and improves the case allocation fairness and the case allocation efficiency of case allocation personnel.

title_en: Multi-microgrid transaction optimization method and system under credit risk
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-microgrid transaction optimization method and system under credit risk, wherein the credit level of each microgrid main body is calculated based on historical transaction information of the microgrid main body; determining constraint conditions and optimization targets of a multi-microgrid transaction optimization problem under the credit risk, and establishing a transaction optimization model; considering the discreteness and continuity of variables, decomposing the multi-microgrid optimization model into a main problem for solving a microgrid transaction combination and a sub problem for solving a microgrid transaction plan considering the uncertainty of the credit level; and solving the decomposed main problem and sub-problem by using a column and constraint generation algorithm to obtain an optimal trading plan, and determining the electricity purchasing and selling state and the electricity quantity of each microgrid. The invention can improve the economy and fairness of multi-microgrid power transaction.

title_en: Apparatus and Method of Altruistic Scheduling based on Reinforcement Learning
title_ko: 강화학습 기반 이타적 스케줄링 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a device and method for altruistic scheduling based on reinforcement learning. According to an embodiment of the present invention, the device for altruistic scheduling includes: an external scheduling agent for determining a basic resource share for each process based on information of a resource management system; an internal scheduling agent for determining a basic resource allocation schedule for each process based on information including the basic resource share and a resource leftover based on the basic resource allocation schedule; and a leftover scheduling agent for determining a leftover resource allocation schedule based on information including the resource leftover. According to an embodiment of the present disclosure, it may be expected that reinforcement learning will not only mitigate the diminution of fairness of an altruistic scheduler but also further improve other performance indicators such as completion time and efficiency.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 강화학습 기반 이타적 스케줄링 장치 및 방법에 관한 것이다.  본 발명의 일 실시예에 따른 이타적 스케줄링 장치는 자원관리 시스템의 정보를 기반으로 프로세스 별 기본 자원 분배량을 결정하는 외부 스케줄링 에이전트, 상기 기본 자원 분배량을 포함한 정보를 기반으로 결정된 프로세스 별 기본 자원 할당 스케줄 및 상기 기본 자원 할당 스케줄을 기반으로 자원 잔여분을 결정하는 내부 스케줄링 에이전트, 상기 자원 잔여분을 포함한 정보를 기반으로 잔여자원 할당 스케줄을 결정하는 잔여 스케줄링 에이전트를 포함한다. 본 발명의 실시예에 의해, 강화학습을 이용하여 이타적 스케줄러의 공정성 하락을 완화시키는 동시에 완료시간 및 효율성과 같은 타 성능지표의 추가적 향상을 기대할 수 있다.

title_en: Road traffic resource allocation fairness measurement method
abstract_en: The invention provides a road traffic resource allocation fairness measuring method, which is characterized in that a Kanberga index-based road traffic resource allocation measurement model is established according to the road area occupied by people in different travel modes, quantitative evaluation of the Kanberga index is applied, and the Kanberga index of a city is calculated from the perspective of traffic fairness among the road areas occupied by people in various traffic modes, so that the fairness of road traffic resource allocation in different districts is measured, a realistic basis is provided for solving the problem of resident travel fairness, the travel service guarantee work is facilitated to be effectively carried out, and government-related departments can make effective decisions according to the evaluation results, guide government organization management strategies to be improved, and promote the operation efficiency to be improved.

title_en: Incremental power distribution network project multi-investment main body income distribution method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power distribution networks, in particular to a multi-investment main body income distribution method for incremental power distribution network projects. Firstly, constructing an incremental power distribution project multi-investment subject income distribution method based on a Shapley value; and then, based on different risk shares, job contribution degrees and contract execution degrees of the investment subjects, correcting the initial Shapley value by adopting a triangular fuzzy number chromatographic analysis method, and determining the final distribution scheme of the investment subjects. The distribution scheme after the Shapley value is corrected can reflect the fairness and the rationality of the income distribution of each investment entity.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Water pollution load distribution method considering region fairness and pollution source treatment difference
abstract_en: The invention provides a water pollution load distribution method considering region fairness and pollution source treatment difference, which comprises the steps of selecting evaluation indexes, and calculating the damping coefficient and the weight of each index; calculating the current comprehensive kini coefficient; setting a total amount control constraint; setting fairness constraints; setting a reduction rate constraint; determining the treatment cost of each administrative area related to each ton of industrial wastewater; determining the ton water treatment cost of urban domestic sewage in each administrative district; determining the ton water treatment cost of municipal upgrading reconstruction; determining the unit pollution load treatment cost of industrial wastewater, urban domestic sewage and municipal upgrading reconstruction in each administrative area; calculating comprehensive treatment cost; and solving the water pollution load distribution problem. The invention can scientifically and reasonably guide the pollutant reduction sequence and the reduction scheme in each region and various pollution sources to make.

title_en: Block chain consensus mechanism for intelligent Internet of things computing service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain consensus mechanism for intelligent internet of things computing service, which comprises a block chain architecture for intelligent internet of things computing service, a matrix product computing task processing mechanism and a reward adjustment mechanism; four types of nodes exist in the block chain architecture facing the intelligent internet of things computing service: AIoT node, coordinator node, miner node, and verifier node. The series of matrix product calculation task processing mechanisms provided by the invention makes unified rules and interfaces for blockchain miners participating in computational power service, ensures fairness of blockchain mining competition, and is beneficial to attracting more miners to participate in blockchains, so that the safety of a blockchain network is further improved. By using the distributed computing service of miners in the block chain, the risk of security and privacy disclosure caused by the central service is reduced, and the security of the computing service is improved.

title_en: Mine accident emergency rescue dynamic scheduling modeling method integrating demand satisfaction and disaster victims loss
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic dispatching and modeling method for mine accident emergency rescue of comprehensive demand satisfaction and disaster victims loss, which comprises the following steps: collecting mine accident information; expressing the demand satisfaction by using a relative demand satisfaction function; designing a loss function to minimize the loss generated when the requirements of emergency materials of the mine accident are not met; constructing a multi-target model of mine accident emergency material scheduling by taking the goals of the minimum delay time of the total materials of the system, the maximum satisfaction degree of the relative requirements of the whole mine accident disaster area on the mine accident emergency materials and the minimum loss when the mine accident emergency material requirements of mine accident victims are not met; and carrying out algorithm design on the solution of the model to obtain an optimal solution. The invention takes the improvement of the satisfaction degree of the public on the rescue work as a key factor in the mine accident emergency rescue coordination optimization problem, so that the dispatching of the mine accident emergency supplies is more suitable for the actual emergency rescue requirements.

title_en: Rights and interests distribution system and method based on cone block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rights and interests distribution system and a rights and interests distribution method based on a cone block chain, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the task issuing module is used for receiving the work tasks sent by the rights and interests main body and uploading the work tasks to the consensus storage module; the authentication module is used for performing real-time identity authentication on the rights and interests person and uploading identity authentication information to the consensus storage module; the equity examination module is used for receiving the work tasks selected by the authenticated equity people and the corresponding work task contributions, and automatically carrying out workload evaluation and equity distribution on the contributions uploaded by the equity people according to an equity examination intelligent contract; and the consensus storage module is used for storing the task information, the identity authentication information, the workload evaluation information and the rights and interests allocation information in a cone block chain associated block in a consensus mode. The invention makes each rights and interests person form the interest correlation body through consensus, can realize real-time sharing of rights and interests distribution information and information transparentization, and has the advantages of energy saving and low cost.
assignees: SHANXI TEXIN HUANYU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Block chain-based whole asset/commodity ownership share transaction implementation method
abstract_en: The invention provides a block chain-based method for realizing the transaction of ownership shares of an overall asset/commodity, namely a method for respectively selling the ownership of a certain overall asset/commodity according to a plurality of equal parts or unequal parts, which can greatly reduce the investment threshold, balance the investment and consumption opportunities of the overall asset/commodity, break through the situation that the investment and consumption opportunities of the original overall asset/commodity are mastered in the hands of a small number of practical people, and can benefit more investors and consumers, thereby being capable of mastering the idle overall asset/commodity which is difficult to find the investors and consumers, realizing the uplink record of the ownership and/or ownership shares of the overall asset/commodity by using a block chain technology, and realizing the uplink, distribution, uplink, distribution, uplink and/or weight share transaction record storage of the overall asset/commodity and/or the ownership shares, And inquiring, so that the authenticity, fairness and safety of investment and/or consumption are greatly improved.

title_en: Task allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a task allocation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring task information of a task to be distributed; pushing the task information of the tasks to be distributed to terminal devices corresponding to a plurality of working personnel respectively so that each working personnel can select whether to seize the tasks to be distributed or not through the corresponding terminal devices; determining target workers for carrying the tasks to be distributed based on the acquisition results of the workers for the tasks to be distributed and historical positioning data of the workers; and distributing the tasks to be distributed to the target staff. The embodiment of the invention enables the task allocation method to be objective and fair, not only considers the subjective will of the workers, but also considers objective factors, and improves the fairness, flexibility and rationality of the task allocation method.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG QIANSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Visual, intelligent and decentralized task allocation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decentralized task allocation method, which comprises the following steps: uniformly calculating the task amount occupied by the sample making sheet according to the sample making type and the sample making quantity recorded in the sample making sheet; determining the task quantity occupied by each task and the sequence of each task according to the declaration of the salesman, and accordingly determining the comprehensive task quantity of each salesman in sequence of time; dividing the comprehensive task quantity in the sequence of time by the allocation proportion of each operator to obtain the priority of each order under the name of the operator, and sequencing the order priorities of all operators from small to large; and integrating orders applied by all the service personnel and transferring the orders to the technicians according to the priority sequence. The invention adopts a decentralized task allocation algorithm, and firstly, the fairness and the accuracy are greatly improved. The workload of each task and the time of each node are recorded and calculated, and any node and transaction can be traced. The working efficiency and the load level of the whole board house can be counted and analyzed, and great convenience is improved for management.
assignees: JIANGSU HIGH HOPE INT GROUP AGLOGY DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Task matching fairness method for large-scale taxi taking platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task matching fairness method for a large-scale taxi taking platform, and belongs to the field of computers; the method comprises the following steps: firstly, aiming at a certain city, forming a bipartite graph by idle online drivers and unserviced orders in a taxi taking scene at a fixed time frequency; updating each side weight of the bipartite graph in the current time window; then, calculating the order matching corresponding to each online driver on the bipartite graph with updated edge weights; finally, learning the matching result of the online driver and the corresponding order, and updating the value function for the evaluation of the next time window; and meanwhile, leading idle online drivers to enter an order hot area according to the updated value function, and avoiding cold start of online learning. The invention adds a guiding strategy to dispatch the drivers to nearby grids with high value, thereby realizing fair profit of each driver; meanwhile, the fairness check is embedded into the process of finding the augmented path, and extra time complexity is not increased.

title_en: Computer-implemented method for calculating trade price reference indicator
abstract_en: A computer-implemented method for calculating a trade price reference indicator includes step 101: creating a frequency distribution chart based on a price increment; step 102: selecting an accumulation distribution point from the frequency distribution chart; and step 103: calculating an average deviation of an active range based on the accumulation distribution point, calculating a significant range, and using the significant range as an equitable value of a market. The method calculates and generates a trading reference price indicator of a financial market product by superimposing discrete quantitative elements of time and quantity distributions onto conventional price-time, so as to accurately reflect real-time market transactions, avoid price manipulation, and achieve accurate statistics and analysis of financial prices.

title_en: Resource processing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource processing method, a resource processing device, a resource processing equipment and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of networks. According to the technical scheme, the user is guided to repeatedly complete the target tasks related to the resource allocation activities in the associated application, the user acquisition probability of the user to the resources is displayed based on the accumulated repeated completion times of the target user group on the platform and the repeated completion times of the user, the user can make an effort for improving the acquisition probability by accessing the associated application, the user activity is greatly improved, and the information such as the acquisition probability is provided for the user in a visual mode, so that the user can know the existing acquisition probability based on intuition, the direction of network activity of the user is determined, the user is stimulated to improve the user activity under the condition that the fairness of resource allocation is guaranteed, and the purpose of effectively improving the user activity is achieved.

title_en: Emergency water supply allocation method for large-range long-duration drought
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency water supply allocation method for large-range long-duration drought, which comprises the steps of classifying and identifying conventional water sources and emergency water sources of allocation units in a drought region; selecting an emergency water supply allocation mode according to different drought degrees; calculating and analyzing the water supply and demand of each allocation unit under different drought degrees; formulating the water source and water user drought emergency water supply allocation rule under different allocation modes of each allocation unit; the method comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer large-range long-duration drought emergency water supply allocation model by taking the minimum integral water shortage, the minimum integral disaster damage and economic cost and the minimum deviation between the actual water storage capacity of a reservoir and the target water storage capacity as targets, wherein the model comprises a data input module, a drought degree evaluation module, a water supply and demand module and an optimized allocation module. The method can improve the emergency water supply allocation efficiency, fairness and sustainability under the drought condition.

title_en: Enterprise risk level evaluation method based on hierarchical analysis and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise risk level evaluation method based on a hierarchical analysis and fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method, which optimizes the equal weight condition in the initial each-level index scoring system by establishing the initial each-level index scoring system, wherein the subjective factors in the system have too much specific gravity, so each-level index weight is objectively given through the hierarchical analysis, taking enterprise risk evaluation as an example, the initial final enterprise risk evaluation is that the possibility that each enterprise belongs to each risk level is given according to the final score of each enterprise by artificially judging the level and having a loss of fairness, in order to obtain an objective evaluation result, a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation model is established, a membership function is established, the weight obtained through the hierarchical analysis is combined, and the probability highest value is taken as the evaluation result, thereby improving the accuracy of the enterprise risk level evaluation.
assignees: ZHEJIANG FEIXIAN SHULIAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Online order matching method for taxi booking based on double-target LP
abstract_en: The invention provides a network car booking online order matching method based on double-target LP. Then, a coefficient matrix is created and two optimal numerical solutions for LP are found by means of a simplex algorithm. And then, when the order arrives online, rounding the numerical solution obtained by the LP to obtain a random binary vector. And finally, selecting a binary vector representing the income or fairness according to the set probability, and matching orders according to random arrangement. The invention considers the fairness problem in the order distribution scene, simultaneously considers the income of the network car booking platform and the fairness among drivers in the order matching process, and can flexibly adjust the weights of the income and the fairness among the drivers so that the platform can better weigh the driver resources and the monetary income, and the long-term development of the platform can be facilitated.

title_en: System and method for graph-based resource allocation using neural networks
abstract_en: A method for using a neural network to generate an improved graph model includes receiving, by the neural network, a graph model. The graph model is based on data relating to an environment for allocating resources to a first group and a second group. The method further includes receiving, by the neural network, a budget for editing the graph model based on a cost of corresponding modification to the environment, and determining, by the neural network, a fairness representation based on a fairness requirement between the first and second groups. It is determined by the neural network, a utility function for the graph model based on first and second group utilities representing resource allocation to the first and second groups respectively. Reinforcement learning is performed on the neural network to generate the improved graph model using the utility function and the fairness representation.

title_en: Online continuous education resource allocation and management method based on artificial intelligence algorithm technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line continuous education resource allocation and management method based on an artificial intelligence algorithm technology, and provides the following scheme aiming at the problems of violation of an education fairness principle, poor allocation efficiency and insufficient transparency of an allocation mode, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: the staff uploads the student identity information and the hiring teacher identity information collected through the platforms to the education system; s2: an education resource manager logs in an online continuous education platform to integrate the identity information of teachers and students; s3: and respectively issuing survey information questionnaires for the teacher and the students in an e-mail mode. The invention effectively and directly hooks the superior teaching information disclosed by the teacher and the subject to be improved by the student through the connection of the resource information matching module, so that the reasonable supply and demand balance is efficiently realized for the bidirectional matching of the teacher and the student, the achievement of the student is improved, and the targeted teaching in the teaching process is enriched.
assignees: HENGJI CULTURE INFORMATION TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Construction method of universal grain system model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a construction method of a general grain system model, which sets the factors of comprehensive evaluation indexes of a grain system as efficiency, profit, sustainability and fairness; setting independent secondary indexes and corresponding index parameters for the elements respectively; acquiring the secondary indexes, and determining index parameters of four secondary indexes by utilizing an analytic hierarchy process from the perspective of three groups of producers, operators and consumers of grain products; the comprehensive evaluation index of the grain system is determined according to the secondary index and the index parameters, a general grain system model is established, the comprehensive evaluation index of the grain system established by the invention comprehensively considers the mutual influence relationship of the factors such as efficiency, profit, sustainability and fairness on the operation of the grain system, and the grain system model obtained by optimization gives consideration to the social benefits such as sustainability and fairness on the basis of ensuring the efficiency and profit, and is more reasonable, effective and stable than the original system.

title_en: Software development outsourcing control system based on block chain and implementation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a software development outsourcing control system based on a block chain and an implementation method. The system comprises: the system comprises a demand release module, a test case generation module, an intelligent contract generation module, a software running sandbox, a task generation module, a task confirmation distribution module and a block chain system; based on the characteristics of decentralized and non-falsification of the block chain technology, all nodes participate in task generation, code verification and capability scoring, the authenticity of software development outsourcing tasks, the fairness for evaluating the software quality and the authority for evaluating the software development outsourcing completion capability of a developer are improved, and the developer is effectively encouraged to improve the participation degree and the completion degree; by utilizing the characteristics of traceability and privacy protection of block chain account book data, each change of the user currency and software copyright is recorded in an encrypted manner, the currency assets and the software copyright are protected, and the data credibility is improved. The invention also discloses a realization method of the software development outsourcing control system based on the block chain.
assignees: SHANGHAI DEVELOPMENT CENTER OF COMPUTER SOFTWARE TECH

title_en: Urban safety barrier optimization design method taking queuing fairness as guiding
abstract_en: The invention relates to urban safety barrier optimization design software taking queuing fairness as a guide, and belongs to the technical field of traffic engineering. Epidemic prevention lock line is an effective means for blocking virus transmission, and constructs a city safety barrier. However, how to make the queuing time of each incoming channel approximately equal under the constraint of limited inspection resources is a technical problem to be solved. The invention provides a double-layer planning model, wherein an upper layer model is the optimal configuration of an epidemic prevention inspection station, a lower layer model is balanced for a traffic system, and the queuing waiting time is calculated by a queuing theory and is considered as a part of generalized travel time. A heuristic algorithm is designed to solve the double-layer planning model, wherein the lower layer is a continuous average algorithm, and the upper layer is a genetic algorithm with elite strategy. Computing software was developed using the free open-source R language. Specific implementation shows that the invention is very effective for policy makers to determine fair epidemic prevention blocking station deployment policies.

title_en: Energy consumption control strategy generation method, system, device, distribution and distribution system and medium
abstract_en: The energy utilization control strategy generation method, the system, the device, the distribution and energy distribution system and the medium are applied to the distribution and energy distribution system, and the prediction renewable energy supply of each future time slot is predicted through the first predictor; obtaining time decomposition slices and corresponding slice energy requirements according to the predicted renewable energy supply and the actual energy requirements; predicting unit energy supply parameters through a second predictor, and determining a strategy threshold value of the time decomposition slice at the current time slot; energy utilization control strategies constructed by the strategy thresholds are used for controlling energy utilization; the method and the device accurately predict the renewable energy supply and the cost parameter through the predictor to construct an online optimal control strategy for obtaining the energy supply, can effectively optimize the energy utilization efficiency and cost, are favorable for promoting rationalization of energy supply allocation, are favorable for energy conservation and emission reduction, and solve the problems in the prior art.
assignees: TURING AI INST OF NANJING CO LTD

title_en: Barrier-free VR teaching resource color optimization method for people with abnormal color vision
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of teaching application of information technology, and provides a barrier-free VR teaching resource color optimization method for people with abnormal color vision, which comprises the following steps: (1) constructing a color cognition factor system; (2) constructing a color evaluation model; (3) and generating a color scheme optimization model. The method comprehensively considers the requirements of people with abnormal color vision, designs various types of tasks and analyzes the color cognition difference; constructing a color evaluation model by using an ensemble learning method; and (4) firstly dividing color patches on the image and then screening the scheme to optimize the color scheme. The invention is beneficial to non-professional persons to design and optimize VR teaching resources, achieves the universality of the color scheme and meets the fairness requirement of education resources.

title_en: Automatic dispatching method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides an automatic dispatching method, an automatic dispatching device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, which are used for acquiring the take-off time of a flight to be refueled; determining whether the time interval between the takeoff moment and the current moment is smaller than a preset time interval; if so, acquiring the current position of each refueler at the current moment, the working data of the current day and historical refueling data aiming at the model type of the flight to be refueled; determining a dispatching score of each refueler for the flight to be refueled based on the obtained current position, the current day work data and the historical refuelling data of each refueler; and determining the refueler with the highest dispatching score as a target refueler capable of refueling the flight to be refueled. Like this, according to dispatching the worker and grading and select the best refueller and carry out automatic dispatch, help improving the rationality and the fairness of dispatching the worker, alleviate dispatcher's work burden, the resource of using manpower sparingly promotes work efficiency.
assignees: CHINA NAT AVIATION FUEL CO LTD

title_en: Automatic client resource allocation system and method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a system and a method for automatically distributing customer resources, wherein the method comprises the following steps: s1: the client information acquisition module acquires client reservation information, classifies the client reservation information according to regions through the first data management module, and counts the number of clients corresponding to different regions to form primary information; s2: storing and backing up the primary information to a total database, and distributing the primary information to each local database through a primary information distribution module; s3: the processing capacity of each team in each region is analyzed through the first analysis module, the first-level information in the database of each region is classified according to the region by the second data management module according to the analysis result of the first analysis module, and the number of clients corresponding to different regions is counted to form second-level information; s4: and the secondary information distribution module distributes the secondary information to each team database according to the analysis result of the first analysis module. The technical scheme provided by the application improves the efficiency and fairness of customer resource allocation.
assignees: BEIJING DIANQU EDUCATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Order allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics distribution and discloses an order distribution method, device, equipment and storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: receiving an order to be distributed, and determining a longitude and latitude value corresponding to address data according to the acquired address data of the order to be distributed; clustering orders to be distributed according to the longitude and latitude values, and determining at least one order cluster; searching whether a target mesh point corresponding to the longitude and latitude value of the order cluster exists in the longitude and latitude range according to the longitude and latitude range corresponding to the preset road grid; screening available couriers from a target network according to logistics capacity information of preset couriers, and calculating order matching degree between the available couriers and an order to be distributed; and determining a target courier corresponding to the order to be distributed according to the order matching degree, and sending the order distribution result to the client of the target courier and a preset order distribution center. According to the invention, through a logistics order forward order sorting strategy, automatic sorting is carried out according to the principle of taking fairness into account in the forward direction, so that efficient assignment of orders is realized, and express receiving efficiency is improved.

title_en: Multi-dimensional case allocation method based on credit card post-credit collection service
abstract_en: The invention relates to a multi-dimensional case distribution method based on credit card post-credit collection service, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps of generating a case to be urged to be collected according to overdue bills, classifying the case to be urged to be collected according to different dimensions, classifying the case according to fairness of urging collectors, and adopting a distribution scheme as follows: firstly, ordering the cases which are not yet left, then ordering the collectors, and distributing the cases which are not yet left and the collectors in a one-to-one correspondence manner; the case classified according to the stock of the receiver is distributed according to the following scheme: finding out the case with the largest sum of money which is not yet stored, distributing the case to the collector with the smallest sum of money of the case stored, and sequentially distributing the case; the case classified according to the hastening difficulty is distributed according to the scheme as follows: and (3) distributing cases with high difficulty to collectors with weak service capability, cases with medium difficulty to collectors with medium service capability, and cases with low difficulty to collectors with strong service capability. The invention sets a reasonable distribution method for the multidimensional case, makes the collection service clearer and increases the rate of money return.
assignees: SHANGHAI ALL IN FINANCIAL SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Method and System for Monitoring Accountability and Fairness for An Enterprises
abstract_en: An automated system & method for real time monitoring and enhancing performance for an enterprise is disclosed herein. The present invention measures the performance objectively, instead of subjective measurement. The system comprises of plurality of electronic devices (1), a remote server (3), and an interface (2) providing link between the electronic devices (1) and the remote server (3), The system of the present invention facilitates time scheduling, parameter setting, progress updation, resource planning, task initiation, survey management and feedback, leave of absence and loss of pay management for the enterprise, day planning and management for the task executor, automated recovery in case of collapse of schedule and such.

title_en: Driver queuing strategy method for order dispatching fairness in airport range
abstract_en: The invention provides a driver queuing strategy method for dispatching fairness in an airport range, which comprises the following steps: subscribing the track of a consumer driver, wherein the driver track information comprises the position of the driver and basic driver information; judging whether a driver queuing strategy is started in a driver service city, and if so, inquiring and starting a driver queuing city list; otherwise, the enqueue of the driver is finished; inquiring a driver list arranged in the fence according to the fence id, judging whether drivers are arranged in the fence or not, and if so, finishing the enqueue of the drivers; judging whether the driver service city opens a priority queue queuing strategy or not, if so, inquiring the order information of the pick-up machine completed by the driver within the last n minutes; and determining that the drivers queue and dequeue according to the driver enqueue record information and the order placing information. And a queuing mechanism is established according to the sequence of entering the airport fence to dispatch the order, so that the relative fairness of drivers can be guaranteed.

title_en: Two-dimensional code-based owner voting innovation mode
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-dimensional code-based owner voting innovation mode, which comprises the following steps of S1: the invention relates to the technical field of owner vote, in particular to a system for verifying house property certificate information, which comprises a plurality of function modules, wherein an owner scans codes to download APP, clicks the corresponding function module, then obtains APP authorization, and after authorization confirmation, the owner selects different types of house property certificate information to verify, if verification fails, the house property certificate information can be checked, and the system can verify according to the real identity of a user, so that the house property of the user is ensured to be correct. This owner's innovation mode of voting based on two-dimensional code can solve traditional voting inefficiency, cycle length, human cost height, fairness are poor, the difficult scheduling problem of statistics of data, and the owner can vote on line through the procedure, and to some old man that can not use the procedure, we can pass through the automatic relevant off-line vote that generates of procedure, have reduced because of the work load of artifical preparation vote, can be fast with on-line, off-line data statistics together, greatly saved the time energy that the owner voted.
assignees: SHANGHAI JET THINK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Medical institution inspection method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a medical institution inspection method and device and electronic equipment.
