abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic supply allocation method on an airplane, which comprises the following steps: s1 preparation before preparation; s2 preparation rule conditions: screening all flight conditions and condition parameters related to the flight conditions; s3 calculation rule formulation: establishing a calculation rule for each supply in the flight according to the flight condition and the condition parameter; s4 begins with: inputting flight conditions, loading calculation rules by a rule engine, and loading condition parameters at the same time; the compiler associates the calculation rule with the condition parameter; the resolver executes the calculation rule of each supply according to the calculation rule and outputs the calculation result of each supply; s5 supply manifest generation: judging whether the number of the supplies is greater than 0, if so, continuing to generate the next supply, otherwise, rejecting the supply and continuing to generate the next supply, and completing the supply list; s6, supply preparation on the machine, the invention does not need to make a guarantee template any more, can rapidly make a supply list, and improves the working efficiency.
assignees: XIAMEN CIVIL AVIATION CARES CO LTD

title_en: Airline airplane engine model selection decision method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a model selection decision method for an aircraft engine of an airline company, which relates to the technical field of model selection of aircraft engines and comprises the following steps: firstly, determining a model selection decision factor of an aircraft engine; evaluating the decision factors by adopting an analytic hierarchy process to obtain weight vectors of all factors in the criterion layer and the index layer; finally, calculating to obtain the comprehensive value coefficient of each aero-engine by combining the weight vector of each factor and adopting a fuzzy comprehensive evaluation method; the method comprises the steps of evaluating each decision factor of airplane engine model selection by using an analytic hierarchy process and obtaining an evaluation weight matrix of the decision factor; the weight matrix is scientifically and fairly distributed to all evaluation factors in the engine type selection decision; when a specific engine model is selected, fuzzy comprehensive evaluation is carried out according to various current environmental factors and the like, and an evaluation coefficient is obtained; the method can solve various defects caused by independently using an analytic hierarchy process for decision making, and better reflects the applicability, continuity and fairness of model selection.

title_en: Block chain-based multi-level multi-system pan-center cooperation platform system and method
abstract_en: A block chain-based multi-level multi-system pan-center cooperation platform system and a method are provided. The system comprises a plurality of hierarchical nodes forming a flat structure, when in demand distribution, the demand type node can issue a demand request message in the system, the supply type node matches the information of the demand product carried in the demand request message with the information of the supply side product stored by the supply type node, and under the condition of matching with a plurality of suppliers, the plurality of suppliers process through a game algorithm to obtain distribution results, the nodes of the demand type select proper distribution results, the product distribution process based on the cooperation competition of the block chain is completed, the system is based on blockchain establishment, macroscopically implements anti-monopoly, determines micro-rules for different products between underlying suppliers, therefore, macro and micro regulation and control are realized, the activity and fairness of the market are promoted, the turnover rate of resources is improved, the cooperation cost is reduced, and the benefit and the enthusiasm of each participant in each level of the market are improved.
assignees: DAKAI INVESTMENT SHENZHEN PARTNERSHIP ENTERPRISE LP

title_en: Civil and biological material unified scheduling and distribution system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil and biological material unified scheduling and distributing system based on big data, and relates to the field of logistics transportation. The system comprises an information acquisition unit, a data acquisition unit and a data processing unit, wherein the information acquisition unit is used for acquiring the positions of a plurality of residential points, material demands and redundant materials; the system is also used for acquiring the positions of a plurality of material centers and residual materials; the dispatching distribution center is used for summarizing the positions of the residential points, the material demands, the redundant materials, the positions of the material centers and the residual materials to obtain an information summarizing result; and distributing the residual materials of the material center and the redundant materials of the residential points to the residential points which put forward the material demands according to the information summarizing result. According to the invention, through data collection and material distribution of logistics personnel, the problem of transmission of big data of material scheduling is solved, and the problem that civil disaster relief materials cannot be reasonably distributed is effectively avoided.
assignees: JIAYUAN JIAXING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Decentralized space-time crowdsourcing system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decentralized space-time crowdsourcing system based on a block chain, which comprises a client, a contract layer and a block chain layer. The blockchain crowdsourcing system registers crowdsourcing participants through a user management contract and manages the relevant flow of crowdsourcing tasks through a task management contract. The task management contract comprises three functional modules of task issuing, task distribution and task settlement. In particular, the system adopts a greedy algorithm based on skill coverage for the distribution process of the space-time crowdsourcing task with multiple skill requirements. The system is most different from the current block chain crowdsourcing system, supports the space-time crowdsourcing task with multiple skill requirements, and has wider application range. The greedy task allocation algorithm based on the skill coverage rate realizes efficient matching of tasks and workers and improves the efficiency of a block chain crowdsourcing system. Finally, the task quality assessment method based on crowdsourcing ensures the fairness of the system.

title_en: Airline-oriented air traffic delay allocation fairness index calculation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an airline-oriented method for calculating air traffic delay distribution fairness indexes, which is used for calculating the average flight delay cost of each airline company in delay distribution; calculating the proportion of the delay cost of each airline company to the sum of the delay costs of all the airlines and the proportion of the number of flights of each airline company to the total number of the flights of all the airlines; respectively calculating the accumulated delay cost proportion and the accumulated flight number proportion based on the delay cost proportion and the flight number proportion of each airline company and the sequence arranged for the airline companies; constructing a Lorentz curve, an absolute common line and an absolute unfairness line; and (4) approximately solving a fairness index result in air traffic delay distribution based on polygon segmentation. The invention realizes the quantitative calculation of fairness concept in the technical field of air traffic flow management, and the calculation method is simple and operable; the method can truly reflect the fairness level of the whole system, and fully considers the influence of each element in the system on the whole system.

title_en: Receiving and transporting scheduling method, system and medium based on renewable resources
abstract_en: The application provides a receiving and transporting scheduling method, a system and a medium based on renewable resources, comprising the following steps: acquiring the overflow duration of the garbage can and the idle busy state of a collector at the current time, and acquiring the garbage can point position of which the overflow duration belongs to the preset overflow duration based on the idle busy state of the collector at the current time; judging whether the transfer station to be recovered exists or not, if so, planning the shortest path of a driver and a time window for staying in the transfer station based on the transfer station to be recovered; and acquiring the point location of the transfer station to be recovered and the time window for the driver to stay in the transfer station, and planning the path of the collector based on the point location of the transfer station to be recovered, the point location of the garbage bin and the time window for the driver to stay in the transfer station, so that the collector reaches the point location of the transfer station to be recovered in the time window. Through the application, according to the collection work order sent by the user, the coupling relation of the collector and the driver in time is considered at the same time, the path planning of the collector is effectively planned, and the fairness of the collector is guaranteed on the premise of ensuring the user experience.
assignees: ZHEJIANG YUNQI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Order processing method, system, device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses an order processing method, an order processing system, an order processing device and electronic equipment, and relates to the field of Internet. The method comprises the steps that a server receives orders sent by a plurality of clients and stores order information, the server analyzes the order information, responds to order state update, the server updates order states corresponding to the stored order information, the server screens orders meeting resource allocation conditions from the orders sent by the clients to serve as target orders, the server creates and executes resource allocation tasks for the target orders according to user information of the target orders and resource allocation quota corresponding to amount information of the target orders, the server sends resource allocation information of the resource allocation tasks to the clients, and the clients display the resource allocation information sent by the server. The method improves the conversion rate of the resources to the users under the condition of ensuring the fairness of the resource allocation.

title_en: Real bilateral auction method for platform logistics
abstract_en: The invention provides a real bilateral auction method facing to platform logistics, and relates to the technical field of logistics. The platform determines a bid conversion parameter through a simulation optimization method, determines the comprehensive bids of both sides based on the original bid information of both sides of the client and the logistics company, the rest required information of both sides and the predetermined bid conversion parameter, constructs a supply and demand pool based on the comprehensive bid information of both sides, and determines the winning client and the logistics company, the respective transaction amount and the transaction price. The invention ensures that the real bidding is optimal for each bidder of the two parties no matter how other bidders bid, and the platform can obtain non-negative profits, thereby simplifying the bidding decisions of the two parties and improving the information reliability and the transaction fairness of the platform; and allows the platform to flexibly select an operation target; the comprehensive bid replaces the original bid to carry out calculation, and the demand response speed and the logistics service quality provided by the platform are improved.

title_en: Power demand side management alternate optimization method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric power demand side management alternate optimization method, which relates to the technical field of electric power systems and is used for solving the problem that the fairness of orderly power utilization is difficult to guarantee at present, and the method comprises the following steps: s1, generating an ordered power utilization user sequence according to the load decompression index completion rate, formulating an ordered power utilization scheme and storing the ordered power utilization scheme to a block chain; s2, collecting user load data during the orderly power utilization, calculating the load reduction amount, and storing the load reduction amount in a block chain; s3, updating the load pressure reduction index completion rate according to the load pressure reduction amount; repeating steps S1-S3 according to the updated load decompression index completion rate. The invention also discloses a power demand side management alternation optimization device, electronic equipment and a computer storage medium. According to the invention, the load index completion rate is automatically updated through the block chain, so that the ordered power utilization scheme is automatically updated, and the load index completion rate of the user is basically consistent.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER SCIENT RES INST STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;UNIV ZHEJIANG;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;INFORMATION AND COMMUNICATION BRANCH STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Heating load scheduling method based on data-physics-knowledge combined drive
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heating load scheduling method based on data-physics-knowledge combined drive, which is characterized in that aiming at the problems of high randomness and difficult regulation of heating load, a load clustering method and a load power prediction algorithm based on data, physics and knowledge models are firstly designed; then a heating double-layer scheduling model is designed, a user layer deploys a load control terminal, power data are collected and reported, a scheduling layer comprises a prediction module, an index set module and a scheduling module, the prediction module classifies loads and predicts heating power, the index set module comprises economy, comfort and fairness indexes, the scheduling module is based on load prediction data, the maximization of economy, comfort and fairness is used as a target, a particle swarm algorithm is adopted to solve scheduling power, the scheduling power is implemented by the load control terminal, and the feasibility of a double-layer scheduling strategy is analyzed according to an example. The invention provides a technical method for load prediction and scheduling under heating transformation, and can effectively improve the fairness and effectiveness of heating.

title_en: Consequence study and judgment based emergency resource allocation method and system for narrow non-exposed space
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency resource allocation method and system for a narrow non-exposed space based on consequence study and judgment, belonging to the technical field of emergency rescue and comprising the following steps: constructing various weight influence factors of secondary disaster occurrence under the emergency of a narrow non-exposed area; constructing an ideal point approaching degree model to estimate the probability of secondary disasters in a narrow and small non-exposed space; the resource demand of the disaster-stricken point is determined, and the improved bee colony algorithm is used for distributing the materials, so that the requirements of highest time satisfaction degree, fairness distribution and minimum total cost are met. The method can timely and efficiently carry out emergency resource allocation for the disaster situation of multiple narrow non-exposed spaces which simultaneously occur, and has good allocation result and good timeliness.

title_en: Task allocation method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The method, the device and the electronic equipment determine matching degrees of different task objects to be allocated and different processing personnel respectively, determine processing time lengths required by the different processing personnel to process the different task objects respectively and an upper threshold value of the total processing time length of each allocated task object by a single processing personnel, and allocate the different task objects by taking the upper threshold value as a constraint according to the determined matching degrees and the processing time lengths. According to the task object allocation method and device, the task objects are allocated according to the matching degree of the task objects and the matching degree of the processing personnel and the time required by the processing personnel to process the task objects, the task objects can be allocated to the processing personnel with the matched attributes as far as possible, excessive difference of the processing time of the respectively allocated task objects by different processing personnel is avoided, the cooperative processing efficiency of tasks in a task processing scene with cooperation of multiple persons can be improved, and the fairness of task allocation is guaranteed.

title_en: Multi-agent cooperative resource allocation method considering fairness principle
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-agent cooperative resource allocation method considering fairness principle, relating to the technical field of multi-agent cooperation, comprising the following steps: each agent takes the observed value and fairness reward of the unmanned aerial vehicle as the input of the Actor network; the Actor network takes the state and fairness reward at the time t as input, outputs the action at the current time, and utilizes the current state and action to estimate the Q value; calculating a strategy loss function according to the estimated Q value and the actual Q value to train the Critic network, and outputting a fair action set of the intelligent agent by using the maximum Q value as the feedback of the Actor network; judging whether the actions in the fair action set meet fairness or not by using the kini coefficient; and orderly charging is carried out by utilizing the training fairness strategy according to different states of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention ensures fair competition among the agents and improves the cooperative ability of the multi-agent system; strengthen unmanned aerial vehicle's duration, improve work efficiency.

title_en: P2P market mechanism considering individual market momentum of producers and consumers and fair distribution of benefits
abstract_en: The invention discloses a P2P market mechanism considering individual market momentum of producers and consumers and equitably distributing benefits in the technical field of electric economy and electric power market operation, which comprises the following steps: step 1: determining the electricity price controllable interval and the market price controllable index of each producer, and analyzing a rational quotation strategy; step 2: constructing a market center matching mechanism for emphasizing total social benefits and an individual center matching mechanism for emphasizing individual benefits; step 3, establishing a model; and 4, step 4: constructing an interaction model; and 5: and constructing a Nash bargaining model. The mechanism of the invention constructs a Nash bargaining model considering the fairness of benefit distribution by taking the market potential of each main producer and consumer into consideration, ensures the effectiveness of the P2P power market and follows the principle of incentive compatibility; according to the invention, an NLMF-Stackelberg master-slave differential game model is constructed, the interaction between a producer optimal quotation strategy and a consumer optimal electricity purchasing strategy is analyzed, the market potential is brought into the producer non-cooperative game model, and an individual center matching mechanism is ensured to meet the excitation compatibility principle.
assignees: UNIV SOUTHEAST;STATE GRID ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD JIAXING POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Order processing method and device and computer storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses an order processing method, an order processing device and a computer storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a starting point position corresponding to a network car booking order to be distributed; obtaining the sequence of at least one candidate network appointment vehicle in the target area where the starting point position is located; the ordering of the candidate network appointment is determined based on at least two information of the order-receiving cancellation rate, the network appointment service score value and the accumulated waiting time in the target area of each candidate network appointment; and distributing the network car booking orders to be distributed to the candidate network car booking meeting preset conditions based on the sequence of the candidate network car booking. So, through ordering candidate net car appointment, and then match with net car appointment order based on the sequencing result, improved net car appointment order distribution's fairness and efficiency.
assignees: GEELY HOLDING GROUP CO LTD;HANGZHOU YOUXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multidimensional scheduling rationality evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multidimensional shift rationality evaluation method and system. The method comprises the following steps: calculating a plurality of corresponding rationality evaluation indexes and comprehensive evaluation indexes of the shift schedule to be evaluated; calculating to obtain a plurality of rationality evaluation indexes of each historical shift schedule; calculating the correlation coefficient value of each principal component influence factor corresponding to each rationality evaluation index, and obtaining multiple groups of predictive evaluation indexes and comprehensive predictive evaluation indexes through a neural network model; optimizing a plurality of groups of predictive evaluation indexes; calculating the relevance of the personnel retention rate and the personnel retention rate of each optimized shift table; and comprehensively evaluating the optimization condition of each optimized scheduling list, and selecting the optimal scheduling list. In the invention, the comfort, the work shift fairness, the business performance and the economy of the call center staff scheduling can be analyzed through a plurality of influence factors, compared with the existing evaluation method, the evaluation dimensionality is richer, and the scheduling rationality can be comprehensively evaluated.
assignees: BEIJING JIARUI INTELLIGENT TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating space distribution fairness of urban sports field
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for evaluating the fairness of urban sports field space distribution, comprising the following steps: obtaining evaluation data for performing the fairness evaluation, the evaluation data including: basic electronic map data of an administrative region of a city to be evaluated, planar boundary data of a sports field space range of the city to be evaluated, and WorldPop grid data of population space distribution of the city to be evaluated; carrying out data processing on the evaluation data based on the grid division standard of the Beidou grid position codes to obtain the per-capita sports field area of the city to be evaluated in each Beidou grid; evaluating the area of the per-capita sports field of the city to be evaluated according to a preset evaluation rule, wherein the evaluation rule comprises the following steps: the higher the per-person sports field area, the higher the score. The Beidou grid is used as a reference space unit, the continuity characteristic of the geographic space is fully considered, and the unreasonable influence of artificial administrative division on evaluation is avoided.
assignees: HUBEI POST TELECOMMUNICATION PLANNING DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: System, method, storage medium and computing device for polling and distributing purchase orders
abstract_en: The invention provides a polling system and a polling method for purchase orders, which can correspondingly send orders to the hands of service personnel in the area where the orders are located through the system when the system receives purchase orders from different areas, ensure that the same number of purchase orders are distributed to the hands of all the service personnel through a polling distribution mode, realize the fairness of order distribution, solve the problem that the processing efficiency is reduced due to too much accumulated orders on the hands of the service personnel, and also solve the problem that the working enthusiasm is influenced due to too few orders distributed by the service personnel.
assignees: GUANGZHOU XINJING INFORMATION TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Urban raw water supply allocation path identification method, system and storable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system and a storable medium for identifying a water supply allocation path of urban raw water, which relate to the technical field of water supply allocation and comprise the following steps: generalizing the urban raw water system, and dividing the urban raw water system into a supply community and a demand community based on a complex network theory; classifying the computing nodes in the supply communities according to the water supply topological relation, and providing a control strategy; according to the category of the computing node, carrying out feasible path recognition by combining engineering capability; and judging according to the operation working condition and engineering capacity of the computing node to generate a water quantity allocation scheme. The invention can calculate water quantity allocation feasible paths aiming at different water quantity allocation targets and generate a water quantity allocation scheme according to the operation conditions of pump stations and gate engineering, thereby providing reference for urban water supply allocation preview and planning and laying a foundation for intelligent management of urban water supply.

title_en: Work area division system and method for recycling renewable resources
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of garbage classification, in particular to a working area dividing system and method for recycling renewable resources. In the method, a matrix coordinate system is constructed through information of all cells in the project, then a local optimal path L for connecting all cells is obtained in the matrix coordinate system according to a GA gene genetic path planning algorithm, then all cell points in the optimal path L are respectively calculated to be k slices by taking 1,2,3 and n as initial points, and { S  1 ,S 2 ,...,S n  } is respectively formed. And finally, calculating an evaluation index for each group of division schemes to obtain an optimal division scheme. The scheme scientifically divides the working area of the renewable resource garbage collector, and ensures the labor cost balance of project operation and the labor allocation fairness among collectors.

title_en: Electronic commerce platform equity architecture design method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electronic commerce, in particular to a method for designing a stock right architecture of an electronic commerce platform, which comprises a stock holding object module, a stock holding proportion analysis module, a stock right investment module, a stock right interest module and a stock right exit module, wherein the stock right object module is used for storing stock right information; wherein: the stock holding object module comprises a consumer, a manufacturer, an investor, a technical party, a marketer, a manager, a staff member, a starting team and a platform, and is used as a component of the stock holding object module, after a new person joins in the stock holding object module, the stock holding object module is directly input through a platform system, and then the input information is divided into corresponding modules through an automatic distribution module; in the invention, 30% of the customer consumption amount is used as equity investment to share profits and value-added wealth together, so that the customers are promoted, benefit incentive and equity guidance are provided, the trust of the customers is enhanced, the consumption of the customers can be promoted, the income of the customers can be increased while the consumption is carried out, and the development of a platform is promoted.
assignees: XIAN QIANJIUJIAREN IOT NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Regional source load coordination scheduling method considering carbon emission cumulative entropy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a regional source load coordination scheduling method considering carbon emission cumulative entropy, and relates to the field of power system scheduling and management. A regional source load coordinated scheduling method considering carbon emission accumulated entropy comprises the following steps: the energy management system comprises a communication interface module, an energy management optimization module and an algorithm solving module; the communication interface module transmits generator set information and load side information at the power generation side; the energy management optimization module establishes a double-layer optimization scheduling model considering the source-load coordination of the comprehensive cost and the carbon emission cumulative entropy, the double-layer optimization scheduling model comprises an upper layer model and a lower layer model, and the carbon emission generated by the power generation side is reduced to the load side, so that the obtained scheduling scheme can take the fairness of the carbon emission responsibility apportionment of the load side into consideration on the basis of improving the system operation economy. The scheduling scheme provided by the invention can give consideration to the fairness of load side carbon emission responsibility allocation on the basis of improving the system operation economy.

title_en: Queuing scheduling method and device for bank outlets
abstract_en: The invention provides a queuing and scheduling method and device for bank outlets, which can be applied to the financial field or other fields. The queuing and scheduling method for the bank outlets comprises the following steps: acquiring a queuing request of a client; the queuing request comprises request sending time, client information and service type; determining the priority data of the client according to the client information, the website information, the request sending time, the current time and the service type; the ordering data for the client is determined based on the priority data. The invention can give consideration to both efficiency and fairness and improve the service efficiency of the network points.

title_en: Transportation capacity control method, device, equipment and computer readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a capacity management and control method, a capacity management and control device, equipment and a computer readable storage medium, which belong to the technical field of information, and the method comprises the following steps: determining a shift result of the plurality of delivery capacities based on the quality parameters of the plurality of delivery capacities; when a scheduling request for a target freight note is received in a target time period, acquiring a plurality of target freight capacities of which the time period is the target time period based on a scheduling result; and scheduling the delivery capacity for the target freight bill based on the delivery quality parameters of the plurality of target freight capacities. The method accurately controls the scheduling and dispatching of the delivery capacity based on the delivery quality parameters, guarantees the normative and the certainty of the period capacity, and guarantees the fairness of the capacity control strategy, thereby ensuring the quick response of the waybill and improving the service quality of the instant delivery.

title_en: Multi-supply-point emergency material address selection optimization method considering timeliness and fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-supply-point emergency material site selection optimization method considering timeliness and fairness, which comprises the steps of sequentially constructing material supply points, temporary distribution centers, disaster areas and damaged roads, constructing a multi-target emergency material distribution model, constructing an initialization individual strategy, constructing a mutation operator and a local search operator based on the initialization individual strategy, constructing a selection strategy and an acceptance criterion, combining the mutation operator and the local search operator, outputting an optimal operator, evaluating the optimal operator and outputting an optimal scheme for emergency distribution. The invention provides a double-target multi-supply-point emergency material site selection distribution model, wherein in the model, the influence of disasters on a road network is considered, so that the concept of waiting time is provided, meanwhile, in order to make the distribution result more fair, the concept of lowest distribution material is introduced, a related calculation method is introduced, and the problem domain design of the emergency disaster relief material problem is completed.

title_en: Multi-objective optimization-based construction industry carbon emission weight quota method
abstract_en: The invention provides a building industry carbon emission right quota method based on multi-objective optimization, which is oriented to the distribution of the carbon emission right in the building industry, fully considers the multi-objective fairness principle including equal definition, historical responsibility and payment capacity, and provides a more reasonable carbon emission right distribution scheme. Firstly, determining the total carbon quota of the construction industry; secondly, quota allocation is carried out based on a single target; finally, obtaining multi-target weight by adopting a maximum deviation method, carrying out quota allocation based on a multi-target optimized view angle, and carrying out fairness measurement by adopting a Gini coefficient method; the method can solve the problem of one-sidedness of the carbon emission right quota of the building industry aiming at a single target, and fully embodies the fairness and scientificity of the distribution scheme.

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a resource allocation method, a device, an electronic device and a storage medium, the method comprising: responding to a resource allocation request sent by a target terminal, and determining a target account corresponding to the resource allocation request; updating the information of the allocated account according to the target account; under the condition that the updated allocated account information meets a first preset condition, updating allocated terminal information according to the target terminal; under the condition that the updated allocated terminal information meets a second preset condition, determining resources to be allocated corresponding to the target account and the target terminal; and determining a current resource inventory, and distributing the resources to be distributed to the target account under the condition that the current resource inventory and the resources to be distributed meet a third preset condition. By utilizing the technical scheme provided by the embodiment of the disclosure, fairness and accuracy of resource allocation can be ensured, and meanwhile, efficiency of resource allocation is effectively improved.
assignees: BEIJING DAJIA INTERCONNECTION INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Energy internet bidirectional auction optimization regulation and control method based on multi-time-slot network flow
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy Internet optimization, in particular to an energy Internet bidirectional auction optimization regulation method based on multi-time-slot network flow, which comprises the steps of obtaining market member declaration information and power distribution network related information, and establishing a target optimization function based on maximized social benefit; the method comprises the steps of converting an optimization problem into a minimum cost maximum flow problem, constructing a network flow model of the minimum cost maximum flow problem, solving the minimum cost maximum flow problem to carry out market clearing, obtaining one-to-one matched achievement of electricity purchasing and selling parties, dynamically describing a market balancing process more clearly and transparently, introducing a decrement transaction mechanism to ensure excitation compatibility of the mechanism, eliminating invalid achievement on the basis of market marginal price, and calculating to obtain full-cost electricity price on the basis of the market marginal price and the distribution cost between the achievement. And finally, the energy internet bidirectional auction optimization regulation method which takes benefit and fairness into consideration is formed.

title_en: Regional fairness oriented power integrated operation and maintenance task and resource scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a region fairness oriented power integrated operation and maintenance task and resource scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: inputting non-sensitive input data into a variational automatic encoder for conversion to obtain mean value and variance data, constructing simulated Gaussian distribution, randomly sampling from the Gaussian distribution to obtain characterization features, dividing the characterization features into a zx part and a za part, fitting power integration operation and maintenance task and resource scheduling acceptance data by using the characterization features, fitting sensitive input data by using the za part data, and training by generating a countermeasure network, so that the independence of the zx part and the za part is improved, and finally, the output zx part is used as fair coding features with sensitive input removed to be input into a regression network, and further, an electric quantity demand prediction value is obtained. The scheduling method provided by the invention processes the data characteristics of the to-be-called areas by adopting a data representation method in deep learning, so that the operation and maintenance tasks and the resource scheduling have fairness among the areas.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Consistency scoring method and system for subjective content
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for scoring consistency of subjective content, which relate to the field of big data mining and analysis, and the method comprises the following steps: calculating the scoring probability of the scoring personnel for the scored objects of different grades by using historical scoring data; calculating the grading distribution of the grading personnel for the graded objects of different grades by utilizing historical grading data; calculating scoring differences among scoring personnel according to the scoring distribution, and selecting a plurality of scoring personnel with the scoring distribution differences larger than a distribution threshold value to form scoring groups; the method comprises the steps of obtaining the score of each scoring person to be scored in a scoring group, and calculating the reliability of the score given by each scoring person according to the scoring probability of each scoring person; and correcting the score of each scoring person according to the credibility of the score given by the scoring person to serve as the final score of the scoring person. The method solves the problems that in subjective content evaluation, the evaluation result is greatly influenced by subjective experience and judgment of evaluation personnel, and fairness and authenticity are difficult to guarantee.

title_en: Exercise data processing method and apparatus in equity incentive, device, medium, and product
abstract_en: The present application provides an exercise data processing method and apparatus in equity incentive, a device, a medium, and a product. The method comprises: acquiring a stock deduction exercise request sent by a target client, the stock deduction exercise request comprising a target exercise quantity; and allocating stocks of a target quantity in an account to be vested to an employee account of the target client, updating the quantity of stocks in the employee account according to the target quantity, transferring the stocks of the target quantity in the account to be vested to a vested account, and updating the quantity of stocks in the vested account according to the target quantity, wherein the target quantity is determined by the target exercise quantity and the quantity of stocks used for deducting exercise cost corresponding to the target exercise quantity, the account to be vested is used for escrowing stocks which are not actually allocated to an employee, and the vested account is used for escrowing stocks which are actually allocated to an employee. Thus, the security and accuracy of exercise data during the exercise of employees are improved, the security of an exercise mode of deducting some stocks is ensured, and the stock transaction efficiency is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN FUTU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent building virtual machine management and control system based on Internet of things perception and block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent building virtual machine management and control system based on internet of things perception and a block chain, which comprises independent buildings and virtual energy station platforms, wherein the virtual energy station platforms are provided with main nodes and play a role in issuing instructions and supervising, each independent building is provided with a block chain node, a plurality of independent buildings are connected with each other and are connected with the main nodes to form the block chain, and each block chain node stores all data information in the whole block chain; when the main node of the virtual energy station platform issues a power grid scheduling instruction, after each building node receives information, the intelligent contract is triggered, and the energy flow strategy is executed according to the intelligent contract to complete an energy flow event. The invention applies the block chain technology, integrates and implements a novel electric power transaction mode which is more reasonable, more information-transparent and stronger in transaction fairness, and realizes that resources such as building adjustable load, green electricity and the like participate in the marketized transaction of the power grid.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;STATE GRID SHANGHAI INTEGRATED ENERGY SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for distributing initial water right of river basin across provinces
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for distributing initial water right of a river basin across provinces, wherein the method comprises the following steps: reading water resource survey data of river basin crossing provinces, and obtaining and analyzing a representative hydrological series capable of reflecting withering changes and current underlying surface conditions; acquiring basic data of river basin across provinces, wherein the basic data comprises water resource development and utilization data, economic and social data and ecological environment data; obtaining an evaluation index of an evaluation index system for constructing initial water resource distribution across provinces, rivers and watersheds, and reducing the evaluation index; and constructing an SMAA-VIKOR initial water weight distribution model, solving, and obtaining the initial water weight distribution proportion of each provincial administrative region. The invention can improve the water resource distribution precision and fairness across provincial river basins.

title_en: Distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method based on a block chain, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distributed photovoltaic energy storage configuration block chain architecture, and carrying out block chain uplink and storage on user data; establishing a storage allocation demand degree assessment mechanism based on the user data, and acquiring the storage allocation demand degree of the user; and triggering an intelligent contract to generate a distribution and storage scheme and distribution and storage rights and interests based on the distribution and storage demand of the user, and selecting the distribution and storage scheme by the user to distribute and install the energy storage device. The invention establishes a public transparent distributed photovoltaic distribution and storage method by using a blockchain, takes real user data as an evaluation standard, preferentially provides the shortage of energy storage batteries for users with high distribution and storage requirements, greatly improves fairness of the distribution and storage process, reduces resource waste caused by improper competition, and contributes to accelerating the reasonable distribution and storage construction of distributed photovoltaic and realizing a double-carbon target.

title_en: Method for evaluating bus running condition
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for evaluating bus running conditions, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining a bus running condition evaluation object; s2, acquiring the cumulative frequency distribution of the bus travel speed of the evaluation object; s3, determining an ideal speed absolute level value of the evaluation object; s4, calculating a bus running condition evaluation index of an evaluation object, namely a bus smooth running index; and S5, outputting the operation condition grade of the evaluation object. The invention provides an evaluation index of a bus smoothness index aiming at the problem that the existing bus running condition evaluation method is lack of objective fairness and universality, reflects the degradation degree of the actual running condition of the bus relative to the ideal running condition, and overcomes the influence of time (natural day) heterogeneity and space (city road network, line and road section) heterogeneity on the value stability of the evaluation index and the objective fairness of the bus running condition evaluation result.

title_en: NCFI carbon emission responsibility allocation method and device considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a NCFI carbon emission responsibility allocation method, a NCFI carbon emission responsibility allocation device, an electronic device and a readable storage medium, which consider fairness. The allocation device comprises a power flow distribution acquisition module, an original allocation result acquisition module, an allocation fairness interval acquisition module, an original satisfaction acquisition module and a satisfaction optimization adjustment module. The satisfaction optimization adjustment module comprises an original satisfaction calculation module, a first satisfaction optimization adjustment module and a second satisfaction optimization adjustment module. According to the invention, on one hand, the historical emission responsibility of the load nodes and the individual development opportunities can be better related to the carbon emission responsibility of the nodes, on the premise of not changing the total responsibility allocation amount, fairness is considered, the phenomenon of fairness deficiency of an allocation scheme is avoided, on the other hand, the responsibility allocation amount of most load nodes is reduced on the basis of reasonable and feasible allocation results, effective data support is provided for the establishment of an enterprise carbon reduction strategy, and the method has important significance for economic coordinated development.

title_en: Average distribution method and system based on post-loan overdue piece average sum
abstract_en: The invention discloses a post-loan overdue item average amount distribution method and system, and relates to the technical field of financial analysis. The method comprises the following steps: recording daily case condition information of each operator; counting the average value of the piece average money of each operator; sorting the distribution priority of the operators according to the average value of the piece average money of each operator to obtain the distribution priority sequence of each operator; obtaining and calculating a threshold value according to the information of the case to be distributed; sorting the cases to be distributed; sequentially distributing each sequenced case to be distributed to the corresponding operator according to the distribution priority sequence of each operator; after each operator finishes the distribution, judging whether the amount of money in the distributed case exceeds a threshold value, and if not, continuing the distribution; otherwise, the allocation is ended. The invention can improve the distribution uniformity and fairness rationality, thereby improving the processing efficiency of operators.

title_en: Water resource distribution method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a water resource allocation method and system. The method comprises the steps of firstly obtaining predicted water resource distribution amount of each industry in a region, and then obtaining weight index composition and weight index relation of water resource distribution of each industry in each region in the region based on a fair principle according to conditions such as population, land and economic and social development. And finally, acquiring the planned water resource allocation amount of each industry in each region again according to the predicted water resource allocation amount and the weight index of each industry in the region. When the method and the device are used for distributing the water resources in the region, social attributes such as population, land and economic social development conditions can be embodied, time attributes are considered, the difference of water resource distribution in time can be reflected, and new ideas and bases are provided for water resource management. The water resource distribution method and the water resource distribution system avoid the situation that multiple water resources are constantly and much in water resource distribution, the fairness of development opportunities in all regions is reflected, and the situation that the development of local economy and society is restricted due to unfair water resource distribution is reduced.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Multi-class cheating identification and traceability analysis method for network security CTF competition
abstract_en: The invention relates to a network security CTF competition multi-class cheating identification and traceability analysis method, and belongs to the technical field of network security. The method comprises the steps of firstly monitoring a player match answering process and recording logs, then analyzing logically abnormal players of an answering step by using a finite state machine, judging the abnormal players when the answering step is used based on normal distribution, providing a player relevance calculating method according to flag submitting time, finding suspected high-similarity players, analyzing and tracing cheating sources of the players, finally collecting and comprehensively judging the answering logs of the suspected players Writeup in new and old environments, and outputting cheating identification results and analysis reports. The method effectively identifies cheating behaviors of replacing the marks or solving the problem of other players in the CTF competition, positions the suspected similar players, can collect multi-dimensional characteristic comprehensive comparison analysis of the suspected players, outputs more convincing judging results and cheating analysis reports, and ensures fairness of the competition.

title_en: Scientific and technological project and achievement evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating scientific and technological projects and achievements, and relates to the technical field of information. The scientific and technological project and result evaluation method comprises the following steps: s1: and (4) auditing setting, namely firstly setting the reviewing party by a reviewing manager at the terminal, and then sending a reviewing notice to each reviewing terminal, wherein the reviewing party setting comprises a project to be reviewed, a reviewer, a reviewing manager, a reviewing principal, a billing rule, a voting rule and a reward rule. According to the scientific and technological project and result evaluation method and system, the evaluation voting results of the project to be evaluated are subjected to statistical sorting, and the allocation of rewards and the results of the statistical sorting are combined, so that the final reward result corresponds to the voting result, the reward quantity is set according to the proportion of the reward, the requirements of different voters are met, the evaluation efficiency and fairness are improved, and the evaluation work is more truly popular, standardized and scientific.
assignees: SHANDONG SHUIMU QINGQING INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scientific and technological thesis introduced quality evaluation method based on introduced frequency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a guided frequency-based scientific and technological paper guided quality evaluation method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of determining an induced quality influence factor index of a paper: a single introduced position factor M of the introduced paper A, a form factor f of the introduced paper B, a journal grade factor lambda of the introduced paper B, and an introduced rate Y of the paper A; secondly, parameterization schemes of influence degrees of the M, f and lambda influence factors are determined respectively; calculating an influence factor index; establishing a mathematical model of the guided quality assessment index of the scientific and technological paper: obtaining a quality evaluation index Q = Mf lambda of the scientific and technological paper introduced in a single time according to the influence factor index  k  Y, and further obtaining the introduced quality evaluation index of the introduced paper A introduced for N times Q     N    . The method can objectively and comprehensively calculate the introduced quality of the scientific and technological paper, eliminate the limitation that the influence of a single paper is evaluated only by the introduced frequency in a mainstream, and optimize the paper quality evaluation schemeThe fairness and the reliability of the quality evaluation result of the paper are effectively improved.
assignees: NORTHWEST INSTITUTE ECO ENVIRONMENT & RESOURCES CAS

title_en: Multi-express-item centralized sorting and scheduling method based on customer behavior evaluation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a centralized sorting and scheduling method for a plurality of express deliveries based on customer behavior evaluation, which is realized by the following steps: a) Building a sorting reservation scheduling system: setting up an online express sorting reservation system for an enterprise needing sorting express; b) Information recording and identification: uploading basic information of an express centralized sorting center, including express sorting speed, work time table and unit time cost; c) Processing the communication problem; d) Customer behavior scoring: grading according to the historical behaviors of the enterprises needing to sort the express, and judging the unit time deposit needing to be paid; e) Sorting and scheduling express; f) Feedback settlement and delivery. According to the centralized sorting and scheduling method for the multiple express deliveries, restriction can be formed on two parties through the customer behavior scoring and the feedback, the fairness and the rationality of sorting and scheduling are guaranteed while the cost is reduced and the efficiency is improved, and the overall cooperative effect of centralized sorting is exerted to the maximum extent.
assignees: ZHEJIANG MINGKE INTELLIGENT LOGISTICS EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Sampling investigation method and system considering distribution balance of power market members
abstract_en: The sampling investigation method and the system for considering the distribution balance of the power market members are characterized by selecting information showing the distribution of the power market members, including power consumption information, distribution coordinates and area information, calculating corresponding quantitative balance indexes based on the information to further obtain distance sums, and screening to obtain sampling investigation results considering the distribution balance of the power market members by adopting a mode of combining the distance sums with penalty functions. The invention has more stable effect in maintaining regional fairness and transaction electric quantity fairness, so that the obtained questionnaire is more typical, can fully reflect the overall situation of the electric power market, and can modify weight parameters according to requirements to obtain more targeted results.

title_en: Airport group flight time optimization method and device, storage medium and terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for optimizing airport group flight moments, a storage medium and a terminal. The optimization method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the following steps: establishing an airport group flight time optimization model based on absolute fairness; step two: solving the airport group flight time optimization model based on the absolute fairness, and performing airport group flight time optimization distribution according to the solving result. The invention makes the capacity limit and transit time limit of the airport and the waypoint as constraint conditions, sets up a dual-objective optimization model by taking the minimum target value of the overall fairness of the airport group and the minimum total offset of the flight time as targets, and respectively makes the capacity limit constraint of 5 minutes and 15 minutes for the airport and the waypoint, thereby enabling the optimization result to be more accurate and the flight time to be distributed more uniformly.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating relationship between financial asset allocation and equity capital cost
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating a relationship between financial asset allocation and equity capital cost, and relates to the technical field of mining the relationship between the financial asset allocation and the equity capital cost. Firstly, determining evaluation variables of the relationship between long-term financial asset allocation and equity capital cost; then, establishing an evaluation model of the relationship between various long-term financial asset configurations and equity capital costs by adopting a common least square method based on evaluation variables, and carrying out reliability test on the evaluation model; and finally, obtaining an evaluation result of the relationship between the long-term financial asset configuration degree and the equity capital cost of the enterprise to be evaluated based on the inspected multiple evaluation models. Compared with the prior art, the method can more comprehensively and accurately evaluate the relationship between the long-term financial asset allocation and the equity capital cost of the enterprise, thereby being beneficial to a manager to reasonably allocate the scale of the long-term financial asset.

title_en: Management method and device capable of reducing credit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management method and a device capable of reducing a credit limit, and relates to the technical field of financial computers. One embodiment of the method comprises: acquiring first transaction data for sale limitation of one or more transaction accounts and deduction transaction data and/or interest change data corresponding to the first transaction data; registering the transaction data according to the transaction source of the transaction data to obtain second transaction data which corresponds to the transaction source and is sold without limitation; adjusting the second transaction data according to the withheld transaction data and/or the equity change data; and determining the target reducible credit line corresponding to each transaction account according to the adjusted second transaction data. According to the embodiment, more accurate second transaction data under different transaction sources can be obtained, and then target reducible credits of each transaction account under different transaction sources are obtained, so that the reducible credits can be reasonably distributed conveniently.
assignees: CHINA SECURITIES REGISTRATION CLEARING CO LTD

title_en: Renewable resource recovery sheet dividing method for identifying aggregation unit and gravity center region
abstract_en: The invention relates to a k-piece dividing method for identifying an aggregation unit and a working gravity center area. According to the scheme, computer simulation division is adopted, related data in the project related range is set first, and a simulation matrix map is constructed through riding distance. In the running process, the original K clusters are divided, the original point positions are scattered into K rho aggregation subunits and H discrete subunits based on the set subunit unit coefficients rho, and the non-gravity units at the edges are continuously absorbed and combined based on the gravity units until the required quantity of the integrated aggregation subunits is greater than or equal to the human effect of the subunits. And finally distributing the obtained partition division result K+H based on the scheme, wherein K is the number of aggregation subunits, and H is the number of discrete partition units. Therefore, the responsible areas of the collectors can be reasonably divided, on one hand, the workload of the collectors is basically consistent, fairness is guaranteed, on the other hand, the cells are covered as much as possible, and the minimum number of the residual discrete units is guaranteed.

title_en: Distributed energy storage and power scheduling method and device based on master-slave game
abstract_en: The embodiment of the disclosure provides a distributed energy storage and power scheduling method and device based on master-slave gaming, and relates to the field of power distribution network operation analysis. The method comprises the following steps: a master-slave game scheduling model is established according to a game relationship between the power distribution network and the micro-grid, wherein the master-slave game scheduling model comprises a power distribution network operation model, a micro-grid operation model and game variable constraint; and solving the master-slave game scheduling model according to a particle swarm algorithm, and determining a power distribution network optimization efficient operation strategy under the condition of maximum benefits of the power distribution network and the micro-grid. In this way, the optimal efficient operation strategy of the distribution network and the distribution network with the largest gain of the micro-grid can be formulated, the efficient consumption of renewable energy sources is promoted to the greatest extent, the maximum benefit of each distribution network operator and the micro-grid is ensured, and the market fairness is improved.
assignees: STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;STATE GRID HEBEI ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method for controlling two-stage flexible climbing capacity of heat pump virtual power plant day-day before day
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for controlling the dual-stage flexible climbing capacity of a heat pump virtual power plant in the day-ahead and day, which comprises the following steps: acquiring parameters required by the flexible climbing capability of the single heat pump based on a cloud-side-end heat pump virtual power plant architecture, and establishing a flexible climbing capability assessment model of the single heat pump by utilizing an affine mathematical theory and considering the uncertainty of outdoor temperature and illumination intensity; on the basis of a single heat pump flexible climbing capacity evaluation model, a heat pump cluster virtual power plant day-ahead flexible climbing capacity evaluation model is constructed, and a climbing capacity boundary is provided for the next day of issuing flexible climbing demands of the power system; and establishing a virtual power plant flexible climbing capacity correction model in the daily stage, correcting the daily flexible climbing capacity of the virtual power plant in a rolling manner, and distributing climbing demands among the heat pumps based on a maximum-minimum fairness algorithm.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD MARKETING SERVICE CENTER

title_en: Peak regulation expense allocation method considering new energy consumption responsibility at electricity utilization side
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak regulation expense allocation method considering new energy consumption responsibility at the electricity utilization side, which comprises the steps of firstly, analyzing peak regulation auxiliary rules in northeast areas, and establishing a 'step' peak regulation auxiliary service expense rapid calculation model; then, analyzing peak regulation values of all participants in a peak regulation market according to a shape marginal contribution theory, establishing a peak regulation cost allocation model at two sides of the power generation, and allocating the peak regulation cost allocation problem in the power generation side according to the mode of the on-line electric quantity ratio; for the problem of peak regulation expense allocation in the electricity utilization side, the unmatched degree of load electricity utilization and new energy power generation is checked by setting fluctuation trend difference coefficient and waveform amplitude difference coefficient parameters, so that unbalanced electricity consumption is calculated, and the respective peak regulation auxiliary service expense bearing amount is determined; the method provided by the invention can simultaneously ensure fairness and economy of the system and provide reference basis for power grid dispatching on the basis of improving the new energy consumption level of the system.

title_en: Shared energy storage cost allocation method based on collaborative playing and cost causal relationship
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shared energy storage cost allocation method based on collaborative games and cost causal relation, which belongs to the technical field of electrical engineering, and aims at the current situation that the shared energy storage cost allocation of a community at the current stage is unreasonable, and simultaneously, in order to reduce the cost of community energy storage construction, the shared energy storage is used as a flexible resource, and a main body in the community performs cost allocation according to the collaborative games, firstly, the operation and the cost allocation of an ES are considered together through the cost causal relation and the form of the collaborative games so as to realize the maximization of economic benefit; then, the traditional shape model is improved by utilizing the principle based on cost causal relationship; and finally, obtaining the allocation value allocated to each main body according to the improved cost allocation model. The invention can fairly distribute the energy storage cost among community bodies, the calculated amount of the improved shape model is reduced, and the fairness can be ensured.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Interaction method of comprehensive energy micro-grid group based on dynamic energy price and non-cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention relates to an interaction method of a comprehensive energy micro-grid group based on dynamic energy price and non-cooperative game, which comprises the following steps: setting an integrated energy micro-grid group energy interaction strategy containing an energy interaction service provider EIP; constructing a dynamic energy price mechanism of the supply-demand relationship; taking the lowest running cost of the comprehensive energy micro-grid as an optimization target, and constructing a comprehensive energy micro-grid model based on various constraint conditions; establishing a non-cooperative game model based on the comprehensive energy micro-grid, the interaction strategy and the comprehensive energy micro-grid model; and the comprehensive energy micro-grid group performs energy interaction according to the solving result of the non-cooperative game model. Compared with the prior art, the invention establishes a non-cooperative game framework of the comprehensive energy micro-grid group, considers each comprehensive energy micro-grid as an equal participant, and ensures the fairness of the game process by the energy interactive price determined by all participants together, and designs a dynamic energy price mechanism to excite the enthusiasm of each micro-grid for comprehensive demand response.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Automatic scheduling algorithm based on rule constraint
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic scheduling algorithm based on rule constraint, which comprises the following steps: respectively constructing a nursing staff set according to the nursing staff level; estimating the number of different levels of nursing staff required by each team in a scheduling period according to the number of actual inpatients and the condition of the patients; creating a combination enumerator of nursing staff at different levels, and generating a scheduling combination of the current shift; checking the original scheduling data according to the constraint conditions; outputting the scheduling data when the checking is passed, and repeating the previous step after the original scheduling data is adjusted when the checking is not passed; according to the invention, the original scheduling data is subjected to the preset constraint condition test, the scheduling data which accords with the constraint condition is directly output, the constraint condition test is carried out after the adjustment is carried out on the scheduling data which does not accord with the constraint condition, the scheduling data which accords with the constraint condition after the adjustment is output, and the working time of nursing staff can be improved and the fairness of scheduling can be improved through the limitation of the constraint condition.
assignees: SUZHOU DERPIN MEDICAL SCIENCE & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Distribution channel management system and method of heterogeneous cooperation platform
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution channel management system and a distribution channel management method of a heterogeneous cooperation platform. In the commodity transaction process, the management platform carries out auditing on the commodity platform through the management module, the commodity auditing module carries out auditing on the commodity platform during auditing, the commodity auditing module carries out order auditing on the commodity, the auditing content can avoid the condition of merchant bill swiping, the logistics auditing module carries out qualification auditing on the delivery logistics units, the timeliness and the safety of logistics delivery are ensured, the commodity payment is saved through the commodity payment agent module, and the fairness of the transaction of both parties is ensured.

title_en: Method for selecting site and rescuing material reserve station in city
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for selecting a disaster relief material reserve station in a city, which comprises the steps of S1, inputting relevant data of the city of the disaster relief material reserve station to be selected, S2, acquiring data characteristics based on the relevant data of the city of the disaster relief material reserve station to be selected, wherein the data characteristics comprise population distribution characteristics, urban road network structure characteristics, urban infrastructure space position information characteristics, geographic information characteristics and urban POI data characteristics, and S3, screening an optimal area in the city based on the data characteristics, a preset site selection model and a preset rule to serve as the disaster relief material reserve station of the city.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle wireless charging service optimization method and system based on game theory
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for optimizing wireless charging service of an unmanned aerial vehicle based on game theory, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a wireless charging service model of the unmanned aerial vehicle based on single-master multi-slave Stackelberg game; setting initial total rewards of wireless charging service of the terminal by taking the maximization of utility function of the terminal as a target; setting initial charging strategies for wireless charging service to the terminals according to initial total rewards of the wireless charging service and respective electric energy loss by taking the maximization of respective utility functions of each unmanned aerial vehicle as targets; solving the Stackelberg equilibrium of the unmanned aerial vehicle wireless charging service model by using a reverse induction method; and finally, the charging service platform dispatches a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles with charging will to provide wireless charging service for the terminal; according to the invention, the energy transaction between the terminal and the unmanned aerial vehicle is planned from the game theory perspective, so that the individuality of the unmanned aerial vehicle is endowed and the fairness of the energy transaction process is ensured.

title_en: Customer service scheduling optimization method, customer service scheduling optimization device, customer service scheduling optimization equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a customer service scheduling optimization method, a customer service scheduling optimization device, customer service scheduling optimization equipment and a storage medium, wherein business volume prediction information and business processing information of customer service personnel are obtained; iterating the preset scheduling optimization model according to the traffic prediction information and the traffic processing information by using a preset particle swarm optimization algorithm to obtain a customer service scheduling scheme of each iteration; calculating an objective function of customer service personnel under a customer service scheduling scheme based on a preset fatigue index model and a preset fairness index model, wherein the objective function comprises fatigue index data and fairness index data; and if the objective function reaches the minimum value, determining the corresponding customer service scheduling scheme when the objective function reaches the minimum value as a target customer service scheduling scheme. Therefore, the computer is utilized to optimize the customer service scheduling through an optimization algorithm, the scheduling efficiency is improved, fatigue and fairness are considered in an optimization model to quantify the workload of customer service staff, and the scheduling result is more reasonable.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;CUSTOMER SERVICE CENTER OF GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Task dispatch method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a task dispatch method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the following steps: under the condition of receiving a task request, determining at least one user to receive a task corresponding to the task request in a preset range of a task place; determining index parameters corresponding to each user based on preset indexes, wherein the index parameters comprise weight values and historical index values of each index; determining the grading value of each user through a good-bad solution distance method according to the index parameters corresponding to each user; and according to the grading value, sending the task corresponding to the task request to the user with the highest grading value. The embodiment ensures fairness of task dispatch.

title_en: Energy distribution system and method applied to hybrid energy storage
