abstract_en: The invention provides an energy distribution system and method applied to hybrid energy storage, wherein the system comprises: the first state information acquisition module is used for acquiring first state information of an energy supply end for supplying energy to the hybrid energy storage bin; an energy supply reservation opportunity determining module, configured to determine whether to enter an energy supply allocation reservation opportunity based on the first state information; the second state information acquisition module is used for acquiring second state information of an energy utilization end for energy supply of the hybrid energy storage bin if the second state information is yes; the energy supply reservation scheme making module is used for making an energy supply distribution reservation scheme based on the second state information; and the energy supply distribution control module is used for correspondingly controlling the energy supply of the hybrid energy storage bin to the energy utilization end based on an energy supply distribution reservation scheme. According to the invention, a manager does not need to determine the electric energy distribution scheme, so that the labor cost is reduced, the system automatically formulates the electric energy distribution scheme when determining to enter the energy supply distribution reservation time, and the timeliness of determining the electric energy distribution scheme is further improved.

title_en: Water supply allocation system based on flow data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water supply allocation system based on flow data, which comprises an intelligent decision module, a big data algorithm center module and a sub-station monitoring transmission module, wherein the intelligent decision module and the big data algorithm center device are connected with each other, the sub-station monitoring transmission module is respectively connected with the intelligent decision module and the big data algorithm center module, and the sub-station monitoring transmission module can carry out monitoring control and related data acquisition feedback transmission on water supply equipment, a flowmeter and a water quality monitoring device which are contained in a corresponding sub-station of the water supply system, and can transmit instructions of the intelligent decision module to the corresponding water supply equipment, the flowmeter and the water quality monitoring device. The invention solves the problems that the traditional water supply system relies on personnel experience judgment, and the water quantity of the water supply network is allocated by manually issuing the regulation and control instruction, so that the allocation of the water supply system network has great subjective dependence on personnel and is seriously limited by personnel professional level and experience reserve.
assignees: ANHUI SHUNYU WATER AFFAIRS CO LTD

title_en: Irrigation district water distribution method considering water resource allocation and canal system water distribution bidirectional mutual feedback influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses an irrigation district water distribution method considering water resource allocation and canal system water distribution bidirectional mutual feedback influence, which is implemented as follows: step 1, collecting data required by the text; 2. distributing the wool water distribution amount in different water consumption departments in different areas; step 3, distributing water for each water department to each secondary channel; step 4, establishing a canal system optimization water distribution model, wherein decision variables are canal water distribution flow and water distribution starting time, and the objective is that the canal leakage loss is minimum and the water distribution duration is shortest; step 5, calculating water leakage loss of each water department in each region; step 6, calculating the net water distribution amount; step 7, configuring a model for water resources, wherein a decision variable is net water distribution amount, and a target function is water supply benefit and fairness; and 8, summarizing the indexes to obtain a water distribution scheme. The invention solves the problem that only water resource allocation is considered to influence a canal system water distribution list in the prior water distribution technology, and provides a water distribution method considering the water resource allocation and the canal system optimization water distribution mutual feedback influence.
assignees: BEIJING LESHUI XINYUAN INTELLIGENT WATER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: classifying the preset users according to the historical verification information to determine a first user and a second user; training a preset neural network model according to the first user, the second user and the historical verification information corresponding to the first user and the second user to obtain a resource verification probability model; determining a resource allocation strategy according to the resource verification probability model, wherein the resource allocation strategy comprises target resource characteristics and allocation scene characteristics; and updating the resources of the target user according to the resource allocation strategy. According to the method, the objectivity and fairness of resource allocation are guaranteed, meanwhile, the target user can obtain the resources which meet the requirements of the target user, the using effect of the resources is improved, and the loyalty of the user is enhanced.

title_en: Industrial load equal proportion-based load index distribution method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of electric power, and particularly relates to a load index distribution method and device based on industrial load equal proportion, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an industrial load total value of a target area in a power limiting period, predicting the highest power consumption load according to climate parameters of the next day, and determining power supply parameters of the next day according to power sources in the target area; and distributing load indexes according to the total value of the power limiting load parameters and the industrial load, and sharing the power limiting indexes according to the industrial load proportion of each city, wherein the cities with high industrial load share the power limiting indexes, and the cities with low industrial load bear little power limiting indexes, so that the fairness of the power limiting of the industrial load is ensured, and the realization of the aim that civil power consumption is not limited in the period of limited power supply capacity and power shortage is ensured.

title_en: Resource distribution method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource issuing method, a resource issuing device, a storage medium and computer equipment. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring a resource verification user and a preset resource; comparing the user characteristics of the resource verification user and the target user, and determining a first similarity between the resource verification user and the target user; comparing the resource characteristics of the preset resource with the resource characteristics of the history resource corresponding to the first user, and determining a second similarity between the preset resource and the history resource; determining the verification probability of the target user relative to the preset resource according to the first similarity and the second similarity; and distributing the preset resources to a target user according to the resource verification probability. According to the method, automatic dynamic resource allocation can be realized without training of a network model, objective and fairness of resource allocation are guaranteed, a target user can obtain resources which meet requirements of the target user, the use effect of the resources and shopping experience of the user are improved, and the loyalty of the user is enhanced.

title_en: New energy power system source load carbon tax allocation method based on carbon responsibility factors
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for allocating source charge carbon tax of a new energy power system based on carbon responsibility factors, which comprises the steps of S1, confirming carbon emission responsibility of a renewable energy unit based on a carbon emission flow CEF model, S2, confirming carbon emission responsibility analysis of an energy storage unit based on the carbon emission flow CEF model, S3, confirming source charge double-side carbon responsibility factors of the new energy, S4, allocating source charge double-side carbon tax in a new energy scene based on the carbon responsibility factors, namely tracking footprint of carbon flow in a power grid based on the carbon emission flow CEF model, reflecting the carbon emission responsibility of the source charge double-side carbon, and allocating carbon emission responsibility amount born by the source charge in a carbon tax form. Compared with the prior art, the method can reasonably distribute the carbon emission responsibility to the two sides of the source load containing the new energy, realizes the reasonable fairness of the carbon emission responsibility distribution of the high-proportion new energy power system, and can excite the two sides of the source load to reduce the emission in the resource optimization operation and configuration problems.

title_en: Metering method, metering device and metering equipment for classified load electric quantity of distributed photovoltaic power generation
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a metering method, a metering device and metering equipment for classified load electric quantity of distributed photovoltaic power generation. The method comprises the steps of setting electric quantity metering points for all distributed photovoltaic power generation modes respectively, determining the running mode of the load electric quantity of a distributed photovoltaic power generation user in response to the fact that classified electric loads exist, calculating the electric quantity of each electric quantity metering point corresponding to the determined running mode based on the determined running mode, and determining the classified electric load electric quantity of the distributed photovoltaic power generation user based on the electric quantity of each electric quantity metering point. The embodiment realizes the accuracy of classified electricity load metering, and further realizes the accuracy of classified electricity price electricity load metering, thereby meeting the requirement of metering fairness and fairness.

title_en: Photovoltaic cluster batch control system and method for low-voltage transformer area
abstract_en: The invention relates to a photovoltaic cluster batch control system for a low-voltage transformer area, which comprises a dispatching master station, an edge side proxy substation and field controllable equipment, wherein the dispatching master station comprises a dispatching master station and a dispatching master station control unit, wherein the dispatching master station comprises a dispatching master station control unit, a dispatching master station control unit and a dispatching master station control unit, wherein the dispatching master station comprises a dispatching master station control unit, and a dispatching master: the edge side proxy substation communicates with the field controllable equipment in a downlink communication mode, collects the running state and power of the field controllable equipment, and sends opening and closing instructions to the field controllable equipment, wherein the opening instructions cut off the field controllable equipment, and the closing instructions grid-connect the field controllable equipment; and the edge side proxy substation communicates with the dispatching master station in an uplink communication mode to send the total power of the station area, the number of the photovoltaic switches put into the station area, the total photovoltaic power of the station area and the actual photovoltaic power removal value, and receives the photovoltaic power removal target value sent by the dispatching master station. The invention reduces the decision calculation amount of the dispatching master station, balances the cut-off times of each photovoltaic user and ensures the fairness of each photovoltaic user for receiving dispatching control.
assignees: STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;QUANZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID FUJIAN ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method and device for constructing virtual power plant cost allocation model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for constructing a virtual power plant cost distribution model, wherein the method comprises the following steps: obtaining basic parameters; establishing an internal cost distribution model of the virtual power plant through a cooperative game theory, wherein the model comprises an objective function and constraint conditions; substituting the basic parameters into the model, solving the model with the goal of highest stability of the virtual power plant cooperation alliance, highest fairness of the virtual power plant internal cost allocation and highest attraction of members participating in the virtual power plant, and outputting the virtual power plant internal cost allocation scheme. According to the invention, the goals of benefit distribution fairness, the participation stability of each member in the cooperation alliance and the attraction of the participation members are fully considered, so that each participation member can obtain satisfactory benefit distribution, and the participation stability of each member in the virtual power plant alliance is improved. The benefit distribution method for each participation member in the virtual power plant provided by the invention can effectively encourage the production and marketing type users to participate in the cooperation of the virtual power plant.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, storage medium and computer equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device, a storage medium and computer equipment. According to the method, three aspects of user characteristics, resource characteristics and scene characteristics are used as reference bases for resource allocation, so that objective and fairness of resource allocation are guaranteed, a target user can obtain resources which meet requirements of the target user, the use effect of the resources can be improved, the total amount of the transaction can be improved, a proper preferential policy can be provided for the user, shopping experience of the user is improved, and loyalty of the user is further enhanced; and a tree structure of model sample feature classification is constructed based on feature engineering, and model sample features with obvious influence are screened out from a plurality of feature dimensions through splitting gains, so that a judging rule on a service is assisted to be determined, the interpretability of a model output result is improved, and the accurate prediction of the verification and marketing behavior of a target user on different resources under different service scenes is effectively realized.

title_en: Apparatus and Method for managing performance of registering members
title_ko: 서비스 가입 유도에 따른 회원유치 실적 관리 장치 및 방법
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a member attraction performance management device and method which induces service subscription by sending a link to guide a membership registration process through an SMS or SNS. The member attraction performance management device comprises: a link transmission monitoring unit monitoring whether a seller terminal transmits the link to guide a membership registration process to a non-member customer terminal through an app or web page dedicated to attracting members; a database unit matching information on the non-member customer terminal to which the link to guide a membership registration process and the seller terminal after monitoring in the link transmission monitoring unit, and creating a database; a seller terminal detection unit detecting, when a request for membership registration is received from the non-member customer terminal, a seller terminal matching the non-member customer terminal which requests membership registration based on data stored in the database unit; and a performance calculating unit calculating a seller's performance in attracting new members according to seller terminal information detected by the seller terminal detection unit. In managing a member attraction performance through a member attraction performance management device based on service subscription induction, transparency and fairness in performance management can be ensured so that a performance is calculated to a seller who actually contributes to attracting members, and incentives based on the performance can be effectively distributed to the seller.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 SMS 또는 SNS를 통해 회원 가입 절차 안내 링크를 전송하여 서비스 가입 유도를 하는 회원 유치 실적 관리 장치 및 방법에 관한 것으로, 판매자 단말이 회원 유치 전용 앱 또는 웹페이지를 통해 비회원 고객 단말로 회원 가입 절차 안내 링크를 전송하는지 모니터링하는 링크 전송 모니터링부, 상기 링크 전송 모니터링부에서 모니터링결과 회원 가입 절차 안내 링크가 전송된 비회원 고객 단말과 판매자 단말 정보를 매칭시켜 데이터베이스화하는 데이터베이스부, 비회원 고객 단말로부터 회원 가입 요청이 수신되면, 상기 데이터베이스부에 저장된 데이터에 기반하여 회원 가입 요청한 비회원 고객 단말과 매칭되는 판매자 단말을 검출하는 판매자 단말 검출부 및 상기 판매자 단말 검출부에서 검출된 판매자 단말 정보에 따라 판매자의 신규 회원 유치 실적으로 집계하는 실적 집계부를 포함하는, 서비스 가입 유도에 따른 회원유치 실적관리장치에 의해 회원 유치 실적을 관리함에 있어 실제 회원 유치에 기여한 판매자에게 실적이 집계되도록 실적 관리의 투명성과 공정성을 보장하고 실적에 따른 인센티브를 판매자에게 효과적으로 분배할 수 있다.

title_en: Green land fairness evaluation method and device based on park green land supply measurement
abstract_en: The invention provides a green land fairness evaluation method and device based on park green land supply measurement. The method comprises the following steps: first, quality factor data of the UPGS is obtained from a large dataset of maps AOI, POI, OSM, etc. A new data source is then introduced: the hundred degree thermodynamic diagram represents the amount of access to the UPGS, making it the basis for establishing UPGS quality factor weights. This approach weakens the subjectivity previously seen in establishing the UPGS quality factor. In addition, the present invention determines its service radius according to the scale of the UPGS and measures the supply of different types of UPGS. The present invention improves the provisioning model of the UPGS to guide optimization of city management.
assignees: AEROSPACE INFORMATION RESEARCH INSTITUTE CHINESE ACADEMY OF SCIENCES;HAINAN KONGTIAN INFORMATION RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Capacity cost compensation method and device for power grid side energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention relates to a capacity cost compensation method and device for a power grid side energy storage power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining relevant data of the power grid side energy storage power station in the current year; analyzing the related data based on an operation mode of the power grid side energy storage power station, and determining annual unit capacity cost of the power grid side energy storage power station; according to the annual unit capacity cost and the preset compensation degree, determining annual capacity cost to be compensated of the power grid energy storage power station and a power distribution standard of each distribution object; and determining monthly capacity cost compensation logic of the power grid side energy storage power station for allocation and settlement according to the power allocation standard of each allocation object. The technical scheme provided by the invention can more accurately quantitatively analyze the capacity cost of the power grid side energy storage power station, and ensure the fairness and rationality of the capacity cost compensation standard verification.
assignees: STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;BEIJING TSINTERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cross-regional water resource allocation method based on Lubinstein discussion price counter-price model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-regional water resource allocation method based on a Lubinstein discussion counter-price model, which comprises the following steps: basic information data of water resource allocation in a research area are obtained; constructing a one-to-many Lubinstein discussion counter-offer water resource allocation conceptual model; introducing a concept of a virtual equivalent competitor, and converting a one-to-many Lubinstein discussion counter-offer water resource distribution conceptual model into a one-to-one Lubinstein discussion counter-offer water resource distribution model; calculating a discount factor comprehensively considering fairness and high efficiency principles; constructing a quotation strategy considering the minimum water supply; solving a one-to-one lubinstein discussion price counter-offer water resource distribution model. The method can effectively reflect the economic and social development level of each benefit body; meanwhile, a decision maker can make a more reasonable quotation strategy, so that the basic water requirement of each benefit body is ensured; the concept of introducing virtual equivalent competitors reduces bilateral negotiations, and efficiency is improved by 58.3% compared to the mathematical expectation of bilateral negotiations.

title_en: Systems and methods for decomposition in workforce optimization with search sub-problems
abstract_en: Systems and methods are provided for solving workforce management scheduling optimization decomposing and iteratively. Execution of a master problem can occur to select a best schedule among generated schedules for each employee of a group of employees while enforcing one or more global constraints. The generated schedule can be determined by execution of one or more sub-problems, each of the one or more sub-problems can be enforced work rules for the respective employee through the use of reduced cost for the employee. A flexible objective function can be executed to account for workforce management schedule wide metrics, including fitness of schedule to demand, fairness among the group of employees, schedule preferences and others.

title_en: Card friend community management system based on WEB3.0
abstract_en: The invention discloses a card friend community management system based on WEB3.0, which comprises the following steps: the block chain system responds to the DID data uplink request and stores the DID data in different block chain accounts; the DID identity recognition system generates a corresponding DID digital identity; the card friend forum system receives requirements and interaction information created by a truck driver, and generates DID requirements and interaction data to be uplink to the blockchain system; the network freight system receives the freight bill information created by a freight owner enterprise and generates DID freight bill data to be uplink to the block chain system; receiving logistics information created by a logistics company, and generating DID logistics data to be uplink to a block chain system; and the vehicle service provider system receives the vehicle service information created by the vehicle service provider and generates DID vehicle service data to be uplink to the block chain system. The invention adopts WEB3.0 internet technology, and realizes community data ownership fairness, data value distribution fairness and data credibility and safety based on block chain.
assignees: HEFEI WEITIAN YUNTONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Double-target emergency material conveying optimization method, system and equipment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a double-target emergency material conveying optimization method, a system and equipment, which relate to the technical field of logistics supply chain optimization and comprise the following steps: receiving truck path parameters and unmanned plane path parameters; inputting the truck path parameters and the unmanned plane path parameters into a pre-established logistics cost function to obtain a minimized logistics cost function, and inputting the truck path parameters and the unmanned plane path parameters into a pre-established deprivation cost function to obtain a minimized deprivation cost function; combining the obtained minimized current cost function and the minimized deprivation cost function, and obtaining a mixed integer nonlinear programming model by utilizing the constraint of the truck-unmanned aerial vehicle cooperative distribution path; and solving the mixed integer nonlinear programming model by utilizing an improved non-dominant order genetic algorithm (INSSGA-II) with elite strategy to obtain a double-target emergency material transportation optimization result.

title_en: School partitioning method considering maximum fairness and minimum objection number
abstract_en: The invention provides a school dividing method considering maximum fairness and minimum objection number, which comprises the steps of acquiring an information set of a school in a research area m and information sets of n residential communities; according to the information set of m schools and the information sets of n residential communities in the research area, under the goals of fairness maximization and objection minimization, constructing an entrance index distribution optimization model for distributing the entrance indexes of m schools to the entrance indexes of n residential communities, and setting constraint conditions of maximum school distance and school scale; and solving the entrance index distribution optimization model to obtain the distribution result of the entrance indexes of each school in each residential district, thereby determining the corresponding relation between each residential district and different schools nearby. The school index distribution scheme obtained by the invention not only improves the fairness of school index distribution, but also ensures the distance-to-school efficiency, reduces the resistance of introducing a random mechanism, and is convenient for implementing and managing the fairness reform of obligation education.
assignees: ZHONGGUIYUAN BEIJING PLANNING AND DESIGN CO LTD

title_en: Water right initial allocation optimization method based on remorse theory
abstract_en: The invention relates to a water resource planning method. The method aims to provide an optimization method for initial distribution of water rights based on the regret theory, so as to realize the initial distribution of water rights in different areas and industries, improve the management capability of water resources, and improve the utilization efficiency of the water resources while ensuring fairness. The technical proposal is as follows: the water right initial allocation optimization method based on the remorse theory comprises the following steps: 1. preparing a basic data set, and collecting regional related social, economic, water conservancy and agricultural related data; 2. setting objective functions, and determining three objective functions by considering that water resource utilization has economic, social, ecological and other values: the social benefit is maximum, the economic benefit is maximum and the ecological benefit is maximum; 3. constraint conditions are set, and water resource water supply balance constraint and water demand constraint of water use departments are set. 4. A multi-objective optimization algorithm, which adopts a second-generation non-dominant order genetic (NSGA-II) algorithm as the multi-objective optimization algorithm; 5. and (5) a water right initial allocation scheme based on the remorse theory.
assignees: ZHEJIANG INSTITUTE OF HYDRAULICS & ESTUARY ZHEJIANG MARINE PLANNING AND DESIGN RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Customer service quality inspection management method, customer service quality inspection management device, customer service quality inspection equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of customer service and discloses a customer service quality inspection management method, a customer service quality inspection management device, customer service quality inspection equipment and a storage medium. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring call recording data of a quality inspector; converting the call recording data into a text format capable of scoring; scoring the performance of the inspected person according to the scoring text format; and sending the evaluation to a terminal of the inspected person, judging whether complaining is carried out by the inspected person, if yes, initiating a rechecking request by the inspected person, and if not, issuing an inspected amount according to the evaluation. According to the invention, the call recording data are converted into the text format capable of being scored, so that the performance of the inspected person is scored. And a brand new calculation formula is adopted, so that more objective scoring is realized, the scoring of all the inspected persons accords with normal distribution, and fairness of quality inspection are facilitated.
assignees: SHANGHAI YUNDA HIGH TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric bus charging plan optimization method considering charging station vehicle queuing
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric bus charging plan optimization method considering charging station vehicle queuing, which belongs to the field of charging management, divides a charging station into three areas of a queuing area, a charging area and a waiting area based on actual bus charging conditions, models an electric bus queuing charging process, enables electric buses to be charged sequentially according to queuing order, and ensures fairness and rationality of electric bus charging. On the basis of the queuing of the electric buses, an electric bus ordered charging model is further established, and whether the electric buses are charged in a stopping interval of a charging station or not is decided, and the corresponding charging starting time and charging duration are determined, so that the charging cost of the electric buses and the queuing cost of the system are the lowest. And finally, integrating optimal electric bus queuing and charging information into an electric bus running diagram, providing an electric bus SOC variation and charging pile charging load variation trend diagram, and directly applying the obtained result to electric bus charging planning and arrangement to promote electric bus charging efficiency.
assignees: SICHUAN CHINA BLUE SKY ENVIRONMENTAL TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Building industry carbon quota method based on fairness and efficiency
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building industry carbon quota method based on fairness and efficiency. Belongs to the technical field of carbon quota in the building industry, and comprises the following specific steps: 1. determining the total amount of carbon quota of the building industry in the target year based on the carbon emission reduction task to determine the ideal carbon emission intensity of the building industry; 2. based on fairness principles comprising three dimensions of equity, lineage and payability, after the weight of each dimension is determined by adopting MDM, initial allocation is carried out on the carbon quota of the construction industry, and an initial allocation result of the carbon quota of the construction industry based on fairness is obtained; 3. adopting a ZSG-DEA model to carry out iterative optimization on an initial allocation result based on an efficiency principle to obtain a carbon quota reallocation result of the provincial building industry; 4. and (3) carrying out fairness measure on the inter-provincial building industry carbon quota reassignment result based on a coefficient of a kene method to obtain a building industry carbon quota scheme with fairness and efficiency. The carbon quota scheme of the building industry provides possibility and theoretical basis for improving efficiency and fairness of carbon quota of industry layers of the building industry and the like.

title_en: Multi-objective scheduling method considering efficiency and fairness of dispatch
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective scheduling method considering dispatch efficiency and fairness, which considers actual needs of network points and service soldiers, considers practical feelings of each service soldier as much as possible during dispatch, takes total transportation cost as an efficiency target, takes minimization of difference of order satisfaction as fairness target, establishes a multi-objective vehicle path planning model considering fairness and distribution efficiency, obtains a solving result by utilizing an optimization algorithm, and enables a manager to formulate a reasonable dispatch scheduling scheme according to the actual needs.
assignees: RIRISHUN SUPPLY CHAIN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Evaluation optimization method and device for credit card activity in guest group performance and related equipment
abstract_en: The application discloses a credit card activity in-guest group performance evaluation optimization method, a credit card activity in-guest group performance evaluation optimization device and related equipment, wherein the credit card activity in-guest group performance evaluation optimization method comprises the following steps: acquiring activity-related data of each credit card equity activity placed at each guest group, wherein the activity-related data comprises: at least one of activity feedback data, credit card user equity usage data, credit card equity activity achievement data on the guest group; and determining the guest group performance of each credit card equity activity in the released guest group according to the activity related data. The application effectively evaluates the performance effect of credit card equity activities on the guest group, overcomes the problems of lack of credit card activity evaluation and the like in the prior art, and the obtained guest group performance can be used for targeted optimization of credit card activities and the release of the activities, so as to improve the participation degree and the interest degree of the users on the activities, further improve the satisfaction degree of the users, reduce the customer loss, improve the credit card performance and expand the markets in the credit card and financial fields.

title_en: Data processing method and system in urban green space optimization based on big data
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a data processing method and device in urban green space optimization based on big data, and relates to the technical field of big data, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring green land distribution information corresponding to each sub-region and remote sensing data; acquiring green land investment information, quality evaluation information and resident satisfaction information of each sub-area; calculating green quantity evaluation scores corresponding to each sub-region according to the remote sensing data and the green land distribution information; calculating a green land evaluation score for enjoyment of residents according to the green land distribution information; calculating fairness quantization scores according to green land investment information, quality evaluation information and resident satisfaction information; calculating a comprehensive planning score according to the green amount evaluation score, the green land enjoyment evaluation score, the fairness quantification score and the corresponding reference score; and determining a city green space planning strategy. When planning the urban green space, the maldistribution of the green space can be reduced, and the possibility that residents equally enjoy all the services provided by the urban green space resource is improved.

title_en: Garbage clearance task scheduling and path optimizing method considering sanitation worker fairness
abstract_en: The invention provides a garbage clearance task scheduling and path optimizing method and system considering sanitation worker fairness, and relates to the technical field of path optimizing. Firstly, obtaining yard information, garbage collection point information, garbage collection vehicle information and garbage transfer center information; then, the information is used for constructing a garbage collection task scheduling and path optimizing model by taking the sum of the minimum carbon emission amount, the vehicle cost, the total vehicle fuel cost and the unbalanced workload punishment cost of sanitation workers as the target; and finally, solving a garbage clearance task scheduling and path optimizing model to obtain a garbage clearance task scheduling and path optimizing scheme. According to the invention, real factors such as sanitation equity consideration and the like are considered in garbage recycling and processing activities, a related mathematical programming model is constructed, the technical problem of poor applicability of a scheme obtained by the existing research is solved, the sanitation equity consideration is considered, and the garbage collection task scheduling and path optimization are enabled to have practical significance.

title_en: Optimal selection method for ground node subset in wireless power transmission of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to an optimal selection method of a ground node subset in wireless power transmission of multiple unmanned aerial vehicles, which belongs to the field of unmanned aerial vehicle auxiliary wireless communication and comprises the following steps: s1: dividing the ground nodes into a plurality of circular areas with the same radius according to the power transmission range of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and taking the circular areas as a ground node subset; s2: constructing an optimal selection model of the ground node subset; s3: and optimizing the hovering points of the unmanned aerial vehicle in each ground node subset, so that the unmanned aerial vehicle can charge the ground nodes at the optimal hovering points. The method is suitable for a large-scale low-power-consumption ground node charging scene, and by optimizing the selection of the ground node subset, the hovering charging times of the unmanned aerial vehicle are reduced, and the flight energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicle is reduced, so that the energy receiving efficiency and fairness of the ground node are improved.

title_en: Bad asset subcontracting method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bad asset sub-packaging method and a system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining bad asset data and object data to be allocated, wherein the bad asset data comprises the total number of cases of the bad asset and the total amount of the bad asset, and the object data to be allocated comprises the object information to be allocated, the target amount proportion and the target amount proportion; generating target amount, target quantity and ratio of the target amount to the target quantity of the objects to be distributed according to the bad asset data and the data of the objects to be distributed; taking the ratio of the target amount of each object to be allocated to the target number as an ideal bad asset allocation mean value of the objects to be allocated, and sequentially allocating the bad assets to the objects to be allocated which are closest to the ratio of the target amount to the target number after receiving the bad assets; and extracting the bad asset detail distributed by each object to be distributed. The bad asset subcontracting method and the bad asset subcontracting system have the advantages of flexibility, fairness and rapidity of distribution.
assignees: SHANGHAI RONGSHU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Transparent data annotation crowdsourcing method, system and medium for settlement balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a transparent data labeling crowd-sourcing method, a system and a medium for settlement balance, wherein the method comprises the steps of establishing a data labeling crowd-sourcing system, determining an interactive entity, enabling a task requester to mix labeled data and unlabeled data to obtain data to be labeled, setting public conditions of the labeled data, enabling a task information tuple to be disclosed on a blockchain through an intelligent contract after encryption, storing task rewards, setting task deposit, disclosing task download links, enabling workers to confirm to accept tasks and store the task deposit, downloading and completing data labeling tasks, generating certificates, disclosing task results and certificates, enabling workers to prove the task requester, evaluating the task results, creating and broadcasting a hash time locking transaction, and paying the task rewards to the workers. The invention carries out fair transaction under the supervision of a non-trusted third party through the blockchain and the hash time lock, realizes the objectivity and fairness of task rewards distribution, and ensures the balance and transparency of task rewards settlement.

title_en: Digital farm autonomous system and digital farm system based on crowd-sourced dispatch
abstract_en: The invention provides a digital farm autonomous system based on crowd-sourcing scheduling, which has the characteristics that a digital farm is constructed by adopting a ternary fusion model comprising a physical space, a digital space and a value space, wherein the digital farm comprises a physical subject, a physical object, a physical resource, a physical service, a physical activity, a digital subject, a digital object, a digital resource, a digital service and a digital activity, the physical space is a real farm space distributed in various places in reality, the digital space and the value space are all operated based on a block chain data infrastructure, the physical space interacts with the digital space through wearable equipment and Internet of things equipment, and the value space is independent of the physical space and the digital space and is treated through a digital farm treatment system. In a word, the method can provide the digital farm with full-element cross-domain integration, full-process efficient collaboration, multi-subject peer-to-peer fairness and integration, green and efficient.

title_en: Intelligent logistics data analysis system based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent logistics data analysis system based on a blockchain, which relates to the technical field of blockchains, wherein a user module in the system realizes interaction with a blockchain platform and a cloud edge cooperative platform for a user; the cloud service business module comprises: resource equipment and cloud facilitator clients; the cloud service provider client side realizes interaction with the service side of the blockchain platform and the cloud edge cooperative platform for a cloud service provider administrator; the resource equipment provides cloud computing service support for users; the cloud edge cooperative platform performs intelligent resource scheduling according to the subscription data and the resource pool condition; cloud edge cooperation platform includes: platform equipment, a platform server and a blockchain access controller; the platform equipment realizes interaction with the blockchain platform through the blockchain access controller; platform server service display, registration, authentication and/or subscription. The invention can ensure the fairness and transparency of scheduling among the user, the cloud edge cooperative platform and the cloud service provider, thereby ensuring the cloud edge cooperative development.

title_en: Distributed carbon transaction market consensus method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed carbon trade market consensus method, which comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps that a node is established, the node comprises a common node and a common node, the common node is used for processing a transaction proposal, checking enterprise qualification and data authenticity, and the common node is used for data submission and data synchronization; starting a consensus algorithm based on the nodes, wherein the consensus algorithm distributes identities for the consensus nodes, and comprises a transaction center, candidate nodes and common consensus nodes; the method comprises the steps that a transaction proposal is created by a common node and sent to a transaction center, the transaction center forwards the transaction proposal to all the consensus nodes, all the consensus nodes audit the transaction proposal, an audit result is generated and sent back to the transaction center, and if the audit is passed, the transaction proposal is broadcasted; and carrying out carbon transaction based on the transaction proposal after the verification, and completing carbon integral management of both transaction parties. The invention can effectively ensure the issuing of the carbon quota, the fairness of the transaction and the safety of the transaction data, and accurately identify and shield the nodes and the clients which try to tamper with the transaction information.

title_en: Method for distributing credible power generation capacity of wind-solar-water complementary power generation system based on cooperative game
abstract_en: The application discloses a method for distributing the credible power generation capacity of a wind-light-water complementary power generation system based on cooperative game. The application is based on the mixed integer programming credible generating capacity cooperative game distribution strategy, can solve the problem that the MCRS method distribution scheme is not necessarily in the problem core solution domain and the core model constraint scale is overlarge, can reduce the invalid constraint of the distribution model by introducing binary variables into the scheduling model to traverse all sub-alliance combination scenes, reduce the solving scale of the distribution model and seek the distribution scheme in the core of the problem; the application takes the MCRS method as a cooperative gain allocation strategy of the iterative initial value, further iterates and optimizes the allocation scheme on the basis of reasonable allocation results, and can greatly improve the rationality, fairness and high efficiency of allocation.

title_en: Method for determining position of judicial organization in cross-administrative division in consideration of efficiency and fairness
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for determining the position of a judicial organization of a cross-administrative division, which is capable of considering efficiency and fairness. The method is characterized in that the advantages of the interdisciplinary are utilized to combine the problem of the setting of the current-stage legal hot spot across administrative division judicial institutions with the graph optimization theory so as to set the approximate optimal position. The method comprises the steps of constructing a directional full-connection network, enabling nodes in the network to be linked according to rules, dividing the nodes into two unconnected subsets by using a graph-cut algorithm, and obtaining an approximate optimal position through calculation.

title_en: Building group comprehensive energy scheduling method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium for dispatching comprehensive energy of a building group, which can carry out real-time optimized dispatching on the comprehensive energy of the target building group, thereby effectively improving the digestion capability of a comprehensive energy management system of the target building group on renewable energy sources, guaranteeing the stability and economy of power grid operation, effectively guaranteeing the comfort of users and the safety of equipment operation of each building of the target building group, and the rationality of corresponding actions of each equipment, and effectively guaranteeing the fairness and rationality of the target building group in cooperation and collaborative operation benefit distribution.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG;GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Data processing method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a data processing method, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of data to be distributed; carrying out batch classification on to-be-allocated data in the plurality of to-be-allocated data to obtain to-be-allocated batch data sets corresponding to the plurality of to-be-allocated data, wherein each allocation batch in the to-be-allocated batch data sets corresponds to a first preset allocation quantity of to-be-allocated data; determining at least one target dispense batch from the batch data set to be dispensed; creating an allocation task according to the target allocation batch and the second preset allocation quantity of data to be allocated corresponding to each target allocation batch; and executing the allocation task, and sequentially allocating the second preset allocation quantity of data to be allocated in each target allocation batch to the agents to be allocated. The method can effectively distribute the data to be distributed with the same or similar quantity and value to each seat to be distributed, thereby ensuring the distribution fairness of the data to be distributed.

title_en: Civilization construction unified platform for basic-level electronic government affairs
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civilization construction unified platform for basic-level e-government affairs, which particularly relates to the field of a data system, and comprises an application information acquisition module, an information preprocessing module, a service module, a database module, a management platform and a man-machine interaction module, wherein the application information acquisition module comprises an informationized dispatching center, the informationized dispatching center is used for the civilization information management optimization treatment, the management platform comprises a practice management unit and a background operation management unit, the background operation management unit is an informationized management unit for preparing operations based on the early stage of practice activities, and the practice management unit is a construction unit for the practice management process of the activities; the invention helps the quick judgment and quick assignment of the public problems based on the data judgment, ensures the fairness of informatization processing, reduces human interference, realizes the high efficiency of informatization realization data, and realizes the real-time feedback of the mutual assistance process by the platform, the progress is transparent and open, thereby reversely promoting the staff to effectively and truly solve the public problems.

title_en: Unloading decision method of intelligent reflection surface-assisted unmanned aerial vehicle mobile edge computing system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unloading decision method of an intelligent reflection surface-assisted unmanned aerial vehicle mobile edge computing system, which comprises the following steps: an effective phase shift model of the intelligent reflecting surface is built, and a wireless transmission model and an unloading calculation energy consumption model between user equipment and the unmanned aerial vehicle are built; constructing a local calculation energy consumption model of the user equipment; constructing a pushing energy consumption model of the unmanned aerial vehicle; constructing a minimum system total energy consumption optimization problem of a communication system to be optimized, dividing the minimum system total energy consumption optimization problem into a first optimization problem, and solving a second optimization problem and a third optimization problem; and solving the first optimization problem, the second optimization problem and the third optimization problem alternately and iteratively until the convergence to the preset precision is stopped, and obtaining the optimal unloading decision scheme. The invention is beneficial to rapidly deploying the mobile edge computing system in application scenes such as natural disaster areas, complex terrains and the like, improves the link performance better, and simultaneously gives consideration to the delay fairness of multi-user execution tasks.

title_en: Multi-target dynamic water resource optimal allocation method based on improved NSGA III algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target dynamic water resource optimal allocation method based on an improved NSGAIII algorithm, which relates to the technical field of water resource management and comprises the following steps: s1, making a hypothesis for a water resource of a flow field and a manager decision; s2, determining objective functions, namely, maximally improving the economic benefit of water consumption in each period, maximally realizing regional water fairness, and maximally improving the water resource allocation efficiency in each period of the river basin to achieve the aim; s3, considering constraint conditions of water resource optimization configuration, and respectively taking available water resource limitation, limitation of water consumption of a partition i, drainage basin economic efficiency loss limitation, ecological environment water limitation, water demand limitation, state transition equation and non-negative variable as constraint limits to be considered; s4, combining the objective function with constraint conditions to obtain a global model of multi-objective multi-stage dynamic planning considering uncertainty risk and randomness; s5, solving the proposed dynamic multi-objective optimization model by adopting a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm NSGAIII.

title_en: Personnel scheduling method and device for changing electricity of shared electric bicycle and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a personnel scheduling method, a device and electronic equipment for changing the power of a shared electric bicycle, wherein the historical task amount occupation ratio of each area to be changed is determined according to the obtained total historical task amount and each second historical task amount; wherein the total historical task amount is the sum of each second historical task amount; aiming at each waiting person, determining the expected pickup probability of the waiting person for each waiting area according to the acquired first historical task quantity of the waiting person in each waiting area; and determining a scheduling result corresponding to the to-be-scheduled staff based on the historical task amount duty ratio of each to-be-scheduled area and each expected pickup probability corresponding to the to-be-scheduled staff. According to the method, the final scheduling result is determined according to the expected pickup probability of the to-be-scheduled staff and the historical task amount ratio of the to-be-scheduled power exchange area, and the fairness of distribution of the to-be-scheduled power exchange area and the to-be-scheduled staff can be improved by integrating the task amount of the to-be-scheduled staff and the task amount of the to-be-scheduled power exchange area.
assignees: ZHEJIANG LIUBIKE INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for realizing shared benefits of community resource allocation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method for realizing shared equity of community resources, which is used for realizing the allocation and management of shared equity corresponding to the community resources shared by owners by monitoring the community resources shared by the owners, so as to realize the balance and management of the ownership, income and expense owned by the owners, achieve the purpose of more reasonable and more refined allocation and management of the community resources, and lighten the workload of the owners for related matters of the property. Based on the balance and expense management of the ownership, the benefits and the expenses of the owners, after the community resources are modified and the community resources are increased, the method can automatically manage according to the authorization or the agreements without increasing the workload of the owners, greatly liberates the attention of the owners to the related balances of the ownership, the benefits and the expenses, and the like, and can improve the efficiency of upgrading and modifying the community resources.
assignees: YAOLING ARTIFICIAL INTELLIGENCE ZHEJIANG CO LTD

title_en: Instant distribution dispatch system based on multiparty fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an instant dispatch system based on multiparty fairness, which comprises a feature processing module, an environment simulation module and an instant dispatch module, wherein the multiparty fairness refers to a service provider or a service receiver participating in an instant dispatch platform. The characteristic processing module collects the environments of different dispatch areas, the historical order records and the fairness information of multiple parties, and corresponding characteristic information is generated through preprocessing. The environment simulation module designs a simulation environment of the timely delivery scene based on the Markov decision process. The instant dispatch module generates a set of candidate riders for each order to be assigned and constructs a status feature space and an action feature space for the set of candidate riders, generates the most appropriate candidate rider based on the input feature space and dispatches the order to the rider. The beneficial effects of the invention are as follows: not only increase the total income of the bill distribution platform, but also is full ofThe order of the customer is satisfied in time, and the margin between the coefficient of the base of the rider and the profit margin of the merchant is respectively reduced And 。

title_en: Routing optimization method for truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles in forest firefighting
abstract_en: A routing optimization method for truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles in forest firefighting includes the following steps: collecting the data of the disaster sites caused by forest fires, calculating transportation time on road and flight time according to the data of the disaster sites, and getting the transportation time data of post-disaster relief; based on the disaster site data, transportation time data, and an amount of relief supplies that can be allocated to disaster relief sites, constructing a mathematical model of the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem; solving the mathematical model of the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem by the optimization algorithm, and specifying a post-disaster rescue route of the truck-drone integrated rescue vehicle according to the solution results. The model based on the truck-drone based vehicle routing problem method can reduce the impact of sudden natural disasters, and give full play to the advantages of truck-drone integrated rescue vehicles.
assignees: BEIJING EVERYONE SAFE TECH CO LTD;UNIV BEIJING CHEM TECH

title_en: Differential game-based data transaction income distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a differential game-based data transaction income distribution method and a differential game-based data transaction income distribution system, which belong to the technical field of data transactions, wherein the method comprises the following steps: determining an objective function of a government when conducting data transactions with an enterprise; obtaining the optimal effort degree of open shared data of government and enterprise, and calculating the open shared storage of data in a stable state; determining an optimal data transaction inventory; obtaining a profit distribution scheme matrix of governments and enterprises; determining a negative ideal profit allocation scheme, and taking the negative ideal profit allocation scheme as a starting point of profit allocation; establishing a dynamic profit allocation scheme; introducing a dynamic profit allocation mechanism to obtain a dynamic allocation profit function; by dynamically assigning revenue functions, the government is assigned respective revenue when conducting data transactions with the enterprise. The method can ensure the time consistency of a profit distribution mechanism when the government and enterprises conduct data transaction, promote the stability of profit distribution, and promote the fairness and stability of data open sharing cooperation between the government and enterprises.

title_en: Benefit distribution method and terminal for electric heating cooperative scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benefit distribution method and a terminal of electric heat cooperative scheduling, which are used for calculating electric heat cooperative scheduling benefits generated by an electric-thermal coupling system, constructing corresponding benefit functions, calculating contribution values of each energy main body to the electric heat cooperative scheduling, and carrying out benefit distribution based on the contribution values after integral solving. In this way, the benefits generated by the CHPD are fairly shared among multiple subjects, and the calculation burden can be greatly reduced on the premise of keeping higher precision through the way of integral solution. The method can be applied to the electric heating collaborative scheduling benefit allocation of multiple main bodies, ensures the fairness of the benefit allocation, and improves the calculation efficiency of the electric heating collaborative scheduling benefit allocation of the multiple main bodies.

title_en: Blocking decoupling management-based power distribution network economic dispatching method and system
abstract_en: The application provides a blocking decoupling management-based power distribution network economic dispatching method and system, and relates to the field of energy market analysis. The power distribution network economic dispatching method based on blocking decoupling management comprises the steps of receiving bidding information submitted by all producers and consumers; performing energy bidding matching through bidding information submitted by each producing and eliminating person; settling the result of energy bidding matching; and performing blocking management based on a preset blocking management model, wherein the blocking management model is established through settlement energy bidding matching results. The method not only can enable the power distribution network operators to correctly recover the cost, but also is beneficial to stimulating the power generation and elimination operators to match nearby energy, and decoupling scheduling of energy matching and blocking management enables the power generation and elimination operators to have more profit space and matching opportunities while improving fairness, greatly improves the solving efficiency of economic scheduling, and can meet the requirements of rapid and high-frequency economic scheduling of the power distribution network in the scene of ultra-large-scale power generation and elimination operators.

title_en: Quality inspection plan scheduling method and tool
abstract_en: The invention discloses a quality inspection plan scheduling method and tool, and relates to the technical field of quality inspection management. In order to ensure the whole-course selective examination separation in the quality inspection process and the objective fairness in the inspection process, the plan scheduling method adopts the following technical scheme: classification and extraction of quality inspection personnel are realized through a resource pool, personnel scheduling is performed on a quality inspection plan, symmetric and asymmetric encryption based on generated samples is realized, and the scheduling, inspection, encryption and decryption processes of the whole quality inspection plan are realized by taking two-dimensional codes as carriers. The planning and scheduling tool executes the method through a marking module, a random sampling module, a grouping marking module, a sequence issuing module, a correlation making module, a grouping processing module, a two-dimension code generating module, a scanning decryption module, a decryption processing module, a cyclic execution module and a result output module. The invention can realize the physical and data dual isolation of sampling personnel and quality inspection personnel, reduce the possibility of falsification of quality and improve the quality inspection reliability.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR DIGITAL BUSINESS TECH CO LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive optimized hospital queuing and calling system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource and personnel data management, in particular to a self-adaptive optimized hospital queuing and calling system. The system acquires illness state information of a patient and queuing number of the patient through an information acquisition module; the priority of the queuing number of the patient is obtained through an information evaluation module and classified; the longest waiting number of the high-priority number is obtained through a data processing module; and dynamically calling numbers through the comprehensive processing module. The invention comprehensively considers the illness state information and fairness of patients and the current treatment condition of hospitals, so that the system can take precedence of emergency illness patients and consider fairness of other patients, the treatment result of the system is fairer and more reasonable, medical resources are more reasonably distributed, and the satisfaction degree of patients is improved.

title_en: Incremental power distribution business-based distribution network joint planning profit distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distribution network joint planning profit distribution method and system based on incremental distribution business, which relate to the technical field of distribution network planning and comprise the following steps: establishing a single fault state probability model and a single power distribution network planning model, and determining independent planning cost; establishing a reliability cost model of the power distribution network; establishing a joint planning model of the power distribution network according to the three models, setting constraint conditions, and determining joint planning cost; making a difference between the combined planning cost and the independent planning cost, and regarding the difference as profit; and establishing a profit distribution model based on the Shapley value according to the principle of the cooperative game, and distributing the profit through the profit distribution model. According to the distribution network joint planning profit distribution method and system based on the incremental distribution service, profit is reasonably distributed, so that each distribution network investment entity participates in unified planning to better accord with fairness principles, and long-term cooperation of participants is facilitated.
assignees: SHANDONG LURUAN DIGITAL TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: House transaction method, system, equipment and medium based on blockchain
abstract_en: The application discloses a house transaction method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a blockchain, which can be applied to the blockchain field or the financial field. The user node uploads the personal information of the user to the blockchain system; the auditing department node opens social security details according to the personal information of the user and uploads the social security details to the blockchain system; the bank node opens fund proving data according to the personal information of the user and uploads the fund proving data to the blockchain system; the intelligent contract carries out house purchasing qualification checking on the user according to the social security details and the fund proving data, and after the checking is passed, the intelligent contract distributes numbers for the user and uploads the numbers to the blockchain system; and the notarization node shakes the number through the number shaking system according to the number, and uploads the number shaking result to the blockchain system. The data are uploaded to the blockchain from each node, so that fairness of real estate transaction can be improved, the user does not need to go back to the line for processing, and convenience is brought to the user to conduct house purchase transaction.

title_en: Logistics unmanned aerial vehicle package receiving station site selection-public route planning method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for selecting addresses of parcel receiving stations of logistics unmanned aerial vehicles and planning public routes. The method comprises the steps of obtaining geographic environment information, demand distribution and other information in a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle operation area; determining an optimization method of a single route planning model of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle, planning single routes among stations and storing planning results into an alternative route library; determining an optimization method of a parcel receiving station site selection-public route planning model; iteratively solving a parcel receiving station site selection-public route planning model, and updating a solution set until the maximum iteration times; according to the final planning result, comparing objective function values of all schemes in the solution set, and selecting an optimal planning scheme; the system comprises a flight environment modeling module, a single-route planning module, an iteration solving module and an optimal logistics unmanned aerial vehicle package receiving station site selection-public route planning scheme determining module. The invention improves the economy and fairness of the location selection of the parcel receiving station and the safety and high efficiency of the public way.

title_en: Local power grid and wind power storage alliance master-slave game optimization scheduling method considering adjustment compensation
abstract_en: The local power grid and wind accumulation alliance master-slave game optimization scheduling method considering adjustment compensation comprises the following steps: step 1: the pumped storage power station and wind power are built into a wind storage alliance, and a local power grid and wind storage alliance master-slave game optimization model is built; step 2: constructing constraint conditions of a master-slave game optimization model of a local power grid and a wind-storage alliance; step 3: constructing a Nash bargaining profit allocation model of the wind-accumulation alliance; step 4: constructing a KKT condition of a lower-layer wind reservoir alliance optimization model, and converting the lower-layer wind reservoir alliance optimization model into a constraint condition of an upper-layer model; step 5: and the pumped storage regulation compensation benefit is considered, so that the two-stage solution of local power grid and wind storage alliance master-slave game scheduling is realized. According to the invention, aiming at the compensation income distribution of wind power in the alliance to pumped storage, the Nash bargaining method is adopted to conduct bargaining, and finally, the compensation electricity price meeting fairness and rationality is obtained, thereby promoting the improvement of the benefits of all parties in the alliance and the dredging of the pumped storage regulation cost.

title_en: Task allocation method based on ternary space-time crowdsourcing high fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task allocation method based on ternary space-time crowdsourcing high fairness. The invention defines fairness space-time crowdsourcing first; secondly, as the invention aims at the problem of article distribution, a worker can receive a plurality of tasks at one time, and a distribution route with the least cost is searched for the worker by adopting a path planning algorithm; then determining a calculation formula of the rewards and the profit; the data is then preprocessed: screening candidate worker sets and site sets for the task by using constraint conditions; screening candidate task sets for workers; finally, a greedy algorithm is used for realizing task allocation, and a local optimal solution is obtained; further increasing the overall profit with an optimal threshold algorithm; the strategy set of workers is determined according to the data obtained through preprocessing, and a game algorithm is utilized, so that each worker selects the optimal strategy under the condition that strategy conflict does not occur with other workers.

title_en: Fairness-considered personal travel carbon transaction distribution method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personal travel carbon transaction distribution method, equipment and medium considering fairness. The method solves the problems that a carbon transaction mechanism in the transportation field does not have a fair and reasonable allocation method and does not consider a carbon quota price forming mechanism.
assignees: INSTITUTE OF TRANSP DEVELOPMENT STRATEGY & PLANNING OF SICHUAN PROVINCE;UNIV SOUTHWEST JIAOTONG

title_en: Rights and interests distribution method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a rights and interests distribution method, device, equipment and storage medium, which can be applied to the field of artificial intelligence or finance. The method comprises the following steps: obtaining a budget allocation model; the budget allocation model is used for deciding allocation information of the equity budgets; optimizing a budget allocation model based on an improved strength pareto evolution algorithm to output optimal decision results of rights and interests budget allocation to a plurality of channels; when determining the user to be assigned with the rights and interests, determining the types of the rights and interests to be assigned with the user based on the rights and interests sensitivity of the user; the rights and interests sensitivity of the user is obtained by solving a Lagrange relaxation algorithm based on a sub-gradient method; and determining the category of the rights to be allocated and the optimal decision result as a rights allocation scheme. Thus, the rights issuing channel and the issuing category can be flexibly and comprehensively considered.

title_en: Multi-target water resource allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target water resource allocation method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of water resource allocation. According to the scheme, economic benefits, social benefits and environmental benefits of a region to be configured are taken as optimization targets, a multi-target optimization configuration model taking distribution water quantity, water demand, pollutant discharge quantity and water supply fairness as constraints is firstly constructed, then the multi-target optimization configuration model is converted into a single-target optimization configuration model taking maximized comprehensive satisfaction as an optimization target through fuzzy processing, and finally the solution is carried out according to each constraint. According to the scheme, water supply fairness constraint is added in the water resource allocation process, and when the multi-objective optimization configuration model is solved, the multi-objective optimization configuration model is converted into a single-objective fuzzy optimization configuration model, so that the maximum comprehensive satisfaction of all optimization objectives is obtained, the labor cost is reduced, the interference of human factors is avoided, and the accuracy and fairness of water resource allocation are improved.
assignees: HEBEI INSTITUTE OF WATER CONSERVANCY SCIENCES HEBEI PROVINCE DAM SAFETY TECH CENTER HEBEI EMBANKMENT

title_en: Multi-stage time sequence dependent crowdsourcing system based on block chain and VCG auction mechanism
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-stage time sequence dependent crowdsourcing system based on a blockchain and VCG auction mechanism, which can be divided into a client, a contract layer and a blockchain layer three-layer structure; the client is used for interaction between the user and the intelligent contract; the contract layer is used for processing data and realizing corresponding functions; the blockchain layer is used to store contract-generated data. Aiming at a multi-stage complex space-time crowdsourcing task with time sequence dependence, the whole task can be divided into subtasks of a plurality of stages, and certain dependency relationship exists among the subtasks; the invention takes the time sequence dependency relationship of the subtasks as a key point of the problem, also considers the limit of the workload of the tasks, combines the task characteristics and the VCG mechanism, and provides a reverse auction mechanism for the task allocation and the commission settlement function, thereby fully considering the marginal benefit of the tasks, avoiding the waste cost and effectively reducing the task cost under the condition of ensuring the reality, fairness and credibility of the auction mechanism.

title_en: Urban waterlogging disaster forecasting, early warning and emergency rescue system and method thereof
