abstract_en: The invention provides an urban waterlogging disaster forecasting, early warning and emergency rescue system and a method thereof, wherein the system comprises the following steps: the system comprises an information input module, a geographic information processing module, a city rainfall converging and calculating module, a city waterlogging inundation calculating module, a disaster analysis module, an early warning information release and feedback module and a disaster relief material management and rescue team communication coordination module. The invention can calculate the inundation range of urban rainfall and issue early warning information, instruct disaster-stricken personnel to evacuate, and supplement and schedule disaster relief materials and disaster relief personnel.

title_en: Dangerous goods full-load distribution path optimization and vehicle dispatching method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of distribution path planning, and discloses a dangerous goods full-load distribution path optimization and vehicle scheduling method, which comprises the steps of establishing a model of vehicle quantity, total vehicle running cost and total risk and distribution time, establishing a vehicle path optimization mathematical model P1, establishing a vehicle scheduling model P2, and carrying out two-stage method solution (comprising a path optimization solution method and a vehicle scheduling optimization solution method). The invention can minimize the transportation cost and transportation risk in the transportation process by optimizing the driving route and scientifically dispatching the vehicles, and simultaneously, the invention can minimize the number of the distributed vehicles and ensure the fairness of the transportation task quantity of the vehicles.

title_en: Order distribution processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an order distribution processing method and device, and relates to the field of warehouse logistics. One embodiment of the method comprises the following steps: responding to the scanning receiving operation of the dispatcher on the first order through the terminal equipment, and determining the current receiving operation time point; acquiring the information of a receiver in the first order, searching an order set corresponding to the information of the receiver from the rest of to-be-distributed order sets, and searching a second order with an inbound operation time point earlier than the current receiving operation time point from the order set; and sending the information of the first order and the second order to the terminal equipment so that the dispatcher can carry out the distribution processing on the first order and the second order. The implementation mode is strictly based on the calculation principle that the dispatcher receives goods while standing, the calculation principle is bound with the delivery frequency of the dispatcher to be used as a charging calculation basis, and the calculation principle is irrelevant to the arrival batch of vehicles, so that fairness and transparency of an operation process are realized, and meanwhile, the real-time reminding function is realized, and order missing operation is avoided.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG ZHENSHI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Civil aviation flight time configuration method for popular travel
abstract_en: The invention discloses a civil aviation flight time configuration method for popular travel, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a multidimensional weight system for popular travel, and calculating the weight of each flight on the dimensions of a passenger type, a flight department type, a route type and a time type according to flight time application data; then, the contribution degree of flights to popular travel is evaluated by integrating the weight of each dimension, and the weight of each flight in the shift of the flight time is determined; then, building a civil aviation flight time configuration model oriented to mass travel, aiming at minimizing the total time offset with weight and restraining the total time offset; and finally, solving the established flight time model in a Python environment by using a Gurobi solver to obtain a civil aviation flight schedule oriented to popular travel. The invention establishes the civil aviation flight time configuration model for popular travel, balances the requirements, the configuration efficiency and the fairness of popular travel, and improves the operability of the civil aviation flight time configuration.

title_en: Project contribution score distribution method, apparatus, device, storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The application discloses a project contribution score distribution method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring input information input by a user and generating a project card, wherein the content of the project card at least comprises one type of characters, pictures and videos; assigning a base score to the generated project card; recording a user participating in the supplement or modification of the project card and the supplement or modification information of the information card, and independently displaying the information in the project card as additional information; recording the execution user and the execution times of the project card; after the user project card is finished, assigning a value according to the participation degree of the user project, and assigning the basic value of the project card to the participating user according to the atmosphere assignment so as to realize project contribution scoring. The project card scoring method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product provided by the disclosure effectively score the contribution of the user to the project and improve the accuracy of contribution calculation and participation fairness.
assignees: DONGGUAN WUWU XIANGXUN SUSTAINABLE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Electric power system load side carbon responsibility accounting system, method and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a system, a method and a medium for accounting carbon responsibility at the load side of an electric power system, wherein a system power flow calculation module of the system is used for obtaining active power flow distribution and network loss of each branch of the electric power system; the net loss fair allocation model module is used for calculating the net loads of the system and the net output force of each unit according to the active power flow distribution; the secondary power flow calculation module is used for constructing a virtual lossless network, carrying out secondary power flow calculation on the virtual lossless network by adopting a direct current power flow calculation method, and determining the time-by-time carbon emission condition of each load member of the system; the total carbon emission amount calculation module is used for obtaining the monthly carbon responsibility amount, the typical electricity consumption amount and the typical carbon intensity of each load member; the final carbon responsibility calculation module is used for correcting the typical electricity consumption of each load member to obtain a final carbon responsibility calculation result. The invention considers the influence of the network loss of the system and the peak load characteristic of the user on the carbon emission of the system, solves the problem of insufficient fairness of the past accounting result, and improves the accuracy of responsibility calculation.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD HUZHOU POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Virtual power plant frequency modulation income distribution method and device considering DLMP
abstract_en: The method and the device for distributing the frequency modulation benefits of the virtual power plant considering the DLMP are used for establishing an economic dispatch model of the power distribution network, and an objective function of the economic dispatch model of the power distribution network is constructed into a Lagrange function form; calculating the frequency modulation cost price of the aggregation main body by considering the marginal electricity price of the nodes of the power distribution network, and calculating the income of the virtual power plant in the frequency modulation auxiliary service market; performing type division on game participants according to a game price strategy distribution interval, calculating benefit expectations of a k-th round game virtual power plant and an aggregation main body, and judging balance point conditions of a virtual power plant internal benefit distribution strategy based on Bayesian game; under the condition that the first round of games are not matched, estimating the quotation mean value and the transaction achievement probability of the opposite game party by adopting the prior probability; and adjusting the quotations of the two game parties through a linear relaxation algorithm until the Bayesian-Nash equilibrium is achieved, so as to achieve the transaction of the two game parties. The invention improves the fairness of the benefit distribution process; and the cooperation stability of the virtual power plant and each aggregation main body is ensured.

title_en: Scheduling recommendation system and method for field authentication checking expert in authentication industry
abstract_en: The application discloses a dispatching recommendation system and a dispatching recommendation method for field authentication and inspection specialists in an authentication industry, wherein the dispatching recommendation system comprises the steps of acquiring task information of field authentication and inspection to be distributed currently and specialist information of the authentication specialists, and carrying out data analysis on the task information and the specialist information; the expert is comprehensively evaluated according to qualification conditions, service areas and working schedules of the authentication expert by a weighted average method, and a comprehensive evaluation result is obtained; and sequencing the comprehensive evaluation results and outputting a recommended expert list through a visual page to finish recommendation. Compared with the prior art, the method and the device can acquire the comprehensive data of the expert and the task, can process more dimensional information under the condition of meeting constraint conditions, and realize finer and intelligent scheduling, thereby effectively avoiding the error of manual scheduling, improving the efficiency and the success rate of expert scheduling, and ensuring the fairness and standardization of the development of authentication business.

title_en: Knowledge enhancement-based multi-water source multi-target water resource allocation method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a knowledge-enhanced multi-water source multi-target water resource allocation method, which is characterized in that a two-stage multi-target model integrating a knowledge graph is established, and the model considers a plurality of water sources (namely ground water, surface water, external water, reclaimed water and river water) and complies with principles of fairness, high efficiency, sustainability and systematicness. The method provided by the research aims at converting the two-stage model into the one-stage model and then solving the one-stage model. The objective function is optimized by population-based searching. Based on the improved genetic algorithm fitness function, the quality of the result is optimized while the searching efficiency of the algorithm is improved. And finally, solving the single-layer model by adopting a modified genetic algorithm, and finally, realizing reasonable and efficient distribution of water resources.

title_en: Multi-granularity weighted analysis method and device based on terminal verification
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-granularity weighted analysis method and device based on terminal verification, wherein the method comprises the steps of sending data, all secondary indexes in preset index types and scoring rules of each secondary index to at least two terminals in a one-way transmission mode, and verifying the safety and effectiveness of the one-way transmission mode; obtaining a target weight value of each primary index based on a preset index weight value and at least two characteristic values of each primary index, and calculating an evaluation value of result quality data according to the at least two characteristic values of each primary index and the corresponding target weight values. According to the invention, the final evaluation value is obtained by carrying out component calculation on the relevant characteristic values of the values corresponding to the indexes of different types and combining with the subjective index weight value, so that uncertainty caused by subjective will is effectively avoided, accuracy and fairness of the result can be ensured, and the subsequent improvement and optimization directions can be conveniently provided.

title_en: Equity finance execution support system, equity finance execution support method and program
abstract_en: To support execution of equity finance.SOLUTION: An equity finance execution support system 1 comprises means of: selecting a prerequisite of a targeting company; registering basic information on the company, an issuance resolution case, an issuance condition, allocation destination information, bills of a share-holder's general meeting or a board of directors, and a kind/holing method/holding schedule of the share-holder's general meeting or a kind/holing method/holding schedule of the board of directors; displaying resolutions; registering a holding time, a holding place of the board of directors, and participants therein; notifying the participant in the board of directors of calling the board of directors; acquiring a first reply of approval or disapproval to the bill from the participant of the board of directors; preparing minutes tabulating the first reply; registering a holing time/holding place of the share-holder's general meeting, and participants therein; notifying the participant in the share-holder's general meeting of calling the share-holder's general meeting; acquiring a second reply of approval or disapproval to the bill from the participant in the share-holder's general meeting; and preparing minutes tabulating the second reply, and a resolution notification.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Method and device for determining object allocation scheme
abstract_en: The embodiment of the specification provides a method and a device for determining an object allocation scheme. In the method, an allocation cost representation and constraint conditions are constructed according to users and objects to be allocated; performing iterative processing until an iteration stop condition is satisfied, in the following manner: aiming at each user, obtaining a current user allocation probability vector according to a user iteration association relation for representing the correlation between user allocation probability vectors in two adjacent iterations and a previous iteration user allocation probability vector or an initial user allocation probability vector corresponding to the user; calculating a current intermediate variable according to the current user allocation probability vector and the current fairness variable of each user; outputting a user allocation probability matrix obtained according to the user allocation probability vectors of the users; and determining the allocation mode between the user and the object according to the user allocation probability matrix.
assignees: ALIPAY HANGZHOU INF TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rural E-commerce product quality traceability system based on double chains
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rural e-commerce product quality traceability system based on double chains, which comprises: the product information acquisition module: the system comprises a block chain link point module, a chain link point module and a chain link point module, wherein the block chain link point module is used for acquiring quality information and production place information of a product; block link point module: the product information acquisition module is used for receiving information sent by the product information acquisition module, giving time stamps to the information and signing the information to share the information; product processing monitoring module: the processing, processing and storage information for recording the product is sent to the block chain link point module; product transportation monitoring module: the system comprises a block chain link point module, a chain link point module and a chain link point module, wherein the block chain point module is used for monitoring the environment, the path and the time information of a product in the transportation process; product sales site monitoring module: and the information for recording the distribution of the transported products to different sales places is sent to the block link point module. The system solves the problems of integrity, fairness and credibility of quality safety data in a rural e-commerce product quality safety traceability system.

title_en: Examination and evaluation method for experimental operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an examination evaluation method for experimental operation, which relates to the technical field of experimental operation and comprises the following steps that firstly, an examinee enters an examination room for carrying out identity verification by using an identity verification module in advance for half an hour, when the identity verification is wrong, the examinee is not allowed to enter the examination room, after the identity verification is correct, the examinee randomly extracts the examination questions, after the examination questions are extracted, each examinee is randomly allocated to a corresponding examination position by using a seat allocation module, after all the examinees are in place and reach examination time, an examination timing module starts to count down, the examinee starts to carry out experimental examination, after each step is completed, the examinee presses a shooting button on a desktop, a camera can shoot the picture, when the examination time is still 10 minutes, a voice reminding module carries out on-site broadcasting reminding, and after the examination is finished, a prison teacher reaches each examination position and scores by using an experiment scoring module. The invention improves the accuracy and fairness of scoring in experimental examination.
assignees: SHANGHAI YINGJIA IND GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Real-time frequency modulation control method and system considering frequency modulation resource balance
abstract_en: The invention provides a real-time frequency modulation control method and a system considering frequency modulation resource balance, comprising the following steps: counting the first frequency modulation response capacity difference among all the frequency modulation power supplies, and constructing a frequency modulation response balance index according to the frequency modulation response capacity difference; according to the frequency modulation response balance index, taking the frequency modulation response balance after the power generation output is maximally adjusted as an optimization target, and establishing a first frequency modulation instruction optimization model; the first frequency modulation instruction optimization scheme obtained by solving the first frequency modulation instruction optimization model is evaluated for effective frequency modulation response capacity, and the effective frequency modulation response capacity of the power grid is obtained; according to the effective frequency modulation response capacity of the power grid and the first frequency modulation requirement, when the frequency modulation safety is not met, correcting the first frequency modulation requirement; by adopting the method and the device, the fairness of the power grid frequency modulation power supply which needs to respond to the frequency modulation requirement can be improved, so that the real-time frequency modulation accuracy is improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;ELECTRIC POWER DISPATCHING CONTROL CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Charging pile charging load balance scheduling method
abstract_en: The application provides a charging pile charging load balance scheduling method, which comprises the following steps: a charging pile terminal subsystem initiates a charging request; and the dispatching center subsystem judges whether the charging request of the new charging pile terminal can be born according to the current load power of the administered area, if so, the charging service is carried out according to the nominal voltage value and the current value of the new charging pile terminal, and if not, the charging configuration parameters of each charging pile terminal in the administered area are adjusted according to the load balancing principle, and then the charging service is carried out on the automobile. According to the application, the budget load power in the jurisdiction is taken as constraint, and the charging configuration parameters of the charging pile terminal are dynamically scheduled and updated based on event triggering by a scheduling strategy of a remaining time fairness principle, a new priority guarantee principle and a saturation yielding principle, so that the purpose of maximum intelligent use of the budget load power is realized on the premise of not overloading electric energy.

title_en: Comprehensive load management user optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive load management user optimization method, belonging to the technical field of power load management; an integrated load management user preference method comprising: input into the load management system: test day h  n  Load gap of time period, response condition of each user with load gap time period on day before test, and history data of each execution time period on n-1 days before test; preprocessing input data; calculating the historical performance, risk avoidance, electricity production value and industry scenic spot degree of each user by utilizing the preprocessed data, carrying out weighted average, multiplying the invited quantity of each user to obtain a comprehensive evaluation index, and obtaining a user preferred scheme according to the comprehensive evaluation index; based on the coefficient of kunning, increasing a fairness constraint index to optimize the user preference; based on optimized user preference scheme, settingAnd calculating a rotation strategy of the factory under the comprehensive load management scheme.
assignees: STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;JINZHOU ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV SOUTHEAST

title_en: College scientific and technological achievement equity distribution method and intelligent management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of college intellectual property management, in particular to a college scientific and technological achievement equity distribution method and an intelligent management system.
assignees: UNIV NANJING SCIENCE & TECH;JIANGSU SHEHUITONG INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Proactive seismic rehabilitation of water pipe networks for equitable recovery
abstract_en: Systems and methods to identify a rehabilitation policy for water pipe networks are provided. A graph is built to represent a water pipe network including edges for each pipe and nodes for each water source or water user. An approach based on proximity analysis is used to determine the criticality of each node in the graph based on the spatial distribution of water demand type in the neighborhood where the node is located. The spatial variabilities of demand criticalities along with the spatial variabilities of the seismic ground motion intensities are integrated into the formulation of an optimization problem to identify rehabilitation policies the water supply network. A purpose-built simulated annealing algorithm is then used to solve the optimization problem. Results of the optimization may then be used to identify pipes in the water pipe network to replace based on a replacement budget.

title_en: Carbon flow real-time calculation method and system considering network loss
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of carbon emission flow calculation, in particular to a method and a system for calculating carbon flow in real time by considering network loss, wherein the method comprises the following steps: constructing a network loss allocation model, and adopting a network loss allocation method for bidirectional allocation according to allocation coefficients to obtain allocation results; determining the power flow distribution in the network according to the allocation result; based on the tide distribution, constructing a real-time carbon flow calculation model; calculating the carbon emission flow before the day and the carbon emission flow of the deviation network before the day-real time based on a real-time carbon flow calculation model to obtain a load carbon flow rate and a branch carbon flow rate; based on the load carbon flow rate and the branch carbon flow rate, a daily planned amount and a deviation amount of the carbon flow rate are obtained, respectively, and based on the daily planned amount and the deviation amount, a real-time carbon flow rate is calculated. The method successfully solves a series of problems that the hidden carbon flow is not equitable in allocation, the carbon emission reduction contribution of the novel renewable energy power generation unit is difficult to quantify and the like by constructing the model and the calculation method.
assignees: SHANXI ENERGY INTERNET RES INSTITUTE;UNIV TAIYUAN TECHNOLOGY;UNIV XI AN JIAOTONG

title_en: Energy scheduling and trading method for interconnected micro-grid system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy scheduling and trading method of an interconnected micro-grid system, which belongs to the technical field of multi-micro-grid interconnection and comprises the following steps: and introducing power trading volume, taking the declared power trading volume of the micro-grid and the actual power trading volume as constraints, dividing the energy scheduling model into two sub-models, wherein a decision variable of a first sub-model is not coupled with a decision variable of the energy trading model, solving the energy trading model on the premise that the first sub-model is optimal, and taking one of the optimal solutions of the energy trading model as the optimal solution of a second sub-model. The invention realizes decoupling between energy scheduling and transaction decision, and can improve decision accuracy; the multi-agent deep reinforcement learning algorithm and the P2P-based Nash negotiation game solution decoupled model are adopted respectively, so that the rapid solution can be realized, the requirement of real-time decision scheduling is met, the intermittent and uncertainty of renewable energy sources can be met, the privacy of a micro-grid is protected, and the fairness of transactions is ensured.

title_en: Distributed game interaction method under mass distributed resource aggregation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a distributed game interaction method under mass distributed resource aggregation, which comprises the following steps: establishing a distributed interaction model of a load aggregator; establishing a micro-grid operator distributed interaction model; performing interactive iteration between the load aggregator and the micro-grid operator; judging whether the interactive iteration of the step (3) is converged, if so, entering the next step, otherwise, returning to the step (3); the load aggregator interacts with the micro-grid operators. The invention establishes a cooperation alliance based on cooperation game match-up aggregators, and maximizes benefits of the aggregators while realizing on-site consumption of new energy and guaranteeing reliability of load power supply; adopting Nash bargained settlement formula to carry out multi-main body cooperation surplus distribution, so that cooperation surplus is distributed among aggregators in pareto optimal mode, and the distribution strategy has fairness and optimality; and the distributed interaction of the aggregators is carried out based on the ADMM algorithm, and only a small amount of coupling transaction information is needed to be interacted by the aggregators during interaction, so that the privacy of multiple subjects can be effectively protected.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Energy acquisition cognitive wireless network joint time and power distribution method based on double-layer game
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for combining time and power distribution of an energy acquisition cognitive wireless network based on double-layer game, which comprises the steps of firstly introducing energy collection (energy harvesting, EH) into a CR network to construct the EH-CR network, and collecting and using energy by using an energy acquisition framework of acquisition-use. The interaction between the PU and the SUs is then modeled as a jackberg game, and the interaction between the SUs is modeled as an supermode game. In order to improve fairness among SUs, this method introduces a fairness evaluation coefficient. Then, by solving the NE solution of the supermode game, an equalized spectrum sensing time coefficient and an equalized power distribution scheme can be obtained.

title_en: User side load optimal scheduling method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a load optimization scheduling method, a device, equipment and a storage medium considering carbon responsibility at a user side, wherein the method comprises the following steps: based on a carbon emission flow theory of the electric power system, constructing a tide model considering the carbon emission flow of the electric power system; based on carbon quota allocation and a generator cost model, embedding an electric energy pricing model of carbon transaction, and constructing a node electricity-carbon comprehensive price pricing model; based on a tide model of the carbon emission flow of the electric power system and a node electricity-carbon comprehensive price pricing model, constructing a load demand response optimization scheduling model, and calculating to obtain a load optimization scheduling result taking account of carbon responsibility of a user side; the device comprises a tide module, a pricing module and a scheduling module. According to the load optimization scheduling method considering the carbon responsibility at the user side, the carbon responsibility at the user side is distributed according to the actual equivalent carbon emission of different users according to the carbon emission flow theory, the unreasonable phenomenon of distributing the carbon responsibility only at the power generation side is avoided, and the principle of fairness and fairness in the power market is embodied.

title_en: Data processing method, apparatus, readable storage medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The invention provides a data processing method, a data processing device, a readable storage medium and a computer program product. The data processing method comprises the following steps: acquiring a plurality of pieces of position information, wherein the plurality of pieces of position information are in one-to-one correspondence with a plurality of service objects, and the plurality of service objects comprise a first type service object and a second type service object; acquiring object dependency relations among a plurality of business objects; creating a position relation model according to the position information and the object dependency relation; receiving demand data of a first service object, wherein the first service object is a service object in a first type of service object; determining a plurality of second business objects associated with the first business object based on the position relation model, wherein the second business objects are business objects in the second class of business objects; and determining a supply allocation scheme of the plurality of second business objects according to the demand data.

title_en: Management apparatus of stockers
abstract_en: To provide a management apparatus of stockers ensuring fairness to a plurality of users.SOLUTION: In a sales management system 10, a management apparatus 30 of stockers 40 has a plurality of delivery chambers 41 and manages stockers used by a plurality of users (entrepreneurs). The plurality of delivery chambers includes delivery chambers of a plurality of sizes, and at least one of the plurality of sizes is a size used for a plurality of delivery chambers of that size. The management apparatus comprises a memory unit which stores, for each size, allocated users who are one or more users to whom usable delivery chambers are allocated among the plurality of users, and the number of allocated delivery chambers which is the number of delivery chambers allocated to the respective allocated users, for the plurality of delivery chambers of the size with the plurality of delivery chambers.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Block chain system for agricultural non-point source pollution treatment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockchain system for agricultural non-point source pollution control, which constructs a Fabric alliance chain architecture system, and innovates agricultural non-point source pollution control data storage, information tracing, excitation and constraint mechanisms by utilizing technologies such as a blockchain consensus mechanism, distributed storage, cryptography, point-to-point transmission, cross-chain mutual recognition and the like so as to improve development dilemmas of unsafe monitoring information storage transmission, asymmetric information, poor multi-head management collaboration, frequent enterprise renting and gambling behaviors, government authority dissimilarity and the like existing in the current agricultural non-point source pollution control mechanism. In mechanism design, the ideas of the characteristics and decentralization of the blockchain are applied to construct a data safety storage, transparent disclosure, credible traceability and consensus autonomous agriculture non-point source pollution treatment blockchain network, a safe and credible treatment environment is created, efficient and lossless transfer of government and enterprise information is realized, and disclosure, fairness and fairness of pollution treatment are promoted.

title_en: Flight pre-flight plan optimization method based on airline flight reduction preference
abstract_en: The invention provides a flight pre-flight plan optimization method based on airline flight reduction preference, which comprises the following steps: determining a limited flight set, a limited flight total number and an unlimited flight set; calculating the residual available guarantee capacity of the airspace; determining the resource allocation priority order of all flights in the limited flight set; determining the number of flights to be subtracted by each airline under the scheme; determining specifically subtracted flights under the scheme; determining a flight pre-flight plan adjustment strategy adopted by flights, and distributing corresponding airspace resources; judging corresponding conditions, and calculating average flight delay of the scheme; and determining a final flight pre-flight plan optimization scheme. The invention realizes the advance deduction of delay levels of different optimization schemes and effectively enhances the rationality of decision results. The flight subtraction considers the fairness of the airlines and the preference degree of the airlines, and improves the participation enthusiasm of the airlines in collaborative decisions.
assignees: THE 28TH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF CHINA ELECTRONICS TECH GROUP CORPORATION

title_en: Anonymous centralized transfer or allocation of resource
abstract_en: Systems and methods for centralized transfer or allocation of resources may include receiving a first set of data describing a plurality of providing entities and an associated number of units of a resource which are available for allocation; receiving a second set of data describing a resource request associated with a requesting entity; assessing the resource request according to a set of predefined allocation criteria; determining at least two providing entities for which the resource request satisfies the set of predefined allocation criteria; and dividing the resource request across the determined set of providing entities in accordance with a fairness criterion.

title_en: Distributed energy scheduling method for interconnected multi-park comprehensive energy system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed energy scheduling method of an interconnected multi-park comprehensive energy system, which comprises the following steps: establishing an equipment output model; establishing a comprehensive demand response model; establishing a waste heat interaction and electric energy interaction model among parks; establishing a park energy balance constraint model; constructing a multi-park comprehensive energy system objective function by taking the lowest total running cost as a target; and solving an objective function by using a regularized alternating direction multiplier algorithm containing a self-adaptive step length link. According to the invention, a waste heat interaction model, an electric energy interaction model and a comprehensive demand response model are established, so that the energy utilization efficiency and the scheduling flexibility are improved; according to the method, the regularized alternating direction multiplier algorithm with the self-adaptive step length links is used for carrying out distributed solving on the multi-park comprehensive energy system scheduling model, regularization can be used for avoiding excessive freedom in the solving process while guaranteeing fairness of the sub-problems, the self-adaptive step length links are added to improve the convergence speed of the algorithm, and the privacy of each park can be protected in the iterative process during distributed solving.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system operation optimization method considering multi-main body fraudulent conduct
abstract_en: The invention provides a comprehensive energy system operation optimization method considering multi-main body fraud. Firstly, constructing a comprehensive energy system collaborative optimization model under a multi-subject transaction mode; then, taking a multi-subject interaction model under the action of game fraud into consideration, and carrying out value evaluation on the multi-subject; finally, solving based on a virtual regretta minimization algorithm to obtain a final optimization result. The invention effectively solves the adverse effect of different main body fraud on the operation of the comprehensive energy system, and has the following beneficial effects: firstly, the fairness and transparency of the energy market are improved, and the benefit balance of each participating main body is ensured; secondly, the economic loss of the energy system caused by fraudulent conduct is reduced, and the economic benefit of the system is improved; and thirdly, the safety and stability of the energy system are improved, the mismatching of energy supply and demand and the unbalanced condition of power load are reduced, and reliable technical support and guarantee are provided for the efficient operation of the energy system.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE;JIANGXI TENGDA ELECTRIC POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Driver service management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of driver service management, and discloses a driver service management system, which obtains the quality of driver service based on the quality score, trip score, compliance score and safety score of the driver service through a service score evaluation module, a driver equity calculation module and a driver equity issuing module, further determines the driver equity and the driver issuing amount, is beneficial to objectively evaluating the driver performance and ensures equity distribution of equity.
assignees: BEIJING BAILONGMA YUNXING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Structured bidding document management method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of file management, in particular to a structured bidding file management method and system, which are used for solving the problems that the efficiency and accuracy of bidding process cannot be ensured because the conventional structured processing system of bidding files cannot reasonably classify the bidding files and allocate professionals for auditing; the structured bidding document management system comprises the following modules: the system comprises a bidding management module, a file acquisition module, a data analysis module, a file management platform and a file auditing module; according to the structured bidding document management method, by means of an automatic distribution method, errors caused by manual operation can be avoided, fairness of bidding process is guaranteed, in addition, special properties of each bidding document can be fully considered, each bidding document can be reasonably distributed to corresponding document auditors, and efficiency and accuracy of bidding process can be greatly improved.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID SHANXI TENDERING CO LTD

title_en: Logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method with priority division
abstract_en: The invention discloses a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation method with priority division, which comprises the following steps: s1, extracting three-dimensional operation space information of a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle based on a geographic environment, a low-altitude airspace structure and performance of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle, and acquiring performance parameters of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle; s2, acquiring transportation type, flow direction and flow time data of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle by combining the requirements of a logistics company and clients, and constructing a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle operation scene; s3, establishing a service satisfaction index of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle by combining task priority and fairness of the logistics company; s4, constructing a logistics unmanned aerial vehicle task allocation model by taking minimum flight impedance and maximum service satisfaction as targets; s5, solving the model by adopting an NSGA-II algorithm, and outputting an optimal resource allocation scheme of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle. By adopting the task allocation method of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle with priority division, the collaborative task allocation of a plurality of logistics unmanned aerial vehicles can be realized, and the operation efficiency and quality of the logistics unmanned aerial vehicle can be improved.

title_en: blockchain-based open-type data processing system of electrical construction for electric vehicle charging equipments which enables privacy protection
title_ko: 개인정보 보호 가능한 블록체인 기반의 개방형 전기차 충전설비 전기공사 데이터 처리 시스템
abstract_en: A purpose of the present invention is to provide a system that openly processes data related to a series of electric vehicle charging facility installation electrical work processes based on blockchain. The open electric vehicle charging facility electrical work data processing system based on blockchain that can protect personal information is to openly process various data generated during a series of electric vehicle charging facility installation electrical work processes in a blockchain-based manner by cooperating with an electric supplier server (300) that operates an electric supplier portal, a distributed ID issuance server (410) that issues a digital ID, a distributed ID, and a distributed ID verification server (420) that verifies the distributed ID. The system includes a use application processing unit (100), a license company processing unit (210), a construction company processing unit (220), and a record analysis server (600). According to the present invention, transparency and fairness in the electrical work process can be guaranteed and responsibility can be clearly determined in the event of a failure after the completion of construction, and accordingly, there is an advantage of being able to induce proper construction of electric vehicle charging facilities.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 전기차 충전설비 전기공사 신청, 전기공사 접수, 시공사업자 선정, 전기공사 수행으로 이루어지는 일련의 전기차 충전설비 설치용 전기공사 과정에 관련된 데이터를 블록체인 기반으로 개방형으로 처리하는 시스템에 관한 것이다. 특히, 본 발명은 전기차 충전설비 설치용 전기공사 신청자들(예: 아파트 입주민들)에 대한 개인정보를 일련의 전기공사 과정에서 적절하게 보호할 수 있는 블록체인 기반의 개방형 전기공사 정보처리 시스템에 관한 것이다. 본 발명에 따르면 전기차 충전설비 전기공사의 관리 전반을 디지털 방식으로 전환하여 전기공사에 관련된 데이터를 개방형으로 처리하고 시공관련 데이터를 명확하게 보존할 수 있어 전기공사 과정에 대한 투명성과 공정성을 보장할 수 있고 공사완료 이후에 장애 발생시에 책임소재를 분명히 가릴 수 있으며, 그에 따라 전기차 충전설비의 적정 시공을 유인할 수 있는 장점이 있다. 또한, 본 발명에 따르면 전기차 충전설비 신청 과정에서 제출된 신청자들의 개인정보를 시공사업자들이 임의로 접근할 수 없도록 통제함으로써 개인정보의 철저한 보호를 보장할 수 있는 장점이 있다.
assignees: HANSHIN UNIV INDUSTRY ACADEMIC COOPERATION FOUNDATION;SUNGJIN MAT CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant low-carbon equity space-time credibility evaluation and optimal scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The application relates to a method and a device for evaluating and optimizing space-time credibility of low-carbon rights and interests of a virtual power plant, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring a current regulation and control instruction of at least one sub-power distribution network area; based on the current regulation and control instruction, determining an energy storage scheduling strategy with the lowest current running cost by using an energy storage scheduling optimization model, wherein the energy storage scheduling optimization model is constructed according to an objective function and a preset core constraint condition based on the space-time characteristics of the electric energy value and the environmental value of the energy storage device of each sub-distribution network area; and optimally scheduling at least one sub-distribution network area according to the energy storage scheduling strategy with the lowest current running cost, and evaluating the carbon reduction benefits of the energy storage scheduling strategy with the lowest current running cost by utilizing an energy storage low-carbon interest evaluation model. Therefore, the problem that the related technology cannot fully evaluate the environmental benefit of the energy storage in the space-time multiple dimensions is solved.
assignees: UNIV TSINGHUA;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Loess region highway slope geological disaster susceptibility testing method based on time sequence
abstract_en: The application provides a loess region highway slope geological disaster susceptibility testing method based on a time sequence, which comprises the following steps: initializing a test object and an evaluation factor, and determining a geological disaster vulnerability evaluation factor; calculating the weight of each evaluation factor by using an analytic hierarchy process, and performing iterative optimization until the consistency check index CR reaches the global minimum; dividing the interval level of the evaluation factors, calculating the corresponding information quantity of each interval, and comprehensively obtaining the information quantity of the single side slope; calculating the AUC value of the evaluation result, and adjusting the interval grade division of the optimization evaluation factor until the evaluation result is relatively optimal; and defining a vulnerability evaluation section according to the evaluation result, and determining the slope evaluation grade. The method can improve the logic of the judgment matrix construction in the analytic hierarchy process, reduce the rationality of the division of the evaluation factor interval in the information quantity calculation, furthest reduce the influence of human subjective factors on the evaluation process, and improve the objective fairness and accuracy of the evaluation result.
assignees: SHANXI SMART TRAFFIC RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Pure electric bus network planning method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of urban traffic planning, and relates to a pure electric public transportation network planning method considering fairness, which comprises the following steps of obtaining site distribution and inter-site distance of a design area to obtain a road network structure diagram of the design area, constructing an objective function of a fairness model of a pure electric public transportation system with a minimum traffic coefficient as a target and an objective function of a total cost model of the pure electric public transportation network with a minimum social travel total cost as a target, further constructing a double-target nonlinear planning model of the pure electric public transportation network, setting constraint conditions of the double-target nonlinear planning model of the pure electric public transportation network by adopting an NAGS-II genetic algorithm, and solving the double-target nonlinear planning model of the pure electric public transportation network to obtain the pure electric public transportation planning network. The method reduces the traffic coefficient while minimizing the total cost of travel, effectively improves the fairness of the public transportation line network design scheme on the premise of controlling the total cost, and has important reference significance.

title_en: Daily emergency disaster relief material storage and emergency distribution method with maximum flow control
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of daily multi-cycle storage of stock materials, and provides a daily storage and emergency distribution method of emergency disaster relief materials with maximum flow control, which comprises the following steps: 1. issuing a purchase amount to a supplier; 2. updating the net stock, and collecting daily demands in the current period, so that suppliers can perform commodity production work; 3. based on the known daily demands of the current period, making inventory decisions; after being used for meeting inventory decisions, the rest part is used for meeting daily demands in the current period; 4. generating a rescue protocol based on inventory decisions for unknown bursty demands; 5. rescue is carried out according to a rescue protocol after the disaster. If the short-term single-stage emergency rescue process is considered, the method comprises a pre-disaster multi-inventory strategy, a rescue protocol based on the inventory strategy and a centralized clearing strategy based on the protocol. If a multi-stage continuous rescue process is considered, a pre-disaster multi-inventory strategy, a rescue protocol based on the inventory strategy, and a multi-stage decentralized settlement strategy based on the protocol are included. The invention has higher management efficiency and low cost.

title_en: Block chain-based multi-microgrid-containing power distribution system supervision and regulation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a block chain-based supervision and regulation method and system for a multi-microgrid-containing power distribution system, and belongs to the technical field of microgrid power distribution system optimization. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an electricity selling request of an electricity selling micro-grid node and an electricity purchasing request of an electricity purchasing micro-grid node in a power distribution system, wherein the electricity selling request or the electricity purchasing request is predicted based on a preset operation scheduling model; based on a preset blockchain intelligent contract, carrying out transaction matching on the electricity selling request and the electricity purchasing request to obtain a transaction scheduling scheme; and respectively sending the transaction scheduling scheme to the terminal where the electricity selling micro-grid node is located and the terminal where the electricity purchasing micro-grid node is located, and performing transaction scheduling according to the transaction scheduling scheme. The block chain architecture is combined with the power distribution system with multiple micro-networks, so that the safety of data and the fairness of a regulation and control process can be guaranteed, and the problem that each micro-network main body is not suitable for traditional centralized regulation and control and is difficult to respond to a dispatching mechanism actively is solved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER CO WEIFANG POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Electric power communication service risk balance route optimization method and system based on service characteristics
abstract_en: The invention discloses a power communication service risk balance route optimization method based on service characteristics, which mainly comprises two parts, namely a multi-type multi-service oriented part and a single-type multi-service oriented part. Firstly, aiming at multiple types of multiple businesses, an analytic hierarchy process is introduced, related evaluation indexes of the businesses are selected, and a business importance evaluation model is constructed; the concepts of overall network risk degree, overall network risk balance degree and the like are provided, and optimal screening is carried out by utilizing a maximum and minimum fairness constraint formula based on risk balance; secondly, according to single-type multiple services, service related constraint conditions are induced, then a risk balance route optimization model based on real-time delay is arranged, and then a route optimization mechanism is designed based on common evolution and self-adaptive fuzzy genetic algorithm. The invention can solve the problem of a power communication service risk balance route optimization mechanism, ensure the stable operation of the network, and improve the performance indexes such as safety, reliability, real time and the like of the service.
assignees: DALIAN POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Disaster relief material two-stage vehicle scheduling path optimization method and system based on KMG-ALNS algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster relief material two-stage vehicle dispatching path optimization method, system, storage medium and electronic equipment based on a KMG-ALNS algorithm, and relates to the technical field of vehicle dispatching. Aiming at the problem of optimizing the dispatching paths of two-stage vehicles for disaster relief materials, the invention sequentially determines the position of the stop point of the first-stage vehicle and the optimal distribution path of the second-stage vehicle from the stop point to the disaster relief point under the condition of known disaster relief condition and considering the limitation of the carrying capacity and the cruising ability of the second-stage vehicle, thereby quickly acquiring the optimal solution and realizing the minimization of the system cost.

title_en: Energy station energy supply allocation method and equipment based on energy utilization data of preset time period
abstract_en: The invention provides an energy supply allocation method and equipment for an energy station based on energy consumption data of a preset time period. The method comprises the following steps: determining energy utilization data indexes and limiting functions of the energy utilization data indexes in a preset time period, and constructing an energy utilization data curve according to the energy utilization data indexes; constructing a polymerization degree evaluation function of the energy consumption data curve, and repeatedly polymerizing and optimizing the energy consumption data curve to obtain a plurality of polymerization schemes; if the polymerization degree evaluation function of one polymerization scheme is strictly better than that of other polymerization schemes after optimization, determining the one polymerization scheme as the final optimized polymerization scheme using the energy data curve; and determining energy production quotas of the energy stations in different time periods according to the final optimized polymerization scheme. The invention can ensure accurate energy production of the energy station, lighten the resource waste in the energy production, ensure the economical efficiency and the environmental protection of energy supply production of the energy station and finally realize the balance and the optimization of energy supply of the energy station.

title_en: Educational resource sharing method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The system comprises a resource acquisition module, a target customer information distribution module, a teaching fee collection module, a resource acquisition timing fee collection result and an additional fee collection processing result, wherein the resource acquisition module acquires teaching resource information of each industry and resource information of all learning entity stores, the target customer information acquisition module acquires teaching resource demand information of a target customer, the teaching resource distribution module acquires target teaching resources required by the target customer according to the teaching resource demand information, the teaching fee collection module carries out information pushing analysis and teaching fee collection processing on the target teaching resources corresponding to a teacher and the target customer, the teaching teacher is selected and determined by the target customer, the resource acquisition timing fee collection result and the additional fee collection processing result are output, and the customer information management module carries out teaching resource information popularization and data introduction and quotation on a platform. The educational resource sharing method and system based on big data provided by the invention expand the class of educational resources and the fairness of resource acquisition.
assignees: HANGZHOU WUXI E COMMERCE CO LTD

title_en: Motor-truck utilization type disaster countermeasure system
abstract_en: To provide a motor-truck utilization type disaster countermeasure system which is capable of quickly providing emergency supplies to people who require them at the time of a disaster by utilizing the enormous number of motor-trucks traveling all over Japan everyday.SOLUTION: A motor-truck utilization type disaster countermeasure system is configured so as to take out a handbag 31 from an upper face opening 23 by opening a cardboard 23 which is normally installed on a front passenger seat Ka of a motor-truck K when a disaster occurs and next, to put a plurality of item packaging bodies 19 into the handbag 31. It thereby makes it possible to convey the plurality of item packaging bodies 19 easily. And then, the system is configured so as to distribute the item packaging bodies 19 to people who require emergency supplies by moving with the handbag 31. The system can function effectively for a person who receives the item packaging body 19 because a plurality of kinds of emergency supplies are packaged for every person in the item packaging body 19.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Network-contracted vehicle fleet scale and charging rate collaborative optimization method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network vehicle team scale and charging rate collaborative optimization method, which comprises the following steps: s1, determining input parameters and output parameters of an optimization model; s2, under the condition that passengers sensitive to price and waiting time are considered, calculating through expected utility functions under the condition that service benefits are considered, and further calculating possible passenger candidates and taxi pricing rates according to average passenger demand rates; s3, calculating profit of the service platform; s4, calculating passenger benefits; and S5, optimizing an objective function, wherein the objective function is that the profit of the platform is maximized or the profit of the platform and the profit of passengers are maximized. According to the invention, the taxi platform vehicle resource allocation efficiency is fully exerted, the social fairness is considered, and the benign development of the market is promoted.

title_en: Scientific and technological rewarding form examination system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a scientific and technological rewarding form examination system, and belongs to the technical field of computer application. The scientific and technological rewarding form examination system of the invention utilizes the form examination information management module to create examination tasks and distribute input personnel and examination personnel, examines the support materials of the rewarding items according to set examination contents, automatically gives examination suggestions, and can generate form examination reports. The invention utilizes the computing technology to automatically compare the contents in the prize-awarding item supporting material according to the examination contents, thereby avoiding the problems of low efficiency and incomplete examination caused by manual examination, improving the accuracy and the working efficiency of formal examination work and ensuring the fairness of scientific and technological rewarding examination.

title_en: Dynamic distribution method for arid period river basin water quantity
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic water distribution method for a arid period river basin, which comprises the following steps: dividing a river basin into a plurality of distribution units according to a water resource partition nested administrative region, and dividing a hydrologic forecasting period into a plurality of time periods from front to back at equal intervals in sequence; setting a particle group comprising a plurality of storage allocation unit water allocation scheme particles, wherein the particles comprise a position tensor and a speed tensor; calculating fairness balance of water distribution based on satisfaction of water distribution, calculating total energy output efficiency based on energy output of various water consumption, and constructing a particle fitness function by combining drought control factors; determining a water distribution scheme of the current period through iterative calculation optimizing of particle fitness; and configuring the water consumption of the river basin in the current period, and then circularly starting the water distribution scheme in the next period to optimize. The method and the system realize the dynamic distribution of the water quantity of the river basin by combining with real-time hydrologic forecast, fully coordinate the fairness, balance and efficiency of the water distribution of the river basin in the drought period, and provide reference for the regulation and control of the water resource of the river basin in the drought period.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Thermal power plant carbon quota allocation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon quota allocation, in particular to a carbon quota allocation method for a thermal power plant, which can realize carbon quota allocation with efficiency as a target by using DEA, and is characterized in that the total amount of annual carbon quota allocation of an emission reduction target is t, n power plants of a traditional power generation type are provided, and each thermal power plant comprises three inputs, two expected outputs and one unexpected output; wherein investment includes energy, capital, labor, etc.; the expected output includes the power generation amount, the heat supply amount, and the like; the undesirable output is carbon emissions; the method specifically comprises the following steps: objective function, constraint, and carbon quota allocation algorithm that combines efficiency and fairness. Aiming at the electric heating requirements, the structural characteristics of the thermal power plant, the actual requirements such as carbon quota allocation of the thermal power plant and the like, a carbon quota basic allocation model with efficiency as a target is established by utilizing DEA, and the efficiency and fairness of the thermal power plant are considered on the basis of guaranteeing the safety of electric heating supply by combining a Tamu-compensation fair iterative allocation mechanism.

title_en: Low-carbon regulation and control method and device for wind, light and hydrogen storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a low-carbon regulation and control method and a device for a wind, light and hydrogen storage system, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining characteristic parameters of various devices in the system; establishing a corresponding carbon emission model according to characteristic parameters of various devices in the system; constructing a carbon flow tracing model of the system according to the carbon emission model; calculating the network loss allocation rate when the system operates, and constructing a network loss equivalent carbon emission allocation model by combining a carbon flow tracing model; constructing an optimization decision model of a user and a wind-light-hydrogen storage system according to the network loss equivalent carbon emission allocation model, and determining constraint conditions; solving the optimization decision model to obtain an optimal operation strategy and benefit; according to the method, the network loss allocation rate is calculated based on the network loss generation factor and combined with the line physics and line parameters, the network loss equivalent carbon emission responsibility between the power generation main body and the energy consumption main body is divided, the carbon fairness of the power system is maintained, the main bodies of all parties can be stimulated to realize the carbon emission responsibility, and an accurate judgment basis is provided for implementing carbon excitation or carbon punishment measures.

title_en: Multi-region interconnected comprehensive energy collaborative optimization operation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-region interconnected comprehensive energy collaborative optimization operation method and system, comprising the following steps: the system comprises a multi-region interconnected system frame which is further formed by a comprehensive energy system consisting of energy supply equipment, energy coupling equipment and energy storage equipment; and a collaborative optimization operation model targeting a minimum collaborative operation cost of the multi-region interconnected integrated energy system; further, the method also comprises a bargained gain distribution model adopting a Nash-Hassay bargained gain distribution method of the cooperative game. The method effectively realizes the collaborative optimization operation of the comprehensive energy systems in a plurality of areas and the flexible resource sharing between networks, promotes the consumption of renewable energy sources, reduces the operation cost of the system and ensures the fairness and rationality of income distribution.

title_en: Blockchain network system, traceability management system, and method
abstract_en: The present invention contributes to objective, neutral, equitable, fair, and easy confirmation of a state present in data when tracing collected information. Provided is a blockchain network system in which nodes are connected in a network and which is configured to allow the nodes to hold identical information about an object in a distributed manner, the nodes comprising: a plurality of responsible nodes each responsible for providing a predetermined role; and a role-providing node configured to store a role database in which a corresponding role is defined for each responsible node, provide each responsible node with a role on the basis of the role database, and connect the responsible node to at least one corresponding terminal outside the blockchain network system.

title_en: Highway network gradient optimization method and device based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a road network gradient optimization method and device based on big data, which belong to the technical field of traffic transportation engineering modeling, and the technical problems to be solved by the invention are as follows: the hierarchical function division of the highway network is fuzzy; the highway trip service capability is insufficient; the highway network has weak sustainable development capability. The specific method of the invention comprises the following steps: collecting regional basic geographic information data, traffic geographic information data, economic and social development data and traffic development data; the large data technology is utilized for processing and analyzing, the scale adaptability, the space accessibility, the fairness and the connectivity of the regional highway network are obtained, a highway network development gradient evaluation result is formed, key factors influencing highway network gradient optimization are further determined, an optimization algorithm is used on the basis, the highway network layout is optimized according to the key factors, an implementation scheme is formulated, the implementation effect is evaluated, and the aims of optimizing the regional highway network structure and improving the regional highway network transportation function are achieved.
assignees: UNIV XINJIANG;XINJIANG HUAYUAN YUNCHI ENTERPRISE MAN CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle network resource allocation method for urban neighborhood emergency communication
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle network resource allocation method for urban block emergency communication, and belongs to the technical field of wireless communication. The method firstly provides a layered rate division multiple access transmission model to cope with communication interference in a cell and among cells, converts the resource allocation problem of an unmanned aerial vehicle network into an optimization problem of combining multiple unmanned aerial vehicle deployment positions, precoding and rate allocation to maximize the minimum user accessibility, and then solves the optimization problem based on a rapid simulated annealing algorithm to obtain the unmanned aerial vehicle network deployment positions, precoding and rate allocation. The method solves the problems that a plurality of air-ground links are seriously interfered by communication and the communication links are blocked by obstacles, can ensure the fairness coverage of urban ground user communication service, improves the communication capacity of the system, and realizes the efficient resource allocation of the unmanned aerial vehicle network in the urban street environment.

title_en: Route planning method considering heterogeneity of driver based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a path planning method considering driver heterogeneity based on machine learning, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing an on-demand distribution optimization model based on maximizing platform long-term benefits in a period of operation time; training a prediction model to predict a category of the real-time order using a two-stage classification prediction algorithm based on machine learning; and solving the established on-demand distribution optimization model to obtain an optimal solution and an optimal strategy of the vehicle path planning problem. The method can effectively improve order distribution efficiency, realizes the excitation of new drivers, and provides a tool for balancing efficiency and fairness for logistics service providers.

title_en: New energy automobile charging station monitored control system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent charging network management and new energy automobile support systems, in particular to a new energy automobile charging station monitoring system. In the invention, the energy management module adopting the convolutional neural network and the long-term and short-term memory network improves the power demand and the power grid load prediction accuracy and improves the energy utilization rate. The safety early warning module combines a support vector machine, a decision tree and an isolated forest algorithm, so that the system safety is improved. In the aspect of pricing optimization, charging prices are adjusted according to power grid loads and user demands by using an ARIMA model and a Q learning algorithm, so that fairness and market response are improved. The charging scheduling module improves and adopts linear programming and genetic algorithm, and charging efficiency is improved. The data acquisition and processing analysis module is upgraded to provide comprehensive and accurate monitoring data.
assignees: GUANGDONG LINKJOY ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method, system, device and storage medium for dynamic issuing of rights and interests products
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of information processing, and particularly relates to a method, a system, a device and a storage medium for dynamically issuing rights and interests. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring user information and inventory rights and interests product information; performing data cleaning and preprocessing on the user information and the inventory right product information to obtain a first feature set; screening the first feature set to determine an optimal feature subset; constructing a verification probability prediction model of the same equity product; classifying the inventory equity products into different distribution levels, and matching the inventory equity products into corresponding distribution levels; predicting the verification probability of different release grades by using a verification probability prediction model to obtain the probability of verifying the same equity product by a user in different expiration time periods; and sorting the verification probability, and taking out the inventory from the release grade to release to the user according to the sorting result. The method solves the problems that the product to be expired cannot be fully utilized in the prior art by dynamically issuing the strategy.
assignees: SHANDONG DINGXIN DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Traffic flow prediction method based on dynamic sampling and related equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a traffic flow prediction method and related equipment based on dynamic sampling, which take calculated sampling probability and preset total sampling number of road nodes as constraint conditions, and sample the road nodes in each traffic area to obtain balanced and diversified data, thereby improving the unbalanced problem of traffic flow data and enabling areas containing different road nodes to obtain similar prediction performance; and forming double-layer fairness constraint according to the discrimination loss, individual dynamic fairness loss, model utility loss and regional static fairness loss of the space-time prediction model so as to promote training and optimization of the space-time prediction model, so that the optimized space-time prediction model generates a fair and accurate traffic flow prediction result, and the accuracy and fairness of regional traffic flow prediction are improved.
assignees: UNIV CENTRAL SOUTH;SHENZHEN RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF NANJING UNIV OF AERONAUTICS AND ASTRONAUTICS

title_en: Water supply allocation method for water supply plant
abstract_en: The application discloses a water supply allocation method for a water supply plant, which comprises the following steps: determining population density, water demand type and water supply network distribution data of a plurality of subarea water supply areas of the water supply area; if the water supply area comprises a first water supply area, predicting the water consumption of each subarea water supply area according to the population density and the water demand type of each subarea water supply area; inputting population density, water demand type and water consumption into a regression analysis model to obtain predicted water supply quantity of each subarea water supply area; inputting population density, water demand type and water consumption into a regression analysis model to obtain predicted water supply pressure of each subarea water supply area; and obtaining the operation water supply quantity and the operation water supply pressure of each subarea water supply area in a fixed time period according to the maximum water supply pressure of the water supply plant, the maximum water supply quantity of the water supply plant, the distribution data of the water supply network, the predicted water supply quantity and the predicted water supply pressure. And water supply allocation is reasonably carried out.

title_en: Optimal path planning method and system for line inspection task distribution
abstract_en: An optimal path planning method and system for line patrol task allocation, comprising: step 1, obtaining line plane coordinate data; step 2, preprocessing the obtained line plane coordinate data to obtain preprocessed line plane coordinate data; step 3, dividing the preprocessed line plane coordinate data obtained in the step 2 to obtain line plane coordinate data of different areas; and 4, carrying out optimal path planning on line inspection of each zone according to the line plane coordinate data of the different zones obtained in the step 3.
