When the line inspection path is planned, the relationship among the line, the tower and the line channel and the inspection path mileage difference of a plurality of inspection staff are considered, and the obtained inspection path can realize comprehensive inspection of the line, ensure the fairness and the rationality of planning and effectively improve the efficiency and the quality of line inspection work.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SUZHOU POWER SUPPLY BRANCH;ZHANGJIAGANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Distributed central large kitchen system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed central large kitchen system. The system comprises: processing food materials into finished products or semi-finished products according to order information, and manufacturing the food materials into a package central kitchen of a standardized meal; a food material supply base for purchasing, culturing, and storing food materials; a logistics distribution system for distributing food material from a food material supply base to the central kitchen and distributing meal packages from the central kitchen to community aid distribution; the community meal assisting distribution is used for distributing the meal packages to the appointed places within the range of the responsible area; and the enterprise industrial Internet system is used for connecting links and collecting data, and performing big data analysis by using the collected data so as to reduce the cost. The invention can provide more convenient and special kitchen products for the elderly users, and ensure the consistency of commodity quality and sanitary standard. Through centralized purchasing, production and price control, the added value of commodities is improved, and the profit of enterprises is ensured, so that the reciprocal win-win between enterprises and users is realized.

title_en: Method and system for determining local fairness of ml model with degree of fairness
abstract_en: State of the art model fairness approaches do not address the degree of local fairness of a ML model. A method and system for determining local fairness of a classification Machine Learning (ML) model with degree of fairness is disclosed. The method creates multiple perturb instances using multilevel GMM clustering approach and a constrained perturbation technique to ensure feature distribution of perturbed data, generated from a tabular base data is within the feature distribution of the tabular base data of the ML model. Further, the class of a protected attribute is flipped, black box model prediction probabilities and the cosine similarity constraint and multiplication factor on the probabilities is used to provide a degree of fairness for the local instance. Thus, provides magnitude of fairness or unfairness to the local instance.

title_en: Fairness enhancing method for hierarchical federal learning RSU scheduling in Internet of vehicles scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fairness enhancing method for hierarchical federal learning RSU scheduling in a car networking scene, which comprises the steps of firstly, defining the car networking scene and intelligently identifying tasks; then constructing a hierarchical federation learning framework in a car networking scene, and describing a main process of participating in cloud aggregation by a vehicle user and an RSU; then, the RSU scheduling problem is converted into a multi-arm slot machine problem, the RSU is selected by using a confidence upper bound algorithm, and meanwhile, the freshness of local data is introduced to enhance the fairness of the process; finally, using Jain index, and combining classification accuracy and overall system time delay to provide comprehensive index for evaluation; the method solves the fairness problem of hierarchical federal learning RSU scheduling problem in the scene of the Internet of vehicles.
assignees: UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS;JIANGSU FUTURE NETWORKS INNOVATION INST

title_en: Comprehensive management system for competition of community robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive management system for competition of a community robot, which relates to the technical field of data analysis and comprises the following components: the system comprises a historical data acquisition module, a scoring module, a matching model module and an updating module; the historical data acquisition module is used for acquiring historical contest records of contestants to construct a historical contest record array; the scoring module is used for evaluating the strength level of each contestant based on the historical contestant record array to obtain contestant capacity indexes; the matching model module is used for performing matching operation based on contestant capacity indexes to obtain an optimal allocation scheme; the updating module is used for acquiring the competition result of the optimal allocation scheme and updating the historical competition record array; through a plurality of modules, comprehensive analysis of contestants is realized, fairness of contestant competition is ensured, and then the competition contestants with equivalent flagstones are added to improve ornamental value of the competition.
assignees: KUNSHAN JUNYOU TECH TRAINING CO LTD

title_en: Demographic data analysis method and system based on deep fairness clustering
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of data mining cluster analysis, and provides a demographic data analysis method and system based on deep fair clustering. The method comprises the steps of taking gender as a binary data point PSV attribute for providing a fairness protection effect, inputting a census data set, and acquiring sensitive attributes of the census data set to obtain two groups with different characteristics, namely a first group and a second group; proportional representation is carried out on the first group and the second group, rough evaluation is carried out on expected values of fairness protection, and target values of fairness protection, namely initial clustering clusters, are determined; constructing a clustered neural network, introducing a judging function, and mapping the fair distribution cluster matrix to an output matrix; calculating the information entropy of the fair distribution cluster matrix and the conditional entropy of the fair distribution cluster matrix and the output matrix; calculating a difference value between the information entropy and the conditional entropy, and maximizing the difference value; and constructing a clustering target constraint based on the initial clustering, the difference value and the elastic network.
assignees: QILU UNIV OF TECHNOLOGY SHANDONG ACADEMY OF SCIENCES

title_en: Hydropower station multi-target balanced scheduling method with minimum negative externality
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective balanced scheduling method for a hydropower station with minimum negative externality, which comprises the steps of selecting a scheduling objective function according to actual scheduling requirements, setting constraint conditions and optimization solving parameters to construct a multi-objective optimization scheduling model, solving each non-inferior solution on the pareto front of the multi-objective optimization scheduling model based on the selected solving algorithm to obtain a non-inferior solution set, calculating the negative externality of each non-inferior solution on the pareto front by utilizing a negative externality calculation method, and taking a scheduling scheme corresponding to the non-inferior solution with the minimum negative externality on the non-inferior solution set as an optimal balanced scheduling scheme. The method has the advantages that fairness and efficiency among targets are effectively balanced, and other targets such as ecology and the like can be fairly considered while the running benefit of the hydropower station is improved. Compared with the prior art, the balanced scheduling method obviously improves the benefits and fairness of multi-objective scheduling.

title_en: User resource scheduling method, system and storage medium based on multi-agent reinforcement learning framework
abstract_en: The invention relates to a user resource scheduling method, a system and a storage medium based on a multi-agent reinforcement learning framework, wherein the method comprises the following steps: formalizing a target application scene and constructing a basic mode of resource scheduling; describing user work logic by using a state machine idea based on discrete time sequence, and taking the user work logic as a basis for operation of a scheduling algorithm; constructing a reinforcement learning algorithm frame, and defining a standardized observation space for reinforcement learning agents; the reinforcement learning agent makes a decision in the action space according to the observation index, and calculates a reward function; designing a strategy function and a cost function matched with the observation space of the agent based on a performer-criticizing home framework; and finishing the training and deployment of the decision model, and carrying out user resource scheduling. The invention can more intelligently cope with complex resource scheduling scenes, reasonably distributes resources between the dominant users and the inferior users, and greatly improves the fairness of resource scheduling on the premise of ensuring the total utilization rate of the resources to be basically unchanged.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system energy-carbon interactive scheduling method and device based on multi-element game
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy scheduling of power systems, in particular to a comprehensive energy system energy-carbon interaction scheduling method and device based on multi-element games. In the invention, a multi-polymer and multi-producer and a multi-producer in the comprehensive energy system form a cooperative game, and a multi-polymer and multi-producer cooperative game mode considering multi-energy and carbon interaction and a low-carbon mechanism is established; and (3) establishing a cooperative game model and a characteristic function of the multi-producer and the multi-aggregator by considering electric energy, heat energy and carbon emission rights sharing. The double-layer profit distribution method based on the multi-subject participation contribution degree is provided, and the fairness of distribution is ensured. The invention introduces a multi-element and flexible interaction mode and a multi-energy-carbon transaction strategy, builds a multi-energy market cooperative energy-carbon coupling interaction mode, improves the system load characteristic, promotes renewable energy consumption and multi-energy mutual economy, and realizes the flexibility, low carbon and safety of multi-AOP and multi-yield operation.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium for dividing distribution area
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for dividing a distribution area, which can be applied to the technical field of logistics. The method comprises the following steps: acquiring an interest surface set in a target area; carrying out distribution area division on the interest surface set according to the preset division quantity, and generating an initial distribution division scheme; taking the initial distribution dividing scheme as a current dividing scheme, and carrying out local search based on the current dividing scheme to generate a candidate dividing scheme to obtain a candidate dividing scheme set; determining fairness coefficients corresponding to the candidate division schemes according to the distribution parameter information aiming at each candidate division scheme in the candidate division scheme set; determining a target distribution division scheme from the candidate division scheme set according to the fairness coefficient; the target distribution division scheme is used as a current division scheme to iteratively perform local search; and outputting a final distribution area dividing scheme when the local search is determined to meet the search ending condition.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG QIANSHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Ground transportation vehicle
abstract_en: A ground transportation vehicle includes a container having a bucket, a hook, and a handle, and a suspension system connected to the container and having first and second rockers and bogies, a plurality of wheels, a plurality of wheel connectors, and one or more variable fasteners. A method of operating a ground transportation vehicle is disclosed. Embodiments of the present disclosure provide solutions to ground transportation of supplies from disaster relief distribution sites to the homes or present lodging locations of disaster victims. In particular, solutions of the present disclosure provide efficient and ergonomic ground transportation when compared to conventional techniques currently used.
assignees: OKEEFE SIENA LYN;ASIF OMERA SYED;KENNARD BENJAMIN YEHL;YANZ ANA;JOHNSON BRAEDEN ARMSTRONG;FERRELL BENJAMIN

title_en: Mine ventilation system with tunnel wind flow reverse resistance increasing function
abstract_en: The invention discloses a mine ventilation system with a roadway wind flow reverse resistance increasing function, which comprises two groups of flow control baffle assemblies oppositely arranged in two sides of a ventilation roadway, wherein a central through air passage is formed between the two groups of flow control baffle assemblies, each group of flow control baffle assemblies comprises a plurality of flow control baffles, each flow control baffle is divided into a plurality of wide flow control baffles and a plurality of narrow flow control baffles which are alternately distributed, the inner side ends of the wide flow control baffles are connected with the corresponding side inner walls of the ventilation roadway, an air flow gap exists between the inner side ends of the narrow flow control baffles and the corresponding side inner walls of the ventilation roadway, and a bypass air passage with two ends communicated with the central through air passage is formed between any narrow flow control baffle and two wide flow control baffles adjacent to the same side. The invention can effectively solve the problems that when the thermal power disaster accident occurs, the traditional air door is in a tight state due to the negative pressure generated by the working face disaster, disaster relief materials are difficult to smoothly transport, and working face operators are difficult to open the air door to quickly escape.

title_en: Method and system for evaluating cooperative medical system policy of agriculture and animal husbandry
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating a medical system policy of agriculture and animal husbandry cooperation, which relate to the technical field of medical insurance system research, and realize accurate allocation of medical resources and personalized assistance by analyzing medical requirements of agriculture and animal husbandry areas and economic conditions of herd and herd people in detail; firstly, by collecting disease data and the balance of herdsmen, the medical self-expense upper limit is customized for the herdsmen with different economic conditions, the accuracy and fairness of medical assistance are enhanced, and then, by analyzing the matching index and the personal self-expense burden index, the reimbursement policy is optimized, the effective utilization of resources is ensured, and the economic burden of the herdsmen is lightened; finally, the constructed adjustment evaluation model improves the flexibility and the instantaneity of policy adjustment, ensures the adaptability and the fairness of the system, promotes the overall improvement of the medical service level, and realizes the fair and efficient medical resource allocation.

title_en: Emergency supply stockpile used for disaster relief float shelter
abstract_en: To provide a disaster relief float shelter which floats and does not submerge even if it is hit by severe flooding, can be loaded overhanging both sides of a truck cargo bed, is transported to a disaster area without any sliding or falling accidents, and is installed horizontally on an uneven ground surface and is used for medical facilities after distributing relief supplies to disaster victims.SOLUTION: A disaster relief float shelter does not submerge as the barge's oar frame of a floating structure is outfitted with waterproofing. When trucks are traveling on steep curves or rough roads, jack seat plates on both sides of a cargo bed prevent the truck from sliding sideways, thus ensuring safe transportation without causing slipping or falling accidents. When unloading the truck on uneven ground, a base jack inserted in the jack seat plate is used to adjust and install the disaster relief float shelter horizontally. After distributing relief supplies from an emergency supply stockpile to disaster victims, beds which are used also for storage shelves are removed and separated, and used as medical beds to use the disaster relief floor shelter, and the empty storage space is used by a disaster relief medical team as a medical first aid station, or a hospital room for disaster victims as a post-disaster medical base. Thus, speedy lifesaving medical activities prevent related deaths due to severe disasters.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 3
assignees: DEBARI NOBUAKI;DEBARI HIROYASU;DEBARI MICHIKO;YAMAZAKI REI;YAMAZAKI MAIKO

title_en: Electric automobile charging guiding method considering user satisfaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric vehicle charging, in particular to an electric vehicle charging guiding method considering user satisfaction, which comprises the following steps of collecting relevant information of all charging stations in a dispatching area; the method comprises the steps of collecting charging requirements and position information of an electric vehicle sending a charging application in a dispatching period, obtaining a charging guiding sequence of the electric vehicle based on a nearby guiding strategy, guaranteeing fairness of a charging process, constructing a user satisfaction evaluation model by taking total charging time and total charging cost of the electric vehicle as clustering points, guiding the electric vehicle according to the charging guiding sequence in sequence, and solving the user satisfaction evaluation model with the highest user satisfaction as a target when guiding any electric vehicle, so as to obtain an optimal guiding result of the current electric vehicle. The invention can save the time cost and the cost of charging for the electric automobile user, improve the satisfaction degree of the user and effectively consider the utilization rate of the charging station.

title_en: Double-queue ordered full-capacity charging method for private charging piles of public transformer area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a public transformer area private charging pile double-queue ordered capacity-saving charging method, which takes whether the total charging power of the public transformer area private charging pile is smaller than or equal to the distribution capacity as a judging condition, and is provided with an on-charging queue, a fixed equity charging queue and a competitive charging queue in an ordered capacity-saving charging strategy to perform charging management on the charging pile, so that the charging pile realizes different charging control under different time periods according to the two queues, namely the fixed equity charging queue and the competitive charging queue. The embodiment of the invention meets the increasing installation requirement of the charging pile and balances the peak-to-valley load of residential electricity of the cell on the premise of not increasing the existing distribution capacity of the cell.
assignees: HANGZHOU YINGLING TECH CO LTD;ZHU CHUANBAI

title_en: Electric vehicle charging control method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a charging control method, a device, equipment and a storage medium for an electric vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps: acquiring respective historical delivery order information and charging related information of electric vehicles in a current area; determining respective charging control information of the electric vehicles based on the historical delivery order information and the charging related information; and carrying out charging control on the electric vehicle based on the charging control information. The invention can reduce the deviation of the quantity of the distribution orders among the riders in the charging control process of the electric vehicle, improve the fairness of the charging control of the electric vehicle and ensure that the riders can work in a fair environment.
assignees: SHENGDOUSHI SHANGHAI TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Ecological compensation method for cross-regional water source supply service
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ecological compensation method for cross-regional water source supply service, which belongs to the field of comprehensive utilization of ecological water resources and comprises the following steps: determining a target river basin for water resource supply and demand, and dividing the target river basin into n different evaluation areas according to administrative areas; calculating an ecological compensation coefficient k (i) according to the water supply E (i) and the water demand F (i) in the evaluation area i; and (3) evaluating whether the water source in the target flow area can be self-sufficient or not by using the ecological compensation coefficients k (i) of all evaluation areas in the target flow area, and formulating a system for scheduling the water source in the target flow area and an ecological compensation standard according to the self-sufficient condition. The invention can rapidly serve the quantitative analysis and implementation of the ecological compensation of the upper, middle and lower streams of the watershed, comprehensively considers multiparty factors, reduces the uncertainty and subjectivity of the ecological compensation of the area, embodies fairness and fairness, reduces the cost of water resource scheduling and utilization, and improves the economic benefit.
assignees: UNIV CHONGQING;CHONGQING INST GEOLOGY & MINERAL RESOURCES

title_en: Intelligent gas pipe network gas supply allocation method, internet of things system and medium
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent gas pipe network gas supply allocation method, an Internet of things system and a medium, which comprise the following steps: the method comprises the steps that an internal combustion gas metering device in a target area is controlled to obtain gas statistical data and store the gas statistical data in a storage unit; acquiring historical gas consumption data of a target area; determining target demand information of a future time point of the target area based on the historical gas consumption data; based on the target demand information, predicting a target difference amplitude of a gas supply and demand difference at a future time point of a target area; determining supply and demand difference reasons corresponding to a target area based on gas statistical data, target difference amplitude and environment data of the target area for the target area with the target difference amplitude meeting a first preset condition; determining a gas supply adjustment parameter based on the target difference amplitude and the supply and demand difference reason, storing the gas supply adjustment parameter into a storage unit, generating a gas supply adjustment instruction based on the gas supply adjustment parameter, and sending the gas supply adjustment instruction to the terminal equipment; and generating an allocation instruction in response to the remaining storage space meeting a second preset condition.

title_en: Reordering method for guaranteeing minimum recommendation utility while considering fairness of both parties
abstract_en: The invention relates to a reordering method for guaranteeing minimum recommendation utility while considering fairness of both sides, which comprises the following steps: calculating the preference score of the user for the articles according to the interest and hobbies of the user, and forming an initial recommendation list according to the ranking from high score to low score And will each Are all considered runways; from the slave According to the front Top-K articles, corresponding exposure resources are allocated for each provider; distributing a fair lifting speed to each provider through a heuristic function according to the distribution condition of provider side exposure resources; each runway The articles on the table acquire the corresponding fair lifting speed according to the provider to which the articles belong; and (3) re-calculating the score according to the determined preference score of each article and the determined corresponding fair lifting speed obtained by the article, and reordering the articles from high to low according to the new score, wherein the reordered recommendation list is denoted as l  u . The method is applicable to static and dynamic recommended scenes and has the characteristics of easy expansion and lower time complexity.

title_en: Air pollution collaborative emission reduction scheme optimization method based on multi-model coupling algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of atmospheric science, and discloses an optimization method of an atmospheric pollution collaborative emission reduction scheme based on a multi-model coupling algorithm, which is used for simulating a preset reference annual emission reduction scene based on a multi-scale air quality model CAMx, carrying out statistical fitting on a simulation result, and constructing a PM  2.5  emission-concentration response curved surface model; acquiring data information of all emission sources and pollutants, quantitatively analyzing emission reduction potential of the emission sources and the pollutants based on the data information, and determining an optimization interval; optimizing an emission reduction scheme of the optimization interval according to a genetic algorithm and a PM  2.5  emission-concentration response curve model; based on the optimization result, the emission reduction amounts of pollutants are respectively distributed to corresponding pollution sources to determine the optimized emission reduction scheme, the invention can construct an atmospheric pollution cooperative emission reduction scheme optimization method according to multiple models, the method realizes the transformation from 'one-cut' to fairness emission reduction, and obtains an emission reduction scheme which meets the air quality target and simultaneously gives consideration to fairness.

title_en: Comprehensive talent management system
abstract_en: The invention particularly relates to a comprehensive talent management system. In the comprehensive talent management system, an administrator creates a declaration template through a template creation module, and an upper management department is responsible for issuing a comment task through a task issuing module, so that a comment standard and time schedule are defined; the declaration person submits the declaration through a declaration and auditing module according to the task requirement; the expert evaluation selecting and scoring module is responsible for constructing and maintaining an expert evaluation library, and scoring online or offline is carried out on the basis of the expert evaluation extracted from the expert evaluation library according to the specific requirements of the evaluation task; the scoring summarization and decision-making module is responsible for summarizing scoring results, and the superior management department makes decisions and publishes according to the comprehensive scores. The comprehensive talent management system solves the problems of low efficiency, insufficient transparency, lack of flexibility and expandability and inconsistent evaluation and selection standards in the prior art, simplifies talent management flow, improves the efficiency and fairness of evaluation, and is suitable for talent management of organizations of various scales.

title_en: Method and system for generating college entrance examination football score based on neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of sports score evaluation, in particular to a method and a system for generating a football score of a middle school examination based on a neural network, which comprises the following steps: based on the athlete's basic data and game performance data, a data envelope analysis model is used to analyze various inputs of the athlete, a random front analysis model is used to process random fluctuations in the data, an efficiency front is constructed, and an efficiency analysis result is generated. According to the invention, through the technologies of fusion data envelope analysis, complex event processing, hypothesis testing, information theory analysis, gradient elevator algorithm, neural symbol learning, ensemble learning and the like, the objectivity, timeliness and accuracy of sports score evaluation are improved. The techniques enable key events in the game to be captured in real time and rapidly update the performance data of the athlete, ensure that the scoring system can instantly reflect the actual performance of the athlete, optimize the scoring criteria by applying hypothesis testing and confidence interval estimation, and enhance the fairness of the scoring process.
assignees: GUAGNZHOU HUAXIA HUIHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Disaster relief material reserve warehouse location method and device based on natural disasters
abstract_en: The invention provides a disaster relief material reserve warehouse location method and device based on natural disasters, and relates to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method comprises the following steps: solving all comprehensive indexes of the region by using an entropy weight method and a geometric average model to obtain a comprehensive factor result of the region before disaster; according to the comprehensive factor results of the pre-disaster area and the risk characteristics of different disaster types, the loss of the post-disaster area is specifically analyzed; acquiring regional geographic information system data and digital elevation model data according to post-disaster analysis results, determining disaster relief material reserve library functional conditions, and distributing regional multi-level disaster relief material reserve libraries according to each level constraint relation; and selecting addresses of the regional multistage disaster relief material reserves according to city planning conditions and layout results to obtain address selection results. The invention can fully consider the comprehensive factors of the pre-disaster area and the influence of post-disaster analysis on site selection, and improve the site selection accuracy and rationality of the disaster relief material reserve warehouse.
assignees: AERO GEOPHYSICAL SURVEY AND REMOTE SENSING CENTER FOR NATURAL RESOURCES OF CHINA

title_en: Load prediction model establishment method, device, equipment and storage medium based on multi-gradient fair descent federal learning algorithm
abstract_en: The application relates to a load prediction model building method, device, equipment, storage medium and program product based on a multi-gradient fair descent federal learning algorithm, and relates to the technical field of power grids and artificial intelligence. The application can improve the accuracy, efficiency, fairness and robustness of the load prediction cooperative modeling while protecting the privacy of the load user and the ownership of data, and provides a mechanism capable of effectively regulating the balance among the fairness, the accuracy and the efficiency of the load prediction cooperative modeling. The method comprises the following steps: the central server initializes global model parameters, gradient fastest common descent direction vectors and learning rate, and in each iteration, each power distribution network operator calculates and feeds back gradient and loss values to the central server according to information sent by the central server and a local load data set, and the central server updates information such as gradient fastest common descent direction vectors and the like based on the fed-back gradient and loss values in combination with an equalization mechanism and sends the information to the power distribution network operators.

title_en: Water resource optimal allocation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource allocation, in particular to a water resource optimal allocation method. The method comprises the steps of establishing a relation model of water resource demand, water resource allocation quantity and water resource distribution parameters of each water resource allocation unit, calculating the value and the core value of each water resource allocation unit cooperation set based on Bayesian game, and determining the water resource demand and the water resource allocation quantity corresponding to the cooperation set as the optimal configuration of each water resource allocation unit according to the water resource distribution parameters when the value of the cooperation set is close to the core value. According to the invention, through accurately modeling the water resource demand and introducing the water resource distribution parameters, the diversity and the change of the water resource demand are better adapted, and meanwhile, the optimal water resource distribution strategy of each water resource distribution unit is determined by considering the water resource distribution behavior of each water resource distribution unit, so that the optimization of resource distribution is realized, and the fairness and the rationality of water resource distribution are ensured.

title_en: Overhead cost distribution device, overhead cost distribution method and overhead cost distribution program
abstract_en: To provide an overhead cost distribution device and others, capable of setting a distribution reference of an overhead cost in which imbalance has been corrected and fairness is high compared to a conventional one to achieve actual cost accounting more closer to an actual state.SOLUTION: An overhead cost distribution method according to the present embodiment includes: 1) referring to a man-hour table to calculate a person-specific total work time and a person-specific and contract specification-specific work time, dividing the calculated person-specific and contract specification-specific work time by the calculated person-specific total work time to calculate a man-specific specific gravity ratio for each employee and each contract, and summing up the calculated man-specific specific gravity ratio for each contract to calculate a contract specification-specific specific gravity; 2) referring to a contract specification table, a man-hour table, an employee master and a scheduled unit price master to extract an overhead cost, and referring to contract specification data and purchase data to extract an overhead cost to calculate a total of the extracted overhead costs; and 3) multiplying the calculated total by the calculated contract specification-specific specific gravity, and dividing the value obtained by multiplication by the number of contracts to which the total is to be distributed to calculate a distribution amount of the overhead cost for each contract.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4

title_en: Block chain-based resource allocation method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a resource allocation method, device and equipment based on a block chain and a storage medium, and belongs to the technical field of block chains. The method comprises the following steps: under the condition that life auxiliary service is completed, acquiring consumption information of a first object, wherein the first object is a service object for receiving life auxiliary service, and the consumption information comprises resources consumed by the first object for the life auxiliary service; determining a plurality of second objects participating in resource allocation and a division proportion between the plurality of second objects based on a resource allocation rule in a blockchain, wherein the plurality of second objects comprise service personnel and a service platform for providing life auxiliary services, and the division proportion is a proportion of resources occupied by each object when resources are allocated; the resources are allocated to the plurality of second objects based on the consumption information and the division in proportion. The technical scheme improves the efficiency of resource allocation and ensures the accuracy and fairness of resource allocation.

title_en: Building carbon asset matching transaction method based on supply-demand ratio and fair benefit principle
abstract_en: The invention discloses a building carbon asset matching transaction method based on supply-demand ratio and fairness benefit principles, which comprises the following steps: step 1: counting building electric equipment and energy consumption thereof; step 2: building carbon asset matching transaction double-layer frames based on supply-demand ratio and fairness benefit principles are established from the regional level; step 3: the regional carbon transaction platform issues initial transaction information according to the historical prediction data; step 4: acquiring real-time supply and demand of each building carbon asset and the expected price of a user; step 5: and obtaining an optimization strategy of the double-layer regional building carbon asset matching transaction based on the supply-demand ratio and the fairness benefit principle. The invention realizes scientific and reasonable accounting of building carbon assets, reflects the yield of building carbon assets, can be incorporated into a carbon transaction system, and promotes carbon reduction through economic means.

title_en: Position optimization method and system for UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a position optimization method and a system for UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the following steps: building a UAV-RIS auxiliary wireless communication model under a disaster scene; obtaining an optimal model of the optimal position with the highest throughput of multi-communication fairness under the disaster scene based on reinforcement learning in the wireless communication model; and training and learning by utilizing environmental data changing along with the position of the unmanned aerial vehicle, optimizing the track of the unmanned aerial vehicle, and optimizing the neural network parameters according to feedback to obtain the optimal position of the maximum throughput of the user side. The invention solves the deployment position relation of the RIS auxiliary mmWave communication system carried by the unmanned aerial vehicle, and simultaneously considers factors such as communication fairness, limitation of the flyable area, transmitting power and the like, can ensure the communication requirements of a plurality of trapped users, and proposes to maximize the throughput of the users.

title_en: Multi-operator cooperative electric automobile distribution network ordered charging control method and device
abstract_en: The method analyzes the charging capacity requirement of a specified period by taking the minimum operation cost as a target through a CSP charging requirement assessment model to obtain a CSP expected charging capacity requirement; sending the obtained CSP expected charging capacity requirement to a DSO, judging whether the total charging capacity requirement of the specified CSP does not exceed the available charging capacity limit of the transformer in the station area, and if the total charging capacity requirement does not exceed the available charging capacity limit of the transformer in the station area, allowing the execution of a charging plan; if the available charging capacity exceeds the available charging capacity of the transformer in the area, introducing a weight coefficient into a maximum-minimum fairness allocation algorithm through an available charging capacity allocation model of the area, and allocating limited available charging capacity of the transformer in the area to the designated CSP; and optimizing and adjusting the designated CSP charging power time sequence by taking available charging capacity of the transformer of the limited distribution area allocated to the CSP as constraint through an EV ordered charging optimization model. The invention effectively avoids overload operation of the transformer in the transformer area.
assignees: UNIV TIANJIN;STATE GRID TIANJIN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Multi-main body energy system guaranteed capacity distribution method, device and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for distributing the guaranteed capacity of a multi-main body energy system, wherein the method comprises the following steps: establishing a calculation model of the guaranteed capacity of each benefit body; determining constraint conditions of the guaranteed capacity calculation model, and taking the maximum guaranteed capacity of the system in a scheduling period as an objective function; and introducing a Nash negotiation theory to unify the cooperative wish of multiple benefit subjects, establishing a wind-light-water multi-subject guaranteed capacity allocation model based on the Nash negotiation theory, excavating the speaking right characteristics of the individuals through a continuous multi-stage negotiation process, endowing different negotiation positions to a game player, and ensuring the fairness and pareto optimality of the cooperative residual allocation. The invention improves the stable power generation capacity of the wind-light-water multi-body energy system, and ensures the fair distribution of the capacity increment of the system on the premise of realizing unspecified cooperation individuals.

title_en: Crowd-sourced competition task and worker intelligent matching method considering multi-subject requirements
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent matching method for crowd-sourced competition tasks and workers considering multi-subject requirements, which comprises the following steps: acquiring a crowdsourcing competition task set to be matched and an available worker set on a crowdsourcing platform; constructing a multi-objective crowdsourcing competition task and worker matching model taking the matching degree of the task and the worker, the knowledge diversity of the worker, the fairness of the worker group and the fairness of the worker individual as optimization targets; designing an improved genetic algorithm to solve a matching model of the multi-objective crowdsourcing competition task and the worker to obtain a matching scheme of the task and the worker; and distributing each crowdsourcing competition task to the corresponding worker based on a matching scheme of the task and the worker. According to the invention, the matching model is constructed by taking the matching degree of the task and the worker, the knowledge diversity of the worker, the fairness of the worker group and the fairness of the worker individual as optimization targets, so that the matching accuracy, fairness and matching efficiency of the crowdsourcing competition task and the worker are improved.

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method, a device, equipment and a medium. The invention relates to the technical field of virtual power plants. The method comprises the following steps: determining target transaction electricity quantity data of the virtual power plant and transaction association data of at least two users in the virtual power plant; determining a response force weight based on the demand response information of the current user; determining the target transaction cost of the current user based on the target transaction electric quantity data, the response force weight of each user, the electric quantity data to be transacted and the total loss of historical energy sources; and determining a target user from each user based on each target transaction cost, and performing resource allocation for the target user based on the to-be-transacted electric quantity data of the target user. According to the technical scheme, the fairness of resource allocation is ensured while the response rate of the user to the power demand is improved, and the effect of ensuring the running stability and economy of the virtual power plant is achieved.
assignees: SHANDONG INSPUR SMART ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: AI intelligent supervision online education system and education method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligent data analysis, in particular to an AI intelligent supervision online education system and an education method, comprising an education information acquisition module, a multi-class balance learning module, an education characteristic extraction module, an education index analysis module and an education evaluation management module; the education information acquisition module collects data in multiple channels, and acquires sample sets covering different population characteristics, so that sampling deviation is avoided, and the sample data is representative; the multi-class balance learning module divides class hierarchical relations to perform data balance processing, so that sample distribution balance is ensured; the educational feature extraction module performs feature extraction to improve the generalization capability and fairness of the system; the education index analysis module establishes a prediction model, and compares and analyzes the prediction results to improve the education quality and realize the education target. The invention is used for solving the technical problems of data analysis deviation of an online education system and intelligent supervision.

title_en: Metering appliance verification flow control device and method based on low-code technology
abstract_en: The invention provides a metering appliance verification process control device and method based on a low-code technology, comprising a tested metering appliance, a verification mechanism main unit portal, a verification process scheduling tool, a remote verification system cloud service, a verification personnel terminal device and a verification measuring tool, wherein the remote verification system cloud service is respectively connected with the verification mechanism main unit portal, the tested metering appliance, the verification personnel terminal device and the verification process scheduling tool, the verification measuring tool is connected with the verification personnel terminal device, the tested metering appliance is connected with the verification personnel terminal device, and the verification mechanism main unit portal is connected with the verification process scheduling tool. The invention solves the problems of various metering devices and complex and changeable verification processes through the graphical and visual verification process arranging tool. Meanwhile, the invention also greatly simplifies the operation process of the verification personnel, reduces the requirements on the skills and experience of the verification personnel, and improves the objectivity and fairness of the verification result.
assignees: METTLER TOLEDO CHANGZHOU MEASUREMENT TECH CO LTD;METTLER TOLEDO CHANGZHOU PREC INSTRUMENT CO LTD;METTLER TOLEDO INT TRADING SHANGHAI CO LTD

title_en: Emergency material distribution and vehicle scheduling method considering multiple rescue points and transportation capacity limitation
abstract_en: The invention provides an emergency material distribution and vehicle scheduling method considering multiple rescue points and capacity limitation, and relates to the technical field of intelligent optimal scheduling of logistics distribution. Firstly, constructing an emergency material distribution and vehicle scheduling model considering multiple rescue points and capacity limitation, and solving the emergency material distribution and vehicle scheduling model by using the total vehicle transportation cost, weighted arrival time of various rescue materials, total rescue time and deviation minimization of the demand and arrival quantity of various rescue materials as an optimization target; secondly, adopting an improved genetic algorithm to determine the quantity of various disaster relief materials; and taking the volume and weight of the loading materials and the capacity and load constraint of the transport vehicle into consideration, determining the loading scheme of each vehicle by adopting a heuristic method. The method can obtain a scheduling scheme with less total transportation cost, shortest arrival time and minimum deviation between the demand quantity and the arrival quantity of various rescue materials.

title_en: Online education management system for art creation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an online education management system for art creation, which belongs to the field of art education and comprises a user management module, a course management module, a real-time interaction module, a content management module, a learning planning module, a data management module, a work display module, a learning analysis module, an assessment feedback module and a security authority module; the invention improves the accurate recognition of the user learning behavior mode, can help the user to adjust the learning plan in time, enhances the learning motivation of the user, excites the learning interest and enthusiasm of the user, improves the learning effect and efficiency, provides data support for teaching improvement and decision making, helps to optimize the education strategy and the teaching method, improves the overall teaching quality, avoids the subjective deviation possibly existing in human evaluation, improves the fairness and consistency of evaluation, can quickly evaluate and feed back, provides instant improvement suggestion, helps the user to adjust and improve works in time, guides the user to continuously improve the artistic creation level, and improves the teaching efficiency.

title_en: Water supply flow detection and allocation optimization system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water supply flow detection and allocation optimization system, which comprises a water supply flow equipment physical module, a virtual digital twin module, a digital twin implementation layer and a communication layer, wherein: the water supply flow equipment physical module is used for collecting various physical entity data in the water supply process; the virtual digital twin module is used for simulating the physical module of the water supply flow equipment by constructing a water supply flow automatic detection virtual digital twin model and is used for showing physical water supply detection data and deciding water supply allocation; the digital twin implementation layer inputs the received data of the physical module of the water supply flow equipment into each training model, and converts the data into a water supply allocation decision to carry out water supply allocation optimization adjustment through algorithm simulation; the communication layer is used for realizing data and command transmission among the modules. The invention can solve the problems that the water supply system is easy to cause pipe explosion and the like in the moment or in the initial stage, and makes a pre-judgment decision for water supply allocation.

title_en: Supporting evaluation and optimization method for primary school infrastructure in area
abstract_en: The invention discloses a supporting evaluation and optimization method of primary school infrastructure in an area, which comprises the steps of measuring and calculating shortest talent time of a kilometer grid, measuring and calculating shortest talent time of administrative areas such as county/village and town, evaluating fairness of educational resources in the Qinghai-Tibet plateau area on a space level by adopting a coefficient of a foundation, evaluating comprehensive cost of educational service, identifying a preferential layout area of the educational facility and optimizing the space layout of the Qinghai-Tibet plateau educational facility. According to the method, the average education expense cost of students, the average teacher index of the students and the average study time cost are integrated to evaluate the education integrated cost of each administrative unit, a differential configuration target is provided according to population density and integrated cost characteristics, and an area which does not reach the target is identified as a priority layout area and layout optimization is performed. Can provide scientific basis for the targeted realization of the space optimal allocation of the primary facilities of Qinghai-Tibet plateau.

title_en: Laminated woven cloth and flood control woven bag containerized rapid transportation unit
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a laminated woven fabric and flood control woven bag containerized quick dispatching unit. A laminated woven fabric containerized quick transfer unit is characterized in that laminated woven fabrics are stacked and fixed on a square nonstandard tray of 2.1 m, forklift holes are reserved between upper and lower plates of the nonstandard tray, the laminated woven fabrics are stacked in a regular mode according to a certain modulus in a groined mode, 4 bags are paved on each layer, a first layer is transverse, a second layer is longitudinal, 15 layers are stacked, and the height of a transfer unit with the tray is not more than 1.2 m. A fast transportation unit for the containerization of flood control woven bags is characterized in that the flood control woven bags are stacked in groups and fixed on rectangular nonstandard trays of which the size is 2.1 x 1.75 meters, forklift holes are reserved between upper and lower planks of the nonstandard trays, the flood control woven bags are stacked in order according to a certain modulus, 6 bags are paved on each layer, 5 layers are stacked, and the height of a transportation unit with the tray is not more than 1.35 meters. The utility model can comprehensively improve the rapid scheduling capability of emergency rescue and relief materials.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER FLOOD CONTROL AND DROUGHT RELIEF MAT RESERVE MANAGEMENT CENTER

title_en: Virtual power plant power dispatching method and device for multiplex commercial park
abstract_en: The invention provides a virtual power plant power dispatching method and device for a multiplex business park, which are used for carrying out hierarchical modeling on the multiplex business park, and constructing an optimization model of the single virtual power plant and a virtual power plant group comprising a plurality of single virtual power plants, solving a day-ahead output plan, reporting the day-ahead output plan, receiving a power grid dispatching instruction, and reasonably distributing the aggregate electric quantity, so that the stability and the reliability of power supply are ensured. Meanwhile, the real-time electricity price is determined according to the electricity quantity mismatch quantity, and the electricity quantity transaction among the virtual power plants is executed, so that the economic benefit of each virtual power plant is maximized, and the fair competition of the electricity market is promoted. Finally, according to the real-time electricity price and transaction data, the daily income is reasonably and equitably distributed to each virtual power plant, and win-win of the economic benefit and the social benefit of power dispatching is realized.

title_en: Multi-level carbon emission right allocation method and system based on carbon marginal utility
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-level carbon emission right distribution method and a system based on carbon marginal utility, wherein the method comprises the following steps: according to the historical carbon emission data, performing optimal distribution of the carbon emission in the class for a plurality of enterprises; calculating marginal utility of various enterprises under equal allocation of resources among classes according to the optimal allocation result of the efficiency in the classes, and constructing a fair efficiency allocation model; solving a fairness efficiency distribution model to obtain fairness efficiency distribution results under different classification numbers, and determining enterprise classification results according to the ratio of efficiency loss to fairness loss under different classification numbers; classifying various enterprises and establishing a multi-level enterprise carbon quota pool; constructing a multi-stage carbon emission quota decision model based on a Markov decision process, and solving the multi-stage carbon emission quota decision model to obtain an optimal decision scheme; setting the carbon quota amount of each enterprise according to the optimal decision scheme; and the carbon emission rights are distributed by taking the marginal utility of the enterprise carbon as a measure index, so that the rationality and fairness of the carbon emission rights distribution are ensured.
assignees: GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO;GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD METROLOGY CENTER

title_en: Supply chain optimization method and system based on digital rights and interests products
abstract_en: The application relates to a supply chain optimization method and a supply chain optimization system based on digital equity products, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining the product acquisition quantity and the product verification quantity of the digital equity products, carrying out product supply planning on the digital equity products to obtain supply plan data, obtaining supply plan and supply operation data of all suppliers, carrying out supply plan matching processing on each supplier, selecting the supplier with the highest matching degree, obtaining supply plan data related to the supply plan data, analyzing the supply association relation between the supply plan data and the supply plan data, constructing a supply chain management model of the digital equity products by combining with peer marketing data of the similar products, obtaining supply performance data of each supplier in the supply process, inputting the supply performance data into the supply chain management model for supply capacity assessment, and carrying out supply optimization processing according to the assessment result. The application has the effect of improving the supply timeliness of the digital rights and interests products.

title_en: Load shedding method based on Newton-Laportson optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a load shedding method based on a Newton-Laportson optimization algorithm, which comprises the following steps of S1: based on load data of the load which can be cut in the power grid system, industry type cost parameters and compensation coefficients in a power grid user interruptible protocol, generating economic cost of each load which can be cut; s2: generating a fairness penalty function based on cut-off frequency data of the cut-off load in the power grid system, and adding the fairness penalty function into the economic cost to form an objective function; s3: respectively constructing a load shedding accuracy constraint condition, a load shedding amount constraint condition and a load importance degree constraint condition; s4: and solving an optimal load shedding strategy under the execution of the Newton-Laporton optimization algorithm according to the objective function of the economic cost and fairness and the constraint condition of the objective function. When the load shedding objective function is established, the fairness penalty function is generated based on the cut times data of the load which can be cut in the power grid system, and is added into the load shedding economic cost to form the objective function, so that the design of the load shedding method is more reasonable.
assignees: STATE GRID JIANGXI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD INFORMATION & COMMUNICATION BRANCH

title_en: Bearing capacity improvement-oriented water resource optimal allocation method
title_ko: 지지력 향상에 대한 맞춤형 수자원 최적화 배치방법
abstract_en: The invention provides a water resource optimal allocation method for bearing capacity improvement, which belongs to the technical field of watershed water and soil resource risk assessment and comprises the following steps: determining water resource data of an area to be configured; respectively determining a social benefit optimization target with the minimum water deficiency of the area to be configured, an economic benefit optimization target with the minimum water consumption of the ten thousand-element GDP, an environmental benefit optimization target with the maximum carbon sink capacity and an ecological benefit optimization target with the maximum satisfaction degree of the ecological base flow; respectively determining a water quantity balance constraint condition, a pollutant discharge quantity constraint condition of an area to be configured and a water supply fairness constraint condition that the water resource bearing capacity of the area to be configured is not higher than a critical overload level; and optimally configuring regional water resources through a hunger game search algorithm. The invention solves the problem of lower accuracy of water resource allocation based on the existing method.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 지지력 향상에 대한 맞춤형 수자원(水資源) 최적화 배치방법을 제공하고, 유역 수토자원 리스크 평가 기술분야에 속하며, 배치 대기 영역의 수자원 데이터를 확정하는 단계; 배치 대기 영역의 물 부족량 최소의 사회 효과 및 이익 최적화 목표, 1만 위안 GDP의 물 사용량 최소의 경제 효과 및 이익 최적화 목표, 카본 싱크(carbon sink) 능력 최대의 환경 효과 및 이익 최적화 목표 및 생태 기저 유량 만족도 최대의 생태 효과 및 이익 최적화 목표를 각각 확정하는 단계; 배치 대기 영역의 물 수량 평형 제약 조건, 오염물 배출량 제약조건 및 배치 대기 영역의 수자원 지지력이 임계 과부하 수준보다 높지 않는 급수 형평성 제약조건을 각각 확정하는 단계; 헝거 게임(hunger game) 검색 알고리즘을 통해 영역의 수자원에 대해 최적화 배치를 진행하는 단계;를 포함한다. 본 발명은 종래방법을 기반으로 하여 획득한 수자원 배치의 정확성이 비교적 낮은 문제를 해결한다.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Multi-main-body collaborative optimization operation method considering dynamic carbon emission factors
abstract_en: According to the multi-main-body collaborative optimization operation method considering the dynamic carbon emission factors, in the process of multi-main-body collaborative operation, the carbon quota demand of each main body can be calculated after the initial carbon emission amount and the carbon emission quota of each main body are determined, and the carbon transaction cost of each carbon quota demand is determined by adopting a stepped carbon transaction mechanism; and finally, carrying out sub-problem solving on the initial carbon emission, the carbon transaction data and the Nash negotiation cracking points by adopting an ADMM algorithm to obtain optimal carbon flow data so as to obtain dynamic carbon emission factors based on the optimal carbon flow data. In summary, the dynamic carbon emission factor obtained by solving the stepwise carbon transaction mechanism and the ADMM algorithm can describe the virtual carbon flow generated by the energy transaction among multiple bodies, and ensure the stability and fairness of the carbon market.
assignees: GUIZHOU POWER GRID CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD CSG

title_en: Double-random-based combined average order-distributing method and device, electronic equipment and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a combined average dispatch method, a device, electronic equipment and a product based on double random, which are used for extracting inspection personnel in each inspection list corresponding inspection group by combining with a personnel selection rule with less dispatch quantity of preferential extraction on the premise that personnel grouping and inspection list grouping are randomly distributed; therefore, the double-random allocation principle is adopted to ensure the randomness of allocation, and the personnel selection rule with less dispatching quantity is extracted preferentially, so that the inspection personnel can be allocated to the inspection sheets with the same quantity to the greatest extent, and the workload of each inspection personnel can be balanced; therefore, the invention not only ensures the fairness of customs law enforcement, but also avoids the problem of uneven distribution of personnel orders in the traditional technology, thereby being capable of effectively utilizing human resources, and being very suitable for large-scale application and popularization.
assignees: HONGQIAO HIGH TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Rail saturation passenger flow control method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a rail saturation passenger flow control method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps: constructing a rail transit passenger flow control environment according to the dynamic characteristic description of three parts of a station hall, a station platform and a train; constructing a distributed multi-agent reinforcement learning passenger flow control framework considering global information and local information; acquiring station passenger flow data, inputting the station passenger flow data into the rail transit passenger flow control environment, interacting with the rail transit passenger flow control environment through multi-agent reinforcement learning, collecting data and training, and finally obtaining a multi-line collaborative passenger flow control model; and based on the multi-line cooperative passenger flow control model, making an optimal control decision according to the current passenger flow condition and state so as to realize the saturated passenger flow control of the rail transit system. The method is beneficial to improving the safety and fairness of the rail transit system while improving the operation efficiency.

title_en: IT equipment time-sharing leasing service management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of time-sharing leasing, in particular to an IT equipment time-sharing leasing business management system, the system comprises a user behavior analysis module, a market demand prediction module, a dynamic pricing module, a resource allocation optimization module, an energy efficiency management module, a danger early warning and response module, a fault diagnosis and tracing module and a flow recombination and optimization module. According to the invention, customer demands are understood through analysis, market trend is predicted through analysis, balance between resource supply and demands is guaranteed, matched sales promotion activities are formulated according to price sensitivity and market demands, flexible adjustment of realized price is realized, market change is adapted, competitive power of price strategies is enhanced, distribution of equipment in available time is adjusted, high efficiency and fairness of resource distribution are ensured, equipment energy consumption is optimized, operation cost is reduced, maximization of resource utilization is realized, diversified demands of users are met, management cost is reduced, and user satisfaction is improved.

title_en: Method and device for proposing calculation, computer equipment, readable storage medium and chip
abstract_en: The application provides a proposal calculating method, a device, computer equipment, a readable storage medium and a chip, wherein the method comprises the following steps: dividing a plurality of service areas into a first area type and a second area type, wherein the receiving and dispatching difficulties of different service areas in the plurality of service areas are different, each service area comprises a plurality of receiving and dispatching personnel, each area type comprises one or more service areas, the average complaint quantity of each service area in the first area type is smaller than a first threshold value, and the average complaint quantity of each service area in the second area type is larger than or equal to the first threshold value; determining the type of the area to which the target receiver belongs according to the service area to which the target receiver belongs; determining the extraction coefficient of the target receiver-transmitter according to the type of the region to which the target receiver-transmitter belongs; and determining the promotion wages of the target receiver according to the promotion coefficients of the target receiver. The method has higher fairness for the receiving and dispatching personnel in the area with high service difficulty, and can improve the logistics service quality.

title_en: Building site resource integration and distribution system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of resource allocation, in particular to a building site resource integration and allocation system, which comprises: the resource contribution evaluation module collects equipment use time and material consumption of a plurality of contractors based on the equipment scheduling data and the material flow records, calculates current resource contribution degree by comparing historical data of the plurality of contractors, calculates a shape value according to the contribution degree of each contractor, and generates a resource allocation reference. According to the invention, the resource contribution is dynamically evaluated by using the equipment scheduling data and the material flow records, the transparency and the accuracy of resource allocation are improved, based on the analysis of real-time and historical data, the system can effectively identify and reward contractors for high-efficiency resource use, the allocation fairness is enhanced, the resource allocation responds to the project progress change by real-time monitoring and dynamic adjustment, the targeted adjustment suggestion is provided by collecting the resource use efficiency and the project progress data, the accuracy of decision support is enhanced, and the cost caused by resource mismatching is reduced.
assignees: WEIHAI CHENAN WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Shared open laboratory reservation distribution system and method based on weighted scoring algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a shared open laboratory reservation distribution system and method based on a weighted scoring algorithm, comprising the following steps: s1: constructing a weighted scoring system; s2: the user initiates a reservation request; s3: receiving a reservation request of an application user and processing related data of the application user; s4: scoring calculation is carried out on the application users according to the processed data, and a shared open laboratory is distributed; according to the shared open laboratory reservation distribution method based on the weighted scoring algorithm, basic information and historical use behaviors of an application user are comprehensively considered through a weighted scoring system, so that human intervention is reduced, and fairness and scientificity of shared open laboratory distribution are further ensured; the problem that in the existing allocation method, laboratory resources are occupied by part of users for a long time, and other users with actual demands are difficult to obtain the laboratory resources is avoided; by automatically processing the request and distributing laboratory resources, the management cost is reduced and the management efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANJING NUOFEIER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Group recommendation method based on causal depolarization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a group recommendation method based on causal depolarization, which comprises the following steps: first, by establishing a causal graph and a Structural Causal Model (SCM), the causal relationship in group recommendation is deeply analyzed, a depolarization module of a causal mechanism is used for solving the deviation problem existing in a recommendation system, and the causal effect caused by confusion factors is reduced. Secondly, different group preference representations are obtained from the group item pairs and the group user pairs through a hypergraph convolution and a self-attention mechanism respectively, and then weights are dynamically adjusted through the attention mechanism. Finally, a final recommendation list is obtained through Bayes personalized ranking loss (BPR) optimization, and the fairness and quality of group recommendation are improved.

title_en: Method for investigation and dispatch of business expansion site
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of investigation dispatch, in particular to an industrial expansion field investigation dispatch method. The method and system for searching and dispatching in the field are disclosed, and the method comprises the following steps: step one: generating a reconnaissance work order; step two: acquiring unprocessed business expansion application information and real-time working state information of investigation personnel; step three: performing priority calculation on the investigation worksheets based on a dynamic priority scheduling algorithm, and sequentially dispatching the worksheets based on the priority of the investigation worksheets; step four: and selecting the investigation work order with the highest priority in the investigation work orders to be processed, matching with all the investigation personnel in an idle state by integrating the skill matching degree and the load capacity, and distributing the work order to the investigation personnel with the highest order receiving priority P2. The method can meet the service requirement and simultaneously ensure the working efficiency and fairness of the investigation personnel.
assignees: WEIHAI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID SHANDONG ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY

title_en: P2P electricity right transaction price optimization method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power markets, in particular to a P2P electricity right transaction price optimization method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which comprise the following steps: the accounting electric quantity of each energy consumption enterprise and the electricity consumption right index of each energy consumption enterprise are determined, the electricity consumption right issuing of each energy consumption enterprise is completed, and a transaction main body in P2P transaction is determined; designing an electricity consumption right trading mechanism, calculating quotation expectations, solving the trading electricity consumption weights of all trading entities when the social benefit objective function is maximum in the current period according to the trading electricity consumption weight constraint conditions in the current period, and obtaining the final trading price and the trading electricity consumption weights of all trading entities; in the P2P transaction process, uncertainty of quotations of all transaction subjects participating in the transaction is fully considered, reserved prices of all transaction subjects are used as private information, so that the fact that the equity quotations under the speculative psychology do not exist in all transaction subjects in the transaction process is ensured, and economic benefits of all transaction subjects participating in the electricity utilization right transaction are improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Intelligent dispatching method and system thereof
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of equipment maintenance dispatching software, in particular to an intelligent dispatching method and a system thereof, wherein the intelligent dispatching method and the system thereof comprise the following steps: acquiring maintenance work order information; analyzing the fault information to generate a diagnosis report, and generating a work order information set according to the maintenance work order information and the diagnosis report; screening all the maintainer information meeting the requirements according to the diagnosis report and the customer information; generating matching priority according to the work order information set and the work order information in processing; generating total priority according to the matching priority and the order allocation priority, and sequentially transmitting work order information sets according to the total priority to match, wherein the transmission time interval between different total priorities is H, and the same total priority is transmitted simultaneously; the method and the system can automatically allocate the worksheets according to the priority, thereby guaranteeing high-quality service provision and allocation fairness.

title_en: Dynamic optimization comprehensive evaluation method, device, equipment and readable storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a dynamic optimized comprehensive evaluation method, a device, equipment and a readable storage medium, which relate to the technical field of comprehensive evaluation and comprise the steps of obtaining the grading value of each evaluator on each object and the initial weight of each grading value; constructing a first fairness index of all evaluators to any one object and a second fairness index of any one evaluators to different evaluation objects; calculating the average value of all the grading values, and constructing the stability index of any one evaluation object by using the average value and the initial weight; the method comprises the steps of establishing a multi-objective function for representing comprehensive scoring fairness, dynamically correcting initial weights of all scoring values by using a weight optimization algorithm, taking the weight corresponding to the minimum value of the multi-objective function as an optimal weight, and calculating to obtain the comprehensive score of each object by using the optimal weight and the corresponding scoring value.
