assignees: INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INFORMATION CHINA ACADEMY OF RAILWAY SCIENCES CORPORATION LIMITED;CHINA ACADEMY RAILWAY SCIENCES CORP LTD

title_en: Self-adaptive answering optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention provides a self-adaptive answering optimization method and system based on reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-mode answering signals of students by using a sensor, preprocessing to obtain target signals, carrying out feature extraction and fusion, collecting target signals by an edge computing node to form multi-mode feature data, carrying out feature fusion on the multi-mode feature data, constructing a reinforcement learning model to prioritize the answering signals, dynamically adjusting the processing sequence and weight of the answering signals, optimizing the transmission path of the answering signals, encrypting and decrypting optical signals generated by an optical self-adaptive optical technology, receiving the decrypted optical signals by a central processing unit, processing and analyzing the decrypted optical signals, and sending analysis results to each edge computing node and a user. The invention provides a self-adaptive optical answering fairness optimization system based on reinforcement learning, which effectively solves the problems of signal transmission delay, fairness and safety of the conventional classroom answering system.

title_en: Block chain-based carbon transaction construction method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon transaction, and discloses a carbon transaction construction method and system based on blockchain, which comprises the steps of registering carbon transaction information, creating a digital carbon transaction unit based on the information, collecting carbon emission data of each carbon transaction unit, issuing corresponding carbon transaction tokens, distributing the carbon transaction units to an edge server, the block chain technology is utilized for data management, the qualification of the carbon transaction unit is evaluated through multidimensional analysis, the transaction record is tracked, the parameters of the carbon transaction token are adjusted according to the qualification and the record, the carbon transaction is realized, the transparency and the efficiency of the carbon transaction are improved, the authenticity and the traceability of information are ensured, the dynamic supervision and the adjustment of the token value are realized, and the fairness and the flexibility of the market are promoted. Solves the problem that some enterprises can not timely obtain transactions in the prior art.
assignees: GUANGDONG ZONGHENG LINGTAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual preference driven heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle cluster multitasking monitoring matching coordination method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of unmanned system information, and relates to a virtual preference driven heterogeneous unmanned aerial vehicle cluster multi-task monitoring matching cooperation method, which comprises the following steps: firstly, performing modeling analysis on performances of different unmanned aerial vehicles in a monitoring system, and performing modeling analysis on energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicles when monitoring tasks are executed, wherein the types of the unmanned aerial vehicles are three types of unmanned aerial vehicles including shooting unmanned aerial vehicles, communication unmanned aerial vehicles and calculation unmanned aerial vehicles, and the energy consumption of the unmanned aerial vehicles comprises three types of flight energy consumption, hovering energy consumption and monitoring energy consumption; then obtaining a preference list of each monitoring task for the unmanned aerial vehicle according to the requirements of different monitoring tasks, and obtaining the preference list of each unmanned aerial vehicle for the monitoring tasks according to the energy consumption of executing different tasks; and finally, a task matching algorithm based on fairness is provided for distributing a proper unmanned aerial vehicle for each heterogeneous monitoring task, so that task scheduling optimization in a monitoring scene with valuable heterogeneity and unmanned aerial vehicle performance difference of the tasks is realized, and the income of a multi-unmanned aerial vehicle monitoring system is improved.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional track optimization method based on probability line-of-sight link
abstract_en: The invention discloses an unmanned aerial vehicle three-dimensional track optimization method based on a probability line-of-sight link, which comprises the steps of firstly constructing an optimization problem conforming to a scene, then decoupling the original optimization problem into sub-problems related to a user scheduling coefficient, unmanned aerial vehicle transmission power, unmanned aerial vehicle horizontal plane track and unmanned aerial vehicle vertical flight track based on a BCD method, converting the non-convex problem into a convex problem by introducing a relaxation variable and performing convex approximate fitting on the non-convex constraint aiming at the non-convex problem of variable decoupling, and finally solving by adopting an iterative algorithm. Compared with the scheme of considering an ideal line-of-sight link, the scheme provided by the invention is more accurate, and compared with the scheme of designing the fixed transmission power or simply considering the scheme to perform partial optimization, the scheme of combining the optimal user scheduling coefficient, the unmanned plane transmission power and the three-dimensional flight track has higher average system reachable rate on the premise of ensuring the fairness scheduling of each user.

title_en: Carbon emission quota allocation regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of carbon emission management, in particular to a carbon emission quota allocation regulation and control method and system, comprising the following steps: first, data collection and processing: second, quota calculation benchmark setting: thirdly, quota preliminary allocation: fourth, dynamic regulation: 1) And (3) real-time monitoring: 2) Quota adjustment: fifth, quota transaction: and sixthly, feeding back and optimizing, wherein the data collection and processing module ensures the accuracy and comparability of data by collecting, cleaning and standardizing key data of each enterprise, provides a reliable basis for subsequent quota allocation, sets a quota calculation reference, considers policy targets and industry characteristics, ensures fairness and rationality of quota allocation, can perform differentiated quota allocation for different industries, and performs quota preliminary allocation based on historical data and set references, thereby avoiding blindness and subjectivity of quota allocation and facilitating fair competition among enterprises.
assignees: HUANENG SHANDONG POWER GENERATION CO LTD;SHANDONG RIZHAO POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: New energy base resource adjustment and allocation method and device
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of peak shaving auxiliary service of an electric power system, and particularly provides a new energy base resource adjustment and allocation method and device, wherein the method comprises the following steps: calculating peak regulation total cost of each new energy type based on historical output data of power generation resources of each new energy base in the area to be allocated; according to the peak regulation total cost of each new energy type, carrying out cost allocation on each new energy base under each new energy type; and according to the cost allocation result of each new energy base, carrying out cost allocation on each station under each new energy base. According to the technical scheme provided by the application, the cost allocation of the new energy bases of various new energy types is realized, the fairness of the cost allocation of the new energy bases is improved, the calculated amount of calculation allocation cost is reduced, and the method has strong practicability.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;NORTHWEST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Vehicle network interactive pricing strategy system based on energy transaction model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a vehicle-network interactive pricing strategy system based on an energy transaction model, relates to the technical field of vehicle-network interactive pricing, and solves the technical problem that the prior art lacks research on balanced benefit distribution of three parties and cannot realize balanced benefit distribution of a power grid dispatching center, an agent and an EV. The method comprises the steps of respectively establishing energy transaction models of EV users, agents and a power grid dispatching center; based on the energy transaction model, analyzing and establishing objective functions of EV users, agents and a power grid dispatching center, and establishing an objective function of a vehicle-network interaction system; according to market transaction data, solving an optimal solution of an objective function of the vehicle network interaction system by utilizing an optimization method, namely, outputting a pricing strategy; the balanced benefit distribution of the power grid dispatching center, the agent and the EV users is realized; and the adoption of the blockchain technology ensures the high security of the transaction environment and meets the requirements of various market bodies on the aspects of trust, fairness, privacy and the like.
assignees: HEFEI YUANLI ZHONGHE ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant cooperative game benefit distribution method considering credit value correction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems, in particular to a virtual power plant cooperative game benefit distribution method considering credit value correction, which is applied to power transactions participated in by virtual power plant aggregation multi-subject and comprises the following steps: determining power supply parameters and corresponding credit values of all transaction subjects in the cooperative alliance, checking whether the credit values meet a preset access threshold, and if so, determining the output power of the transaction subjects based on the power supply parameters; if not, rejecting the transaction main body; distributing power generation tasks for the transaction main body based on the output power, and calculating alliance benefits; the federated revenue is assigned to the transaction principal based on the reputation improved Shapley method and marginal contributions. The invention can improve the credit and performance rate of the transaction main body and realize the fairness of the income distribution.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Initial carbon emission right distribution method, system, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an initial carbon emission right distribution method, an initial carbon emission right distribution system, initial carbon emission right distribution equipment and a storage medium, wherein initial carbon emission rights which can be distributed are distributed to a plurality of areas based on a basic fair distribution model of a bankruptcy theory; carrying out weighted average treatment on different fair distribution results in the basic fair distribution model by using a total distribution method to obtain an initial carbon emission right distribution result of a comprehensive fair principle; evaluating the relative efficiency of comparing the results of the initial carbon emissions assignments for the different regions based on the data envelope analysis model to determine which regions are assigned in a relatively optimal and less efficient state; adjusting the distribution amount of the carbon emission weights of all areas based on a zero and data envelope analysis model, and ensuring that the distribution total amount is kept unchanged according to an efficiency principle until the front of the efficiency is reached; and calculating information entropy weight coefficients of the equity principle and efficiency principle distribution results by adopting an information entropy method, and weighting to obtain the initial carbon emission weight comprehensive distribution results of the equity principle and the efficiency principle.

title_en: Hierarchical clustering-based multistage contribution quantitative evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical clustering-based multistage contribution quantitative evaluation method and a hierarchical clustering-based multistage contribution quantitative evaluation system, which relate to the technical field of multidimensional contribution evaluation and divide each group of historical contribution data into K Gaussian classification clusters by collecting historical contribution data and using a Gaussian mixture model for preliminary clustering; and for the kth Gaussian classification cluster, clustering into kJ refined classification clusters by using a clustering algorithm, inputting historical contribution data in each refined classification cluster into a hierarchical clustering algorithm to obtain hierarchical distribution structures of each clustering level of each refined classification cluster, and automatically classifying each hierarchical distribution structure to obtain a classified boundary of each contribution index of each clustering level in each refined classification cluster, and determining the contribution level of each refined classification cluster based on the classified boundary to realize quantitative evaluation on comprehensive contribution of community members and improve the efficiency and fairness of community management.
assignees: SHANDONG WUHUI INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Subway passenger scheduling optimization method considering fairness under full-automatic operation environment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a subway passenger scheduling optimization method considering fairness under a full-automatic operation environment, which comprises the following steps: 1. constructing a space-time network of subway passenger scheduling customization; 2. building a subway passenger scheduling model based on a multi-commodity network flow; 3. solving a subway passenger scheduling model by using a Lagrange relaxation algorithm to obtain an initial scheduling scheme; 4. and adjusting the initial scheduling scheme by using an insertion heuristic algorithm to obtain an optimal scheduling scheme considering fairness. The invention starts from the equilibrium angle of the scheduling efficiency and the fair allocation of the passengers, takes Lagrange relaxation and insertion heuristic algorithm as optimization means through the construction of the customized space-time network and the establishment of the scheduling model of the passengers, obtains a high-quality initial scheduling scheme, adjusts on the basis to obtain a fairer scheduling scheme, and remarkably improves the scheduling efficiency and the working quality of the passengers of the subway.

title_en: Optimized scheduling method and system for source network load generalized energy storage system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of peak regulation of power systems and discloses a source network load generalized energy storage system optimization scheduling method which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a source-load double-layer optimization scheduling model, wherein an upper layer model aims at maximizing net benefit of source-side leased energy storage operation, and a lower layer model aims at minimizing net load variance, S2, generating an energy storage configuration result according to the upper layer model and transmitting the energy storage configuration result to the lower layer, and the source network load generalized energy storage system optimization scheduling system comprises a source-load double-layer optimization scheduling model which is used for maximizing net benefit of source-side leased energy storage operation and minimizing net load variance of the system. The peak shaving demand is determined through the optimized net load, peak shaving and clearing are carried out with the aim of minimizing the peak shaving cost of the system, the fairness and the effectiveness of peak shaving transaction are ensured, and each market body can participate in the peak shaving transaction in a fair competition environment, so that the economical efficiency is improved.

title_en: Law enforcement quality supervision system based on computer vision and semantic analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of law enforcement supervision, in particular to a law enforcement quality supervision system based on computer vision and semantic analysis. According to the invention, the accurate identification and analysis of fingerprints, seals and signatures in law enforcement documents are realized through integrating computer vision and semantic analysis technology, the accuracy of document verification is remarkably improved, the fine capture of image details is ensured through boundary detection and pixel level optimization, so that a system can identify fine image changes with higher resolution, the response speed and sensitivity of the system to complex details are improved, the misjudgment is reduced, the reliability of true and false judgment is improved in the identification and coding process of image features by the deep learning technology, the compliance of law enforcement texts can be comprehensively inspected through automatic semantic analysis and logic verification, and the law enforcement transparency and fairness are enhanced.

title_en: Digital scheduling method and system based on priority
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital scheduling method and a system based on priority, wherein the method comprises the following steps: 1) Acquiring data information to be scheduled, including personnel information, post information and on-duty place information; 2) Providing a shift selection calendar, and receiving shift selection operation submitted by a shift scheduling person in a shift selection period, and canceling the shift selection operation; 3) After the working selecting period is finished, locking the working selecting register, and automatically triggering the scheduling after locking; according to the daily personnel requirement constraint, scheduling and distributing a scheduling table; 4) After the scheduling list is issued, receiving the shift application intention of all personnel, matching the shift application intention, returning the shift application intention which is not matched successfully and issuing shift information which is matched successfully; 5) After the scheduling result is determined, receiving a leave request initiated by a person; 6) And updating the shift table according to the shift information and the leave information. According to the invention, the flexibility and fairness of scheduling are considered through the design of selecting the shifts, the final scheduling result can be obtained rapidly, and the efficiency is improved.
assignees: NANJING KAIAOSI DATA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Equitable resource access through adjudication of flight plan requests or other requests
abstract_en: A method includes obtaining information associated with requests to access at least one shared resource. The requests are associated with multiple requestors wishing to access or use the at least one shared resource. The method also includes generating at least one expected distribution of requests. The at least one expected distribution of requests defines one or more expected or desired characteristics of the requests. The method further includes granting one or more first ones of the requests in response to determining that the one or more first ones of the requests have the one or more expected or desired characteristics. In addition, the method includes denying or demoting one or more second ones of the requests in response to determining that the one or more second ones of the requests do not have the one or more expected or desired characteristics.

title_en: Management system and method for teenager safety education
abstract_en: The invention discloses a management system and a management method for teenager safety education, which relate to the technical field of safety education, wherein the escape consciousness degree of each student can be identified and analyzed through personalized psychological education plan and exercise evaluation analysis, the personalized psychological education plan is provided for each student, the students are helped to strengthen self-protection consciousness, the safety consciousness and escape skills of the students can be effectively improved, the safety education scheme is continuously improved, the school is helped to improve the safety management level, the exercise effect and daily safety behaviors of the students are comprehensively evaluated, the system can help the school to know the safety condition of the students more accurately, so that the distribution of educational resources is adjusted according to the requirement, the fairness and the effectiveness of the safety education are ensured, and the system can timely dredge the emotion of the students with escape consciousness disorder through the implementation of the psychological education plan, and is helped to establish confidence and cope with emergency.
assignees: JIANGSU JIECHENG MINGDAO CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Scoring system for hospital work order report
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scoring system for hospital work order report, which comprises a management end, a comment login module, a work order consulting module, a scoring processing module, a storage database and an interactive display interface. This a scoring system for hospital work order is reported, through being provided with scoring system, utilize the management end to realize the input of data and handle the operation of carrying out the distribution after the back, utilize the work order to consult the module and select the work order, accomplish the consulting operation of producing concrete real-time process to the work order, can withdraw from the score after satisfying the consulting condition, realize the operation of grading and grading calculation at last, in the in-process of realizing the grading, realize checking the definition of real-time process to the commentaries on classics personnel, and carry out the operation of grading after complete consulting, summarize the score numerical value of many different commentaries on classics personnel and carry out average calculation simultaneously, with this fairness of guaranteeing the grading, and make final grading result more accurate.

title_en: Cloud edge collaborative carbon intelligent management platform resource optimization scheduling method based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention relates to a cloud edge cooperative carbon intelligent management platform resource optimization scheduling method based on a blockchain, which comprises the following steps of collecting carbon emission data through measuring equipment, and the microprocessor performs preliminary processing, and then transmits the processed data to the blockchain server for unified formatting storage, and the safety and the integrity of the data are ensured by utilizing the blockchain technology. In addition, the method and the system classify the users according to the privacy sensitivity degree by constructing a user side model, and generate a smart grid real-time pricing strategy; through the standardized carbon transaction flow of intelligent contract, trust construction of both supply and demand parties is promoted, a carbon transaction model is optimized, and transaction flexibility and fairness are improved. According to the method, through a data processing mode of decentralization, the stability and the reliability of the system are enhanced, the efficiency of carbon management work is improved, and a user is stimulated to participate in energy conservation and emission reduction through a credit evaluation mechanism, so that the efficiency and the reliability of overall carbon management are improved.
assignees: NANJING JIANGXING LIANJIA INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent analysis method for accounting subjects in financial data based on machine learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent analysis method of accounting subjects in financial data based on machine learning, which relates to the field of financial data analysis and comprises the following steps: p1: acquiring financial data; p2: data identification and classification; p3: abnormality analysis; p4: risk analysis; p5: checking abnormal vocabulary entries; the association degree of the entry and the meeting and accounting purposes can be more accurately estimated by setting feature words and calculating important scores by using a TF-IDF algorithm, so that the classification accuracy is improved, and the automatic classification of the entry and the meeting and accounting purposes is realized; through sorting and selecting the early warning entries, the potential risk caused by missed examination of high-risk entries is reduced, the timely processing and examination of key abnormal entries are ensured, and the possible problems of financial inaccuracy or violation are avoided; meanwhile, the priority value is obtained through analysis according to the processing efficiency of each processing person, and the cyclic scheduling distribution is carried out according to the priority value, so that the efficiency and fairness of task distribution can be realized, and the overall processing efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU TAX SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method for selecting number of black start power supply nodes by considering fairness and openness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for selecting the number of black start power supply nodes by considering fairness and openness, which comprises the following steps: s1, constructing a fairness imbalance level evaluation model of which a units are selected from n units as a black start power supply; s2, determining inherent cost required by providing black start service according to the ith BSU and corresponding cost factors; s3, taking the selected frequency of each BSU under different purchase numbers as a value index; s4, for a certain BSU address selection combination obtained through bidding, the scheduling mechanism takes the highest BSU cost in the combination as a reference to determine the purchase price paid to each unit; s5, calculating expected E  a  of the total purchase price of the market under different values of a, and carrying out objective function modeling by a scheduling center decision process to solve the number of units which enable the objective function to be minimum. The invention can establish the optimal BSU purchasing total number under the dual requirements of comprehensively considering the control fairness and the improvement of the purchasing scheme economy.
assignees: UNIV CHINESE HONG KONG SHENZHEN;CHINA SOUTHERN POWER GRID CO

title_en: Distributed multi-energy transaction method based on aggregated game strategy
abstract_en: The invention discloses a distributed multi-energy transaction method based on an aggregate game strategy, which comprises the following steps: constructing a distributed multi-energy transaction system, and participating in real-time sharing and information interaction among the main bodies; an energy trading platform is built and used for matching energy trading among all participating subjects, and real-time monitoring and analysis of trading data are provided; the participating main body formulates an aggregate game strategy according to own interests and targets; the energy trading platform realizes automatic matching and optimal configuration of energy trading; and (3) establishing a strict supervision mechanism, and monitoring and evaluating the transaction process in real time. The transaction method provided by the invention has the advantages and effects of high-efficiency resource allocation, fairness guarantee, flexibility and adaptability, stability and sustainability, technical innovation and application, user experience improvement, safety improvement and the like. The advantages and the beneficial effects lead the invention to have wide application prospect and market competitiveness in the field of distributed multi-energy transaction.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Relief Supplies Distribution System in Relief Station
title_ko: 구호소 물자 배분 시스템
abstract_en: One aspect of the present invention relates to a material distribution system of a relief center and, more specifically, to a material distribution system of a relief center, capable of properly distributing materials to each of a plurality of relief centers from a material storage center when a disaster situation occurs, and in some cases, properly distributing materials between the plurality of relief centers so that the materials are efficiently distributed. According to an embodiment of the present invention, provided is a material distribution system capable of properly distributing disaster materials from a material storage center to a relief center. In addition, according to another embodiment of the present invention, when a plurality of relief centers are installed, the system can effectively distribute the disaster materials between the relief centers. In particular, provided is a material distribution system which implements effective redistribution of victims and relief materials when a difference in risk level occurs between the relief centers depending on a disaster environment and a relief center with a high risk level is closed.
abstract_ko:
본 발명의 일 측면은 구호소의 물자 배분 시스템에 관한 것으로, 더욱 상세하게는 재난 상황이 발생시 물자보관소에서 복수의 구호소 각각에 적절하게 물자 배분이 수행되고, 경우에 따라서 복수의 구호소 상호 간에 적절하게 물자 배분이 수행되어 물자의 효율적인 분배가 이루어지도록 하는 구호소의 물자 배분 시스템에 관한 것이다. 
본 발명의 일 실시예에 따르면 물자보관소에서 구호소로 재해물자 배분이 적절하게 이루어지도록 하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 
또한, 본 발명의 다른 실시예에 따르면 복수의 구호소가 설치된 경우, 구호소 상호 간에 재해물자의 배분이 효과적으로 이루어지도록 하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다. 특히, 재난환경에 따라서 분포된 구호소 간에 위험등급에 차이가 생기고, 위험등급이 높은 구호소가 폐쇄되는 경우, 이재민 및 구호물자의 효과적인 재분배를 구현하는 물자 배분 시스템을 제공할 수 있다.

title_en: Random number shaking distribution method for accommodation of colleges and universities
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of college accommodation management, and particularly provides a college accommodation random shaking number distribution method which comprises a mobile terminal, a management terminal and a college terminal; the method comprises the following steps: s1, a manager imports the number of beds at a management end; s2, applying for a bed by the student at the mobile terminal; s3, a manager confirms a student list of the allocated beds at a management end; s4, dividing accommodation areas at a management end by management personnel, and adding assignable beds; s5, the bed is allocated to the corresponding students in the universities, and the students check in at the mobile terminal; according to the invention, under the condition that the number of beds is larger than that of students, the qualification of the students for entering the residence is confirmed by adopting a shaking number mode, so that each student can be ensured to have equal opportunity to select the beds, and the fairness of the distribution process is improved; the shaking number is carried out on the basis of a linear congruence algorithm, so that manual intervention can be reduced, the workload of a host manager is lightened, and the distribution efficiency is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU SHUANGQI UNITED WISDOM TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for preventing conflict in on-line examination time period
abstract_en: The application provides a method and a system for preventing conflict in an on-machine examination time period, which comprise the steps of obtaining real-time examination reservation requests of examinees, recording time periods of each examination reservation request, predicting examinee flow and examination room resource requirements during examination based on the real-time examination reservation requests and a mixed prediction model, obtaining prediction results, dynamically adjusting the examination time periods to generate time period distribution results, optimizing the time period distribution results by utilizing a multi-objective optimization algorithm, generating a preliminary examination time period distribution scheme, detecting whether the preliminary examination time period distribution scheme has time conflict or not by utilizing a real-time monitoring mechanism, and adjusting the preliminary examination time period distribution scheme based on the severity of the time conflict to obtain a conflict-free examination schedule, so that examination scheduling efficiency and fairness are improved.

title_en: Urban park exposure fairness assessment method based on population and social value weighting
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city park exposure fairness evaluation method based on population and social value weighting, which comprises the following steps: firstly, evaluating the cultural service social value of an urban park ecological system in a research area by using SolVES models; step two, acquiring data of flow distribution points of a person's mouth in a research area; step three, constructing a city park exposure evaluation model weighted by population and social value; step four, evaluating fairness of urban park exposure by using a kenel coefficient method by taking streets and villages as research scales; and fifthly, identifying the difference of the exposure unfairness driving mechanism among the villages and towns by using a random forest model. The evaluation method has guiding significance for improving social value benefits of the urban park and planning construction.

title_en: Renewable energy consumption responsibility assessment method based on carbon market system
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of electric power markets, and discloses a renewable energy source consumption responsibility assessment method based on a carbon market system, which comprises the following steps of: s1, acquiring meteorological data, power grid data and power load data, and preprocessing; s2, predicting future renewable energy power generation capacity by using a machine learning model based on the preprocessed data; s3, calculating carbon emission according to the power generation data and the emission factor; s4, designing an optimization model based on renewable energy prediction and carbon emission calculation results, determining an optimization target and constraint conditions, and solving an optimal scheduling scheme; s5, designing a carbon quota allocation method and a transaction rule, and carrying out carbon market transaction; s6, calculating renewable energy source absorption responsibility of each region, and making absorption responsibility targets and assessment standards. The application improves the accuracy and fairness of renewable energy consumption, optimizes the scheduling and carbon emission management of the power system, and promotes the efficient utilization of renewable energy and the realization of carbon emission reduction targets.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO;SHANXI XINXING ELECTRIC POWER MARKET RES INSTITUTE

title_en: Big data-based network freight management system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a network freight management system based on big data, in particular to the technical field of freight management, the intelligent logistics ecological system comprises a virtual logistics ecological module for creating a virtual environment by utilizing digital twinning and blockchain technology, an intelligent emotion interaction module for identifying through voice emotion and virtual assistant technology, and an environment and health management module for monitoring and managing health and ecological driving behaviors of a driver in real time. The intelligent logistics park module monitors and predicts the states of vehicles and cargoes in real time through a digital twin technology and a blockchain intelligent contract, ensures transparency and fairness of a transport protocol, improves safety, monitors the emotion states of a driver through a voice emotion recognition technology, prevents safety problems caused by emotion fluctuation, provides emotion accompaniment and social support, reduces the feeling of long-time driving solitary, improves efficiency, uses unmanned vehicles and robots to carry cargoes, and optimizes operation in the logistics park.
assignees: WELLONG ETOWN INT LOGISTICS CO LTD

title_en: Scheduling plan adjustment method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling plan adjusting method, device, equipment and medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a to-be-scheduled object input in a scheduling configuration interface, selecting a current shift sequence for the to-be-scheduled object from a preset shift mechanism configured by a shift management service system, obtaining executed times of all preset shifts in the current shift sequence from an attendance data source, determining priority adjustment reference values of all preset shifts according to the executed times of all preset shifts and initial sequence numbers, determining a target ending shift based on the priority adjustment reference values, generating a shift adjustment message for the target ending shift for display, responding to confirmation feedback of the target ending shift, determining a target shift sequence according to the sequence execution sequence between the target ending shift and all preset shifts, and adjusting a shift plan of the to-be-scheduled object. The technical scheme can simplify the scheduling adjustment process and improve the scheduling adjustment efficiency while guaranteeing the fairness and the rationality of scheduling.

title_en: Personnel examination scheduling method and system based on multidimensional data analysis
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of intelligent data analysis, in particular to a personnel examination scheduling method and system based on multidimensional data analysis. The method comprises the steps of collecting personal information of a target examinee object and personal information of other four examinee objects adjacent to the target examinee object, introducing a data processing and semantic understanding algorithm based on artificial intelligence and natural language processing technology to the rear end to extract semantic features of the personal information of the target examinee object and the personal information of the other four examinee objects, automatically learning and capturing implicit association relations and semantic difference measurement coefficients between the personal semantic features of the target examinee object and the personal semantic features of the other four examinee objects respectively, and accordingly performing intelligent evaluation of rationality of examination seat arrangement to judge reasonable grades of the examination seat arrangement. Thus, powerful guarantee can be provided for the fairness of the examination.
assignees: ANQING PERSONNEL EXAMINATION INST ANQING PERSONNEL TRAINING CENTER

title_en: Important control and emission industrial carbon quota optimal allocation method considering bearing capacity of terminal
abstract_en: The invention discloses a key control and emission industry carbon quota optimal allocation method considering terminal bearing capacity, which relates to the technical field of carbon quota optimal allocation and comprises the steps of dynamically adjusting allocation strategies according to different energy utilization characteristics of terminals in each industry to conduct differentiated management and control in different industries to obtain fairness indexes, constructing a multi-index-method-based decision allocation model based on the fairness indexes to obtain initial carbon quota quantity, considering the effectiveness of a carbon quota allocation efficiency principle based on the fairness principle, introducing a zero and game data envelope analysis method (ZSG-DEA) to obtain a ZSG-DEA-based key control and emission industry carbon quota allocation model, performing key control and emission industry allocation efficiency evaluation on the initial carbon quota quantity, further obtaining all industry optimal carbon quota, and providing policy references for the carbon quota allocation method in each industry in China.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Information recommendation method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a device for recommending information, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of carrying out feature extraction on behavior data of a plurality of fields of a user to obtain user features, wherein the user features comprise user flow features, user equity behavior features and user ordering lines as features, obtaining conversion probability of the user to each equity based on the user features, determining ordering probability of the user based on the user flow features and the user ordering lines as features, and carrying out operation optimization calculation based on the conversion probability of the user to each equity and the ordering probability of the user to obtain rights information to be recommended of the user. The implementation mode greatly reduces operation and maintenance cost and improves flexibility of rights and interests information recommendation.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG YUANSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Online automatic evaluation system for project process management
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-line automatic evaluation system for project process management, which comprises a permission distribution module, a system login module, a coefficient setting module, an evaluation table editing module, a score calculation and ranking module, a performance assessment correlation module and a performance assessment correlation module, wherein the permission distribution module is used for performing permission distribution on a user by an administrator, the system login module is used for verifying login permission of the user according to the permission distributed by the permission distribution module, the coefficient setting module is used for setting different evaluation score additional coefficients according to project engineering scale, the evaluation table editing module is used for user-defined editing of an evaluation table according to project process management characteristics and requirements, the score calculation and ranking module is used for calculating project process management evaluation scores according to the evaluation score additional coefficients set by the user editing evaluation table and the coefficient setting module and performing project assessment ranking according to the sequence of the project process management evaluation scores from high to low, and the performance assessment correlation module is used for directly correlating the project process management evaluation scores with performance assessment of project managers. The invention realizes the on-line evaluation scoring of project process management and improves the efficiency and fairness of project process management.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR IND HUAXING CONSTR CO LTD

title_en: Water resource allocation scheme decision method and system based on multi-main-body game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource allocation scheme decision method and system based on multi-main game, and relates to the technical and method field of water resource management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a water resource allocation scheme set of a research area, calculating water utilization benefits of multiple subjects, calculating water utilization fairness of the multiple subjects, determining a allocation scheme preference matrix of the multiple subjects, analyzing a allocation scheme negotiation space of the multiple subjects, carrying out multi-subject negotiation based on group decision game, and determining a water resource allocation scheme under balanced game. The invention is beneficial to considering reasonable utilization requirements of each main body in the decision, and gives consideration to the public distribution of benefits and the water resource allocation efficiency.

title_en: Resource allocation method and system applied to customer management data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resource allocation method and a system applied to customer management data, which relate to the technical field of customer management and comprise the steps of obtaining supply efficiency of various resources of all current resource supply sites to form a resource supply matrix A, calling historical demand data of each customer, predicting a resource demand predicted value of the customer based on the historical demand data of the customer, constructing a resource demand predicted matrix B of the customer, generating resource allocation conditions based on the resource supply matrix A, generating a plurality of resource allocation schemes based on the resource allocation conditions and the resource demand predicted matrix B, determining resource allocation C under each resource allocation scheme, and carrying out resource supply allocation planning of the various resources of the resource supply sites through an equilibrium allocation algorithm. The method has the advantages of remarkably improving the client data management capability and the resource utilization efficiency of enterprises, greatly optimizing the resource allocation of the enterprises and improving the operation efficiency.
assignees: NANJING YIZHUO MEIYU CULTURE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-micro-grid two-stage collaborative scheduling method based on GBS-ADMM and generalized Nash balance
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-micro-grid two-stage collaborative scheduling method based on GBS-ADMM and generalized Nash balance, which aims to construct a micro-grid day-ahead low-carbon scheduling model with minimized day-ahead running cost, solves the problem by using an alternate direction multiplier method to obtain a day-ahead scheduling result, constructs the micro-grid day-ahead low-carbon scheduling model with minimized day-ahead running cost as a target, solves the problem by using an improved alternate direction multiplier method with Gaussian back substitution to obtain a day-ahead scheduling result, aims to maximize micro-grid distribution income, constructs a benefit distribution model, solves the problem by using an NSGA-III algorithm to obtain a final day-ahead scheduling result and a benefit distribution result. The invention can provide the dispatching result with optimal system operation economy in two stages of day-before-day and the micro-grid operation income distribution result with fairness and reasonability, thereby providing support for the multi-time scale dispatching of the novel power system and having certain engineering use value.

title_en: Intelligent standard sample examination and distribution device
abstract_en: The intelligent standard sample examination and issuing device comprises a base station, wherein a face recognition module, a management system, a taking mechanism and a sample placing basket are arranged on the base station. The sample placing basket is used for placing a sample bottle, a two-dimensional code is attached to the sample bottle, and the two-dimensional code contains sample information of the sample. The face recognition module is used for recognizing the identity information of the checked person. The taking mechanism is used for taking the sample bottle from the sample placing basket, and a sample identification module for identifying the two-dimensional code is arranged on the taking mechanism. The management system is electrically connected with the face recognition module, the taking mechanism and the sample recognition module. Compared with the prior art, the utility model has the beneficial effects that through integrating the face recognition technology, the mechanical arm operation and the advanced sample management information system, the accurate distribution, effective tracking and intelligent management of the assessment sample are realized, and the efficiency and fairness of the sample assessment process are obviously improved.
assignees: NINGBO CITY BEILUN DISTRICT ENVIRONMENTAL PROT MONITORING STATION;ZHEJIANG PUBLIC INFORMATION IND CO LTD

title_en: Stock right optimizing method, device and medium suitable for electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all manufacturing companies
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device and a medium for optimizing the equity of all manufacturing companies by mixing an electric-hydrogen micro energy network, and belongs to the technical field of investment planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining an improved electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all-system company game payment model, solving the improved electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all-system company game payment model by combining financial constraint and physical planning constraint according to the obtained related data of an electric-hydrogen micro energy network system and taking the maximum social benefit of the electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all-system company as an optimization target, and determining the share right distribution and the benefit distribution proportion of the electric-hydrogen micro energy network hybrid all-system company according to the obtained maximum alliance benefit and the edge contribution of alliance members. The invention breaks through the individual investment mode of the traditional power enterprise, and effectively realizes the fair benefit distribution of each investment body by fully exerting the absorption and wind/photoelectric stabilization advantages of the electric-hydrogen hybrid energy storage.
assignees: JIANGSU POWER DESIGN INST CO LTD CHINA ENERGY ENG GROUP

title_en: Dynamic scheduling method for emergency resources under emergency situation of reservoir dam
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic emergency resource scheduling method under a reservoir dam emergency situation, which comprises the steps of carrying out flood evolution simulation under the emergency situation, constructing a flood-road network coupling model containing road, placement points, flood flow rate and water depth information, predicting disaster victims according to situation information, calculating resource demands according to a resource demand prediction model, determining resource allocation related coefficients, introducing resource demand coefficients and disaster victimization severity coefficients, constructing an emergency resource fairness index based on a foundation coefficient, determining an optimal route from a resource storage point to the placement points, constructing an emergency resource transportation efficiency index based on the optimal route, constructing an emergency resource scheduling model by taking scheduling fairness and transportation efficiency as target functions, and obtaining a scheduling scheme under the dynamic situation by solving the scheduling model.

title_en: Method for distributing benefits of virtual power plant internal alliance cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for distributing benefits of virtual power plant internal alliance cooperative games, which comprises the steps of constructing an alliance by distributed energy sources, constructing a multi-subject optimization scheduling model in a virtual power plant with maximized electricity selling benefits, constructing constraint conditions of the multi-subject optimization scheduling model in the virtual power plant, determining a multi-subject cooperative game model of game participants, strategy sets and characteristic functions, determining the overall electricity selling benefits of the virtual power plant, designing a two-stage refined benefit distribution scheme of a multi-factor improvement shapley value method and a kernel method based on parity loops, and calling a CLPEX solver of YALMIP on a Matlab platform by the cooperative game scheduling model and the benefit distribution strategy to solve. The method realizes the cooperation and complementation operation among alliances in the virtual power plant, and ensures fairness and rationality of the income distribution among a plurality of subjects.

title_en: Network constraint-free bilateral transaction optimization clearing method and system based on new energy consumption
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of power automation, and discloses a network constraint-free bilateral transaction optimization clearing method and system based on new energy consumption, the invention can better identify the supply and demand deviation of the market through the accurate comparison of the plan value and the predicted value, thereby optimizing the consumption of new energy and reducing the resource waste caused by the mismatch of the supply and the demand. By constructing a refined market bidding space curve and a price information matching mechanism, the transmission efficiency of market price signals is enhanced, the demand side can respond to price change more quickly and accurately, and the price elasticity of power demands is released. The established optimization clear model considers various market constraint conditions, so that an optimal trading pair can be found in a complex market environment, the high efficiency and fairness of a trading process are ensured, the market stability is improved, and the risk of market failure is reduced.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Method and system for informationized management of assessment results of fire rescue institutions
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for informationized management of examination results of fire-fighting and rescue institutions, wherein the method comprises the steps of manufacturing an actual examination scheme or examination paper, distributing the actual examination scheme or examination paper on an examination paper line, submitting an individual actual examination performance-proving examination-finished examination paper by an examinee, recycling the individual actual examination performance-proving examination-finished examination paper line, and checking and approving the actual examination performance-proving examination-finished examination paper line. According to the method, different courses are switched through manual selection scheme modes, and test questions under the current course are checked and browsed, so that the generated real operation examination scheme is selected in a targeted mode according to examination points, examination personnel are checked more accurately, the real operation examination scheme is input into a question library through manual input and batch identification and introduction, test question updating in a database is performed in real time, and the situations that the generated online real operation examination scheme is difficult and knowledge points are simpler are avoided, so that fairness and fairness cannot be ensured are avoided.

title_en: Model construction method for urban rail emergency facility site selection-distribution problem
abstract_en: The invention relates to a model construction method for address selection-allocation problems of urban rail emergency facilities, and belongs to the field of address selection and planning of emergency facilities. The method comprises the steps of S1, assessment of site vulnerability parameters, S2, establishment of site selection and material distribution strategies of urban rail emergency facilities, S3, symbolic definition of parameters and decision variables, S4, construction of a two-stage site selection-distribution model under uncertain transportation time, and S5, dynamic site selection and material distribution of the facilities. The method is used for solving the technical problems that the existing urban rail transit lacks reasonable layout of emergency facilities, has low material distribution efficiency and fairness and has insufficient flexibility for coping with disaster change when coping with storm flood disasters.

title_en: Virtual power plant low-carbon optimization method, system and equipment based on two-stage carbon transaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy power, and discloses a virtual power plant low-carbon optimization method, system and equipment based on two-stage carbon transaction, which comprehensively consider the differences of equipment types and loads in each functional area and an electric automobile aggregator based on a frame model divided according to functions; the method comprises the steps of establishing a two-stage carbon transaction model, realizing optimal distribution of carbon quota through carbon quota transaction among all main bodies in the first stage, enabling all main bodies to participate in stepped carbon transaction in a carbon market in the second stage, taking carbon emission reduction capacity of an electric automobile as obtained carbon quota to enable the electric automobile to fully participate in the carbon transaction to sell the carbon quota to obtain benefits, and enabling VPP systems with larger contribution degree to obtain higher benefits due to different contribution degrees of each VPP system to the whole, so that benefit distribution is carried out by utilizing comprehensive contribution rate, the comprehensive contribution rate is applied to payment bargaining sub-problems, and fairness and rationality of benefit distribution are improved.

title_en: Water environment capacity distribution method and system suitable for cross administrative areas
abstract_en: The application provides a water environment capacity distribution method and system suitable for cross administrative areas, which comprise the steps of obtaining ground resource data basic data of each administrative area in a target area, calculating the overall water environment capacity of a river based on the ground resource data basic data, dividing three levels of indexes based on economic factors, social population factors, resources and environmental factors, establishing a index dividing system of each level of indexes, obtaining water environment capacity distribution coefficients of planning water flat year of each administrative area based on the index dividing system, and carrying out water environment capacity distribution of planning water flat year based on the overall water environment capacity of the river and the water environment capacity distribution coefficients of planning water flat year of each administrative area. The application is applicable to an index system for water environment capacity distribution of the cross-administrative areas, has the characteristics of universality, objectivity and quantification with the index system, fully considers the heterogeneity of each area, and effectively ensures the economic optimality and fairness of the water environment capacity distribution scheme of the cross-administrative areas.
assignees: SHANGHAI INVESTIGATION DESIGN & RES INST CO LTD

title_en: Progressive planning power grid evaluation method and system based on combination evaluation theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a progressive planning power grid evaluation method and a system based on a combination evaluation theory, which relate to the technical field of power grid evaluation and optimization and comprise the steps of carrying out weight correction on an obtained index by adopting a combination weighting method; the method comprises the steps of obtaining an evaluation value based on a similarity theory evaluation method, carrying out standardization processing on indexes by utilizing dimensionless processing, and carrying out evaluation based on non-parameter regression. The invention ensures the objectivity and fairness of the evaluation result by a subjective and objective combination weighting method. Through a deep learning model, particularly an LSTM network and an attention mechanism, the efficiency and the accuracy of evaluation are improved. The systemization method has wide application prospect. By automatically optimizing the design of the evaluation parameters, the invention can carry out self-adaptive adjustment according to the historical data and the real-time data, so that the evaluation result is closer to the actual, and the practicability of the evaluation is improved.

title_en: House type confirmation and house area increasing purchase solving method applied to shed improvement project
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for confirming house type and solving house area increasing purchase applied to a shed changing project, which relates to the technical field of shed changing and comprises the steps of forming an alternative house type of shed changing and returning to a resident aiming at the total returning area of shed changing and returning to the resident; the method comprises the steps of obtaining confirmation conditions of the shed-changing and returning households for alternative house types, updating house types of a built shed-changing and returning house, obtaining house type requirements of the shed-changing and returning households, forming modified house types of the shed-changing and returning households according to the house type requirements, obtaining confirmation conditions of the shed-changing and returning households for the modified house types, numbering the shed-changing and returning households, and selecting the shed-changing and returning households which are not returned from the house types of the shed-changing and returning house according to the numbering sequence to obtain the final house types. The reasonability and the relative fairness of the allocation scheme are ensured by forming the alternative house type of the shed-changing-back resident, forming the modified house type of the shed-changing-back resident and obtaining the final house type, so that the shed-changing project can be normally propelled.
assignees: SHENZHEN GUOFANGYUN DATA TECH SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent urban resource scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of intelligent cities, and particularly relates to an intelligent city resource scheduling method. The method comprises the steps of monitoring various resource states and demands of cities in real time, establishing a scheduling model comprehensively considering resource availability, demand emergency degree, fairness and efficiency, solving an optimal allocation scheme by improving a particle swarm optimization algorithm, and executing and adjusting the scheme. The method can comprehensively and accurately monitor resources, scientifically schedule the resources, improve the utilization efficiency of the resources, adapt to dynamic changes and improve the overall benefits of cities. Specifically, accurate scheduling can be performed according to monitoring data of different resources such as traffic, energy sources and the like, waste is reduced, the comprehensive multi-factor model enables resource allocation to be more reasonable, an optimal scheme can be quickly found by an optimization algorithm, the optimal resource allocation is ensured by dynamic adjustment, and therefore urban operation efficiency and sustainable development capability are improved.
assignees: LIAOCHENG ANXIN BIG DATA GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Carrier automatic assessment method and system based on big data analysis
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of logistics management, in particular to an automatic assessment method and system for a carrier based on big data analysis, comprising the following steps of S1, data collection and preprocessing, S2, data analysis, S3, complex network analysis and dynamic adjustment, S4, model establishment, S5, automatic assessment, real-time assessment of the carrier through the carrier assessment model, and generation of assessment reports, S6, feedback and optimization, wherein the key performance indexes of the carrier are extracted, the complex network analysis and dynamic adjustment, the key nodes and bottlenecks are identified, the key performance indexes are dynamically adjusted, the model establishment, the carrier assessment model is established, the various indexes of the carrier are comprehensively scored, the real-time assessment of the carrier is carried out through the carrier assessment model, and the assessment reports are generated, and the feedback and optimization are carried out according to the assessment results, the assessment results and the optimization suggestions are fed back to the carrier, and the assessment model is optimized according to the actual performance of the carrier. The invention can reflect the change of external environment in real time and improve the accuracy and fairness of the examination result.
assignees: SICHUAN KUANZHAI SMART LOGISTICS CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise management assessment evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides an enterprise management assessment evaluation method and system, the method comprises the steps of obtaining report data, conducting filtering processing on the report data, generating a completion score corresponding to a rating index, generating the completion rating based on the completion score, determining an initial comprehensive score, determining the initial comprehensive rating through the initial comprehensive score, obtaining comprehensive information entropy based on a first category of the initial comprehensive rating and the number of staff, respectively designating different rating indexes as main indexes, obtaining index information entropy of the main indexes based on a second category of the completion rating corresponding to the main indexes, determining a plurality of gain values based on the comprehensive information entropy and the index information entropy, determining the rating proportion of the rating index through the gain values, and generating a final comprehensive rating. The relevance strength between different rating indexes and the overall evaluation result is clear through the gain value, different specific gravities are distributed, the staff is more accurately and integrally evaluated, and the fairness of enterprise management assessment is ensured.

title_en: Future community construction method and system based on government big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent communities, in particular to a future community construction method and system based on government big data, comprising the following steps: and collecting electric power use data, water resource consumption data and public traffic utilization rate data in the community, synchronizing the data and performing standardized processing to generate a community resource use data set. According to the invention, the resource demand of a community in the future week can be effectively predicted by a time sequence analysis method, a resource flow simulation model is established, prediction data is input in real time, model parameters are adjusted, the influence of a policy is continuously simulated and evaluated, the optimal configuration of community resources is realized, the high efficiency and fairness of resource allocation are realized by constructing a resource allocation diagram and determining an optimal path, the adaptability and the persistence of resource allocation are further ensured by continuously tracking the allocation effect and resident feedback, the community resource management is optimized, the welfare of residents is promoted, and the sustainable development of the community is enhanced.
assignees: GUANGZHOU URBAN PLANNING & DESIGN SURVEY RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Laboratory equipment management method and system for chemical detection
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of equipment management, and provides a laboratory equipment management method and system for chemical detection, comprising the following steps of receiving the use requirement of experimental equipment input by a user, wherein the use requirement of the experimental equipment comprises an experimental project, user information, requirement equipment and a requirement time period; the method comprises the steps of judging whether the required equipment needs queuing for use, calling priority, credit and integrity of corresponding user information when the required equipment needs queuing for use, calculating to obtain equipment use base numbers of the user information, determining expiration time of a required time period, determining the allocated user information of the equipment when the expiration time is over, calling historical equipment use data of the allocated user information, analyzing the historical equipment use data, and sending equipment training information to a user account. The invention determines the base number of the equipment use by calling the priority, the credibility and the integrity of the user information based on the multidimensional equipment allocation strategy, thereby realizing the fairness and the rationality of the equipment allocation.
assignees: JIANGXI YUAN HAO DETECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: New energy station transaction method and device adapting to green electricity mechanism and camera adjustment access
abstract_en: The application provides a new energy station transaction method and device adapting to a green electricity mechanism and camera access, and relates to the technical field of new energy. The method comprises the steps of solving the constraint condition of the power generation constraint of the new energy station with the maximum capacity of the delivery channel as a target to generate a new energy station delivery channel capacity allocation strategy adapting to the access requirement of the camera, constructing a Nash bargained model which is incorporated into the market benefit contribution degree by taking the overall benefit optimal as a target and the individual rationality constraint as the constraint condition, solving the Nash bargained model to generate a benefit allocation strategy, and taking the new energy station delivery channel capacity allocation strategy and the benefit allocation strategy as transaction strategies. The application adopting the scheme effectively improves the capacity of the regional outgoing channel and ensures the fairness and rationality of the benefit distribution of market members participating in the electric power market.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ZHANGJIAKOU SCENERY STORAGE AND TRANS NEW ENERGY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Cooperative-type Stackelberg game irrigation area-based water right distribution method
abstract_en: The invention provides a water right distribution method based on a cooperative type Stackelberg game irrigation district, which relates to the technical field of water resource management and distribution. In the analysis framework, the irrigated area management bureau can set related conditional risk value parameters according to the risk preference degree of the management bureau so as to balance risks with expected benefits and determine water supply prices, and the analysis framework defines a distribution rule of benefits obtained by sharing water rights by using the GNB theory so as to encourage water rights transaction among irrigation domains, thereby ensuring fairness of benefit distribution. The method can further improve the capability of the irrigation area water resource management system for coping with risks, and improve expected benefits of various participation roles under different risk avoidance levels.
assignees: TAOSHENG ENVIRONMENT TECH SHAOXING SHANGYU CO LTD;UNIV NORTH CHINA WATER RESOURCES & ELECTRIC POWER;CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: Resource allocation method and device for agents, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of data processing and financial science and technology, in particular to a resource allocation method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium of agents, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining working state information and historical working information of a plurality of agents, and generating weight lists of the agents according to the working state information and the historical working information; the method comprises the steps of obtaining value evaluation information and residual deadline information of a plurality of distribution objects in a resource pool, generating a distribution sequence list of the plurality of distribution objects according to the value evaluation information and the residual deadline information, and matching the distribution objects for agents according to the distribution sequence list and the weight list. The application provides a single pool grabbing algorithm for distributing customer lists to agents, wherein the algorithm distributes a renewal pool list through weight, evaluation and resource distribution, improves business success rate, ensures fairness and efficiency of list distribution in a resource pool, and improves customer service efficiency and quality.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Company equity scheme generation method and system based on data encryption
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of financial processing and discloses a method and a system for generating a corporate equity scheme based on data encryption, wherein the method comprises the steps of identifying the work purpose of a corporate member and analyzing the distribution requirement of the corporate member by utilizing the work purpose; the method comprises the steps of analyzing member contribution degree of company members to company targets, generating member voting grades of the company members by utilizing the member contribution degree to construct an initial distribution scheme of the company, carrying out member anonymous voting on the initial distribution scheme by the company members, counting normal voting data and regret voting data in anonymous voting results, calculating self-approval degree of single person in the company members, calculating other approval degrees of single person in the company members to others, counting single person approval degrees of the company members by utilizing the member voting grades, judging whether the initial distribution scheme needs to be regulated or not, and carrying out scheme intermodulation between high approval schemes and low approval schemes to obtain an intermodulation distribution scheme. The invention can promote equity of share right distribution.
assignees: SHENZHEN OCEAN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Training quality assessment method and system based on pilot attention distribution
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of operation training evaluation, in particular to a training quality evaluation method and system based on pilot attention distribution. The method comprises the steps of collecting data required by pilot attention distribution training quality assessment according to a specific flight mission scene, calculating a standard attention distribution model of a pilot in the specific flight mission scene based on the collected data, generating attention distribution and actual attention distribution of the standard attention distribution model, comparing the attention distribution and the actual attention distribution of the standard attention distribution model, assessing the training quality of the attention distribution of the pilot in the specific flight mission scene, and forming and displaying an assessment result. According to the invention, through quantifying the attention distribution mode of the pilot and combining with eye movement tracking technology and task related subjective and objective data, the performance of the pilot in the simulation training can be objectively and accurately estimated, and the scientificity, fairness and safety of the flight training are improved.

title_en: Scheduling method, device, equipment and medium based on customer service agents
abstract_en: The application discloses a scheduling method, device, equipment and medium based on customer service agents, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a manual gap every day in a scheduling period and a manual gap at each scheduling time point; acquiring a predicted date with the maximum manpower gap and a predicted shift time point with the maximum manpower gap in the predicted date according to the manpower gap per day and the manpower gap of each shift time point; calculating the manual work capable of being scheduled at the predicted scheduling time point of the predicted date, and acquiring the available shift of the manual work capable of being scheduled; and calculating residual square sum descending values of available shifts of all manual labor to be shifted and the manual labor to be shifted by using a least square method, and selecting the available shifts of the manual labor to be shifted with the largest residual square sum descending value for shifting. The problems that the conventional manual scheduling personnel are not timely enough to allocate, the call completing rate reaches the standard, the operation cost of a call center is high, fairness and efficiency are difficult to consider are solved, and compared with a traditional planning algorithm, a better solution can be found rapidly.
assignees: PING AN TECH SHENZHEN CO LTD

title_en: Multi-terminal collaborative intelligent scheduling platform and method for flexible labor management
