abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling platform and method for multi-terminal cooperation of flexible labor management, in particular to the technical field of labor management, comprising the following steps of carrying out work scheduling according to flexible labor requirements by a preset scheduling rule algorithm and generating scheduling schedule forms of each time; and in each scheduling period, the fairness and rationality of the work arrangement are evaluated by extracting the feature set influencing the scheduling, an evaluation report is generated, and whether the scheduling rule algorithm is optimized or not is determined according to the evaluation report and a feedback signal. In the optimization process, an optimization scheme is designed through a feedback signal, a scheduling algorithm is trained in an iteration mode, so that the scheduling algorithm is better adapted to the labor requirement, the work distribution is guaranteed to be more fair and reasonable, and the optimized algorithm is applied to scheduling of the next period.

title_en: Disaster area emergency unmanned aerial vehicle networking method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of unmanned aerial vehicle dispatching, in particular to a disaster area emergency unmanned aerial vehicle networking method based on reinforcement learning, which comprises the following steps of taking an unmanned aerial vehicle as an intelligent body, and taking an abscissa, a speed, a direction, residual energy consumption and user throughput of the unmanned aerial vehicle as an observation space of the unmanned aerial vehicle; the method comprises the steps of taking a speed scheduling scheme and a bandwidth allocation scheme of an unmanned aerial vehicle as an action space of the unmanned aerial vehicle, introducing a graph attention mechanism to aggregate observation features of adjacent unmanned aerial vehicles, obtaining bandwidth allocation actions and corresponding rewards of the unmanned aerial vehicle under each speed scheduling based on the aggregated observation features, introducing Jain's fairness index to measure fairness of service quality of the unmanned aerial vehicle in an area, and optimizing speed scheduling and bandwidth allocation of the unmanned aerial vehicle. The invention realizes reasonable allocation of communication bandwidth under the condition of limited resources and maximizes service coverage rate for disaster-stricken users.

title_en: Benefit distribution method, device, equipment and medium of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a benefit distribution method, device, equipment and medium of an electric power system, and relates to the technical field of electric power engineering; the method comprises the steps of determining an environmental protection correction coefficient of each benefit body based on environmental protection contribution degree of each benefit body, wherein the environmental protection contribution degree is related to environmental protection input cost of the benefit body, obtaining environmental protection weight parameters of each benefit body, wherein the environmental protection weight parameters are related to the environmental protection correction coefficient, correcting a value distribution result determined based on a first cost distribution model based on the environmental protection weight parameters and the environmental protection correction coefficient, and obtaining a corrected value distribution result. According to the invention, the environmental protection contribution degree of each benefit body is fully considered, the value distribution result is readjusted according to the environmental protection contribution degree of each benefit body, and the value distribution fairness of each benefit body is ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Real estate data processing method and device based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a house property data processing method and device based on a block chain, and relates to the technical field of block chains, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining resident information of residents to be placed; the method comprises the steps of auditing intelligent contracts based on residents in a house property distribution block chain and a zero knowledge proof technology, creating resident information nodes after auditing is passed, matching the intelligent contracts with basic information of different house properties based on the house property distribution, determining matched target house properties, building association relations between the residents and the target house properties, uploading the association relations to the house property information nodes, broadcasting the association relations by a house property management node and the resident nodes, generating digital property proofs corresponding to the target house properties when the association relations pass the auditing, and broadcasting the digital property proofs in the block chain. The real estate data processing method is used for realizing automation, transparency and traceability of real estate data processing and improving fairness, standardization and efficiency of real estate distribution.
assignees: CHINA CONSTRUCTION BANK CORP;CCB FINTECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent management method and system based on multi-factor task allocation and performance evaluation
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent management method and system based on multi-factor task allocation and performance evaluation, comprising the steps of S1, performing multi-task creation on a system by an administrator, inputting corresponding task descriptions and relevant coefficients of tasks, S2, calculating total scores of all tasks by the system according to the task descriptions and the task relevant coefficients input by task performers, S3, selecting all tasks by the task performers through mutual negotiation, S4, recording by the task performers according to the task execution degree conditions, S5, calculating actual scores of all tasks by the system according to the recorded task completion degree conditions, S6, calculating total task score conditions of all task performers by the system according to the actual scores of all tasks, and S7, ranking and prize distribution by the system according to the total score conditions of all task performers. According to the intelligent management method and system for multi-factor task allocation and performance evaluation, fairness of task allocation and accuracy of performance evaluation can be effectively improved.
assignees: HAINAN DANZHOU YUEHAI WATER SUPPLY CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant optimal scheduling method for power grid peak shaving service
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant optimization scheduling method for power grid peak shaving service, which comprises the following steps of 1, constructing a virtual power plant peak shaving response model, 2, taking the maximum profit of a virtual power plant as an objective function by considering the virtual power plant peak shaving response model obtained in the step 1, setting constraint conditions of the objective function, constructing the virtual power plant optimization scheduling model for the power grid peak shaving service, 3, introducing virtual power plant peak shaving punishment rewards, 4, solving the virtual power plant optimization scheduling model for the power grid peak shaving service, introducing the virtual power plant peak shaving punishment rewards, and realizing virtual power plant optimization scheduling according to a solving result. The invention ensures fairness and high efficiency of resource utilization through rationalization benefit distribution, and stimulates active participation of users and operators.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Operation resource pool management system and method
abstract_en: The application discloses an operation resource pool management system and method, and relates to the technical field of resource management, wherein the system comprises an operation resource and expense management module, an equity management module and an equity management module, wherein the operation resource and expense management module is used for generating project standing budgets according to a special operation plan and associating with a resource pool, the equity management module is used for creating equity required by an operation activity and associating with the resource pool, the equity management module is used for associating an integral corresponding to the operation activity with the resource pool to obtain a data mart when the equity is triggered, and the resource pool allocation module is used for optimally allocating the data mart and equity using field Jing Guanlian according to the budge consumption condition of the operation activity. According to the application, the rights management module and the point management module are introduced to perform associated management on the resource pool and the rights and point issuing process, so that the condition of large difficulty in duplication caused by the fact that the traditional resource pool is not strictly controlled is avoided, the cost and fund consumption in the marketing field can be traceable and can be monitored, and the execution efficiency of the marketing process is improved.

title_en: Device scheduling method and system based on dynamic priority and multi-objective optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a device scheduling method and a system based on dynamic priority and multi-objective optimization, wherein the method takes minimized waiting time mean square error, minimized total waiting time and minimized maximum finishing time as optimization targets, comprehensively considers task dependency relationship, device maintenance time window, time window constraint, learner learning progress priority and delay compensation mechanism constraint conditions, introduces a dynamic priority computing mechanism, dynamically adjusts priority in real time according to task waiting time, deadline and urgency, generates a high-quality initial population through CMA-ES, combines a non-dominant ordering framework optimized by NSGA-II, uses PSO to update cross variation of a traditional genetic algorithm, and searches for optimal solution by using an elite reservation mechanism. The method and the device can effectively improve the utilization rate of equipment resources, reduce the task completion time, optimize the fairness of task allocation, are suitable for equipment sharing and dynamic scheduling scenes, and have strong practicability and popularization value.

title_en: Charging pile interface distribution method, device and system and computing equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a charging pile interface distribution method, a charging pile interface distribution device, a charging pile interface distribution system and a computing device. The method comprises the steps of obtaining charging pile information and a preset request, wherein the preset request comprises vehicle identification information, charging position information, charging period information and user bidding information, and obtaining an allocation result of a charging pile interface by adopting a Wickey-Clark-Grosven auction algorithm based on the charging pile information and the preset request. The VCG auction algorithm is applied to the distribution process of the charging pile interface, so that the real bidding of new energy automobile owners is promoted, the possibility that the new energy automobile owners perform strategic manipulation or bid too much is reduced, the efficiency and fairness of the charging pile booking process are improved, social benefit is improved to the greatest extent, and the motivation of the charging pile owners to participate in sharing a charging plan is increased.

title_en: Post-earthquake emergency material distribution optimization method considering distribution fairness and demand urgency
abstract_en: The invention provides a post-earthquake emergency material distribution optimization method considering distribution fairness and demand urgency, which relates to the technical field of emergency logistics multi-objective distribution optimization under the background of urban earthquake disasters, and comprises the following steps of S1, determining a basic assumption, namely, taking actual situations of disaster rescue operation into consideration, and making the basic assumption on the problem of emergency material distribution; S2, establishing an emergency material distribution fairness model, S3, establishing an emergency degree evaluation index system of emergency material demands at disaster points, S4, establishing a multi-objective path optimization model, and S5, solving the established multi-objective model by utilizing an improved hybrid multi-universe optimization algorithm. The invention provides a hybrid multi-universe algorithm based on differential evolution, which has higher convergence precision, better robustness and uniformity, improves the optimization accuracy of an earthquake disaster emergency logistics distribution path, ensures the meeting and distribution fairness of material demand urgency, reduces distribution cost, and improves the disaster satisfaction degree and demand emergency adaptation degree.

title_en: Diversity recommendation optimization method integrating inventory information
abstract_en: The invention discloses a diversity recommendation optimization method for integrating inventory information, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a data set of a user and commodities, 2, constructing a matrix decomposition model, 3, constructing a utility maximization function, embedding commodity inventory constraint and commodity type constraint to optimize recommendation results, and 4, solving a prediction score of the user on the commodities by adopting a heuristic algorithm, and obtaining a final recommendation result. The invention adopts the matrix-decomposed commodity recommendation model, and simultaneously fuses the inventory information of the commodity, thereby reducing the condition that the recommendation system recommends the backorder product, and further improving the fairness of system recommendation and the satisfaction degree of users on the platform.

title_en: Adjustable resource optimal allocation method taking line loss optimization as target
abstract_en: The optimal allocation method of the adjustable resources with the line loss optimization as a target comprises the following steps of 1, carrying out mathematical modeling on a system annual loss reduction problem, 2, carrying out mathematical modeling on multiple types of adjustable resources, and 3, carrying out SOP, capacitor and distributed power supply allocation and running optimization scheme solving by using an EO iterative algorithm. The invention solves the optimization problem of SOP, capacitor and distributed power supply configuration and operation through the EO-based iterative optimization algorithm, and achieves the purpose of reducing annual line loss of the power distribution network.
assignees: ENSHI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Virtual power plant bidding strategy optimization method based on chaotic game optimization algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual power plant bidding strategy optimization method based on a chaotic game optimization algorithm, which comprises the steps of generating an initial bidding strategy of a virtual power plant through chaotic mapping, enabling each virtual power plant to receive feedback information of a market, performing games in consideration of factors of cost and income, fluctuation of photovoltaic power generation, scheduling cost and attenuation of an energy storage battery and service life of equipment, adjusting the bidding strategy of the virtual power plant, applying punishment income to bidding behaviors which violate constraint of ethics or benefit distribution, calculating income of the power plant according to the adjusted strategies, updating the bidding strategy of each virtual power plant, repeating the game process until convergence conditions are reached, and outputting the virtual power plant bidding strategy. Compared with the prior art, the method utilizes the randomness and unpredictability of the chaotic system, so that the bidding strategy of the virtual power plant has higher flexibility and adaptability, and meanwhile, the fairness, the sustainability and the healthy market development of the system are ensured by introducing ethical constraint and equipment life management.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;JIANGSU DUODUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Influence resource allocation method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to an influence resource allocation method, an influence resource allocation device, computer equipment and a storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of estimating influence boundary values of a plurality of seed nodes in a social network, determining densities of the seed nodes according to the influence boundary values of the seed nodes and spending of the seed nodes, determining influence resources owned by each agent in the plurality of agents, and allocating the seed nodes with the largest densities in a budget range to each agent according to the order of the influence resources from small to large. By adopting the method, when the real influence of the seed node is unknown, the finally obtained influence resource allocation scheme is ensured to have better fairness.
assignees: HANGZHOU HIGH TECH ZONE BINJIANG BLOCKCHAIN AND DATA SECURITY RES INSTITUTE;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Port safety production responsibility insurance rate optimization method under multi-factor influence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port safety production responsibility insurance rate optimization method under the influence of multiple factors, which comprises the steps of analyzing historical accident cases to obtain risk factor groups, constructing a judgment matrix, calculating a characteristic vector corresponding to the maximum characteristic root of the judgment matrix to obtain each risk factor weight, determining each node risk association function according to the flow relation of a port network topology structure and the risk factor weight, further obtaining position weight, determining risk factors by combining the controllable degree of the risk factors, constructing an insurance rate calculation model of each node, adding uncertain disturbance items to form a risk evolution model, acquiring an accident cause chain set, determining an insurance rate scheme set, and finally selecting a scheme of balancing the fairness of the insurance rates and the capital income rate from the set. The method can scientifically price by comprehensively considering various factors, gives consideration to fairness and income, improves the reasonability and risk management and control level of the port safety production responsibility insurance rate, and has better interpretability.

title_en: System for village-oriented disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal
title_ko: 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a village-centered disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal system that enables optimal response within the golden time, such as rapid disaster situation dissemination and distribution of relief supplies, through a village-centered independent disaster response system in a village with low accessibility and insufficient transportation infrastructure, in the event of a disaster. More specifically, the village-centered disaster response intelligent unmanned information terminal system according to the present invention includes a disaster response system server that provides various disaster information, including nuclear power plant accidents and natural disasters, in real time to an unmanned information terminal when a disaster occurs, and an unmanned information terminal that is installed in a public facility including a village hall, a senior center, etc., and receives disaster information from the disaster response system server when a disaster occurs, disseminates the disaster situation, and distributes relief supplies.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 접근성이 낮고 교통 인프라가 부족한 마을에 마을 중심의 독자적인 재난 대응 시스템을 통해 재난 발생 시, 신속한 재난 상황 전파 및 구호 물자 배포 등 골든타임 내 최적의 대응을 가능하게 하는 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 본 발명에 따른 마을 중심의 재난대응 지능형 무인 정보 단말 시스템은, 재난 발생 시, 실시간으로 원전 사고 및 자연재난 등을 포함하는 다양한 재난정보를 무인정보 단말기로 제공하는 재난대응 시스템 서버 및 마을회관, 경로당 등을 포함하는 공동시설에 설치되어 재난 발생 시, 상기 재난대응 시스템 서버로부터 재난정보를 수신하여 재난 상황을 전파하고, 구호물자를 배포하기 위한 무인정보 단말기를 포함한다.

title_en: Regional obligation education resource layout optimization method considering study area room premium
abstract_en: An area obligation education resource layout optimization method considering the price of a study area room belongs to the technical field of education science. By constructing a double-layer planning model based on network games, the upper layer planning is used for school layout decision of education management departments, the aim is to minimize the total cost of the system, and the lower layer planning is used for parents to choose school behaviors, so that the purpose of choosing school effectiveness is maximized. According to the method, factors such as the attraction of schools, geographical positions, price of schools and the like are comprehensively considered, and reasonable allocation of educational resources is realized by using a Stackelberg equilibrium theory. Through algorithm optimization, the upper layer planning realizes the scientization of school site selection and resource allocation, and the lower layer planning guides parents to conduct school selection, so that the phenomenon of price overflow of a study area room is effectively relieved, and the problem of uneven education resource distribution is solved. The invention provides a scientific decision tool for education management departments, which can obviously improve the allocation efficiency and fairness of obligation education resources and promote the balanced development of education quality.

title_en: Medical resource allocation fairness analysis method based on multi-source big data and regression model
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical resource allocation fairness analysis method based on multi-source big data and a regression model, which belongs to the field of medical resource allocation fairness analysis, and comprises the steps of 1, preprocessing map and medical data to obtain medical resource data related to the map data, 2, analyzing optimal grid segmentation granularity, determining optimal grid segmentation granularity by combining data statistics and actual requirements and application scenes, 3, constructing a regional population prediction model based on the multi-source data and an MLP-RF model, predicting population data of grids by the regional population prediction model, and 4, constructing a medical resource assessment model, and obtaining medical resource indexes of different grids by the assessment model.

title_en: SKU asset management-based cost accounting system
abstract_en: The application relates to a cost accounting system based on SKU asset management, which is applied to the technical field of asset management and comprises the steps of realizing classified management, SKU attribute definition, asset price calculation and dynamic update of assets by constructing an asset price management system based on SKU, supporting a multidimensional pricing strategy and being capable of adapting to a scene of dynamic change of the assets, and simultaneously, in the cost accounting process, different allocation modes can be adopted according to user requirements to carry out allocation instead of a simple average allocation mode, so that the fairness and flexibility of the accounting are improved.

title_en: Fire-fighting power supply control system with electric quantity allocation function and control method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fire-fighting power supply control system with an electric quantity allocation function and a control method thereof, which belong to the technical field of electric quantity allocation of fire-fighting power supplies and comprise a power supply and a controller, wherein the controller comprises a data acquisition module, a fire-fighting power supply control module, a data processing unit and a dynamic power supply allocation strategy module, wherein the data acquisition module is used for collecting power supply data and fire scene data, the fire-fighting power supply control module is connected with the data acquisition module, is internally provided with a real-time data analysis algorithm and is used for receiving the data transmitted by the data acquisition module and analyzing the conditions of each area in the emergency of a fire, and the data processing unit is electrically connected with the fire-fighting power supply control module and is used for rapidly processing the output result of the real-time data analysis algorithm and identifying the key areas of fire spreading and the demand priority of fire-fighting equipment.

title_en: Staff dormitory recommendation method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention provides a staff dormitory recommendation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium, wherein personal information and basic intention dormitory information of dormitory to-be-selected personnel are determined, sampling step sizes and dormitory recommendation quantity are recommended, the information of the to-be-selected personnel in the dormitory matched with the basic intention dormitory information is obtained, a matched dormitory set matched with the dormitory to-be-selected personnel is determined based on the information of the to-be-selected personnel and the personal information of the dormitory to-be-selected personnel, then the to-be-selected personnel in the matched dormitory set and the dormitory to-be-selected personnel are ordered, sampling to-be-selected personnel are determined based on the ordering numbers and the recommended sampling step sizes of the dormitory to-be-selected personnel, accordingly, the occupation ratio of various types of dormitory is determined based on the dormitory attribute information of the sampling to-be-selected personnel, and the recommended dormitory recommended to the dormitory to-be-selected personnel is selected from current room sources based on the occupation ratio of various types of dormitory types, and the dormitory allocation fairness is improved.

title_en: Dynamic distribution method and system for data element service effect based on car pile network scene
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data distribution and optimization, in particular to a dynamic distribution method and a dynamic distribution system for data element service effects based on a vehicle pile network scene, which are used for carrying out static distribution on the service effects and determining the static distribution proportion; according to the principle of distribution of data element service effect markets of a car-pile-network scene, the contribution degree of a data provider in multiple main bodies is dynamically calculated, a dynamic distribution mechanism is implemented, the data quality of the data provider is dynamically calculated, the dynamic distribution proportion of the data element service effect is calculated based on service characteristics and data characteristics, distribution weights are dynamically adjusted by monitoring the contribution degree and the quality of the data in real time, fair and efficient benefit distribution is ensured, and the data provider is motivated to continuously optimize the data quality. The multi-main-body cooperative cooperation improves the utilization efficiency of data resources and promotes the healthy development of a car-pile-net ecological system. Meanwhile, the block chain technology enhances the transparency and the credibility of the distribution process, and ensures fairness and reliability.
assignees: INF CT YUNNAN GRID POWER CO LTD

title_en: Benefit analysis method and system considering distributed adjustable resource multi-element main body
abstract_en: A benefit analysis method and system considering distributed tunable resource multi-element subjects. The method comprises the steps of analyzing operation characteristics of a multi-element main body, wherein the multi-element main body comprises a new energy generator, an energy storage operator, a thermal power generator and an electricity purchasing operator, establishing a quotation decision model based on reputation values according to the reputation values and the operation characteristics of the multi-element main body in electric power transaction, solving the quotation decision model through a multi-objective evolutionary algorithm to obtain clear electric quantity and clear electric quantity, establishing benefit evaluation indexes according to comprehensive benefits of the multi-element main body, output duty ratio of the new energy main body, peak-valley difference of a user and energy utilization rate, calculating weight vectors of the plurality of benefit evaluation indexes by using a game theory combined weighting method, and balancing the benefit evaluation indexes through a multi-criterion optimization and compromise solving method to obtain comprehensive benefit analysis results of the multi-element main body. The scheme of the invention improves the scientificity and fairness of decisions.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;UNIV NORTHEASTERN;STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER SUPPLY CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dispatching method and system for LNG liquid-state export vehicles
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of storage, loading or distribution, in particular to transportation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and monitoring a tank car dispatching state of each flow node, obtaining a tank car dispatching stage statistics according to the tank car dispatching state and the operation state, calculating a low value coefficient of the number of waiting tank cars, building a dispatching model, and dispatching the tank cars according to the dispatching model. The system comprises a main control module, a data acquisition module, a supervision module, a communication module and a current device, wherein the main control module receives data and determines a scheduling instruction through a scheduling model, the data acquisition module acquires real-time data from the device and the communication module, the supervision module receives the scheduling instruction and confirms whether the scheduling instruction is fed back to the communication module, and the communication module receives and feeds back reservation information of an external tank car and sends the scheduling instruction to the current device. The scheduling method and the scheduling system for the LNG liquid state export vehicles solve the problems of low execution efficiency and difficulty in operation continuity in the prior art, and achieve the purposes of ensuring scheduling fairness, being strong in adaptability and keeping operation continuity.

title_en: Smart retail marketing platform system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a smart retail marketing platform system which comprises a conversion module, an iterative optimization module, a content module, a channel integration management module, an interaction module, an event identification module, a rights and interests service module and a marketing module; according to the invention, the conversion module, the iteration optimization module, the content module, the channel integrated management module, the interaction module, the event identification module, the equity service module and the marketing module are arranged for integration, so that the operation efficiency is improved, the operation cost is reduced, the marketing benefit is improved, the channel is widened, the management of clients is regulated, and the labor cost is reduced.

title_en: Subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization method in reservation trip mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization method under a reservation travel mode, which comprises the steps of obtaining subway line data and passenger flow data, establishing decision variables, constructing constraint conditions according to fairness between the number of passengers served by a train at each station and the number of waiting passengers and the coupling relationship between the capacity and the traffic volume of the train according to the coupling relationship between reserved passengers and unreserved passengers in a subway system, constructing an initial subway train running chart and demand management collaborative optimization nonlinear programming model by combining the subway line data, the passenger flow data, the decision variables and the constraint conditions, equivalently converting the nonlinear programming model into a linear form according to large M constraint to obtain a demand management collaborative optimization linear programming model, and solving by designing a solving algorithm according to mathematical characteristics of the linear programming model until a standard subway train running chart, a reservation name allocation scheme and a passenger flow control scheme are obtained. The method of the invention improves the service efficiency and reduces the operation cost.

title_en: Passenger train schedule optimization method considering efficiency and fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an efficiency and fairness-considered passenger railway train schedule optimization method which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a customized space-time network under passenger railways, 2, constructing a passenger railway efficiency-maximized train schedule model P  1 , 3, constructing a passenger railway fairness-based train schedule model P  2 , 4, solving an efficiency-oriented train schedule model P  1  by utilizing a train generation algorithm to obtain an efficiency-oriented train schedule scheme, 5, applying a decomposition scheme to the fairness-oriented train schedule model P  2 , and then solving by utilizing a train generation algorithm to obtain the fairness-considered train schedule scheme. The train schedule model for train operators is constructed based on the train schedule model with the maximum efficiency, and the train schedule model is decomposed so that the train schedule model can be solved by using an optimization algorithm generated by train lines, so that the technical problem that the efficiency and fairness of the existing train schedule are difficult to balance is solved.

title_en: Regional intelligent education investment layout optimization method taking fairness as guiding
abstract_en: An area intelligent education investment layout optimization method taking fairness as a guide belongs to the technical field of education science. By constructing a double-layer planning model, the upper-layer model aims at minimizing the maximum OD (optical density) versus cost, optimizes government intelligent education investment allocation strategies to improve school quality and achieve fairness of education resource allocation, and the lower-layer model aims at minimizing school selection cost and simulates parents' school selection behaviors and student flow distribution conditions. The upper layer model and the lower layer model are coordinated and optimized through an interaction mechanism, and finally government resource allocation and parent demands are balanced under the balance of the Stackelberg. Based on the theory of the network game theory, the invention combines the discrete selection model and the education quality function to describe the interaction between the parent's school selecting action and the government decision, adopts the genetic algorithm to solve the optimization scheme, and improves the calculation efficiency. The method effectively solves the contradiction between fairness and efficiency in educational resource allocation, provides scientific basis for regional education policy formulation, and is suitable for educational investment optimization scenes of different scales.

title_en: Ambulance parking and locating and sizing method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ambulance site selection and volume determination method considering fairness, which can optimize and select ambulance docking stations and optimize the number of the ambulance docks of each docking station on the basis of the site selection of the ambulance docking stations. The system is divided into a first-aid demand coverage maximization model, an ambulance reachable fairness maximization model based on a two-step mobile search method and a multi-objective optimization model of an ambulance travel cost minimization model. And integrating a plurality of objective functions into a single objective function by using a weight coefficient method, establishing a mixed integer nonlinear programming model, solving by using a Gurobi solver, defining an input model comprising variables, constraint conditions and the objective function, outputting the solution of the model, namely the value of the variables and the optimal value of the objective function, and realizing simultaneous decision of the location and the constant volume of the ambulance stop. The method reduces the time and error of manual judgment and improves the dispatching efficiency and response speed of the ambulance.

title_en: Enterprise carbon emission management system based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention discloses an enterprise carbon emission management system based on a blockchain technology, which comprises a carbon emission data storage module, a carbon emission quota allocation module and a carbon emission trans-regional transaction module. The invention has the advantages that the data processing efficiency and the intelligent analysis capability of the system under different time dimensions are enhanced through time weighting, dynamic compression and environment data embedding at the carbon data storage and management level. The intelligent, flexibility and fairness of enterprise carbon quota allocation are ensured by utilizing a dynamic quota allocation algorithm through self-adaptive learning, game theory optimization and a market feedback mechanism, and the method is suitable for continuously changing carbon markets and enterprise behaviors. The cross-regional carbon transaction mechanism is established, the isolated current situation of carbon transaction in different regions is broken through the automatic execution of inter-chain interoperation protocols and intelligent contracts, and globalization of carbon transaction market integration is realized. This mechanism promotes transaction transparency and market efficiency, pushing the development and standardization of the carbon trade market.
assignees: BEIJING TELECOM PLANNING & DESIGNING INST CO LTD;CHINA INF TECHNOLOGY DESIGNING CONSULTING INST CO LTD

title_en: Block chain-based water resource management method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource management method based on a blockchain, which relates to the technical field of water resource management, and when a node initiates a transaction, each node suitable for the transaction is matched for the node according to the price, water quality and required water quantity of the node, so that the suitability of both transaction sides is ensured, the success probability of the transaction is improved, the formation of the transaction is effectively promoted, and the efficiency of the water right transaction on the blockchain is improved; according to the water consumption data, the water resource data, the transaction data and the industry data of each node in each period, analyzing the difference among the nodes, then analyzing whether the water resource allocation plan needs to be adjusted or not, simultaneously acquiring each node in a high consumption state, formulating a water saving scheme, improving the accuracy of water consumption evaluation of each area, providing reliable data reference for water resource allocation, improving the fairness of the water resource allocation, and reducing the waste of the water resource.
assignees: YANGZHOU ZHISHUI INTERNET OF THINGS CO LTD

title_en: Multi-factor-considered renewable energy consumption responsibility weight distribution optimization method
abstract_en: A multi-factor renewable energy consumption responsibility weight distribution optimization method relates to the technical field of electric power markets and comprises the following steps of S1, taking multiple factors into consideration, utilizing an entropy weight method to calculate objective renewable energy power consumption responsibility weights of market main bodies, S2, establishing an upper-layer optimization objective function, S3, establishing a lower-layer objective function, and S4, iteratively solving optimal renewable energy consumption responsibility amounts and consumption amounts of the market main bodies based on a double-layer optimization model established in the steps S2 and S3. According to the invention, by taking province as a unit, the resource endowment, the power supply structure and the economic level of each region and the green electricity consumption proportion and the profit capability of each market subject are comprehensively considered, the renewable energy consumption responsibility weight is reasonably distributed, the optimal allocation of resources is realized, the utilization efficiency of renewable energy sources is further improved, the energy waste is reduced, and the fairness and the operability of policies can be improved.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING;ELECTRIC POWER RES INST STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: New energy power generation curve differentiation assessment method considering line transmission blocking
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy power generation curve differentiation assessment method considering line transmission blockage, which belongs to the technical field of novel power system scheduling and operation and comprises the steps of establishing an RES day time scale power curve differentiation deviation assessment mechanism considering transmission line blockage and regional power grid comprehensive regulation and control requirements, setting an assessment mechanism deviation correction method considering BESS use efficiency and assessment fairness, adjusting weights of the BESS use efficiency and the assessment fairness in an optimization target, establishing an assessment mechanism operation effect comprehensive evaluation index, assisting in quantifying implementation effects of the assessment mechanism, and guiding weight setting of the BESS use efficiency and the assessment fairness. The invention provides a differential assessment mechanism which can effectively give consideration to fairness and BESS comprehensive regulation and control efficiency, and the fairness of the mechanism can be enhanced by improving the weight coefficient alpha  fair  in a region with more abundant upper-level power grid flexibility regulation and control capability.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RES INST STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Information processing device, information processing method, and computer program
abstract_en: To generate a plurality of paths with fairness between the paths taken into account.SOLUTION: This information processing device comprises a processing unit that divides one or more pieces of stripe information containing a plurality of stop positions of a mobile body on which a crew member can board and at least one of the departure time and the arrival time of the stop positions on the basis of a stop position where the crew member can be replaced to generate a plurality of pieces of crew assignment fragment information indicating the crew assignment for each divided stripe part, and allocates each of the pieces of the crew assignment fragment information to one of a plurality of target periods longer than that of a basic path on the basis of constraints regarding the basic period including a period when the crew member continuously performs duty, thereby generating a plurality of paths indicating crew schedules for the respective target periods.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA INFRASTRUCTURE SYSTEMS & SOLUTIONS CORP

title_en: Examination seat arrangement method and system based on intelligent examination table
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent education equipment and examination management, in particular to an examination seat arrangement method and system based on an intelligent examination table, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting environmental data through the intelligent examination table and generating an environmental characteristic matrix by combining an implicit perception technology; dividing examination room areas based on quantum dot distribution models, optimizing seat distribution through reinforcement learning to generate optimized seat distribution data, completing identity verification of an examinee by utilizing a multi-mode verification module, binding the verification data with the optimized seat distribution data, unlocking an examination interface and loading examination tasks. The invention effectively improves the fairness and the intellectualization level of the seat allocation of the examination room, realizes the preferential allocation of special demand examination workers and the dynamic management of the examination process, and has remarkable reliability and convenience.
assignees: BEIJING SHIDUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Resource allocation method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application discloses a resource allocation method, a resource allocation device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of medical equipment. The method comprises the steps of determining at least one dealer needing to perform resource allocation, determining the total amount of allocated resources for the at least one dealer, and respectively executing the following operations for the at least one dealer, wherein the total amount of resource requirements corresponding to the one dealer is determined based on the total amount of allocated resources and the predicted required duty ratio corresponding to the one dealer, the total amount of resource requirements comprises the amount of inventory resources, the corresponding amount of resource allocation corresponding to the one dealer is determined based on the total amount of resource requirements, and the at least one dealer is respectively allocated with resources according to the corresponding amount of resource allocation. According to the technical scheme, through accurate demand prediction and resource allocation, not only are the efficiency and the accuracy of resource allocation improved, but also inventory management is optimized, market response speed is enhanced, fairness of resource allocation is promoted, and dealer satisfaction is improved.

title_en: New energy automobile charging pile load balancing and scheduling method based on intelligent algorithm
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of new energy automobiles, in particular to a new energy automobile charging pile load balancing and scheduling method based on an intelligent algorithm, which comprises the following steps of S1, data acquisition, real-time acquisition of operation data of a charging pile; the method comprises the steps of S2, predicting charging demands of all charging piles in a preset time in the future through a graph rolling network model, S3, optimizing space dispatching of the charging piles, namely, optimizing the dispatching of the charging piles in space according to geographic distribution conditions of the charging piles, surrounding vehicle flow and charging demand prediction results, S4, carrying out load dispatching and resource allocation, namely, carrying out resource allocation according to the charging demand prediction and charging pile space dispatching optimization results and combining power grid load conditions. The invention improves the utilization efficiency of the charging pile resources, optimizes the layout of the whole charging network, and ensures the fairness of charging service and the balance of power grid load.

title_en: Block chain-based virtual power plant optimal scheduling method in electric-carbon coupling market environment
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual power plant optimal scheduling method based on a blockchain in an electric carbon coupling market environment, which comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a committee based on all participating subjects in a virtual power plant, including a main representative node and a plurality of other member nodes, S2, establishing a virtual power plant optimal scheduling model, S3, solving the model outside the blockchain by the main representative node by applying a KKT condition, S4, encrypting and storing the obtained optimal solution by the main representative node to the blockchain, and then broadcasting the optimal solution to all other member nodes, S5, verifying received information by each other member node through a verification mechanism on the blockchain, judging whether the optimal solution is correct or not through a voting mechanism, if so, executing the optimal solution by the virtual power plant, and otherwise, determining a new main representative node and returning to the step S3. Compared with the prior art, the invention can realize high-efficiency resource optimization in peak shaving-carbon coupling markets, and ensure fairness of market participation and credibility of data.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG

title_en: Centralized scheduling optimization method, system, equipment and medium for energy storage power station
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of energy storage regulation and control, and discloses a centralized scheduling optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium for an energy storage power station, wherein the method comprises the steps of monitoring a thermal power unit with the control deviation regulation of a region between the energy storage power station and the participation region in real time according to the preset sliding window time to obtain the parameters of the energy storage power station and the parameters of the thermal power unit; based on the energy storage power station parameters and the thermal power unit parameters, the total adjustment rate of the thermal power unit is obtained, the total adjustment rate of the energy storage power station after the rate is limited by the energy storage power station is judged, and the maximum charge/discharge rate constraint of the energy storage power station equipment is combined to obtain the optimized adjustment rate of the energy storage power station. The method can obviously reduce the impact of centralized calling of the energy storage power station on the running stability of the power grid, improves the coordination efficiency of the thermal power unit and the energy storage power station, simultaneously gives attention to fairness and flexibility in an allocation mechanism, meets the real-time scheduling requirement of the spot market, and promotes the efficient application of the energy storage technology in the power grid.

title_en: system
abstract_en: To utilize information on earthquake intensity to estimate the scale of disaster, number of victims, and types of damage, efficiently determine the allocation ratio of supplies to each municipality and optimize the quantity of supplies, transportation means and transportation routes to improve the efficiency of distribution and transportation of relief supplies in the event of a disaster.SOLUTION: A system comprises: means for estimating the scale of disaster, number of victims, and types of damage from earthquake intensity information, and determining the allocation ratio of supplies to each municipality; means for determining the quantity of supplies provided from non-affected areas that can provide supplies, transportation means, and transportation routes; and means for transporting the supplies using drones or the like.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system for collecting information regarding natural disasters to provide guidance on appropriate evacuation places and reconstruction support.SOLUTION: A system comprises means of: collecting information regarding natural disasters to automatically distribute evacuation places and evacuation routes according to disaster situations of the respective areas to a preliminarily registered guidance destination including image information; and guiding procedures of reconstruction support, providing places of relief supplies, and selling places of required items by unit of municipality by reporting damage situations in reconstruction.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Irrigation area water resource optimal allocation, scheduling and control system and software
abstract_en: The invention provides a system and software for optimizing configuration, dispatching and controlling water resources in a irrigation area, comprising a water resource configuration module, a water quantity optimizing dispatching module and an operation control module, wherein the water resource configuration module is used for realizing a water resource configuration process and comprises three parts of objective function determination, model expression and model solving, and in the water quantity optimizing dispatching module, according to the water resource configuration model, water distribution quantity of each water unit in each time period is obtained after substituting time period parameters for solving, and then water quantity dispatching is carried out according to the water distribution quantity. The invention realizes the omnibearing and multilevel configuration of water resources, and realizes the accurate management of the water resources by determining reasonable objective functions, such as considering economic benefits, social benefits, natural resource balance and the like, constructing corresponding mathematical models to express the water resource configuration problem, providing a basis for solving. The objective function can reflect the demands of different benefit groups, and ensure the fairness and sustainability of water resource allocation.
assignees: HUBEI CHUYU WATER TECH CO LTD

title_en: Salary budgeting method, device, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The present invention relates to the field of salary budgeting, and in particular, to a salary budgeting method, apparatus, computer device and storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining task configuration data and a pay settlement mode of a target dispatcher, wherein the task configuration data comprise a delivery area, a new configuration time range of a new delivery task and an old configuration time range of an old delivery task, determining a time range to be released of the target task according to the new configuration time range and the old configuration time range, generating a budget application form corresponding to the new delivery task according to the new configuration time range, the pay settlement mode and all delivery areas, generating a budget release form corresponding to the target task according to the time range to be released, the pay settlement mode and all delivery areas, and determining pay budget data according to the budget application form and the budget release form. The invention considers the distribution area, the salary settlement mode and the new and old configuration time ranges, ensures the fairness of budget release and reasonably distributes the budget resources.

title_en: Dynamic charging-sharing coupling scheduling method and system for new energy automobile
abstract_en: The invention relates to a dynamic charging-sharing coupling scheduling method and system for a new energy automobile, wherein the method comprises the steps of dividing a target area into a plurality of subareas, obtaining relevant parameters of each subarea and vehicle scheduling constraint, calculating travel benefits of a sharing platform, calculating regional fairness benefits of each subarea, calculating photovoltaic power generation utilization rates of all subareas in all time periods, taking the travel benefits of the sharing platform, the regional fairness benefits and the photovoltaic power generation utilization rates as target functions, calculating an evaluation value of each target function by using a pareto optimal solution method, and generating a vehicle charging scheduling strategy based on the evaluation values. Compared with the prior art, the photovoltaic power generation method has the advantages that photovoltaic power generation is brought into the consideration range of vehicle charging scheduling, and vehicle sharing charging scheduling is comprehensively optimized from the aspects of travel benefits, regional fairness benefits and photovoltaic power generation utilization rate of a sharing platform.

title_en: Land resource space optimization configuration method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of land resource management, in particular to a land resource space optimization configuration method and a land resource space optimization configuration system, which comprise the following steps: dividing grid cells based on a land research area, setting an initial land utilization state of each cell, updating the land utilization type by comparing land suitability of adjacent cells, recursively calculating the change in each time step, and iteratively executing transfer regulation to obtain a land utilization change state sequence. According to the invention, the land utilization state is calculated and updated in a recursion manner, the land utilization dynamics is simulated, the data continuity and the regional adaptability are enhanced, the data and environmental factor feedback is regulated by combining the vacancy value filling and the neural network, the prediction precision and the trend judging capability are improved, the land use proportion and the space layout are optimized by quantifying economic, social and ecological benefits, the land resource allocation efficiency is improved, the differential decision support is provided by combining the policy regulation and the scene simulation, and the social fairness and the efficient utilization of resources are promoted.
assignees: THE EIGHTH GEOLOGICAL BRIGADE OF SHANDONG PROVINCIAL BUREAU OF GEOLOGY AND MINERAL EXPLORATION AND D

title_en: Automatic expressway toll collection management system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of transaction settlement, in particular to an automatic expressway toll management system, which comprises a traffic state capturing module, a vehicle speed and direction analyzing module and a vehicle passing and overtaking module, wherein the traffic state capturing module is used for collecting and recording the vehicle position based on vehicle running data, updating according to time sequence, determining a running track, determining the following and overtaking behaviors by utilizing the relative position among vehicles, and constructing nodes and sides of a graph. According to the invention, through comprehensive collection and real-time analysis of the vehicle running data, the fine capture and dynamic update of traffic states are realized, the interaction among vehicles is accurately evaluated, key vehicles affecting traffic flows are timely identified, based on the fact, the charging standard is dynamically set, reasonable road use cost distribution is ensured, the congestion risk is reduced, the charging fairness and the road use efficiency are improved, the charging information is synchronized in real time, the vehicle decision is more time-efficient, the path selection error caused by information lag is avoided, the traffic flow distribution is further optimized, the traffic efficiency is improved, and the congestion problem is effectively relieved.

title_en: Energy consumption analysis method and system based on micro-grid resource physical digital space model
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy consumption analysis method and system based on a physical digital space model of a micro-grid resource, wherein the method is used for constructing the physical digital space model of the micro-grid resource by acquiring first monitoring data of distributed energy equipment and second monitoring data of electric equipment in the micro-grid and fusing the data; constructing a distributed energy trading platform based on a blockchain based on the model; integrating an energy consumption tracing function in the transaction platform, constructing an energy consumption tracing tree model, further calculating the energy consumption contribution degree of each distributed energy device and the energy utilization responsibility sharing proportion of each electric device, generating an energy consumption tracing report and uploading a chain storage certificate; according to the invention, by constructing the energy consumption traceability tree model, the fine traceability and responsibility sharing of the micro-grid energy flow can be realized, accurate data support is provided for energy consumption analysis and management, and the transparency and fairness of micro-grid energy management are remarkably improved.
assignees: Jiangsu electric power information technology co ltd

title_en: Staff work performance grade determining method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for determining work performance levels of employees, which comprise the steps of carrying out data processing on core business work data of each month of the employees to determine core task performance index values of each month of the employees, carrying out core business score calculation on the basis of target performance score proportion of departments where the employees are located and core task performance index values, determining core business scores of each month of the employees, carrying out score calculation on basic business data of each month of the employees to determine basic business scores of each month of the employees, adding the basic business scores and the core business scores under the same month to determine month performance scores of the employees, and carrying out performance level assessment on a plurality of month performance scores of the employees based on a normal distribution function to determine the work performance levels of the employees. The influence of subjective judgment on the evaluation result is reduced, the fairness and accuracy of performance evaluation are ensured, and the evaluation efficiency is improved.
assignees: LIVZON SANMED BIOTECH LTD;ZHUHAI HENGQIN SHENGAO YUNZHI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-target ship scheduling method based on GA-SA algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-target ship scheduling method based on a GA-SA algorithm, which comprises the following steps of obtaining ship information, comprehensively evaluating ship lock throughput rate, ship lock chamber area utilization rate, average time to lock and fairness of lock passing by using a fitness function, encoding a selection state of a ship to be locked into a binary character string to generate an initial population, selecting individuals with high fitness to enter the next generation through selection operation, performing crossover and mutation operation on the selected individuals to obtain a new population, performing simulated annealing optimization on partial individuals with high fitness of each generation in a main cycle of a genetic algorithm to perform disturbance operation on the individuals with high fitness to obtain a new solution, selecting whether to accept the new solution according to probability until the temperature is reduced to a designated temperature, retaining the optimal solution obtained by simulated annealing, judging whether the iteration number is reached, and outputting a scheduling scheme with the highest fitness. The invention solves the problems of manual dependence and low efficiency of traditional ship passing-gate scheduling.

title_en: Industrial park intensive electricity charge calculation system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an industrial park intensive electricity charge calculation and system, which comprises a data interaction module, a user setting module, a comprehensive calculation module and a system verification and inspection module, wherein the data interaction module is used for extracting basic data of industrial park users from a power grid marketing system database, the user setting module is used for classifying each industrial park user, setting an owner and at least one terminal user, adding extended attributes for the users to distinguish roles of the users, and checking the correctness of user setting, the comprehensive calculation module is used for carrying out intensive calculation on the electricity charge of the users in the industrial park according to set rules and algorithms, and the system verification and inspection module is used for checking the correctness of calculation results, so that the electric quantity of the owner of the industrial park is ensured to be larger than the sum of electric quantity of the terminal users, and the basic electricity charge of an owner transformer is ensured to be larger than the sum of basic electricity charge of the terminal users. The invention also provides a corresponding method. By implementing the method, the fairness, reasonable calculation and allocation of the electric charge in the industrial park can be realized, the phenomenon of 'middle layer' to power supply and price adding is eliminated, the electricity cost of a park terminal enterprise is reduced, and the efficiency and transparency of electric charge management are improved.

title_en: Transformer-based person post matching method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a person post matching method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a Transformer, which belong to the technical field of natural language processing and human resource management cross application, and the technical problem to be solved by the invention is how to reduce subjective errors in the person post matching process, improve the accuracy, fairness and objectivity of matching and improve the efficiency of manual matching; the text preprocessing comprises the steps of preprocessing collected and tidied post description texts and resume texts, obtaining preprocessed post description texts and resume texts, fusing a transducer and a BERT model, constructing a encoder-decoder structure based on the transducer, optimizing the model, classifying multi-label texts, constructing a multi-label classification system, and outputting and evaluating a matching result.

title_en: Traditional Chinese medicine dispensing task allocation method and system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for distributing traditional Chinese medicine dispensing tasks, which relate to the technical field of traditional Chinese medicine dispensing, and solve the problems of uneven busy and idle of a working group and low dispensing efficiency caused by sequential alternate distribution according to the quantity of traditional Chinese medicine dispensing tasks in the prior art; the preparation task is distributed to a working group with the shortest current day accumulation duration, the predicted working duration of the preparation task processed by the working group is predicted, the predicted working duration is accumulated in the current day accumulation duration of the working group, the circulation is performed, a traditional Chinese medicine prescription list can be acquired from an HIS system through accessing the HIS system of a hospital, the preparation task is automatically generated, and the preparation task is distributed to the working group with the shortest current day accumulation duration, so that the fairness and the rationality of task distribution are realized, and the efficiency is improved.

title_en: Peak shaving auxiliary service optimization decision method based on fairness index
abstract_en: The invention discloses a peak shaving auxiliary service optimization decision method based on fairness indexes, and aims to solve the problem of unfair cost allocation caused by supply and demand mismatch, insufficient flexibility, carbon emission and other multidimensional risks in a new energy power system. A new fairness index is provided for quantifying the deviation of the actual allocation amount and the theoretical allocation amount of the participants and comprehensively considering the difference of the system risk and the individual preference. And a combined weighting method is introduced, a risk weight is determined through an analytic hierarchy process and an anti-entropy weighting method, a risk weighted Shapley value cost allocation model is constructed, and dynamic adjustment of individual risk responsibility is realized. And further establishing a peak shaving auxiliary service dispatching optimization model, and optimizing a peak shaving scheme by comprehensively considering constraint conditions of system balance, standby and unit dispatching with the aim of minimizing the total cost of the system. The method effectively improves fairness and scientificity of cost allocation, and provides important technical support for efficient operation of the high-proportion access power system of new energy.
assignees: NANCHANG POWER SUPPLY BRANCH STATE GRID JIANGXI PROVINCE ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Load side power demand response scheduling method, system, electronic equipment and medium
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a load side power demand response scheduling method, a system, electronic equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of power. The specific implementation scheme is that when the dispatching mechanism node detects that the regional power grid has abnormal load, a demand response offer is issued to the aggregator node. And determining an objective function by the aggregator node according to the industrial load production curve of the regional power grid, the state information of the electric vehicle, the distributed energy storage information and the electricity price information, and solving to obtain the maximum adjustable capacity. And the dispatching mechanism node determines the subsidy power unit price and the winning capacity of the aggregator according to the edge clearing mode of price priority, time priority and capacity priority. And the aggregator node obtains the arrangement sequence of the adjustable load nodes according to the comprehensive scheduling index of the adjustable load nodes, and schedules the adjustable loads in the regional power grid by combining the load adjustment capacity of the adjustable load nodes. Thus, the accuracy and fairness of load scheduling of each node can be ensured.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANXI ELECTRIC POWER CO INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION BRANCH;STATE GRID DIGITAL TECH HOLDINGS CO LTD;STATE GRID BLOCK CHAIN TECH BEIJING COMPANY

title_en: Inland ship reservation and gate passing scheduling method in key reservation and declaration queuing mode
abstract_en: The invention provides a inland ship reservation and passing scheduling method in a key reservation and declaration queuing mode, which is characterized in that the priority of a ship is set according to the type of the ship, the priority of a common ship needing to be declared and queued is set as the lowest, the priority of the key ship needing to be reserved and passed is higher than the priority of the common ship, and a cost function is constructed based on the priority of the ship, the waiting time of the ship and the navigation time of the ship Constructing a queuing fairness function through ship passing time difference Establishing a comprehensive congestion function through a complex network model By a cost function And the fairness function Comprehensive congestion function Chamber utilization function And a gate-discharging frequency function And solving the objective function and the constraint conditions through an optimization algorithm to obtain a gate passing scheduling scheme. The operation efficiency of the ship lock is effectively improved, and support is provided for scheduling of inland navigation.

title_en: Renewable energy power consumption weight determining and decomposing method
abstract_en: The invention provides a renewable energy power consumption weight determining and decomposing method which comprises the steps of determining influence factors influencing renewable energy power consumption, including resource endowment factors, economic development factors, power consumption capacity factors, environment-friendly constraint factors and industry-commerce environment factors, evaluating indexes of the influence factors of each research subarea, calculating to obtain renewable energy power consumption comprehensive indexes, and distributing the increment of the whole renewable energy power consumption from the current year to the future year research subareas to each research subarea according to the ratio of the renewable energy power consumption comprehensive indexes of each research subarea so as to obtain the renewable energy power consumption required to be consumed by each research subarea in the future year. According to the invention, by constructing a multi-index comprehensive evaluation system and combining normalization processing and weighted calculation, the consumption responsibility weight is scientifically distributed, and the fairness and rationality of renewable energy power consumption distribution are ensured.
assignees: CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST;CHINA RENEWABLE ENERGY ENGINEERING INST CO LTD;CHINA WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER ENG CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Data processing method and device combining power grid tide calculation and environmental equity assessment
abstract_en: The invention provides a data processing method and device combining power grid power flow calculation and environmental equity assessment, wherein the method comprises the steps of carrying out power grid power flow analysis on a target power grid to obtain a power flow analysis result of the target power grid, wherein the power flow analysis result is used for indicating the running state of the target power grid in the running process of the target power grid, determining the environmental equity assessment result of the target power grid by adopting an environmental equity assessment model according to the power flow analysis result, wherein the environmental equity assessment result is used for indicating the environmental influence brought by the target power grid in the running process of the target power grid, and integrating and analyzing the power flow analysis result and the environmental equity assessment result to generate an assessment report based on the analysis result. Therefore, by comprehensively considering power flow calculation and environmental benefit analysis of the power grid, the environmental impact in the operation of the power grid can be accurately estimated, and the dual aims of power grid optimal scheduling and environmental protection are achieved.
assignees: HUANENG ZHAOCAI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;BEIJING HUANENG CHANGJIANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING YIQING NENGHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Urban industrial space intelligent distribution system based on persistent data learning
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent distribution system of urban industrial space based on continuous data learning, which relates to the technical field of planning and design, and comprises a data acquisition module, a data processing and analyzing module, an intelligent decision module, a user interface module and a continuous learning module, wherein the system can acquire and analyze multi-source data in real time through continuous data learning, the industrial space distribution scheme is dynamically adjusted, so that the change of traffic flow, industrial demand and environmental conditions can be quickly adapted in the urban development process, and the comprehensive and balanced decision-making is ensured by comprehensively considering multidimensional targets such as economic benefit, environmental influence, social fairness and the like through a multi-target optimizing engine when the system prepares the industrial distribution scheme.
assignees: SHENZHEN NATURAL RESOURCES AND REAL ESTATE EVALUATION DEVELOPMENT RES CENTER SHENZHEN GEOLOGICAL ENV

title_en: Work order auditing method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a work order auditing method, a device, equipment and a storage medium, which relate to the technical field of computers, and the method comprises the steps of determining the work order types of a plurality of work orders to be audited; the method comprises the steps of determining the priority of each auditor for each to-be-audited worksheet based on the worksheet type, identifying audit materials in the to-be-audited worksheets for each to-be-audited worksheet, generating intelligent audit results according to identification results, and distributing the to-be-audited worksheets and associated intelligent audit results to corresponding auditors for worksheet audit according to the priority.
