According to the method and the system, the priorities of the work orders to be audited are determined by setting the priorities of auditors corresponding to the work orders of different work order types according to the different work order types, and in addition, the auditing materials in the work orders to be audited can be intelligently audited, so that the work orders to be audited and the intelligent auditing results are distributed to the corresponding auditors according to the priorities for the work order auditing, and the fairness and the efficiency of the auditing are ensured.

title_en: AI-based dairy cow feed proportioning optimization method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of feed proportioning optimization and discloses an AI-based cow feed proportioning optimization method and system, wherein the optimization method comprises the following steps of processing cow group characteristic data through a hierarchical heterogeneous graph network construction system to generate a dynamic cow group graph network structure; the hierarchical diagram reinforcement learning system is used for processing the real-time group network state tensor to generate a multi-level feed proportioning decision scheme, and the multi-level Nash equilibrium optimization system is used for processing the multi-level decision scheme to generate an optimal feed distribution strategy table. The method obtains the optimal feed distribution strategy table by optimizing the feed proportion of the dairy cows in multiple aspects, so that the dairy cows in the modern large-scale dairy cow pasture are intelligently fed, the effects of improving the yield and promoting fairness and strong adaptation and expansion are improved.

title_en: Underground mining efficiency score management and excitation system based on real-time compensation settlement
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent management and compensation incentive in mining areas, in particular to an underground mining efficiency management and incentive system based on real-time compensation settlement, which optimizes a profit allocation rule through a causal inference model and dynamically adjusts weight allocation of basic profits, task rewards and rewards; meanwhile, the multi-agent reinforcement learning technology is adopted to dynamically optimize task allocation and resource scheduling, so that the maximization of the resource utilization efficiency and the task completion rate is ensured; finally, the working enthusiasm of miners and teams is comprehensively stimulated by generating a multi-level incentive strategy of personal rewards, team rewards and global rewards, so that fairness of salary distribution, diversity of incentive mechanisms and high efficiency of mining area management are realized, and mining area production benefits and miner satisfaction are effectively improved.
assignees: SHAANXI SHANMEI CAOJIATAN MINING CO LTD;CHONGQING MAS SCI & TECH CO LTD

title_en: Bus turnover plan optimization method considering train number task allocation fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a bus turnover plan optimization method considering fairness of traffic task allocation, which comprises the steps of 1, constructing a turnover state space-time network capable of representing a bus to execute traffic tasks according to a given schedule, comprising a space-time node set and a space-time arc set in a space-time network diagram, 2, constructing a bus turnover plan network flow model aiming at minimizing the number of buses to execute service tasks based on the constructed space-time network, 3, solving the mathematical model by utilizing a Lagrange relaxation algorithm to obtain an initial bus turnover plan scheme, and 4, adjusting the obtained initial bus turnover plan scheme considering fairness to finally obtain an optimal bus turnover plan scheme. The invention considers fairness of the allocation of the bus number tasks, uses fewer buses as possible, ensures that all the bus number tasks are executed, improves the bus running efficiency, and balances the workload of bus service personnel.

title_en: Railway capacity resource allocation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, equipment and a medium for distributing railway capacity resources, which relate to the technical field of transportation and comprise the steps of determining part of shippers in a plurality of shippers as a first shipper under the condition that the current railway capacity resources of an enterprise cannot meet a first report plan submitted by the shippers on a first report day at the same time; performing plan matching according to a first report plan submitted by a first shipper and a second report plan submitted by the first shipper on a second report day, and if the plan matching is successful, distributing transport capacity resources to the first shipper based on the first report plan submitted by the first shipper; for a first shipper with failed plan matching, based on the relevant situation information, it is determined whether to allocate capacity resources to the first shipper based on a first reporting plan submitted by the first shipper. The application can effectively solve the problems of scientificity, rationality and fairness of the distribution result by using manual distribution of capacity resources.
assignees: CHN ENERGY NEW ENERGY TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;CHN ENERGY INVEST GROUP CO LTD;GUONENG BAOSHEN RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Task allocation management method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a task allocation management method based on big data, which relates to the technical field of enterprise management and comprises the following steps of automatically collecting and enqueuing tasks, automatically capturing and arranging inspection tasks to be allocated by a system, orderly putting the arranged tasks into a message queue, arranging departments and personnel information in real time and a system personnel database according to priority and types, calculating allocation ratio calculated by an allocation ratio system of each department according to the synchronous data, combining task characteristics, automatically allocating the tasks to staff of the corresponding department, optimally allocating the allocated tasks according to the current task quantity of the staff, and pushing the allocated tasks to the staff of the corresponding department through a system automation means. The invention can comprehensively consider multidimensional factors such as the number of departments, the work load of the departments and the like, automatically calculate and optimize the allocation of the inspection tasks, realize the maximization of the rationality and fairness of the allocation of the tasks, and simultaneously improve the overall work efficiency.
assignees: BEIJING ZHENGCHEN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Personalized dynamic weight teaching evaluation model and parameter adjustment method thereof
abstract_en: The invention discloses a personalized dynamic weight teaching evaluation model and a parameter adjustment method thereof, and relates to the technical field of teaching evaluation. According to the invention, the personalized dynamic weight teaching evaluation model is constructed, teaching reality can be tightly combined, evaluation key points can be adjusted in real time according to teaching stages and student learning states, so that an evaluation result is more timeliness and accuracy, more accurate teaching feedback is provided for teachers, the teachers are helped to adjust teaching strategies in time, a plurality of important aspects of evaluation are comprehensively considered by utilizing a multi-objective optimized parameter adjustment method, fairness and interpretability are ensured while evaluation accuracy is improved, and the comprehensive optimization method improves the overall performance of the teaching evaluation model, meets the demands of different teaching scenes and student groups, and is beneficial to promoting the improvement of education and teaching quality.

title_en: Performance management system and method based on cloud computing and artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of enterprise management, and provides a performance management system and a performance management method based on cloud computing and artificial intelligence, wherein the performance management system comprises a user management module, a performance evaluation module, a display module, a message leaving module, an address book module, a reward and punishment module and a data analysis module; the system utilizes cloud computing technology to ensure data safety and efficient access, combines an artificial intelligent algorithm to dynamically adjust performance indexes and weights, improves assessment fairness, improves prediction accuracy through deep learning and time sequence prediction, provides powerful support for enterprise decision and personnel development, enhances communication and interaction among personnel, optimizes a reward and punishment mechanism and promotes overall performance level.

title_en: Comment expert extraction system
abstract_en: The invention provides a bid evaluation expert extraction system which comprises a black box module and an expert extraction module. The black box module ensures data safety and operation compliance through data isolation and authority control. The expert extraction module realizes automatic expert extraction, notification and feedback management, and covers parameter configuration, random extraction, supplement scheme, timing task and automatic settlement functions. The system is controlled by a task automation and intelligent scheme, so that manual intervention is reduced, operation timeliness is optimized, fairness, transparency and high efficiency of the label evaluation process are ensured, and overall operation efficiency and data safety are improved.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Marking expert extraction system based on RPA technology and black box design
abstract_en: The invention provides a marking expert extraction system based on an RPA technology and a black box design. The system comprises a black box module, an expert extraction module, a dynamic parameter adjustment module and an automatic settlement function module. The black box module ensures data safety and operation compliance through data isolation and user authority management. The expert extraction module automatically performs expert extraction, parameter configuration and notification operations using RPA techniques. The dynamic parameter adjustment module carries out intelligent prediction and simulation based on a machine learning algorithm, adjusts the extraction strategy in real time, and improves the extraction efficiency and accuracy. And the automatic settlement functional module automatically adjusts the scheme state according to expert feedback and extraction results, and optimizes the management flow. Through the cooperative work of the modules, the system realizes full automation and intellectualization of the expert extraction process, and ensures fairness and efficiency of operation.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD

title_en: Lottery drawing method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a lottery drawing method, which comprises the following steps of firstly generating and publishing a first group of lottery numbers at preset time, secondly judging winning conditions by comparing purchased lottery numbers and distributing prizes according to rules, then detecting the balance of a prize pool, generating additional lottery numbers until the balance is lower than a preset threshold value or the number of times of additional, and finally carrying out winning judgment and prize distribution on the additional lottery numbers and rolling out non-distributed prizes to a next prize pool. The method improves the attraction and fairness of the lottery ticket by adding the lottery ticket for a plurality of times, and ensures reasonable distribution of the lottery ticket.

title_en: IPD project profit distribution method based on multidimensional fairness preference and BIM
abstract_en: The invention discloses an IPD project profit distribution method based on multidimensional equity preference and BIM, which comprises the following steps of establishing a basic assumption of a model according to a Stackelberg game theory, constructing the model by analyzing output utility, effort cost, equity utility and risk cost of participants, introducing the multidimensional equity preference of the participants to determine an optimal sharing coefficient of equity preference of each dimension in the model, and finally adopting a simulation method for analysis. Based on the Stackelberg game theory, the invention builds an IPD project profit distribution model by utilizing BIM technology under multidimensional fairness preference by considering the fairness preference of participants, finds out the optimal sharing coefficient, promotes reasonable distribution of project profit among allied members, enhances team cooperation, promotes smooth implementation of the IPD project, and improves the profitability of the project while perfecting the IPD project profit distribution mechanism.
assignees: COMPREHENSIVE SERVICE CENTER OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Shares segmentation investment platform of solar plant based on blockchain
title_ko: 블록체인기반 태양광 발전소 지분분할투자 플랫폼
abstract_en: The present invention discloses a blockchain-based solar power plant equity split investment platform comprising: an equity generation part (110) which divides an equity for a solar power plant (100) to provide corresponding investment equity information to an investment terminal (200) of an individual investor; a profit distribution part (120) which distributes sales profits of the solar power plant (100) according to a ratio corresponding to the investment equity information; an information collection part (130) which collects transaction information and power plant information, respectively; a transaction information storage part (140) which distributes and stores the investment equity information, the transaction information, and the power plant information in a distributed ledger based on a blockchain, respectively; and an information providing part (150) which transmits market price, price fluctuation trend, annual return, transaction information of annual return, and power plant information for the equity for each solar power plant to the investment terminal (200) to enable real-time confirmation on the web or app, thereby disclosing the transaction information and the power plant information to increase the reliability of the individual investor and maximize profitability through power plant management.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은, 태양광 발전소(100)에 대한 지분을 분할하여 개인투자자의 투자 단말기(200)로 해당 투자지분정보를 제공하는 지분 생성부(110), 태양광 발전소(100)의 매전 수익을 투자지분정보에 상응하는 비율에 따라 배분하는 수익 배분부(120), 거래정보 및 발전소정보를 각각 수집하는 정보 수집부(130), 투자지분정보와 거래정보와 발전소정보를 블록체인기반으로 각각 분산원장에 분산저장하는 거래정보 저장부(140), 및 태양광 발전소별 지분에 대한 시가와 가격변동추이와 연수익률의 거래정보, 및 발전소정보를 투자 단말기(200)로 전송하여 웹 또는 앱에서 실시간으로 확인이 가능하도록 하는 정보 제공부(150)를 포함하여, 거래정보와 발전소정보를 공개하여 개인투자자의 신뢰도를 높이도록 하고 발전소 관리를 통해 수익성을 최대화하는, 블록체인기반 태양광 발전소 지분분할투자 플랫폼을 개시한다.

title_en: Internet and data processing-based heat supply network management metering and charging system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heat supply network management, discloses a heat supply network management metering and charging system based on the Internet and data processing, and aims to solve the defects of the traditional heat supply network management system in the aspects of data acquisition, energy consumption prediction, charging processing, anomaly detection and the like. The system comprises a data acquisition unit for collecting heat supply network operation data in real time, an energy consumption prediction unit for predicting future user energy consumption by utilizing a time sequence data set training model, a charging unit for generating a heat charge bill by combining a prediction result and a user type, an anomaly detection unit for identifying data anomaly through the model and ensuring stable operation of the heat supply network, and a system optimization unit for adjusting operation parameters according to the anomaly detection result and optimizing heat supply network efficiency. The invention adopts advanced data processing technology and internet communication means, realizes high efficiency, accuracy and intellectualization of the heat supply network management, improves the accuracy of energy consumption prediction, enhances the fairness of charging processing, and ensures the safe and stable operation of the heat supply network.
assignees: HANGZHOU DONGXIAN SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Laboratory equipment intelligent reservation management system
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of laboratory management and discloses an intelligent reservation management system of laboratory equipment, which comprises a data acquisition and processing module, a reservation scheduling engine module and a game theory decision module, wherein the data acquisition and processing module is used for collecting equipment state data, user reservation request data and historical use data in real time, cleaning, standardizing and storing the collected data, the reservation scheduling engine module is used for performing reservation scheduling on the equipment according to a multi-objective optimization algorithm, maximizing the utilization rate of the equipment, minimizing reservation conflicts and optimizing time distribution, and the game theory decision module is used for simulating a plurality of users to play games in the reservation process. By introducing deep learning, reinforcement learning, game theory and real-time feedback mechanisms, the problems of insufficient dynamic adjustment, unreasonable resource allocation, inaccurate demand prediction and frequent reservation conflict in the traditional laboratory equipment reservation system are solved, and the equipment utilization rate, fairness and scheduling response capability are remarkably improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG XINGMA ELECTRONIC TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-objective decision-making technology for investment of equity of power grid management industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of multi-objective decision making, discloses a multi-objective decision making technology for investment equity in the power grid saving industry, which is used for constructing an incremental power distribution network investment risk assessment index system considering planning risks, management risks, market risks and economic risks, constructing an incremental power distribution network investment risk assessment model based on MGARA, constructing an investment capacity prediction model based on deep learning and optimization algorithms, deducing an equilibrium solution by setting proper constraint conditions and objective functions and combining benefit functions of multi-party subjects, adopting multi-subject game optimization of a genetic algorithm nested particle swarm algorithm to carry out model solving so as to obtain an optimal investment strategy, realizing optimal cooperation and benefit balance among the subjects and achieving the overall optimal investment decision of a system, and can realize cooperation and benefit maximization among different subjects and provide an innovative solution for power grid equity investment, resource allocation and risk management.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Crowd sensing task scheduling method and system based on multi-space modeling and fairness reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the crossing field of crowd sensing technology and artificial intelligence technology, in particular to a crowd sensing task scheduling method and a system based on multi-space modeling and fairness reinforcement learning, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a ground and air collaborative multi-layer space task structure according to acquired tasks; the method comprises the steps of establishing a topological association model among tasks according to space region division results, defining a priority sequence of task scheduling through a critical path extraction mechanism, constructing a differentiated agent matching strategy, reasonably configuring critical path tasks based on the priority sequence, dynamically distributing non-critical path tasks by utilizing a fairness perception multi-objective scheduling algorithm, reducing search space through a space division and path screening mechanism, improving task completion rate and overall scheduling performance of a system, and being suitable for high-efficiency resource configuration requirements in a multi-space collaborative perception task scene.

title_en: Fairness-based energy quota allocation and double-layer decision relationship method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a fairness-based energy quota allocation and double-layer decision relation method. Belongs to the technical field of energy policy and planning. And constructing a fairness measurement index system comprising responsibility, capability and equal principles, and determining a region comprehensive score and fairness constraint by integrating the multiple data. The decision maker aims at maximizing the renewable energy proportion under the constraint of fairness and cost, sets the objective function and constraint conditions, and the executor aims at minimizing the implementation cost and definitely associating the constraint. The reasonable quota allocation scheme is finally determined through the establishment of an energy production transaction plan by an executor and the establishment of an allocation target by a decision maker, interactive evaluation and adjustment and repeated cyclic optimization so as to coordinate the targets of the decision maker and the executor in renewable energy quota allocation and implementation.

title_en: Method for evaluating equity investment risk of power grid provincial industry
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of risk assessment, discloses a method for assessing the equity investment risk of a power grid management industry, which comprises the steps of identifying equity investment risk types by a system, defining main influencing factors of different risks, constructing a GDP growth prediction model based on ARIMA, forming a market risk quantitative assessment standard formulation, constructing a load prediction model based on SAO optimization LSTM, forming an operation risk quantitative assessment standard formulation, constructing an operation risk grade assessment model based on Markov and LS-SVM, realizing operation risk quantitative assessment standard formulation, applying a neural network model, realizing scientific setting of market risk, operation risk and operation risk scoring weight, and obtaining a final risk assessment result.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Standardized examination room intelligent management method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and particularly discloses an artificial intelligence-based standardized examination room intelligent management method and system, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining target monitoring object coordinates of a target examination room, S2, screening covered target monitoring object coordinates, S3, analyzing monitoring coverage of the target examination room, S4, analyzing monitoring cost effectiveness of the target examination room, S5, establishing a management maintenance control index model, and S6, outputting management evaluation results of the target examination room; by introducing artificial intelligence technology, the invention realizes accurate coverage of the monitoring range, effectively reduces the monitoring blind area, improves the monitoring efficiency, optimizes the resource allocation and reduces the management cost through cost-effective evaluation, establishes a management maintenance control index model, provides scientific decision basis for examination room management, improves the fairness and fairness of examination, and provides a scientific and efficient solution for standardized examination room management.
assignees: SHANGHAI SHENYI ZHIGUANG TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment and medium for managing system resources
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of system resource management, and particularly relates to a system resource management method, device, equipment and medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining node resource total amount owned by a system and historical service processing data of the system, determining service processing time length and node occupation amount of each historical service according to the historical service processing data, establishing a plurality of resource pools according to the service processing time length of all the historical services, determining node allocation amount of each resource pool according to the node occupation amount and the node resource total amount of all the historical services, and managing resources of the system according to all the resource pools and the service queues of each resource pool. The method realizes the operation isolation of different services, the operation time of the same service is fixed, and different users are relatively fair when using cluster resources, so that the service stability and the resource use fairness of the earthquake processing system are ensured.
assignees: CHINA PETROLEUM & CHEM CORP;SINOPEC GEOPHYSICAL RES INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Information processing device, information processing system, information processing method, and program
abstract_en: To provide an information processing device, an information processing system, an information processing method, and a program that are capable of appropriately controlling a distribution system.SOLUTION: An information processing device includes a processing unit that calculates a control amount of power for a plurality of power units based on: a management value of wiring in a distribution system; a first evaluation function for evaluating power control for the plurality of power units in the distribution system, in terms of economy; and a second evaluation function for evaluating the power control for the plurality of power units in terms of fairness.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 4
assignees: TOSHIBA CORP;TOSHIBA ENERGY SYSTEM & SOLUTION CORP

title_en: Disaster relief material distribution algorithm based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a disaster relief material distribution algorithm based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of computer application, and comprises Markov process modeling based on multi-agent reinforcement learning, a deep neural network comprising a codec based on an attention mechanism and corresponding training and application methods; the method comprises the steps of establishing a problem formalized expression of disaster relief material distribution through Markov process modeling, and providing a deep neural network for learning a vehicle team strategy, wherein an encoder takes a distribution task target place as input, outputs an embedded vector of the target place, and combines an environment state and the embedded vector to output a next task point of a vehicle, training of the neural network depends on a simulation environment and a classical multi-agent reinforcement learning training algorithm, the trained network can be deployed in a real scene, and the algorithm is provided for solving the problems of high time requirement, unknown material requirement, complex vehicle cooperation and the like in an emergency disaster relief scene and can be used for various emergency material delivery scenes.

title_en: Multi-target method for efficiency and fairness in water resource distribution
abstract_en: The invention provides a method for treating multiple targets of efficiency and fairness in water resource allocation, which belongs to the field of water resource allocation, and comprises the steps of constructing fairness coefficients according to river basin information, and calculating to obtain water resource allocation fairness indexes based on the base-Ni non-purity of a classification regression tree; the method comprises the steps of calculating efficiency loss based on fairness cost to obtain a water resource allocation utilization efficiency index, setting necessary constraint conditions of water resource allocation, constructing a water resource allocation multi-objective model according to the water resource allocation fairness index and the water resource allocation utilization efficiency index and the constraint conditions of water resource allocation, converting the water resource allocation multi-objective model into a water resource allocation single-objective model according to decision maker preference information and solving the water resource allocation single-objective model to obtain an optimal water resource allocation scheme, and solving the problems that fairness and efficiency are easy to conflict, the multi-objective water resource allocation model is complex to solve and an accurate water resource allocation scheme cannot be provided in the existing water resource allocation process.

title_en: New energy permeability threshold-based self-adaptive allocation method for carbon emission responsibility of electric power system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of new energy power systems, discloses a self-adaptive allocation method of carbon emission responsibility of a power system based on a new energy permeability threshold, and provides a dynamic responsibility allocation strategy aiming at the problem that the traditional carbon emission responsibility allocation mechanism is difficult to adapt to new energy volatility and permeability change; firstly, constructing a source-load collaborative carbon emission simulation model, defining a new energy permeability threshold and a hysteresis interval, dynamically switching three modes based on a permeability real-time value, namely a power generation side full-responsibility mode, a source-load benchmark allocation mechanism and a transition interval, and secondly, constructing a multi-objective optimization model, and collaborative optimizing fairness, new energy consumption and economy. The method can reduce the carbon emission responsibility distribution deviation, improve the new energy consumption rate and reduce the system operation cost, and provides technical support for the accurate carbon responsibility distribution of the high-proportion new energy power grid.

title_en: Intelligent decision method and system based on neural network
abstract_en: The application discloses an intelligent decision method and system based on a neural network, which relate to data processing and comprise the steps of obtaining location data and corresponding attribute data of an item to be decided, establishing a fuzzy relation matrix between the location and the attribute, generating a network model reflecting the trust relation strength among users through trust propagation operation of a graph neural network according to the fuzzy relation matrix, identifying a community structure comprising community overlapping degree through a community discovery algorithm according to the network model, calculating influence weight of a decision maker according to the trust relation strength among users and the community overlapping degree, forming group consensus through a robust optimization method according to the influence weight and the community structure, and generating a decision result of the item to be decided. The trust relationship among users is usually ignored in the traditional project decision, and the community structure containing the overlapping degree is identified by combining secretary bird optimization algorithm and improved K-means cluster, and influence weight and the like are calculated based on trust strength, so that the scientificity and fairness of the decision are improved.
assignees: BEIJING CHANGHE SHUZHI TECH CO LTD;CHANGHE INFORMATION CO LTD;UNIV SHANXI

title_en: Electric power spot market unbalanced cost compensation allocation method under different modes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a compensation and allocation method for unbalanced cost of an electric power spot market under different modes, and relates to the technical field of electric power markets. The method comprises the following steps of S1, obtaining power compensation data of each area of a power spot market in different modes, S2, constructing a weight function according to the power compensation data in different modes, S3, carrying out weighting processing on the weight function to obtain an allocation coefficient, S4, calculating compensation allocation proportion of each area according to different allocation coefficients, and S5, distributing unbalanced cost of the power spot market into corresponding accounts according to the compensation allocation proportion of each area. According to the invention, the power compensation data of each area of the power spot market in different modes are obtained, the weight function is constructed to calculate the allocation coefficient, and the compensation allocation proportion of each area is calculated according to the difference of the allocation coefficient, so that the rationality and fairness of the compensation allocation of each area are improved.
assignees: GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Hierarchical personalized federal learning method for oilfield production prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a hierarchical personalized federal learning method for oilfield production prediction, which relates to the technical field of petroleum engineering and artificial intelligence fusion application, and adopts a client-server architecture, wherein each oil well is used as a client. Each client independently calculates the encrypted production structure features and updates its local model with regularized optimization objectives. The central server clusters the clients based on the encrypted PSFs and coordinates a double aggregation process, wherein the double aggregation process comprises a global model fusing cross-cluster knowledge and a cluster agent model capturing personalized features in each cluster. The method not only improves the prediction accuracy of the single oil well level, but also ensures the consistency of the prediction performance of different oil wells, promotes the model prediction fairness, can effectively balance the relationship between global generalization and local individuation, does not leak data privacy information, and improves the convergence rate of the prediction model training.

title_en: Financial automatic subsidy settlement system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a financial automatic subsidy settlement system and a financial automatic subsidy settlement method, and relates to the technical field of subsidy settlement. The financial automatic subsidy settlement system and method specifically comprises the following steps of S1, data collection and integration, S2, dynamic data updating, S3, data preprocessing, S4, bill verification and calculation, S5, coefficient calculation, S6, subsidy amount calculation, S7, auditing and approval, S8, fund payment, S9, follow-up tracking and evaluation, and through high-level informatization and flow design, the real-time data updating and verification mechanism ensures the authenticity and timeliness of subsidy basis, effectively prevents false reporting, introduces a multidimensional coefficient calculation model, not only embodies personalized care on the disability degree, household economic condition and special requirements, but also ensures fairness of subsidy distribution, and the automatic auditing and payment flow reduces manual operation.
assignees: DONGYING XINCHUANG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Digital twinning-based intelligent accounting and payment system for peasant wages
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital twinning-based intelligent accounting and payment system for peasant wages, which relates to the technical field of intelligent accounting and payment for peasant wages and comprises an initial acquisition setting module, a data acquisition window module, a data analysis and feature extraction module, a task change classification module and a dynamic acquisition regulation module; the initial acquisition setting module is used for setting an initial acquisition interval duration to acquire data of a worker work task according to work arrangement of a construction site and initial complexity of the worker task. According to the invention, the data acquisition mode is optimized according to the complexity and the change mode of the work task of the worker by intelligently and dynamically regulating and controlling the acquisition interval. For complex and changeable tasks, the system shortens the acquisition interval, accurately records the switching of the high-intensity tasks and the low-intensity tasks, and ensures the fairness of wage accounting. For a single task, the acquisition interval is prolonged, redundant data is reduced, the resource utilization rate is improved, and the accuracy of wage accounting and the system operation efficiency are effectively improved.

title_en: Adaptive space crowdsourcing task allocation method based on dynamic task demand prediction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a self-adaptive space crowdsourcing task allocation method based on dynamic task demand prediction, which relates to the technical field of space crowdsourcing and comprises the steps of carrying out dynamic task demand prediction based on a demand-dependent learning module and a graph neural network according to historical task data of a target area to obtain predicted task demand information; and according to the predicted task demand information, obtaining an optimal task distribution result based on worker dependency separation, task cost function learning and a self-adaptive algorithm by the current task set and an availability window of staff. The invention remarkably improves the efficiency, flexibility and fairness of space crowdsourcing task allocation by innovations of dynamic task demand prediction, global optimization task allocation strategy, reduction of computational complexity, enhancement of stability and reliability of task allocation and the like, and has wide application prospect and social and economic value.
assignees: YANGTZE RIVER DELTA RESEARCH INSTITUTE QUZHOU OF ELECTRONIC SCIENCE AND TECHNOLOGY UNIV

title_en: Multi-group time sequence student cognitive diagnosis method based on joint probability model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-group time sequence student cognitive diagnosis method based on a joint probability model, which belongs to the field of education and comprises the following steps of obtaining student answer data, group classification labels and covariate data of at least two continuous time points, constructing the joint probability model according to the student answer data, the group classification labels and the covariate data, wherein the joint probability model comprises a structure model and a measurement model, the structure model is used for describing a dynamic change process of a potential knowledge mastering state of a student, the measurement model is used for establishing an association relation between the student answer data and the potential knowledge mastering state of the student at each time point, and analyzing based on the joint probability model to obtain the potential knowledge mastering state of the student. The invention can compare the differences of potential knowledge mastering states and response modes among a plurality of groups, and provides important basis for evaluating educational fairness and optimizing teaching strategies.

title_en: Quality inspection bill distribution method, device and equipment
abstract_en: The invention provides a quality inspection list distribution method, a device and equipment, belonging to the technical field of computers, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a plurality of quality inspection lists to be distributed and distribution rules of the plurality of quality inspection lists, wherein the distribution rules are associated with quality inspection requirements; the quality inspection method comprises the steps of sequentially distributing quality inspection sheets to each quality inspector according to a plurality of quality inspection sheets until the sum of quality inspection time periods corresponding to the quality inspection sheets distributed to a first quality inspector reaches a first preset time period, sequencing unallocated quality inspection sheets in the plurality of quality inspection sheets according to a distribution rule to obtain at least one target sequence, distributing the quality inspection sheets to each quality inspector again according to the arrangement sequence of the quality inspection sheets in the at least one target sequence, and enabling the sum of the quality inspection time periods corresponding to the quality inspection sheets distributed to each quality inspector to be not smaller than a second preset time period, wherein the second preset time period is longer than the first preset time period. Therefore, the distribution efficiency and the distribution fairness of the quality inspection bill can be improved, and the labor cost is reduced.
assignees: YUANBAO KECHUANG BEIJING TECH CO LTD

title_en: Railway temporary facility construction progress optimization method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of construction management, and discloses a method and a system for optimizing construction progress of temporary railway facilities based on artificial intelligence; the method realizes the accurate quantification of construction contradiction through heterogeneous data fusion and conflict map modeling, combines a multi-agent auction mechanism with a virtual credit system, improves the fairness and efficiency of resource allocation, and breaks through the limitations of the traditional algorithm from the local and global levels respectively through a self-healing mechanism of a pulse neural network and quantum genetic optimization. And at the system level, the edge computing nodes and the distributed consensus engine ensure the reliability of real-time decision making, the dynamic digital sand table realizes the visual prediction of risks, and the self-organizing control tower ensures the compliance of the specification. Through practical verification, the invention reduces the number of resource conflict, improves the emergency response, has higher early warning accuracy of major risks, and remarkably improves the construction efficiency and the safety.

title_en: Base layer management system and method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of office automation and time management, in particular to a base layer management system and method based on a blockchain technology. The method comprises the steps of automatically collecting basic management task data, generating a hash value of a task, updating a task state based on the hash value of the task, calculating a task priority score, performing resource allocation based on the task priority score, dynamically adjusting task execution efficiency based on the resource amount obtained by the task, dynamically adjusting the planned completion time of the task, and dynamically adjusting the task state, the resource allocation and approval circulation based on the corrected task plan completion time. The method solves the problems that the traditional management system is easy to attack and lacks traceability, task scheduling priority management is disordered, resource allocation cannot be flexibly adjusted according to task states, task execution efficiency is low, overtime task influence is not reasonably modeled, approval circulation depends on manual auditing, performance assessment is easy to be manually interfered, and fairness and reliability of basic management are reduced.
assignees: JILIN RUNSHI SOFTWARE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Performance and preference-based resource allocation method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data processing, which can be applied to business scenes such as the financial and technological field, and discloses a resource allocation method based on performance and preference, comprising the steps of collecting performance index data of a target object in a data platform and text information in an interaction platform; the method comprises the steps of performing performance grade classification processing on target objects according to performance index data to generate performance labels containing performance grade identifiers, extracting keywords related to resource item preferences from text information, generating preference labels based on the keywords, generating distribution parameters containing resource item value weights and distribution probability weights based on the performance labels and the preference labels, executing resource distribution operation according to the distribution parameters, and outputting distribution results. According to the invention, the resource allocation is optimized by combining the performance data and the preference information, so that individuation and fairness are improved, a high-performance object can obtain more reasonable resources, and the incentive effect and allocation flexibility are improved.
assignees: PING AN INT FINANCIAL LEASING CO LTD

title_en: Method, device, equipment, medium and program for determining disaster relief materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for determining disaster relief supplies, which comprises the steps of obtaining the number of people to be saved reported in a plurality of disaster-stricken areas, obtaining at least one disaster-stricken statistical data of crop disaster-stricken areas, crop receiving areas, disaster-stricken population data, death population data, missing population data, collapse house data, damaged house data and regional economic loss data reported in the disaster-stricken areas under the condition that the number of people to be saved in the disaster-stricken areas meets a number constraint condition and the disaster-stricken areas are not preset areas, determining the resource allocation data of the disaster-stricken areas according to regional resource information and regional population data of the disaster-stricken areas, determining disaster-stricken level corresponding to each disaster-stricken data according to the disaster-stricken index data, and determining the disaster-stricken data of each disaster-stricken area according to the number of people to be saved, the disaster-stricken level, the disaster-stricken data and the resource allocation data, and improving the rescue precision and rescue efficiency of the disaster-stricken areas.
assignees: NAT DISASTER REDUCTION CENTER OF EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT EMERGENCY MANAGEMENT DEPARTMENT SAT

title_en: Emergency rescue item transfer system using drone
title_ko: 드론을 이용한 응급 구호 물품 배송 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to an emergency relief product delivery system using a drone and, more specifically, to an emergency relief product delivery system using a drone, which can quickly provide an emergency relief product such as an automatic cardiac shock device to a required position within a golden time by using a drone outdoors such as a golf course where an ambulance cannot arrive quickly. This task (result) is a three-stage industry-academic cooperation leading university fostering project conducted with the funding of the ministry of education and the korea research foundation (linc 3. title_en: Dynamic space-time supply and demand adaptation-based fair transaction method and system for computing power resources
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of server resource management and transaction, but is not limited to, and discloses a server resource fair transaction method and a system based on dynamic space-time supply and demand adaptation, wherein in a computing resource market, computing resource supply provides computing resources for a computing matching transaction platform, and a utility function of a computing provider is utilized to optimize computing supply strategies; in the transaction flow, an algorithm force resource demand party submits a resource application to an algorithm force matching transaction platform according to the real-time demand of a calculation task, and an utility function of the algorithm force resource demand party is utilized to enable the algorithm force resource demand party to obtain an algorithm force resource meeting the calculation time delay demand, and meanwhile, the payment cost is ensured to be in a reasonable range. The invention improves the transaction efficiency by optimizing the resource allocation of the server and ensures the fairness of supply and demand.
assignees: GUANGZHOU RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF XIDIAN UNIV;GUANGZHOU YUNQU INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;UNIV XIDIAN;GUANGZHOU LIANRONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent decision and priority distribution system for wound rescue
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of wound rescue, in particular to an intelligent decision and priority distribution system for wound rescue, which comprises the steps of collecting original rescue data; the method comprises the steps of preprocessing original rescue data to obtain preprocessed rescue data, processing the preprocessed rescue data through a deep learning model to obtain shock probability, damage type and environment physiological associated data, calculating ISS total score priority in an associated mode by using the shock probability, the damage type and the environment physiological associated data, generating a patient priority list according to the ISS total score priority, and distributing resources to the patient priority with the highest score in the patient priority list. According to the invention, the patient injury scores are dynamically generated through the deep learning model, medical resources are automatically allocated according to the score high-low ordering, and the optimal route of the ambulance is generated by combining the GIS map, so that critical patients can be treated preferentially, and the fairness and timeliness of rescue are improved.

title_en: Intelligent system suitable for evaluating comprehensive performance of power plant team
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system suitable for evaluating the comprehensive performance of a group in a power plant, and relates to the technical field of big data intelligent management, comprising the following steps of inputting a group name, claiming a card punching record of the group and sending the card punching record to a computing device; the method comprises the steps of calculating month evaluation scores and annual average performance scores of all people in the teams, obtaining comprehensive capacity scores by all people in the teams according to answer scores in an answer device, calculating total scores of a plurality of staff to be annual total scores of the teams, calculating final performance scores of the teams by combining the annual total score ranking of all teams from nine aspects, calculating final performance scores of all teams after the annual total scores of all teams are ranked, and obtaining final total scores and ranking according to the final performance scores and the annual total scores. The intelligent system is suitable for evaluating the comprehensive performance of the teams in the power plant, increases the evaluation data sources and evaluation indexes, increases the calculation weight of basic staff, and optimizes the evaluation process and fairness of the teams.
assignees: CHN ENERGY GUIZHOU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Surgical grade grading incentive issuing method for performance assessment
abstract_en: The invention discloses a surgical grade grading incentive issuing method for performance assessment, which belongs to the technical field of medical management and comprises the following steps of 1) constructing a dynamic operation grading weight model based on operation risks, technical difficulties, resource consumption and ethical risks, adjusting the performance score of each operation in real time, 2) integrating technical dimension indexes and quality dimension indexes, weighting each index through a machine learning model, and realizing personalized assessment, and 3) blocking chain driven incentive issuing, namely recording operation data and assessment results through a blocking chain technology, and improving enthusiasm of high-difficulty operation development, optimizing medical resource allocation, reducing weight and quality risks and enhancing data credibility and incentive fairness through the dynamic operation grading weight model, the multi-dimensional performance assessment index system and a blocking chain driven incentive issuing and cross-hospital collaborative incentive pool.
assignees: GUANGXI HOSPITAL AFFILIATED TO SUN YAT SEN UNIV

title_en: Smart dynamic equity distribution framework
abstract_en: This invention introduces the Dynamic Equity Distribution Method, a groundbreaking system designed to enable fair, transparent, and adaptable equity allocation in startups and collaborative ventures. By integrating blockchain technology, tokenization, and dynamic adjustment mechanisms, this method overcomes the limitations of static equity models, ensuring that ownership shares continuously align with each member's real-time contributions. Key features include: Comprehensive Contribution Valuation: A structured approach to evaluate both financial and non-financial contributions, such as intellectual property, network resources, physical assets, skills, and time, using Fair Market Value (FMV) assessments. Dynamic Adjustment Mechanism: Automated equity realignments powered by smart contracts, conducting periodic reviews to reflect ongoing contributions and performance milestones. Tokenization and Blockchain Integration: Equity shares represented as digital tokens stored on a blockchain, ensuring transparency, security, and ease of ownership transfer. Structured Exit Protocols: Predefined procedures for member exits, including buy-back options, share dilution mechanisms, reserve funds to manage ownership transitions seamlessly.
assignees: MANAFI MIRALILOO FAEGHEH;BAKHSHI GHOURT TAPPEH VAHID

title_en: Green space optimization system considering ecological connectivity and green space equality
title_ko: 생태 연계성 및 녹지 형평성을 고려한 녹지 최적화 시스템
abstract_en: The present invention relates to a system implemented in software in a computer device to select and evaluate an optimal location of a green area in consideration of green area equity and ecological connectivity. Provided is a green area optimization system in consideration of ecological connectivity and green area equity, which includes: a first green area calculation unit for calculating the size and location of the green area required for a city block by calculating the equity of the green area based on the location of the city block and the existing green area; a second green area calculation unit for calculating the size and location of the green area required for the city block based on ecological connectivity; a third green area calculation unit for preventing sporadic green area shapes and calculating the green area shapes required for the city block; and an optimization algorithm calculation unit for deriving the optimized size and location of the green area by applying each object function corresponding to the calculation algorithm of the first green area calculation unit, the second green area calculation unit, and the third green area calculation unit as a multi-purpose function.
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 녹지 형평성 및 생태 연계성을 고려하여 녹지의 최적 위치를 선정하여 평가하도록 전산 장치에서 소프트웨어적으로 구현되는 시스템으로서, 도시 블록과 기존 녹지의 위치에 기초한 녹지의 형평성을 계산하여 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 계산하는 제1 녹지 계산부; 생태 연계성에 기초하여 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 계산하는 제2 녹지 계산부; 산발적 녹지 형태를 방지하는 것으로서, 상기 도시 블록에 요구되는 녹지 형태를 계산하는 제3 녹지 계산부; 및 상기 제1 녹지 계산부, 상기 제2 녹지 계산부 및 상기 제3 녹지 계산부의 계산 알고리즘에 해당하는 각각의 목적함수(Object Function)를 다중목적함수로 적용하여 최적화된 녹지의 규모 및 위치를 도출하는 최적화 알고리즘 계산부를 포함하는 생태 연계성 및 녹지 형평성을 고려한 녹지 최적화 시스템을 제공한다.

title_en: Digital rights near-field real-time verification and verification system and method based on edge calculation
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of information and discloses a digital equity near-field real-time verification system based on edge calculation, which comprises a space-time coding module, a dynamic weight module, a blockchain segmentation module and a verification execution module, wherein the space-time coding module is used for generating a unique verification identifier according to the geographic position and time of a user and transmitting the identifier to the dynamic weight module, the dynamic weight module is connected with the space-time coding module, generates equity distribution strategies based on a federal learning model and an optimization algorithm and outputs the optimized strategies to the blockchain segmentation module, the blockchain segmentation module is connected with the dynamic weight module, dynamically divides a consensus network according to the real-time verification density, executes distributed verification in segments and generates verification authorization instructions, and the verification execution module distributes verification tasks according to the authorization instructions and synchronously updates the point inventory state. By adopting the technical scheme of meshing coordinate mapping, time window division and nonlinear hash of the space-time coding module, the technical effects of unpredictable and unique binding of the verification identifier are achieved.
assignees: HEBEI CHENDING HUAYUN TECH DEVELOPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Resource reservation method, electronic device, storage medium, and computer program product
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a resource reservation method, electronic equipment, a storage medium and a computer program product, and relates to the field of data processing. The resource reservation method comprises the steps of responding to a demand portrait of an initiator of a resource reservation request, determining the reservation priority of the initiator, wherein the resource reservation request is a request for the use permission of a target resource, the reservation priority represents the order of the initiator to obtain the use permission of the target resource, comparing the reservation priority of the initiator with a first mapping table, determining the resource level of a resource unit which can be reserved in the target resource by the initiator, recording the corresponding relation between the reservation priority and the resource level in the first mapping table, and distributing the use permission of the resource unit corresponding to the resource level to the initiator. According to the technical scheme, the fairness of resource allocation is guaranteed while the differentiated requirements are met in the resource reservation process.

title_en: Multi-energy alliance profit-risk collaborative distribution system based on improved Shapley value method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-energy alliance profit-risk collaborative distribution system based on an improved Shapley value method, which belongs to the field of multi-market collaborative optimization and comprises a multi-dimensional contribution degree calculation module, a risk evaluation and correction module, a dynamic adjustment module and a data interface module, wherein the multi-dimensional contribution degree calculation module is used for calculating low-carbon contribution degrees, comprehensive profit contribution degrees and cost contribution degrees respectively, the risk evaluation and correction module is used for dynamically correcting Shapley values to obtain corrected Shapley values, namely alliance profit distribution results, the dynamic adjustment module is used for executing Shapley value redistribution considering comprehensive contribution degrees of different power generation subjects to obtain redistribution results, and adjusting the redistribution results according to differences between the comprehensive contribution degrees and average contribution degrees of all the power generation subjects. By adopting the multi-energy alliance profit-risk collaborative distribution system based on the improved Shapley value method, the profit fairness and the operation stability of the multi-energy alliance are obviously improved through multi-dimensional contribution quantification, dynamic risk correction and a differential excitation mechanism, and the multi-energy alliance profit-risk collaborative distribution system has important theoretical significance and engineering application value.

title_en: Heterogeneous type emergency resource scheduling optimization method considering fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a heterogeneous type emergency resource scheduling optimization method considering fairness, and belongs to the field of emergency resource scheduling optimization. Aiming at compact cooperative heterogeneous resources, adopting time and satisfaction rate dual dimension modeling, adopting a mixed coding and decoding mode according to problem characteristics, expressing an emergency resource scheduling scheme in a mathematical form, aiming at target and constraint conditions, adopting a random rule with priority to ensure the quality of an initial population, adopting a cross operator combining shuffling cross and partial matching cross to ensure the diversity and stability of the population in an iterative process, adopting self-adaptive cross variation probability to maintain the diversity of the population, improving the efficiency of the algorithm, adopting an elite retention strategy with a lowest crowdedness threshold to increase the diversity of the population and prevent the population from maturing prematurely. The method is suitable for dispatching optimization of the close-cooperation type heterogeneous resources under the condition of supply and demand in the early period of disasters, and provides a new thought for solving the problem of dispatching the heterogeneous resources in emergency resources.

title_en: Unmanned aerial vehicle unloading decision and track optimization method and system for sea
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of communication, and particularly relates to a method and a system for unloading decision and track optimization of an offshore unmanned aerial vehicle, wherein the method comprises the following steps of S1, establishing a communication simulation model, including position information of a user and an unmanned aerial vehicle edge server, and setting parameters; and S2, under the condition of determining total computing resources, setting up a joint optimization model by taking the time delay and the energy consumption comprehensive cost of all tasks as targets, S3, optimizing an unloading strategy of ground equipment, searching an unloading scheme through a reinforcement learning method, distributing the computing resources of a server according to a differential evolution simulated annealing hybrid algorithm, and S4, optimizing the moving track of the unmanned aerial vehicle by taking load fairness as targets. According to the invention, computing and storage resources are provided for navigation users in a marine special communication environment, so that the service quality of the mobile users and the network use experience are improved. The invention can also be applied to offshore emergency rescue scenes to provide high-priority and low-delay quick service for emergency users.

title_en: Aversion type facility site selection method based on power graph and improved genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an aversion type facility site selection method based on a Power diagram and an improved genetic algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of facility planning site selection, and improves decision fairness and acceptability of aversion type facility site selection by combining Maximin site selection models, the Power diagram, the improved genetic algorithm and a local search algorithm, has more accurate global search capability and reduces negative influence on residents nearby or environments nearby. Specifically, the dual goals of maximizing public benefits and minimizing adverse effects are considered through a Maximin addressing model, a Power graph can accurately describe the adjacency and the influence range of each potential position, the application of an improved genetic algorithm can more effectively find a global optimal solution in a complex search space, effective position optimization is carried out through a simulated evolution process, and the accuracy of knowledge is further improved through a local search algorithm, so that a better solution is ensured to be achieved in a local area.

title_en: Emergency material dispatching system and material dispatching method based on ant colony algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent emergency material scheduling system and method based on an ant colony algorithm. A demand prediction module of the emergency material intelligent scheduling system utilizes a space-time diagram neural network to dynamically predict material demands and constructs a layered network model integrating multi-mode transportation of unmanned aerial vehicles, ground vehicles and the like. The optimization calculation module adopts an improved ant colony algorithm, introduces a demand urgency weight factor and a green weight factor to construct a multi-objective fitness function, and combines a dynamic pheromone updating mechanism and a multi-ant colony cooperative strategy to optimize a transportation path. The system is provided with a dynamic adjustment module driven by edge calculation to realize 30-second-level rapid path re-planning, creatively integrates a psychological aid priority model, and extracts a psychological crisis index optimization scheduling strategy through emotion analysis. The invention effectively solves the problems of lag response and insufficient multi-objective optimization of the traditional dispatching system, remarkably improves the transportation efficiency by 25% -35%, reduces carbon emission and ensures the high efficiency, fairness and humanity care of emergency dispatching.

title_en: Low-altitude economic trusted data processing method and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention discloses a low-altitude economy credible data processing method and a storage medium, belonging to the technical field of low-altitude economy and data element circulation. The method comprises the steps of responding to a saproli value calculation instruction, reading low-altitude data corresponding to unmanned aerial vehicles from a block chain for each unmanned aerial vehicle in a plurality of unmanned aerial vehicles operating cooperatively in a low-altitude space, determining unmanned aerial vehicle contribution values of the unmanned aerial vehicles according to the low-altitude data, determining alliance contribution values according to the unmanned aerial vehicle contribution values and a first airspace openness correction factor by utilizing a target saproli formula, determining weight coefficients according to the first airspace openness correction factor and an alliance scale, determining target saproli values of the unmanned aerial vehicles according to the alliance contribution values and the weight coefficients, and distributing value to all low-altitude data for each unmanned aerial vehicle according to the target saproli values respectively corresponding to each unmanned aerial vehicle. The technical scheme of the embodiment of the invention can ensure fairness in value allocation for low-altitude data.
assignees: ISOFTSTONE DATA TECH BEIJING CO LTD

title_en: Urban green space fairness evaluation method for coupling social ecological supply and demand potential
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban ecological system regulation and discloses an urban green space fairness evaluation method for coupling social ecological supply and demand potential, which comprises the steps of collecting multi-source data and constructing a green space basic database based on the multi-source data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a green space comprehensive supply index, a green space comprehensive demand index and a green space line-of-sight reachable potential index based on a green space basic database based on multi-source data, generating a green space supply and demand coupling coordination degree index based on the green space comprehensive supply index and the green space comprehensive demand index through coupling coordination analysis, generating a green space fairness index based on the green space supply and demand coupling coordination degree index and the green space line-of-sight reachable potential index, and evaluating fairness of urban green space allocation by judging the category of the green space fairness index.

title_en: Household service system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of household services, and discloses a household service system which comprises a user system module, a service management module, an order scheduling module and an evaluation wind control module, wherein the user system module supports hierarchical authentication and authority allocation of clients, service personnel and administrators, and generates portrait tag drive matching based on behavior data of the clients and the service personnel, the service management module constructs a secondary classification system, adopts an intelligent recommendation engine driven by a fusion collaborative filtering algorithm and a deep learning algorithm to recommend household items, the order scheduling module utilizes order period management and the intelligent matching engine to optimize a service flow, and the evaluation wind control module ensures service quality monitoring and fairness of a credit system through a bidirectional evaluation mechanism and abnormal evaluation detection. The invention can improve the supply and demand matching efficiency of the household service, optimize the service standard, perfect the credit system and provide decision basis for data support for large-scale operation.
assignees: WUHU JINCHEN HOUSEKEEPING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: AGV charging pile distribution method and system based on dynamic graph neural network and PSO optimization
abstract_en: The invention provides an AGV charging pile distribution method and system based on a dynamic graph neural network and PSO optimization, and belongs to the technical field of AGV charging control. The method comprises the steps of obtaining operation data of a charging pile and an AGV, extracting time sequence features of the operation data by using a sliding window technology, reducing dimensions by means of principal component analysis, taking the charging pile and the AGV as nodes in a graph, taking a charging request and a state as edges, updating the node features by using a cross-layer graph attention mechanism, combining a self-attention mechanism and a multi-head attention mechanism, fusing different features, and respectively optimizing charging speed and user fairness by using a multi-branch neural network. And further optimizing a neural network architecture through a PSO algorithm to generate a final charging pile distribution scheme. The method solves the problem of insufficient multi-objective collaborative optimization, reduces the AGV charging waiting time, improves the system resource utilization rate and the user fairness, and is suitable for large-scale AGV cluster intelligent charging management.
assignees: LIYANG RESEARCH INSTITUTE SOUTHEAST UNIV;UNIV NANJING POSTS & TELECOMMUNICATIONS

title_en: Particle swarm optimization-based real-time load gap allocation optimization method
abstract_en: The invention provides an optimization method for real-time load gap distribution based on a particle swarm algorithm, which belongs to the technical field of power system operation and control, and specifically comprises the following steps of 1, constructing an adaptability function for fusing economic influence and environmental benefit; and step 2, setting constraint conditions comprising total load notch constraint and a single enterprise safety load interval, and step 3, adopting a particle swarm optimization algorithm to solve the minimum value of the fitness function and outputting an optimal load distribution scheme. According to the invention, the load gap is scientifically distributed through the quantitative index, so that the communication cost is reduced, and the efficiency, fairness and environmental benefit of load management are improved. The method is used for enterprise elastic load management in the power demand peak period, and scientific distribution and optimization of load gaps are realized.

title_en: Virtual power plant transaction scheduling method and device based on block chain consensus
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual power plant transaction scheduling method and device based on blockchain consensus, which construct a virtual power plant transaction scheduling framework, wherein the virtual power plant transaction scheduling framework comprises a blockchain main chain and at least one blockchain slave chain, transaction center nodes, scheduling center nodes and at least one distributed energy node are deployed on the blockchain main chain, each blockchain slave chain is provided with at least one distributed energy node, and effective coordination of virtual power plant transaction scheduling is realized through a blockchain-based distributed consensus and token bucket electric power flow control algorithm. The invention can ensure fairness and balance of scheduling of each distributed energy node in the virtual power plant, realize peak clipping and valley filling when external power transaction demand fluctuates, ensure transparency and traceability of transaction scheduling, and enhance safety of the device.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG;YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Electric-gas comprehensive energy system planning method based on cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric-gas comprehensive energy system planning method based on collaborative games, which comprises the steps of S1, establishing a multi-main-body electric-gas comprehensive energy system model comprising a carbon capture power plant, renewable energy sources and a carbon utilization unit, S2, establishing a distributed optimization objective function and operation constraint of each main-body model, S3, establishing a collaborative game model through distributed optimization according to the distributed optimization objective function and operation constraint based on a collaborative game alliance, and S4, decomposing and collaborative solving the collaborative game model by adopting an alternate direction multiplier method to generate electric-carbon bilateral transaction amount and dynamic negotiation price. The invention can process the distributed decision behaviors among multiple subjects, truly characterize the physical interaction relationship among the multiple energy flows in the electric-gas-carbon system, improve the physical reliability and engineering applicability of the model, maximize the income of each subject, and give consideration to privacy protection requirements and cooperative residual value distribution, and improve the running efficiency and fairness of the system.

title_en: Blockchain-based carbon right-green evidence cooperative transaction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon right-green certificate cooperative transaction method based on a blockchain, and belongs to the fields of blockchain technology and environment management. The method specifically comprises the steps of 1) deploying intelligent contracts based on an Ethernet platform, integrating power transaction, carbon quota delivery and green evidence verification flow chains to realize automatic execution of transaction rules and non-falsification of data, 2) innovatively designing a Carbon Token (Carbon Token) excitation mechanism, providing a DPoS-CT consensus algorithm considering Carbon Token rights, exciting a market subject to continuously reduce emission, 3) quantifying main body performance and distributing chain equity by a dynamic reputation model and a reward and punishment mechanism, and 4) resetting transaction periods every 24 hours, and optimizing quota distribution and consensus parameters based on historical data. The mechanism provided by the invention can effectively stimulate the renewable energy source transaction, and after the blockchain carbon-through certification system is introduced, the quota completion rate, the green electricity utilization rate, the carbon emission, the carbon right-green certification transaction amount and the economic benefit are optimized to a certain extent.

title_en: Task allocation method and device based on artificial intelligence, computer equipment and medium
