abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and relates to a task allocation method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium based on artificial intelligence, wherein the task allocation method comprises the steps of carrying out data association and cleaning treatment on acquired agent information, incomplete task information, allocable task information and residual working time length information of a target agent to obtain target agent data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out workload prediction on target agent data based on a called workload evaluation model to obtain the number of predicted tasks, judging whether the number of the predicted tasks is larger than 0, if so, obtaining target task types good for the target agents, obtaining target number thresholds corresponding to the target task types, and carrying out task allocation processing corresponding to the target task types on the target agents based on the target number thresholds and the number of the predicted tasks. Furthermore, the number of prediction tasks of the present application may be stored in the blockchain. The application can be applied to task dispatch processing in the financial field, and improves the processing efficiency, accuracy and fairness of task allocation.
assignees: CHINA PING AN PROPERTY INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Landscape multifunction and fairness optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a landscape versatility and fairness optimization method, device, equipment and storage medium. Relates to the technical field of land space planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining land utilization type data, generating an unconstrained sample set based on continuous uniform distribution based on a random sample generator, generating a constrained sample set based on discrete uniform distribution based on the unconstrained sample set based on constraint conditions and landscape proportion data of land utilization, simulating land utilization conversion quantity based on the constrained sample set according to continuous multivariable probability distribution and random weight to obtain a plurality of landscape combinations, calculating versatility and fairness of each landscape combination, and determining optimal landscape situations according to the versatility and fairness of each landscape combination. The application discovers the optimal landscape combination through the scene setting, realizes the promotion of the service versatility of the ecological system, and reduces the uneven phenomenon of ecological benefit in group distribution.

title_en: Intelligent evaluation system of cloud computing platform
abstract_en: The invention provides an intelligent evaluation system of a cloud computing platform, which belongs to the technical field of intelligent evaluation and comprises a four-dimensional heterogeneous topological network module, a dynamic load sensing neural network module, a privacy protection module, a disaster recovery and performance optimization module and a compliance and adaptation module. The intelligent evaluation system of the cloud computing platform provided by the invention solves the core defects of the existing intelligent evaluation system of cloud computing in the aspects of dynamic fairness, non-European resource association modeling and fault self-healing capacity. By introducing a time attenuation factor and multidimensional contribution quantification through a dynamic shape value evaluation model, the fairness barrier of traditional static evaluation is broken, and real-time accurate measurement of node contribution is realized.

title_en: Automatic distribution and management system for digital member rights based on block chain
abstract_en: The invention discloses a blockchain-based digital member equity automatic distribution and management system, which relates to the technical field of digital member equity management and comprises a state fingerprint generation module, a state abstract communication module, a consistency feature extraction module, a consistency risk assessment module and an intelligent contract delay control and rollback module, wherein the state fingerprint generation module extracts key parameters representing the current blockchain state from a chain account book unit and a consensus unit, performs feature coding, hash compression and instruction stream abstract modeling on the key parameters, and forms a state fingerprint which uniquely identifies the current node chain state. The intelligent delay and rollback control of key equity issuing on the chain is realized through the state fingerprint comparison and the support vector machine risk assessment mechanism, the issuing accuracy and the system stability under abnormal states are improved, and the false issuing, missed issuing and repeated issuing risks are effectively prevented.
assignees: HEFEI LIANSHI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Heating fee charging management system based on Internet of things
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of heating fee charge management and discloses a heating fee charge management system based on the Internet of things. The system collects multidimensional energy consumption data through the user energy consumption sensing module, and heterogeneous feature fusion is carried out through the energy consumption feature analysis module to generate an energy consumption feature vector. The dynamic pricing modeling module generates a user charging weight matrix based on a space-time random forest algorithm. And constructing a double-layer optimization library of the heat source supply and user demand prediction model by the resource balance scheduling library. The intelligent charging control module generates real-time charge accounting instructions and heat source regulation and control decisions by means of a multi-task deep reinforcement learning framework. The system can also detect abnormal heat utilization behaviors and construct a heat price fluctuation prediction model. The invention realizes accurate charging and intelligent heat source scheduling, improves charging fairness and heat source utilization rate, enhances system management capability, adapts to market change, and has obvious economic benefit and practical value.
assignees: XINJIANG SHUIFA WISDOM SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Charging reservation optimization method and system based on block chain
abstract_en: The application relates to a charging reservation optimization method and system based on a block chain. The method comprises the steps of storing the encrypted charging requirements of users and parameters of the charging piles into a blockchain, automatically screening available charging pile lists meeting the position and time requirements by using the blockchain, checking the health degree of the charging piles to generate a final available list, generating a locking identifier through the blockchain after the users select the charging piles, starting charging after verifying the validity of the locking identifier when the users arrive, recording data to the blockchain in real time in the charging process, automatically settling fees after the charging process is finished and unlocking the charging piles, realizing the real-time synchronous verification of the charging pile state and the blockchain data, solving the problem that the actual state of the charging piles is inconsistent with the system display in the traditional reservation, avoiding invalid reservation, and simultaneously guaranteeing fairness of resource allocation of the charging piles through a timestamp mechanism of the blockchain.
assignees: ZHONGDE CENTURY TIANJIN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;ZHONGDE CENTURY KUNSHAN NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD;ZHIQING NEW ENERGY TECH TIANJIN CO LTD

title_en: Green energy-saving building planning method and system based on big data
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green energy-saving building planning method and system based on big data, which relate to the technical field of building energy-saving planning and information, in user behavior analysis, dynamic influence of user behavior on energy consumption is accurately quantified by collecting and comparing data such as historical energy consumption of a building, active temperature adjustment times and the like, mechanical refrigeration with insufficient passive design and active temperature adjustment energy consumption of a user are distinguished in refrigeration energy consumption prediction, influence of climate change on building refrigeration is treated in a prospective manner, a green planning index containing renewable energy power generation capacity, refrigeration energy consumption and microclimate temperature rise is constructed in a planning stage, comprehensive unified indexes of emission reduction mean value and standard deviation are introduced in an evaluation link, carbon fairness is quantified, balance of regional low-carbon targets is guaranteed, a systematic scientific path is provided for green building planning through multi-source data fusion, energy consumption coupling modeling and regional collaborative optimization, and adaptability and sustainability of planning are effectively improved.
assignees: HANGZHOU DEYUN CONSTRUCTION ENG CO LTD

title_en: Ship brake passing scheduling method based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention discloses a ship pass gate scheduling method based on artificial intelligence, and relates to the technical field of ship pass gate scheduling. The method comprises the steps of obtaining ship information, multidimensional ship observation information and historical track data, estimating the ship state based on the multidimensional ship observation information, dividing the confidence level of the ship according to the ship information and marking the confidence level to generate a ship information set, obtaining a ship queue reorganization scheme and a corresponding prediction result based on the multi-node collaborative optimization model, and updating the multi-node collaborative optimization model according to the comparison result of the collected data and the prediction result. According to the invention, a plurality of scheduling targets covering lock room space utilization, safe passing constraint, ship priority, fairness balance and water level linkage are set, and a weight dynamic adjustment mechanism and a multi-target balance strategy are introduced in the optimization process, so that the scheduling method is flexibly balanced among various operation requirements.

title_en: Electric power market force analysis and supervision method based on multidimensional index and machine learning algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric power market force analysis and supervision method based on a multi-dimensional index and a machine learning algorithm, which comprises the following steps of obtaining historical data of an electric power market and constructing a multi-dimensional index according to the historical data; the method comprises the steps of carrying out time sequence coding on multi-dimensional indexes which are calculated and normalized, capturing time correlation characteristics among the multi-dimensional indexes according to a double-flow machine learning algorithm, establishing a high-dimensional polyhedral model through high-dimensional joint distribution, deriving a dynamic threshold value according to probability volume density of the high-dimensional polyhedral model, setting a multi-index voting mechanism, setting a risk quantization model, dividing market force risk levels according to the multi-dimensional indexes and the dynamic threshold value, constructing a dynamic degradation mechanism, and generating a risk characteristic library according to the dynamic degradation mechanism. The invention can consider multidimensional factors, dynamically optimize the market force monitoring and supervising method, accurately grade the market force risk of each market participant, improve the supervising efficiency and ensure the fairness and stability of the electric power market.

title_en: Irrigation area water and fertilizer coupling regulation and control method based on cross-scale collaborative optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water and fertilizer coupling regulation and control method for a irrigated area based on cross-scale collaborative optimization, which improves the agricultural water and fertilizer management efficiency through a systematic methodology. Firstly, collecting meteorological and agricultural basic data, fitting a water and fertilizer production function by using a least square method, and establishing a relation between crop yield and water and fertilizer input. And constructing a water balance model and a multi-objective optimization function on the farmland scale, and solving the optimal irrigation and nitrogen application scheme of each field by adopting NSGA-II and TOPSIS algorithms. And (3) optimizing a water supply scheme with the aim of subtracting the water and fertilizer cost from the total yield value of crops at the irrigation domain scale, forming a local water supply boundary, and realizing cooperative iteration of irrigation domain and farmland through a dynamic feedback mechanism. And finally, carrying out global optimization evaluation on the scale of the irrigation area through a fairness model, and providing decision support for reasonable allocation of water resources. Economic benefit, resource utilization rate and environmental influence are comprehensively considered, scientificity and sustainability of water and fertilizer management in irrigation areas are effectively improved, and a new idea is provided for intelligent development of modern agriculture.

title_en: Data processing method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a data processing method and device, and relates to the field of warehouse logistics. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a delivery bill, screening delivery single file data of cross-region delivery from the delivery bill, determining purchase application line data matched with each delivery single file data, obtaining the allocable shortage number of each purchase application line data, comparing the allocable shortage number with the delivery number of each delivery single file data, determining the hit delivery number of each purchase application line data according to a comparison result, updating the allocable shortage number, and determining whether the cross-region delivery of each delivery single file data is caused by the shortage of an upstream supply warehouse according to a processing result. According to the embodiment, whether transregional delivery is caused by the shortage of the upstream delivery warehouse can be determined, the intelligent responsibility division closed loop is realized, the judgment precision and efficiency are obviously improved, and the fairness and reliability of transregional delivery responsibility definition are optimized.
assignees: BEIJING JINGDONG YUANSHENG TECH CO LTD

title_en: Public transport travel service big data processing method and system
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of public transportation travel service, and discloses a public transportation travel service big data processing method and system, wherein the method comprises the steps of accessing heterogeneous public transportation data, calibrating coordinate deviation, fusing real-time weather events and generating space-time grid entities; the method comprises the steps of constructing a priority decision tree and rule matching logic according to four-dimensional equity rules, generating a scheduling vector with an equity label, synchronously generating a network resource arbitration log, fusing the scheduling vector and the network resource arbitration log, defining and executing a three-level dynamic rule chain, generating a confidence arbitration result, carrying out path feasibility check, further generating a space-time constraint scheduling path, formulating a sharing distribution strategy according to the four-dimensional equity rules, classifying an associated data set, executing three-level quality check on the associated data set after the classification, triggering an anomaly correction mechanism, generating a data quality evaluation report, and reversely optimizing through space-time analysis to form a closed-loop treatment flow.

title_en: Multi-station collaborative pipelined capability verification sample online distribution method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-station collaborative pipelined capacity verification sample online distribution method and system, which specifically comprises the steps of 1, manufacturing a preparation mark for each sample, 2, evaluating the samples, 3, setting laboratory marks and associating laboratories, 4, setting sample combination and associating distribution numbers in the laboratories, 5, distributing the samples for the laboratories and associating the distributed samples with each other, and 6, packaging and express delivering the distributed and associated samples. The invention avoids the situation of capability verification sample false sending or false identification, provides solid data support for sample tracing, and ensures confidentiality and fairness.

title_en: Government work order dispatching system based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence and government service, and discloses a government work order dispatching system based on deep reinforcement learning, which comprises an agent dispatching module, a control module and a control module, wherein the agent dispatching module is used for respectively configuring deep reinforcement learning dispatching agents for a plurality of government service areas and outputting execution work order allocation and priority ordering; the system comprises a fairness monitoring module, a bias analysis module, an agent optimizing module, a collaborative scheduling and auditing module, a collaborative scheduling system and a scheduling process recording module, wherein the fairness monitoring module is used for defining and monitoring fairness indexes, the bias analysis module is used for analyzing attention patterns in scheduling decisions, identifying potential bias characteristics related to changes of the fairness indexes and quantifying the influence of the potential bias characteristics on the fairness of the scheduling, the agent optimizing module is used for optimizing the scheduling agents, the collaborative scheduling and auditing module is used for constructing a collaborative scheduling system and recording scheduling processes to form auditable logs, and the original opaque deep reinforcement learning decision process is made understandable by integrating the interpretable artificial intelligent module, so that the transparency of the scheduling decisions is improved.
assignees: JIANGSU HUIZHI INTELLIGENT DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy micro-grid point-to-point energy scheduling method, device, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a device, equipment and a medium for dispatching point-to-point energy sources of a multi-energy micro-grid, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-energy micro-grid optimization model containing electric, gas and heat energy sources according to network coupling constraint, equipment characteristic constraint and dispatching operation constraint of an energy micro-grid, carrying out distributed iterative solution on the multi-energy micro-grid optimization model by adopting an alternating direction multiplication algorithm to obtain P2P energy exchange quantity among micro-grids, calculating P2P energy exchange price by adopting a lubine bargaining RBS strategy based on the P2P energy exchange quantity to obtain an excitation signal of micro-grid energy exchange, and obtaining a comprehensive dispatching scheme of the micro-grid according to the P2P energy exchange quantity and the excitation signal. The invention can perform multi-energy coordination, ensure information safety and improve interaction fairness and resource utilization rate.

title_en: Endocrine nursing teaching decision-making system based on deep learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and provides an endocrine care teaching decision system based on deep learning, which comprises a data acquisition module, a data preprocessing module, a feature extraction module, a teaching evaluation module and a teaching decision module, wherein the teaching evaluation module introduces a fair constraint dual-BiGRU model, improves consistency and stability of teaching evaluation among different student groups through a subgroup division and fairness constraint mechanism, the teaching decision module introduces a risk perception D3QN model, builds a risk sensitive Q value function, performs segmentation weighting on teaching action return by combining a static spectrum risk measurement mechanism, optimizes decision capability and risk regulation capability of a strategy network, is particularly suitable for complex medical teaching scenes such as endocrine care, and has good fairness, self-adaptability and practicability.

title_en: Railway emergency material scheduling optimization method based on distributed system architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a railway emergency material dispatching optimization method based on a distributed system architecture, which comprises the following steps of obtaining disaster condition multi-dimensional information, predicting emergency material demands, obtaining the demand quantity of emergency materials at each disaster point, using shortest path rules to draw out initial dispatching paths of the emergency materials at each disaster point, updating disaster condition evolution information collected according to big data to obtain final dispatching paths, constructing a multi-objective emergency material dispatching optimization model, respectively solving the perception of the disaster people on risks and the unevenness of the emergency material dispatching at each disaster point, carrying out directional distribution according to solving results, carrying out satisfaction evaluation, updating the demand quantity and the dispatching paths if a preset satisfaction value is not reached, and carrying out model solving until the preset satisfaction value is reached. The invention shortens the response time of resource scheduling, optimizes the fairness of material scheduling, and ensures that the scheduling process of emergency materials is more scientific and effective.
assignees: UNIV BEIHANG;CHINA STATE RAILWAY GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Online collaborative task distribution system for digital media
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital media online collaborative task distribution system, which belongs to the technical field of digital media and comprises an input storage module, a task demand analysis module, a task personnel screening module and a task distribution module, wherein the input storage module is responsible for collecting storage members and task information, the task demand analysis module calculates personnel scheduling values according to task difficulty, urgency and error rate to determine the number of personnel required by each subtask, the task personnel screening module obtains personnel selection scoring values according to personnel task average consumption, task quality scoring and task light load values to screen out acknowledgement personnel, the task distribution module divides the subtasks into sub-skill tasks, distributes the sub-skill tasks according to the acknowledgement personnel technical task adaptation and the sub-skill task priority and dynamically adjusts the sub-skill tasks after distribution, the problems of low efficiency, lack of fairness and the like of traditional task distribution are solved, manpower resources can be scientifically allocated, the task completion quality and efficiency are improved, and fair and reasonable task distribution is realized.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging process optimization scheduling method based on queue theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses an electric automobile charging process optimization scheduling method based on a queue theory. The charging process of the electric automobile is divided into an input process, a queuing process and a service process, and when the electric automobile is connected into a power grid according to the probability of discrete poisson distribution, the electric automobile enters the queuing process. When the number of electric vehicles connected to the power grid is not large or the power grid load is low, the electric vehicles can be directly charged without waiting, and when the number of electric vehicles connected to the power grid is large or the power grid load is at a peak value, the available power grid power resources are limited, and queuing waiting is needed. According to the invention, the queuing process is optimized, so that the efficiency and fairness of the charging process of the electric vehicle can be effectively considered, and the queuing length and waiting time of the electric vehicle at the charging station can be greatly reduced.

title_en: Knowledge graph-based environment equity asset management method and device
abstract_en: The application provides an environmental equity asset management method and device based on a knowledge graph, wherein the method comprises the steps of determining a first target node associated with a target user in the knowledge graph related to the environmental equity asset according to first information of the target user, obtaining environmental equity asset data associated with the target user according to a second target node connected with the first target node in the knowledge graph and attribute information of edges between the first target node and the second target node, inputting the environmental equity asset data into an asset evaluation model to obtain an evaluation result output by the asset evaluation model on the current environmental equity asset of the target user, and generating an asset management strategy of the target user according to the evaluation result. Therefore, the method can be combined with a knowledge graph and a machine learning model to dynamically evaluate and accurately predict the value and risk of the environmental equity asset, can provide advice of asset management optimization, and is beneficial to improving the efficiency and income of asset management.
assignees: HUANENG ZHAOCAI DIGITAL TECH CO LTD;BEIJING HUANENG CHANGJIANG ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;BEIJING YIQING NENGHUAN TECH CO LTD

title_en: Elevator operation control method and system based on optimized elevator operation strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of elevator operation, in particular to an elevator operation control method and system based on an optimized elevator operation strategy. An elevator operation control system based on an optimized elevator operation strategy comprises a call request information acquisition module, an elevator operation task management module, an elevator agent game module, a task sequence updating module and an elevator operation strategy execution module. The method and the system realize request priority ordering through task value weighted evaluation, can improve response sensitivity of a dispatching system to key requests, optimize resource allocation sequence, ensure service fairness and timeliness of users at different floors in peak periods, carry out disturbance value game analysis on target tasks through a plurality of elevator agents, execute the target tasks by optimizing an elevator with the least disturbance, and ensure that task insertion has the least influence on the original path, thereby improving overall dispatching efficiency and path utilization rate.

title_en: Multi-star task scheduling method and system based on uniform revisit routine and emergency observation integration
abstract_en: The invention provides a multi-star task scheduling method and system based on uniform revisit routine and emergency observation integration, and belongs to the technical field of remote sensing satellite task planning and autonomous scheduling. The method comprises the steps of dividing a ground area into a plurality of observation grids based on orbit parameters and imaging parameters of remote sensing satellites, traversing an orbit time sequence of each satellite under a unified time axis, dynamically planning conventional observation tasks of each satellite according to satellite point positions and grid observation marks, carrying out emergency observation task rescheduling according to the conventional observation tasks of the current satellites when an emergency observation request of a specific area is received, and obtaining a satellite joint scheduling plan containing the conventional observation tasks and the emergency observation tasks. The invention has the advantages of high scheduling fairness, controllable gesture adjustment, high response speed and the like, and is suitable for the high-efficiency task joint scheduling scene of the large-scale low-orbit remote sensing constellation under the conventional and emergency states.
assignees: SHANGHAI WEICHUANG LISHIKONG INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Sport production selection method and platform based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of performance prediction, in particular to a sports production and pulling method and platform based on artificial intelligence, comprising the following steps: based on the game score, skill score and training data of the athlete, the athlete is arranged and summarized into structural information, the structural information is subjected to data cleaning and structural processing, information nodes are constructed, and an athlete capability knowledge graph is generated. According to the invention, the organization and visualization of data are enhanced by constructing the knowledge graph, so that the performance data and skill scores of athletes are intuitively displayed, the organization and visualization of the data are enhanced, a training team and a pulling person can conveniently and quickly grasp the comprehensive capacity and potential of the athletes, the efficiency and accuracy of data processing are improved through the structural processing of the athlete data, the improvement of decision logic is realized, a prediction model is optimized, the support is provided for pulling excellent athletes by a training team, and the fairness and the high efficiency of pulling are ensured.
assignees: GUAGNZHOU HUAXIA HUIHAI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Monitoring system and method for preventing power station from flooding based on Internet
abstract_en: The invention discloses a monitoring system and a method for preventing a power station from flooding based on the Internet, which relate to the technical field of power station management, the intelligent water regime prediction system comprises an intelligent water regime prediction module, an intelligent drainage optimization control module, an underwater perception network module, an environment collaborative perception module, an automatic facility protection module, an abnormal event instant alarm module and a community linkage emergency response module. The monitoring system and the method for preventing the power station from flooding on the basis of the Internet overcome the defects of the prior art by integrating the technologies of intelligent water regime prediction, real-time drainage optimization, underwater perception network and the like, realize the multi-dimension of data perception, the dynamics of prediction analysis and the intellectualization of protective measures, not only remarkably improve the monitoring precision and the response efficiency of complex hydrologic events, but also enhance the transparency and fairness of resource scheduling through a cooperative network based on a block chain, and provide a comprehensive and efficient protection solution for the power station and surrounding communities.
assignees: THREE GORGES JINSHA JIANGCHUAN CLOUD HYDROPOWER DEV CO LTD

title_en: Campus duty task self-adaptive scheduling system and method based on multi-source data
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of multi-source data processing, in particular to a campus duty task self-adaptive scheduling system and method based on multi-source data, which can analyze the consulting timeliness of different users on transmitted duty information, can realize the conflict with personal time arrangement of most users at regular intervals, can cause the users to initiate the duty shift of relay application to monitor, and prompt that people are uniformly shifted on the duty shift when shifting, so that the generated duty shift keeps certain fairness and avoids individual staff from bearing unpopular shifts for a long time; furthermore, on the premise of considering the timeliness of each user for consulting the on-duty information, after the on-duty adjustment occurs in response to relay application, the application can carry out early warning judgment on the possibility that whether partial related personnel can occur or not, which is caused by the failure of consulting the notification information in time, so that the normal execution of the on-duty work is influenced.

title_en: Multi-source data fusion carbon emission on-line monitoring and quota allocation control method and device
abstract_en: The invention discloses a control method and a device for on-line monitoring and quota allocation of carbon emission of multi-source data fusion, and relates to the technical field of carbon emission monitoring and quota management, comprising the following steps of calculating comprehensive scores of carbon emission intensity of all process units through a comprehensive score model based on multi-source data, and constructing an urgency mapping function to convert the comprehensive scores to obtain carbon emission urgency of all process units; the carbon quota is primarily allocated according to the carbon emission urgency, the carbon quota demand condition of each unit is calculated, a quota allocation optimization model is built based on the carbon quota demand condition, and the optimization model is solved to obtain the final quota borrowing amount and the carbon quota of each unit. The invention is used for solving the problems that the subjectivity of the existing carbon emission quota allocation is strong, and fairness and efficiency are difficult to be considered.

title_en: Task equity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a task equity distribution method and device, electronic equipment and a storage medium, belongs to the technical field of artificial intelligence, and is suitable for financial science and technology business scenes and medical science and technology business scenes. The method comprises the steps of predicting task efficiency based on historical task data to obtain predicted task efficiency data, obtaining target task progress of a target user, predicting task achievement of the target task progress according to the predicted task efficiency data to obtain target task achievement conditions of the target user, screening target equity distribution strategies from candidate equity distribution strategies according to the target task achievement conditions, and distributing equity to the target user based on candidate equity information of the target equity distribution strategies. According to the embodiment of the application, the candidate equity information based on the target equity allocation strategy is used for allocating equity for the target user, and corresponding equity information can be allocated according to the actual task completion condition of the user, so that the reasonability of task equity information allocation is ensured.
assignees: PING AN HEALTH INSURANCE CO LTD

title_en: Virtual equity operation visual monitoring platform based on digital twinning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a virtual equity operation visual monitoring platform based on digital twinning, which dynamically maps real-time states, historical circulation records and business indexes of virtual equity through a digital twinning model, realizes millisecond synchronization of physical and virtual worlds, eliminates monitoring delay, builds a circulation path diagram, supports dynamic backtracking and abnormal path identification, rapidly positions problem nodes, and a virtual equity state calculation unit calculates operation states in real time based on a comprehensive evaluation formula, dynamically generates strategy suggestions, optimizes issuing strategies by monitoring inventory, holding capacity and circulation efficiency, reduces expiration rate and resource waste, and the visual monitoring module displays global states in real time, reduces manual statistics workload, supports interactive screening and drilling, improves analysis efficiency.

title_en: Chemical laboratory equipment whole-flow management method and system
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of experimental equipment management and provides a method and a system for managing the whole process of chemical laboratory equipment, comprising the following steps of receiving an experimental equipment application form, analyzing the experimental equipment application form to determine experimental projects, applicant, application equipment sequences and urgency; the method comprises the steps of receiving an audit passing instruction, entering a queuing mode through a corresponding experimental equipment application form, calling all experimental equipment application forms at each interval set time value, calculating the earliest available time of all experimental equipment in a laboratory, calculating the time concentration degree of the application equipment corresponding to each experimental equipment application form according to the earliest available time, calling the queuing time and the emergency degree of each experimental equipment application form, and distributing the experimental equipment to the experimental equipment application form based on the time concentration degree, the queuing time and the emergency degree. The invention comprehensively considers the factors of time concentration, queuing time and urgency, and realizes the quantitative balance of efficiency and fairness through dynamic adjustment.

title_en: Method of distributing revenue through the equity division of the transport space using the space division of the transport container for ship or air transportation
title_ko: 선박 또는 항공 운송을 위한 수송 용기의 공간 분할을 이용한 운송 공간의 지분 분할을 통한 수익 분배 방법
abstract_en: According to the present invention, a method for distributing profits through equity division of a transport space using space division of a transport container for ship or air transport comprises the steps of: receiving investment according to the use of each transport container from a plurality of investors; equity division of the transport space of the transport container in response to the determined investment stake; and allocating the equity-divided transport space to each investor, and utilizing the allocated space to allow each investor to ship imports or exports and use them for ship or air transport.
abstract_ko: 본 발명에 따른 선박 또는 항공 운송을 위한 수송 용기의 공간 분할을 이용한 운송 공간의 지분 분할을 통한 수익 분배 방법은, 각 수송 용기의 사용에 따른 투자금을 다수의 투자자들로부터 받는 단계, 결정된 투자 지분에 대응하여 수송 용기의 운송 공간을 지분 분할하는 단계 및 지분 분할된 운송 공간을 각 투자자에 할당하고, 할당된 공간을 활용하여 각 투자자들이 수입품 또는 수출품을 선적하여 선박 또는 항공 운송에 사용할 수 있게 하는 단계를 포함한다.

title_en: Intelligent port operation vehicle dispatching system and dispatching robot
abstract_en: The invention discloses a scheduling system and a scheduling robot for an intelligent port operation vehicle, and relates to the technical field of intelligent port operation. The method aims at solving the problems that in the traditional port vehicle dispatching, the manual dispatching response is slow, the error rate is high, the resource allocation is uneven, the labor cost is too high, and the high-efficiency and intelligent requirements of modern ports are difficult to meet; according to the invention, the idle load distance of the vehicle is reduced by utilizing the bipartite graph matching strategy, the overload rate is improved, the predictive scheduling module is planned in advance, the backlog of the task and the idle of the vehicle are reduced, the operation efficiency is effectively improved, the constraint processing module optimizes the task distribution according to the task and the vehicle condition, the multi-objective optimizing module optimizes the task distribution and the dispatch fairness, so that the resource distribution is more reasonable, the scheduling robot integrated system function, the intelligent scheduling can be adapted to different operation environments through continuous optimization of the acquired data and the online learning technology, the scheduling accuracy and efficiency are improved, the labor cost is reduced, and the port overall competitiveness is improved.

title_en: Intelligent multidimensional evaluation analysis and decision method based on big data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent evaluation, and provides an intelligent multidimensional evaluation analysis and decision method based on big data, the method comprises the steps of obtaining original evaluation data from a multi-source heterogeneous data interface, and generating a space-time associated data set through fusion of semantic role labeling and a time stamp alignment algorithm. And performing multi-level cleaning to generate a high-confidence rating data set. And extracting multi-dimensional indexes based on the domain knowledge graph, generating a dynamic characteristic tensor, and dynamically distributing weights by adopting a coupling attenuation weight model. And constructing a bidder association network, calculating a node influence score, detecting potential bidder ring behaviors and generating a risk correction coefficient. And injecting the real-time data stream into the dynamic characteristic tensor, updating the index weight, and generating a three-dimensional scoring vector through a multi-objective aggregation decision algorithm. And performing pareto optimization by using the asymmetric game balancing model, and outputting an optimal winning-winning sequence and a risk early warning report. The invention can improve the bid evaluation efficiency and fairness and reduce bid-recruitment risk.

title_en: Multi-agent reinforcement learning-based multi-mode intermodal route selection method
abstract_en: The application relates to a multi-agent reinforcement learning-based multi-mode intermodal route selection method. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-agent intermodal transportation network and a system environment, carrying out initial planning by adopting a self-adaptive large neighborhood search algorithm based on the multi-agent intermodal transportation network and the system environment, acquiring accident information when an accident occurs, optimizing the initial planning by adopting a multi-agent reinforcement learning algorithm based on the accident information and a cost objective function to obtain an accident action decision, and carrying out transportation tasks based on the accident action decision. By constructing a large neighborhood disturbance response mechanism fused with ALNS, when the node/path service time deviation is detected to exceed a threshold value, the intelligent trigger path reconstruction is performed, a new alternative path is generated, based on a MADDPG multi-Agent reinforcement learning framework, each carrier Agent can obtain global information in centralized training, independent decision is made in execution, and the utilization efficiency of transportation resources and the task allocation fairness are effectively improved.

title_en: Optimal unit combination method based on large-scale power grid load
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optimal unit combination method based on large-scale power grid load, which relates to the technical field of power dispatching and solves the problems of energy consumption reduction and cost control by not fully considering the combination conditions of different generator sets, and the invention precisely determines the power intervals to be regulated associated with different characteristic time periods by the method on the power supply allocation layer, so that the power scale required to be supplemented can be clearly known when the power requirements of different time periods are faced, thereby reasonably arranging the generator sets to supplement the power; the power supply system ensures the stability and reliability of power supply while meeting the power demand, avoids the condition of insufficient power supply or excessive power supply caused by improper power allocation, and forcefully maintains the stable operation of a power grid.
assignees: HEFEI TIANYING TECH CO LTD;FUYANG POWER SUPPLY COMPANY STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Task allocation method and system based on hybrid dynamic strategy
abstract_en: The invention relates to a task allocation method and a task allocation system based on a hybrid dynamic strategy, wherein the task allocation method comprises the steps of dividing a working area of an agent into K sub-areas, combining task points belonging to the same sub-area in a current order to obtain a task set to be allocated, calculating execution time cost of the agent to be allocated according to current state information of the agent, predicting area density prediction cost of the agent to be allocated when the agent is executed according to the current state information of the agent, calculating total bid cost of the agent to be allocated according to the execution time cost of the agent to be allocated and the area density prediction cost of the agent to be allocated when the agent is executed, and allocating the task to be allocated in the task set to be allocated to each agent by taking the minimum total bid cost of the agent to be allocated as a target. The invention can ensure fairness and stability of task allocation in a dynamic execution environment, and effectively avoid phenomena of resource waste and uneven load.

title_en: Community education resource scheduling system based on multidimensional demand matching
abstract_en: The invention discloses a community education resource scheduling system based on multidimensional demand matching, which particularly relates to the field of education resource management, and comprises a disturbance construction module, an acquisition module, an extraction module, an evaluation module and a scheduling module; the disturbance construction module is used for constructing a disturbance task sequence of the target course, wherein the disturbance task sequence is composed of a plurality of disturbance tasks, and each disturbance task comprises task content, random excitation parameters and task trigger time of the target course. By constructing disturbance task induced behavior reaction, extracting behavior characteristics and combining with a motivation offset evaluation function, the recognition of pseudo learning behaviors and the dynamic adjustment of scheduling priority are realized, so that the long-term occupation of high-value education resources by non-real demand users is restrained, and the authenticity of the education resource allocation and the fairness of system operation are improved.

title_en: Virtual power plant alliance optimal scheduling method and system based on electric carbon certificate transaction
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power system optimization scheduling, in particular to a virtual power plant alliance optimization scheduling method and system based on electric carbon evidence transaction, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a virtual power plant alliance collaborative cost minimization model considering electric energy, carbon rights and green evidence multidimensional value flows; the method comprises the steps of adopting a second special ordered set to precisely linearize the ladder-type carbon price, constructing a dynamic internal collaborative green license conversion mechanism, defining electric energy transaction quantity, carbon transaction quantity and green license transaction quantity for each virtual power plant to form a multi-commodity internal market with electricity, carbon and green license coupled, adopting an asynchronous self-adaptive alternating direction multiplier method to carry out distributed solution on the inside of the alliance, and based on a collaborative game theory, fairly distributing collaborative surplus according to contribution indexes of all alliance members. The invention can obviously reduce the total operation cost and carbon emission of the virtual power plant alliance by constructing the multidimensional value flow cooperative model and the equity cost allocation mechanism, and simultaneously ensure the cost allocation fairness to maintain the alliance stable.

title_en: Service personnel clock setting optimization method and system based on data driving
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of manual service operation management, in particular to a service personnel clock setting optimization method and system based on data driving. The method comprises the steps of obtaining clock-up data of a history service person, carrying out clock-up feature extraction according to the clock-up data of the history service person to obtain clock-up feature data, carrying out clock-down same-frequency processing according to the clock-up feature data to obtain clock-down same-frequency data, carrying out clock-arranging conflict processing according to the clock-down same-frequency data to obtain clock-arranging conflict data, carrying out clock-arranging order disturbance according to the clock-arranging conflict data to obtain clock-arranging disturbance data, carrying out cooling window control according to the clock-arranging disturbance data to obtain cooling window data, and carrying out dispersion degree processing on the clock-arranging disturbance data according to the cooling window data to obtain clock-arranging optimization data. The invention realizes the dynamic perception and intelligent optimization of the service personnel clock arranging process. Compared with the traditional static shift arrangement mode, the method can effectively relieve resource conflict and improve service continuity and fairness.
assignees: CHANGSHA TIMES BEAT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Public service facility layout evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating public service facility layout, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting multi-source space data in a research area, cleaning, standardizing and space matching the data, drawing a public service facility distribution diagram based on the public service facility data to obtain the space distribution of public service facilities, analyzing the current situation coverage situation of the public service facilities based on a network analysis method, calculating the public service comprehensive score of a living unit, and statistically analyzing to give a space site selection suggestion of public service setting according to the space distribution of the public service facilities, the current situation coverage situation of the public service facilities and the public service comprehensive score of the living unit. According to the invention, the traditional public service accessibility analysis is improved from the street or community scale to the living unit scale, so that the analysis is more refined, various factors are introduced to evaluate the accessibility of public service facilities, and the fairness of accessibility evaluation is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN ZONDY SOFTWARE ENG CO LTD

title_en: Multi-energy system supply and demand collaborative planning method based on consumer psychology
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of energy supply and demand analysis, in particular to a multi-energy system supply and demand collaborative planning method based on consumer psychology, which comprises the following steps of firstly, establishing demand response modeling based on consumer psychology; and step three, performing Nash game fair transaction optimization based on the Nash game theory. The method comprises the steps of establishing a consumer psychological demand response uncertainty model, describing response behaviors of consumers through piecewise linear functions, accurately capturing uncertainty of flexible energy demand capacity, comprehensively considering configuration and operation constraint of various energy technologies such as photovoltaic power generation, cogeneration and the like, constructing a multi-energy system design and operation optimization model covering electric power, heat supply and cold supply, adopting a Nash game theory to ensure balance of benefits of both supply and demand parties, and ensuring fairness and sustainability of energy transaction.

title_en: Dynamic load triggering-based seamless supply method for disaster relief materials of dog clusters of autonomous fire extinguishing machine
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic load triggering-based seamless replenishment method for disaster relief materials of an autonomous fire-extinguishing machine dog cluster, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-resource health degree model, dividing the machine dog resources into core output resources, auxiliary output resources and action survival resources, calculating the health degree of each type of resources through weighting, adjusting resource weight coefficients in real time according to fire levels and wearing parts life, defining a multi-level threshold triggering mechanism, dynamically calculating thresholds according to core output resource triggering, action survival resource triggering and auxiliary output resource triggering, triggering replenishment demands in advance by combining fire change rates and environmental temperature, fusing resource health degree gaps and replenishment station distance penalty items to generate individual priorities of the machine dog, dynamically distributing replenishment tasks according to the priorities, and avoiding replenishment station congestion through a two-level load balancing strategy.
assignees: HANGZHOU DIANZI UNIVERSTIY INFORMATION ENG SCHOOL

title_en: Carbon emission accounting method, system, equipment and medium for accounting carbon emission distribution in transaction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon emission accounting method, a system, equipment and a medium for carbon emission distribution in transactions, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining an original carbon emission active set; the method comprises the steps of screening an original carbon emission active set to obtain a carbon emission active set, dividing carbon emission activities in the carbon emission active set to obtain a division result, calculating carbon emission quantity of the carbon emission activities based on the division result, and carrying out responsibility allocation on the carbon emission quantity through an allocation model to obtain the carbon emission quantity of both transaction parties. According to the invention, the flexible adjustable allocation coefficient is introduced to construct the bidirectional responsibility allocation model, so that the production end and the consumption end fairly bear carbon emission responsibility in the transaction in proportion, the problem of repeated calculation of the same carbon emission by the production end and the consumption end in traditional calculation is avoided, the fairness, accuracy and executable of carbon emission calculation are improved, and scientific support is provided for standardized operation of a carbon trade market.

title_en: China electric power industry carbon quota allocation method considering inter-generation fairness and inter-province fairness
abstract_en: The invention discloses a carbon quota allocation method for the power industry of China, which takes the inter-generation and inter-provincial fairness into consideration, and comprises the steps of acquiring carbon emission data of the power industry of the past year and the national carbon emission data of the past year; based on the generation-based emission reduction model, predicting the carbon emission of the power industry in the t year according to the national carbon emission data of the past year and the carbon emission data of the power industry of the past year, multiplying the carbon emission of the power industry in the t year by the adjusted accumulated carbon intensity of the power industry in the set area, and obtaining the carbon quota of the power industry in the t year corresponding to the set area. The invention realizes cross-generation carbon quota upper limit setting, introduces a carbon transfer responsibility adjustment mechanism based on regional power dispatching, effectively relieves the problem of carbon responsibility imbalance caused by power cross-regional dispatching, and simultaneously quantifies the emission reduction economic cost of each period and each region, thereby providing a data basis for carbon regulation.

title_en: Method and device for deciding cross-region river water flow distribution with balanced fairness and stability
abstract_en: The invention discloses a decision method and a decision device for cross-regional river water flow distribution with balanced fairness and stability, which comprise the steps of obtaining basic information data of cross-regional river water flow distribution, adopting a bankruptcy theory rule to generate a plurality of water distribution schemes, each water distribution scheme comprises water resource shares corresponding to each regional main body respectively, respectively obtaining fairness indexes and stability indexes of each water distribution scheme based on a base index and a Charpy-Shu Bike power index, adopting a game theory method to generate a combined index of the fairness indexes and the stability indexes of each water distribution scheme, and sequencing all water distribution schemes based on the combined index to obtain an optimal water distribution scheme. On the basis of the principles of quantized fairness and stability, the method adopts a game theory method to aggregate the two, and provides a practical and feasible water allocation strategy for solving the cross-region river water allocation conflict under the water shortage situation.

title_en: Shared bicycle scheduling optimization method considering bicycle allocation fairness among areas
abstract_en: The invention discloses a shared bicycle scheduling optimization method considering fairness of bicycle allocation among areas, which comprises the steps of 1 setting an operation period set, an area set and parameters and variables related to a shared bicycle deterministic scheduling optimization model of a free floating shared bicycle system, 2 establishing the shared bicycle deterministic scheduling model, 3 establishing the shared bicycle uncertainty scheduling model under the condition of considering random demands, 4 reconstructing the shared bicycle uncertainty scheduling model based on a strong dual principle of second order cone planning, and 5 solving the reconstructed shared bicycle uncertainty scheduling model by utilizing a binary search algorithm to obtain a scheduling optimization result. The invention can realize fairness of bicycle distribution among areas, ensure that the demands of users in each area are fairly met, and simultaneously, consider the uncertainty of the demands in an important way, enhance the adaptability and the robustness of a dispatching scheme, thereby reducing the waste of shared bicycle resources and improving the service quality of a shared bicycle system.

title_en: Cross-regional frequency modulation clearing method and device
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric auxiliary service, in particular to a cross-region frequency modulation clearing method and equipment, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing a frequency modulation mutual aid objective function aiming at a plurality of regions in a region; aiming at the region needing to be supported with frequency modulation resources, determining the frequency modulation capacity requirement of the region based on a unified load prediction result, determining the frequency modulation capacity gap of the region based on the sum of standard frequency modulation capacity and frequency modulation capacity requirement of the regional schedulable frequency modulation resources, constructing a cost calculation model and a fairness loss function of actual frequency modulation service, and a local resource guarantee proportion target value, and determining the optimal scheme of cross-region frequency modulation resource scheduling based on the local resource guarantee proportion target value and the frequency modulation capacity gap through the cost calculation model, the fairness loss function and a frequency modulation mutual aid objective function. Therefore, on the premise of ensuring the frequency modulation capacity requirement of the system, the optimal allocation of resources and balance of regional interests can be realized according to different scene requirements.
assignees: CENTRAL CHINA BRANCH STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Multi-dimensional dynamic elastic identification method and system for key coupling nodes of power distribution information physical system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent power grids, in particular to a multidimensional dynamic elastic identification method and system for key coupling nodes of a power distribution information physical system, wherein the system comprises a key node screening unit, a unified CPDS model is constructed, and a candidate key node set is primarily screened based on structural controllability and structural observability; the invention provides a novel CPDS key coupling node precise identification method for integrating structure controllability, structure observability, dynamic fuzzy disaster scenes, reverse reinforcement learning and shape value comprehensive calculation, which is used for improving the accuracy, fairness and adaptability of system elasticity analysis and decision making and improving the quick response and recovery capability of a power grid to disasters or attack disturbance.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;TIANSHUI POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER COMPANY;STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Emergency rescue resource scheduling dynamic planning method for post-disaster wounded evacuation
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency rescue resource scheduling dynamic planning method for evacuation of wounded persons after disaster, which particularly relates to the technical field of emergency rescue, and is based on a preset disaster area rescue environment, wherein the method divides the wounded evacuation rescue process into multi-stage calculation of deprivation cost of each stage by setting tent and service constraint, keeping wounded circulation and conservation, ambulance scheduling constraint, treatment of non-rescue wounded persons and hospitals and setting decision variable types, and introducing deprivation cost, including deprivation cost of heavy wounded persons, total deprivation cost of each wounded person and total deprivation cost of all wounded persons; the total deprivation cost of all wounded persons is combined with the moving cost of the medical rescue tent, the transportation cost of the ambulance, the penalty cost of the wounded persons not being cured, i.e. the total cost of the whole emergency rescue is minimized.

title_en: Block chain energy optimization method, device, equipment, medium and computer program product
abstract_en: The present application relates to a blockchain energy optimization method, apparatus, device, medium and computer program product. The method comprises the steps of obtaining alternative energy data, establishing an evaluation criterion corresponding to the alternative energy data, respectively establishing a weighted sum model, a risk aversion decision model and a fairness criterion weight model according to the alternative energy data and the evaluation criterion, establishing a multi-objective comprehensive optimization model according to the weighted sum model, the risk aversion decision model and the fairness criterion weight model, and determining an energy decision scheme of a current blockchain through the multi-objective comprehensive optimization model. By adopting the method, the block chain energy optimization efficiency can be improved, and the robustness, fairness and optimization efficiency can be considered.

title_en: Internal span type tire crane instruction scheduling method based on multidimensional dynamic priority and predictive scheduling
abstract_en: The invention discloses an internal cross tire crane instruction scheduling method based on multidimensional dynamic priority and predictive scheduling, which comprises the following steps of S1, S2, opportunistic overtaking window evaluation, S3, nonlinear dynamic sequencing of conventional instructions, and S4, instruction issuing and rescheduling. The invention quantifies and decides whether to execute the overtaking instruction with higher net benefit through the opportunistic overtaking window evaluation so as to improve the operation efficiency, ensures that the priority of the instruction waiting for a long time can be systematically improved by introducing the instruction waiting time length factor with exponential growth characteristic and the maximum tolerance threshold so as to ensure the dispatching fairness, and reduces the instruction priority of the congestion area through the local congestion factor so as to achieve the effect of relieving the traffic bottleneck.
assignees: NANJING PORT LONGTAN CONTAINER CO LTD

title_en: Social equity renewable energy credit datastructures and distributed generation engine apparatuses, processes and systems
abstract_en: A system and method for energy social equity allocation using at least one memory, and at least one processor configured to issue a plurality of processor-executable instructions to obtain an energy equity participation request data structure for the benefit of an underserved community, a site data structure from an energy production site, and a purchaser request data structure from an energy consumption site. The system and method further aggregate low amounts of energy generation from multiple sites into a larger saleable quantity for a purchaser and manages the transfer of power over an electrical grid. Payment for the energy is used to provide community apportionment values to requesting communities.

title_en: Multi-terminal cooperative wage resource intelligent distribution method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent medical dispatching, in particular to a multi-terminal cooperative wage resource intelligent distribution method, which comprises the steps of firstly collecting positioning, road, nursing physiology and old man demand data and generating multi-mode standardized data; the method comprises the steps of constructing a three-dimensional digital twin potential field, constructing a matching model by utilizing photon prediction to correct the potential field, constructing a correction potential field, a protection capability vector and an old man demand vector, performing annealing optimization to obtain initial matching, constructing a protection-old man-period trisection diagram based on a matching result, performing tension diffusion and gradient projection iteration to obtain optimal matching, performing double digital signatures on each matching, casting a non-homogeneous promise in a blockchain to realize credible performance, continuously outputting fatigue probability by a wearing-end pulse neural network, mapping the fatigue probability into a potential energy increment write-back potential field, triggering sub potential field re-decomposition, zero knowledge shift and closed-loop updating. The method and the system improve scheduling instantaneity and fairness, reduce fatigue risk and ensure service whole-course traceability.
assignees: HANGZHOU YUANJIE ENVIRONMENTAL PROTECTION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic priority grouping and intelligent arrangement system for events
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic athletic and data processing and discloses an event dynamic priority grouping and intelligent arrangement system which comprises an event twinning body construction module, a dynamic narrative potential field generation module, an intelligent arrangement decision module and a narrative intervention module, wherein the event twinning body construction module is used for aggregating multi-mode data in real time to construct an event panoramic digital mirror image, the dynamic narrative potential field generation module is used for quantifying and modeling multi-dimensional narrative values such as 'cold explosion', 'old enemy' of all potential pairs in the future based on the event twinning body data, the intelligent arrangement decision module takes event states and the narrative potential fields as inputs, takes the maximum athletic fairness, audience participation and the narrative values as targets through an enhanced learning algorithm, and the narrative intervention module is used for generating an executable operation strategy to actively promote the attractiveness of an event by analyzing potential field gradient identification. The invention enables the system to continuously self-optimize through the closed loop design of 'intervention-feedback-enhancement', and obviously improves the ornamental value and commercial value of the event.
assignees: XIAN JINGFA CHENGYUN CULTURE AND SPORTS IND CO LTD

title_en: Resource allocation method of non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm containing heuristic information
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of space resource allocation of relocation optimization of old urban areas, in particular to a resource allocation method of a non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm containing heuristic information. The method comprises the steps of obtaining a comprehensive living quality score of a current land block, selecting candidate migration land blocks, calculating compensation amount of each candidate migration land block, constructing a multi-target migration optimization model comprising the compensation amount, introducing heuristic information to correct decision variables, solving the multi-target migration model by using a non-dominant sorting genetic algorithm, and calculating the final migration land block. The invention designs the candidate migration plots and the migration compensation strategy based on the plot comprehensive scoring difference, and ensures the fairness and acceptability of migration. Meanwhile, by introducing a non-dominant ordering genetic algorithm containing heuristic information, the multi-objective intelligent relocation optimization model is solved, and high-quality solutions can be effectively searched under the condition that the dimension and the search range of the solution are remarkably reduced.

title_en: Method and device for automatically distributing bill tasks, storage medium and server
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a method and a device for automatically distributing bill tasks, a storage medium and a server, and relates to the field of financial processing. According to the method, a bill task pool is traversed at task allocation time, bill types and associated operator lists with processing authorities are extracted, and after the current bill types and user lists are selected according to a preset sequence, matching tasks are screened to generate a set to be allocated. And calculating a weighted average value of the total to-do amount and the task amount to be distributed based on the number of to-do receipts of each operator in the current user list, and determining a dynamic distribution threshold. And in the distribution process, sequentially distributing tasks to be distributed to operators in the user list until the to-do amount of each operator reaches the upper limit of the threshold value. The application not only avoids the static stiffness defect of the traditional automatic dispatch, but also overcomes the fairness missing problem of manual robbing, ensures the load balance of high-efficiency staff and low-efficiency staff, and simultaneously improves the timeliness of task processing and the overall throughput of the system.

title_en: Fresh product periodic distribution scheduling method considering customer service fairness
abstract_en: The invention relates to a periodic fresh product distribution scheduling method considering customer service fairness, and belongs to the technical field of logistics distribution scheduling optimization. The method comprises the steps of initializing delivery vehicle data, delivery driver sets and customer sets in a delivery area, constructing a delivery network diagram by taking a delivery center and customer positions as nodes, constructing a customer perception satisfaction evaluation index system, obtaining scores of evaluation indexes of different receiving time periods, calculating comprehensive perception satisfaction scores corresponding to the receiving time periods, establishing customer service fairness indexes based on the comprehensive perception satisfaction scores of the receiving time periods, establishing a fresh product periodic delivery scheduling model with minimum delivery total energy consumption and maximum customer service fairness as targets, and adopting a genetic algorithm to calculate a fresh product periodic delivery scheduling scheme. The invention can generate a reasonable and economic distribution path scheme, effectively optimize the energy consumption cost of the distribution process and balance the fairness of customer service.

title_en: Automatic driving vehicle dispatching system for signalless intersection based on game optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent dispatching method and system for an automatic driving vehicle without a signalized intersection, and belongs to the technical field of automatic driving and intelligent traffic control. Aiming at the problems of low traffic efficiency and unfair traffic of the existing signalless intersections, the invention provides a multi-vehicle cooperative scheduling method based on game theory optimization. According to the method, the state information of each vehicle is acquired through the communication of the Internet of vehicles, an optimization model which aims at minimizing the weighted maximum waiting time is constructed, and scheduling fairness and efficiency are comprehensively considered. And setting explicit safety constraint, fleet consistency constraint and global waiting time constraint, and ensuring that a scheduling result meets the requirements of safety and systematicness. Meanwhile, adjustable priority weights are given to different types of vehicles, so that differentiated dispatching control of emergency vehicles, public service vehicles and the like is realized. The method has the advantages of high interpretability, clear structure, strong adaptability and the like, and has good engineering realizability and popularization value.

title_en: Electric vehicle charging station planning and site selection method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of optimal planning and address selection of electric vehicle charging stations, and particularly relates to an electric vehicle charging station planning and address selection method, which comprises the following steps of S1, constructing an uncertainty set comprising roads and node traffic capacity loss; the method comprises the steps of combining historical travel data of vehicles to construct a travel scene set of a vehicle starting point-end point, S2, constructing a network balance model considering the fairness of arrival time of electric vehicle users to solve regional traffic flow distribution aiming at the cost difference of the transit time of the electric vehicle users on a traffic channel when the electric vehicle users go to a charging station from the starting point, S3, constructing a charging station planning model considering the fairness of the arrival time of the users based on the traffic flow distribution in S2, and determining the optimal address and capacity configuration scheme of the charging station. The invention can effectively cope with the traffic uncertainty of the traffic network section, ensure the fairness of the time for the electric automobile user to reach the charging station, and has better market application prospect.

title_en: Evaluation mechanism method of carbon emission detection index
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of evaluation of carbon emission detection indexes, in particular to an evaluation mechanism method of the carbon emission detection indexes, which comprises the following steps of constructing a three-level index system, establishing 3 first-level indexes, setting 6 second-level indexes and subdividing the three-level index system into 18 third-level indexes, monitoring index data, collecting the original data of the three-level indexes of an enterprise, including values of target year setting, energy source occupation ratio, carbon emission, energy consumption intensity and the like, performing index scoring through a comprehensive scoring method, a standardized scoring method and a quantile scoring method, calculating level scores and calculating the total score of the enterprise.
