According to the invention, three classification methods are customized according to index characteristics and embedded in MK trend test, the significant emission reduction trend is objectively identified through the statistic Z value, the traditional static evaluation device is broken through, the transverse fairness and longitudinal comparability of an evaluation result are improved, an enterprise is driven to actively optimize an emission reduction path through a dynamic scoring mechanism, and a reliable basis is provided for policy accurate regulation.
assignees: QINGDAO MENGDOU NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power carbon emission dynamic distribution method based on multistage responsibility main body
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and discloses a dynamic distribution method of electric carbon emission based on a multistage responsibility main body, which comprises the steps of firstly determining a dynamic carbon emission factor and calculating direct carbon emission based on real-time load data of a generator set; and finally, dividing the power network into multi-stage responsibility bodies, calculating regional carbon emission factors of the bodies according to the node carbon emission factors, and calculating indirect carbon emission by combining the net electricity consumption of the regional carbon emission factors, thereby realizing dynamic and accurate distribution of carbon emission responsibility. The invention solves the problems of inaccurate and unbroken responsibility allocation of the traditional accounting method, improves the accuracy and fairness of allocation through dynamic factors and multistage tracing, and provides scientific basis for guiding the emission reduction of a user side and promoting the new energy consumption.

title_en: Green electricity transaction industry chain dynamic optimization method based on multi-factor evaluation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of green electricity transaction industry chain optimization, in particular to a green electricity transaction industry chain dynamic optimization method based on multi-factor evaluation, which realizes the accurate depiction of a green electricity transaction industry chain network structure through multi-dimensional node attribute definition and bidirectional relation edge construction, and can comprehensively capture economic cooperation and implicit decision-making conduction relation among nodes in an industry chain by distinguishing quantization logic of transaction relation edge and influence edge and combining comprehensive association strength to construct a unified adjacency matrix, the invention innovatively integrates the efficiency and fairness targets into a dynamic optimization framework, achieves the cooperative balance of the improvement of the industrial chain efficiency and the fairness guarantee by scientifically designing objective functions and introducing a multi-target optimization algorithm, focuses on resource allocation and cost optimization of the efficiency targets and focuses on the accessibility and association balance of the edge nodes of the fairness targets.
assignees: GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Fairness constraint-based platform economic flow distribution control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a platform economic flow distribution control method and system based on fairness constraint, which belong to the technical field of flow distribution, and are characterized in that historical multidimensional data and real-time multidimensional data are acquired, based on the historical multidimensional data and preset fairness constraint rules, the real-time multidimensional data are calculated by using a dynamic weight distributor to obtain flow distribution weights of all resource suppliers, the current industry concentration of all the resource suppliers and a preset fusing threshold and industry concentration warning line are judged, if the current industry concentration is larger, an anti-monopoly fusing mechanism is triggered, if the current industry concentration is smaller, flow distribution is carried out according to the flow distribution weights of all the resource suppliers, the flow distribution of all the resource suppliers is timely regulated by using the dynamic weight distributor, monopoly trends can be effectively restrained, the understanding and the supervision of a platform, the resource suppliers and a supervision organization can be combined with real-time dynamics, flow distribution response is carried out, and application and popularization are facilitated.

title_en: Meat distribution method and related equipment
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application provides a meat distribution method and related equipment, belonging to the technical field of resource distribution. The method comprises the steps of obtaining current meat data, determining low-grade shops and medium-high-grade shops distribution sequences based on the to-be-distributed shops according to the current meat data, historical sorting data, shop protection data and current demand, distributing whole units of shops according to corresponding sequence sequences to obtain whole unit distribution results of the low-grade shops and the medium-high-grade shops, calculating front and rear leg scores of shops of a subdivision unit based on front and rear leg sorting data, determining low-grade shops and medium-high-grade shops subdivision distribution sequences based on front and rear leg scores and historical sorting data, and distributing the current meat data according to the low-grade and medium-high-grade shops subdivision distribution sequences to obtain the subdivision unit distribution results of the low-grade shops and the medium-high-grade shops. According to the embodiment of the application, automatic meat distribution can be realized as required, and the distribution efficiency, accuracy and fairness are improved.
assignees: GUANGZHOU QIANDAMA INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Policy reporting and auditing method based on large language model
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of large language models, in particular to a policy reporting and auditing method based on a large language model. The policy reporting auditing method based on the large language model comprises the steps of collecting policy reporting materials, converting the policy reporting materials into a text format, conducting cleaning and word segmentation processing, training and fine tuning the model by using a model based on a Transformer framework and using a marked policy reporting auditing data set, inputting the preprocessed policy reporting materials into the trained large language model, generating auditing results, conducting visual display, feeding the auditing results back to reporting enterprises, collecting feedback comments, conducting evaluation and analysis on the auditing results, and optimizing and adjusting the large language model according to the feedback comments and the evaluation results. The policy reporting auditing method based on the large language model shortens auditing time, reduces time cost and labor cost, avoids the influence of subjective factors in manual auditing, and improves the accuracy and fairness of auditing results.
assignees: TIANYUAN BIG DATA CREDIT MAN CO LTD

title_en: Urban junction site traffic fairness and land income comprehensive evaluation method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a comprehensive evaluation method and system for traffic fairness and land income of urban junction sites, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining administrative boundaries of a research area, subway sites and route data in the research area, real-time population thermodynamic data and POI data, calculating the sum of time for each subway site to reach all other subway sites, establishing a first circular buffer area and a second circular buffer area, equidistantly taking a plurality of preset points on a side line, obtaining longitude and latitude coordinates of the preset points, obtaining time and distance from each junction site to each preset point in different travel modes, calculating population data in the first circular buffer area and the second circular buffer area, screening second-hand house data in a circle layer according to the circular buffer areas, calculating land income of the first circular buffer area and the second circular buffer area, calculating POI mixing degree of each junction site, and evaluating traffic fairness and land income of the urban junction sites. The invention provides quantitative decision support for city development and promotes the collaborative development of fair allocation of traffic resources and intensive land utilization.

title_en: Comprehensive energy system source-charge main body cooperative carbon reduction method based on block chain technology
abstract_en: The invention is suitable for the technical field of low-carbon scheduling of integrated energy systems, and provides a comprehensive energy system source-load main body collaborative carbon reduction method based on a block chain technology. The system not only can enable users to actively participate in carbon transaction on the individual level under the guidance and the excitation of a market mechanism and adjust the electricity utilization strategy, but also can drive the side to coordinate and complement with multiple functions so as to increase the carbon emission reduction degree. Thus, a complete emission reduction system from an energy production source to terminal consumption is constructed, and the cooperative emission reduction effect of both supply and demand sides is realized. In addition, through DPoS consensus mechanism based on credit threshold, nodes can be stimulated to actively participate in consensus election, fairness of the consensus election is guaranteed, and abnormal nodes are effectively processed.

title_en: Air film emergency type refrigeration house
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of emergency rescue equipment and discloses an air film emergency type refrigeration house which comprises an air film main body, a refrigerating unit and an air compressor, wherein a heat preservation mechanism is arranged in the air film main body, a protection mechanism is arranged at the front end of the air film main body, two air inlets are formed in the front end of the refrigerating unit, a universal distribution box is arranged outside the refrigerating unit, an epidemic prevention mechanism is arranged outside the air inlets, the heat preservation mechanism comprises a protective layer, the outside of the protective layer is fixedly connected to the top side of the inside of the air film main body, and a heat insulation layer is fixedly connected to the bottom of the protective layer. According to the invention, the air film main body adopts an inflatable structure, so that the air film inflation construction can be completed in a short time, the double-layer door curtain and the sealing rubber strip combined with the bin opening are quickly opened and closed through the magic tape, and the sealing rubber strip is overlapped and extruded to block air flow during closing, thereby effectively reducing cold energy loss and meeting the quick refrigeration requirement of disaster relief materials.
assignees: SHENZHEN JUNJIA MECH AND ELECTRICAL EQUIPMENT CO LTD

title_en: Multi-agent asynchronous coordination method and system under centralized architecture
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent asynchronous coordination method and system under a centralized architecture, which are suitable for task scheduling and resource coordination of heterogeneous agents in an intelligent Internet of things environment. According to the method, a centralized control mechanism of a main dispatching node is adopted, a dispatching priority function is calculated according to real-time state information of a plurality of heterogeneous intelligent agents by combining a multi-intelligent-agent game model, and asynchronous allocation and feedback control of tasks are realized. Meanwhile, an asynchronous synchronous window mechanism is introduced, the scheduling continuity and the scheduling efficiency can be kept under the condition of incomplete information, and the fairness and the robustness of task allocation are realized through intelligent feedback delay modeling and revenue function design. The invention improves the throughput and response speed of the system, gives consideration to isomerism and expandability, and is suitable for multi-agent cooperation scenes such as disaster emergency, industrial manufacturing, intelligent home, intelligent traffic and the like.
assignees: SCHOOL OF SOFTWARE TECHNOLOGY NINGBO INNOVATION AND MANAGEMENT CENTER OF ZHEJIANG UNIV;UNIV ZHEJIANG

title_en: Emergency scene-oriented efficient dispatching and logistics optimization method for electric power materials
abstract_en: The invention discloses an emergency scene-oriented efficient dispatching and logistics optimization method for electric power materials, and belongs to the field of dispatching of electric network materials. Aiming at the material scheduling requirements of the power system under different disaster classes, a hierarchical response mechanism is provided, wherein the hierarchical response mechanism comprises three modes of single-bin quick response, multi-bin collaborative supplement and whole network centralized support. A mathematical optimization model comprising supply, transfer, demand nodes and transport paths is established, and improved optimization algorithms such as Sine mapping population initialization, differential variation disturbance, elite retention, dynamic reverse learning and the like are introduced to improve the solving efficiency and the solution diversity. The model enables full-flow optimization of supply allocation, transport paths and resource scheduling under the assumption that node locations and material demands, vehicle parameters, etc. are known. The method can effectively improve the emergency material dispatching efficiency, reduce the transportation cost and the material shortage risk, and has good practical application value.

title_en: Remote off-site bid evaluation intelligent platform construction system and method based on multipoint distributed intelligent collaboration
abstract_en: The invention discloses a remote label evaluation intelligent platform construction system and method based on multipoint decentralized intelligent collaboration, comprising a user side, an application layer and a support layer, wherein the application layer comprises site management, expert resource management, expert signature, evaluation management, label evaluation system management, file transmission storage management and service guarantee collaborative management, data among all plates are seamlessly abutted and shared in real time, the support layer comprises a unified user management, a workflow platform, a general data management, a unified message platform, an intelligent analysis platform, a portal support platform and a data exchange platform, and the user side supports a transaction main body, a supervisor, a manager and the like to log in through access channels such as a mobile phone, a PC. The invention solves the problems that heterogeneous information in the current remote evaluation mark cannot be intercommunicated and shared, remote sites and equipment resources are difficult to share, and the supervision of a secondary field project is not sufficient, realizes the inter-regional interconnection and the resource sharing, and improves the evaluation mark efficiency and fairness.
assignees: SANMENXIA XIAOYUN INFORMATION SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Distributed energy benefit automatic distribution method and system based on IOT
abstract_en: The invention provides an automatic distribution method and system of distributed energy benefit based on IOT, which relates to the technical field of Internet of things and distributed energy management, comprising the steps of receiving energy data through an Internet of things communication gateway, dividing energy sub-networks according to geographic positions, unifying time references through a distributed clock synchronization protocol when executing energy transmission, and constructing an energy network topological graph, selecting an optimal mutual-aid transmission path based on the predicted energy matching degree of the long-term memory network, writing the path and the weight into an intelligent contract to automatically allocate benefits, and effectively improving the energy utilization rate and allocation fairness.
assignees: STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Stochastic trading system with synthetic charting and real-time price anchoring for enhanced execution control
abstract_en: The invention relates to a trading platform that shifts focus from market prediction to disciplined execution, capital management, and trading psychology. By disclosing the general market trend in advance, users are empowered to train and operate within a known directional framework. The system generates synthetic charts using directional random walks anchored at algorithmically or randomly selected convergence points from historical data. This recreates real trends while introducing stochastic variability between anchors. A simulated order book models supply-demand dynamics using Poisson-distributed flows, capturing sentiment, liquidity shifts, and large trades. Features include Accelerated Time Compression for fast-forwarded trade simulation and a Rewind Trade mechanism allowing entry at the start of validated candlesticks. The rewind logic applies to both futures and spot markets, including staking actions. Safeguards such as rewind limits, volume caps, and LP prioritization preserve fairness. The platform supports multi-timeframe execution and bridges strategic training with interactive trading, enhancing decision quality and behavioral discipline.

title_en: Roof greening fairness dynamic evaluation and composite risk identification method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of roof greening, in particular to a dynamic evaluation and composite risk identification method for fairness of roof greening. And constructing greening supply strength indexes of unit structures by combining high-resolution remote sensing images with building structure data, and introducing Gini coefficients to realize quantitative analysis of multi-scale space inequality. Meanwhile, the integration GeoDetector model identifies the driving effect of the space attribute factor, combines a static-dynamic two-dimensional modeling and a three-factor composite risk identification mechanism, realizes the accurate identification of the fairness evolution trend and the vulnerability area of roof greening, is suitable for urban green infrastructure optimization and policy intervention decision support under the condition of multi-temporal data, and has wide popularization value.

title_en: Feature analysis and influence evaluation method, device, equipment, medium and product based on composite energy drought event
abstract_en: The application discloses a characteristic analysis and influence evaluation method, device, equipment, medium and product based on a composite energy drought event, and relates to the technical field of renewable energy low-carbon transformation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining information data, preprocessing the information data to obtain integrated information data, calculating the endowed spatial distribution of wind and light resources based on the integrated information data to obtain the endowed spatial distribution information of the wind and light resources, carrying out characteristic analysis of a composite energy drought event according to the endowed spatial distribution information of the wind and light resources to determine spatial distribution index information, and carrying out exposure spatial characteristic analysis based on a fairness quantitative analysis frame according to the spatial distribution index information to obtain an analysis result. Therefore, the method can evaluate the evolution trend of the influence of the drought event of the composite energy source and provide a quantitative basis for the influence bias.

title_en: Urban and rural passenger, cargo and mail integrated service management platform and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an urban and rural passenger-cargo mail integrated service management platform and method, which relate to the technical field of logistics management and information, and comprise a multi-source data collaborative center module, a dynamic benefit distribution engine module and a dynamic correction module, wherein the multi-source data collaborative center module is used for converging and fusing heterogeneous data from a passenger enterprise system, a postal express enterprise system, a village service point terminal, a vehicle-mounted terminal and a government supervision system to construct a unified passenger-cargo delivery by mail nutrient data model, and the dynamic benefit distribution engine module is used for integrating an initial benefit distribution model and a dynamic correction model based on a shape value method. According to the urban and rural passenger-cargo-mail integrated service management platform and method, heterogeneous data from multiple parties such as passenger transportation, postal express, village-level service points and the like are effectively converged and fused through the multi-source data collaborative center module, a unified passenger-cargo delivery by mail-nutrient data model is built, an information island is broken, comprehensive sharing and efficient utilization of data are achieved, and fairness and efficiency of benefit distribution in a collaborative alliance are ensured.

title_en: Carbon distribution method, system and related equipment for charging electric automobile
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of carbon emission and provides a carbon distribution method, a system and related equipment for charging an electric automobile, wherein the method comprises the steps of acquiring multi-source data comprising unique identity marks of users, power grid energy structure data, charging equipment parameters, vehicle energy efficiency data and user behavior data through a charging operation system; the method comprises the steps of calculating reference fuel vehicle carbon emission and electric vehicle charging carbon emission based on power grid energy structure data and vehicle energy efficiency data to generate user net carbon reduction, constructing a carbon universal index system, dynamically optimizing weights of indexes in the constructed carbon universal index system by utilizing a random forest model, calculating user carbon integration according to the optimized weights, and completing the storage and transaction of the user carbon integration through a blockchain intelligent contract, so that the fairness and excitation efficiency of carbon integration distribution are effectively improved.
assignees: ELECTRIC POWER RES INST GUANGXI POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Staff reddening intelligent distribution system with post differentiation and fairness adaptation
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of community canteens and employee restaurants and discloses an employee distribution system with post differentiation and fairness adaptation, which comprises the following steps of determining post levels of employees of a company, dividing the post of the employee into a plurality of different levels according to factors such as post responsibility, work difficulty, work intensity and the like, wherein each level corresponds to a different weight coefficient; work performance data of the staff is collected, including but not limited to performance in terms of work outcome, work quality, work efficiency, team cooperation, etc., and the data is quantitatively processed to obtain performance scores of each staff. The differentiation and fairness adaptation of employee reddening are realized by comprehensively considering multidimensional factors such as the post level, work performance, attendance rate, work attitude, special contribution and the like of the employees. Compared with the existing reddening system, the system can reflect the actual contribution of staff to the company more accurately, and avoid unfairness caused by reddening according to the post level or performance.

title_en: Cross-regional pollution compensation method based on multidimensional ecological bearing capacity and game theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cross-regional pollution compensation method based on multidimensional ecological bearing capacity and game theory, which relates to the technical field of intersection of environmental economics and ecological compensation, and comprises the following steps of firstly, constructing a dynamic ecological bearing index CEI (i, t), and quantifying the bearing level of an ecological environment of a region by fusing the service supply capacity, pollution absorption capacity and socioeconomic pressure of the ecological system of the region; and secondly, establishing a pollution compensation responsibility distribution model based on the CEI (i, t) and the game theory, and determining the pollution responsibility proportion and compensation amount of each area. Dynamic quantification of ecological bearing capacity is realized, the limitation of the traditional evaluation mode is broken through, the compensation mechanism is made to have fairness and scientificity, and the acceptance of the system is improved.
assignees: SHENZHEN SHANYUANCHENG TECH HOLDING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Energy storage excitation value distribution measurement method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an energy storage incentive value distribution measurement method, system, equipment and medium, which relate to the technical field of power market and carbon transaction optimization and comprise the steps of collecting historical transaction data and system equipment parameter data of a power market and a carbon transaction market, constructing an electric carbon coupling quotation model according to electric carbon market data, defining constraint conditions in a dispatching optimization process, constructing a novel energy storage optimization dispatching model according to constraint conditions by adopting a double-layer optimization modeling method, optimizing a dispatching strategy through the novel energy storage optimization dispatching model, and outputting the electric carbon coupling quotation model to calculate the market value of a bidding subject by using a VCG mechanism. According to the method, competitive bidding payment is optimized through a VCG mechanism, equitable and reasonable market value distribution is ensured, and the double-layer optimized scheduling model is adopted, so that the benefits of the energy storage device in the electric energy market and the frequency modulation market are improved.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;UNIV ZHEJIANG FINANCE & ECONOMICS;ZHEJIANG UNIV SHAOXING RESEARCH INSTITUTE

title_en: New energy digital twin skill training platform based on wind turbine generator
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of new energy skill training and discloses a new energy digital twin skill training platform based on a wind turbine generator. According to the application, the operation flow and the maintenance process of the wind turbine generator can be simulated in a virtual-real combination mode, real-time guidance and quantitative evaluation are provided, meanwhile, the data linkage of training and safety management is realized, the learning efficiency and examination fairness are ensured, the practical training environment is optimized, and comprehensive, safe and efficient skill training support is provided for students.
assignees: SHAANXI HUADIAN NEW ENERGY POWER GENERATION CO LTD

title_en: Emergency material scheduling method considering retired equipment utilization
abstract_en: The invention relates to an emergency material scheduling method considering retired equipment utilization, and belongs to the technical field of emergency material scheduling. The method comprises five steps of constructing a fairness objective function, constructing a disaster recovery personnel loss objective function, constructing an emergency material cost objective function, constructing an emergency material scheduling model and solving the model. The invention improves the utilization rate and recovery rate of materials, improves the distribution rationality of the materials, reduces unnecessary energy loss and personnel scheduling, and is easy to popularize and apply.
assignees: YUXI POWER SUPPLY BUREAU OF YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Closed-loop power grid-oriented carbon emission flow analysis system and method for electric energy tracking and tide tracing coupling
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of carbon emission flow analysis of an electric power system, in particular to a carbon emission flow analysis method for electric energy tracking and tide tracing coupling of a closed-loop power grid. By establishing a tide distribution matrix, a unit injection matrix, a load distribution matrix and a carbon emission intensity vector, recursively calculating the carbon potential, the branch carbon flow rate and the load carbon flow rate of each node, coupling an electric energy tracking method with tide tracing, iteratively optimizing node allocation, and accordingly revealing the actual flow path and the spatial distribution characteristic of carbon flow in a power grid. The method can adapt to the scenes of complex multi-source access, ring network structure and the like, improves the scientificity and fairness of closed-loop power grid carbon emission management, and provides theoretical and method support for low-carbon scheduling, carbon accounting and low-carbon economic development.
assignees: UNIV NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER;STATE GRID ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD

title_en: Fixed source multistage emission limit value determining method and system based on statistical characteristics
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for determining a fixed source multistage emission limit value based on statistical characteristics, and relates to the technical field of environmental monitoring and management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining and controlling the concentration of historical emission monitoring data of a point pollution source, calculating a long-term average value as a statistical base line, further calculating a variation coefficient, establishing a difference state coefficient across time scales, combining a statistical guarantee rate with log-normal distribution deviation correction on the basis, determining a daily maximum, weekly average and monthly average concentration limit value, further introducing a standardized fluctuation coefficient to realize unified expression of the limit value, multiplying the standardized fluctuation coefficient with average water discharge of a corresponding statistical period to obtain a multi-stage load limit value, and accordingly realizing concentration and total quantity cooperative control under a unified statistical framework, and considering short-term risk inhibition and long-term risk constraint, and has scientificity, fairness and management operability.

title_en: Directional rights and interests distribution method, device, equipment and medium based on multidimensional contribution value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a directional rights and interests distribution method, device, equipment and medium based on multidimensional contribution values, the method collects actions of praise, sign-in, reporting, uploading content and the like of a user through an event monitoring mechanism, and converts the actions into two types of platform contribution values and civilized contribution values. At the end of the activity, the system selects a duty cycle mode, a ranking mode or a fixed value mode for benefit allocation calculation according to the configuration rules. The duty ratio mode distributes benefits according to the proportion of the contribution values of the users; and selecting a user with the contribution value ranked at the top by the ranking mode to issue the equity cards, and issuing the equity cards for the user reaching the threshold value by the fixed value mode. And the distribution result is asynchronously processed through the message queue, so that income warehouse entry or rights and interests card generation is realized. The invention supports a two-dimensional contribution value system and a plurality of flexible allocation strategies, adopts Redis cache and parallel computing technology to improve the processing efficiency, and can meet the accurate rights and interests allocation requirements under complex scenes such as government affair service, community management and the like.
assignees: QINGDAO BLUEPRINT THINK TANK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Port integrated card driver dispatching method, system and related equipment based on intelligent prediction and fairness optimization
abstract_en: The invention discloses a port integrated card driver dispatching method, a port integrated card driver dispatching system and related equipment based on intelligent prediction and fairness optimization; the invention relates to the port integrated card driver dispatching field, and aims at the technical problems that the existing dispatching method only takes the empty driving distance as the matching cost, so that the task allocation of a driver is not public and lacks the prospective, the weight of a matching edge is defined as the comprehensive dispatching cost in a weighted bipartite graph, the cost is composed of three items of the empty driving distance, a fairness penalty item and a task demand guide item, and the fairness penalty item reflecting the historical load balance of the driver and the task demand guide item reflecting the future task distribution trend are explicitly introduced into the weight of the matching edge, so that when the optimal matching is solved, the task allocation fairness and the prospective of the system response are obviously improved on the premise of not sacrificing the transportation efficiency.
assignees: Ningbo port information communication co ltd

title_en: Securities fund net value trend prediction method based on time sequence deep neural network
abstract_en: The invention relates to a securities fund equity trend prediction method based on a time sequence deep neural network, which aims at a multi-asset history equity sequence, establishes a grouping collection, cleaning, archiving and time axis synchronization process, combines multi-dimensional dynamic feature extraction and standardization, fuses information such as morphology, periodicity, fluctuation rate, mutation points and the like into a high-dimensional feature vector, adopts unsupervised clustering to realize effective clustering of asset dynamic features, combines a local window controller and a hierarchical window coordination mechanism in the time sequence deep neural network to realize dynamic optimization of window parameters and trend signal synchronization, and outputs a multi-asset cooperative and high-timeliness trend prediction result.

title_en: Multi-agent cooperative grouping and profit distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent cooperation grouping and profit distribution method, which is characterized in that an improved HCS algorithm is introduced to reasonably initialize tasks and agents, task priorities are calculated according to skill demands and predicted workload distribution, cross-task resource distribution is optimized in a competition stage combining profit prediction and cost constraint, marginal contribution of the agents is calculated based on Shapley values, profit distribution is carried out by combining dynamic excitation coefficients, profit distribution proportion is adjusted according to parameters, and after individual rationality constraint and overall profit maximization are met, iterative strategy update is carried out on formed initial grouping results until Nash equilibrium is reached. The method and the system enable the initial allocation to be intelligent, remarkably improve the resource utilization rate and the total income of the tasks based on the skill demand prediction and the workload priority, ensure the fairness and the high efficiency of the income allocation, and are suitable for industrial automation, smart cities and other scenes.

title_en: Dynamic adjustment method for electricity utilization priority of intelligent cabin equipment
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent cabin energy management and power consumption scheduling control, and discloses a dynamic adjustment method of power consumption priority of intelligent cabin equipment. The method comprises the steps of uniformly numbering all devices, collecting power requirements, minimum continuous power supply duration, categories and request states, screening out real needed devices in the current period according to a fixed period, counting average power and reference duration, combining the categories, relative power and relative duration to generate bidding factors, sequencing the factors, performing prefix accumulation allocation according to allocable power, giving priority to form a record list, recursively delaying counting for the devices which are not allocated continuously at the end of the period, setting a forced threshold, ensuring fairness at the front of the next period, executing on-off instructions, identifying the devices which are not requested for a long time after clearing, meeting conditions, re-incorporating and circularly advancing.

title_en: Three-stage thermal power generating unit capacity electricity price spot check optimization method, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a three-stage thermal power generating unit capacity electricity price spot check optimizing method, equipment and medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining short-term prediction data before D days; the method comprises the steps of obtaining a D day optimal spot check number according to the D day short-term prediction data, constructing a spot check optimizing function of a thermal power unit, and solving to obtain details of the D day spot check unit to be spot checked. Aiming at the problems of rigidification of the existing fixed spot check time period, no consideration of maintenance of the unit and the like, the invention can screen out the optimal time period to execute spot check on the premise of ensuring the maximum consumption of new energy, dynamically adjust the spot check unit number according to ultra-short term prediction data, and realize the coordination and optimization of the safety and economic scheduling of the power grid and the spot check fairness by introducing a spot check penalty function.
assignees: NANJING NARI RELAYS ENG TECH;NORTHEAST BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA

title_en: Vehicle charging management method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a vehicle charging management method, device, equipment and storage medium, relates to the technical field of vehicles, and aims to improve the accuracy of vehicle charging management, effectively improve the utilization rate of charging resources by optimizing the distribution and dispatch of the charging resources, and help a power grid to balance the power consumption requirements of different time periods, so that the user charging satisfaction is improved. The method comprises the steps of obtaining charging emergency degree information, charging economy information and scheduling fairness information of a vehicle to be charged, carrying out weighted fusion on the charging emergency degree information, the charging economy information and the scheduling fairness information to obtain comprehensive priority scores of the vehicle to be charged, and generating a corresponding charging strategy by a real-time power distribution function based on the obtained electric pile power information and the comprehensive priority scores, wherein the charging strategy is used for planning a charging power curve of the vehicle changing along with time in a preset future time period.

title_en: Path-based green land fairness evaluation method and device
abstract_en: The application discloses a green land fairness evaluation method and device based on a path, and relates to the field of urban ecological planning and evaluation, comprising the steps of acquiring green land characteristic data and individual activity data of an area to be evaluated; the green land feature data comprises remote sensing image data and street view image data, the individual activity data comprises population density distribution and individual activity position time sequence sets, activity paths of all the collected individuals are determined according to the individual activity position time sequence sets, green land coverage indexes corresponding to the activity paths of all the collected individuals are calculated according to the remote sensing image data based on the activity paths of all the collected individuals, street green vision rates corresponding to the activity paths of all the collected individuals are calculated according to the street view image data, comprehensive green land exposure indexes of all the collected individuals are calculated according to the population density distribution and by combining the green land coverage indexes and the street green vision rates, and green land fair assessment results of an area to be assessed are obtained according to the comprehensive green land exposure indexes of all the collected individuals and based on a base coefficient and a Talc coefficient.
assignees: HARBIN INSTITUTE OF TECH SHENZHEN INSTITUTE OF SCIENCE AND TECH INNOVATION

title_en: A book sharing system and its method of working
abstract_en: The novel book sharing platform offers a multifaceted solution to address the diverse needs and interests of users within the literary community. The platform facilitates knowledge sharing, collaboration, and engagement through centralized hubs for selecting reading lists, facilitating discussions, and connecting with fellow readers and writers. Authors leverage the platform for book promotion, feedback gathering, and audience engagement, while access Meta data for reader preference statistics. Additionally, the platform enhances the user experience by offering personalized recommendations, fair and equitable exchanges through a credit management system, and cost optimization features for shipping. Overall, the novel book sharing platform serves as a dynamic and inclusive space that enriches the reading experience, promotes knowledge sharing, and fosters connections within the literary community.

title_en: System for managing cargo vehicle entry and exit and method thereof
title_ko: 화물 차량의 입출차 관리 시스템 및 그 방법
abstract_ko: 본 발명은 화물 차량의 입출차 관리 시스템 및 그 방법에 관한 것으로서, 더욱 상세하게는 다수의 현장에서 화물 차량의 운전자들이 공통으로 사용하는 어플리케이션을 이용하여, 화물 차량의 기처리 운반 횟수(탕수)에 따라 입차 및 출차를 관리함으로써, 해당 현장에서의 업무가 특정 차량에 집중되지 않고 공평히 배분되도록 하는 것이 가능한 화물 차량의 입출차 관리 시스템 및 그 방법을 제공한다.

title_en: Artificial intelligence-based fair examination method and system for bidding documents
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of artificial intelligence examination and discloses a fair examination method and a fair examination system for bidding documents based on artificial intelligence. The system comprises a file acquisition unit, a scoring model unit and a fairness examination optimizing unit. The method comprises the steps of acquiring bidding document information and corresponding grading rule information input by a user, wherein the bidding document information comprises document type information and grading weight information, the grading rule information comprises business grading rule and technical grading rule, the grading model unit determines a grading program according to the document type information, and the fairness examination optimizing unit determines a grading optimizing program according to the document type information, the grading rule information and the grading program, and the fairness examination is completed through the program. The system can solve the problems of scoring deviation, program confusion, low efficiency and the like of the traditional manual examination, realizes examination automation and standardization through multi-unit cooperation, maintains a fair competitive environment for bidding, and meets the requirements of industry on efficient and fair examination.

title_en: Multi-agent collaborative city community space planning method and device based on large model driving
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-agent collaborative city community space planning method and device based on large model driving, wherein the method comprises the steps of converting original city space data into a structured community space distribution map; the method comprises the steps of constructing a 'planner' agent, utilizing the 'planner' agent to understand and analyze a community space distribution map, outputting an initial city planning scheme, dividing the initial city planning scheme into a plurality of community areas, respectively generating local optimization suggestions by a plurality of 'community planning reviewer' agents, fusing all community optimization suggestions by a 'advanced planner' agent, carrying out global reasoning and coordination, and outputting a final city space planning scheme. The intelligent level, the cooperative efficiency and the service fairness of urban space planning are improved through cooperative work of multiple intelligent agents, and the problems of lack of multiple value expression in traditional generation type planning, high labor cost, slow response and the like in participation type planning are solved.
assignees: UNIV SOUTH CHINA TECH;GUANGDONG URBAN & RURAL PLANNING AND DESIGN INSTITUTE TECH GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Risk scheduling method for water resource system
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water resource system risk scheduling method which comprises the steps of obtaining regional basic data, constructing a supply and demand pressure field, identifying causal relations, generating heterogeneous computing grids and a space-time causal network, dynamically determining a water-required tail cutting threshold value by adopting a cascade buffer pool mechanism based on historical supply and demand sequence data of the heterogeneous computing grids and influence factors identified by the space-time causal network, outputting a regulated water-required sequence, generating a water scene set by adopting an optimal transmission method of tail conformal by utilizing the regulated water-required sequence, simplifying the water scene set into a representative scene subset, constructing a distributed robust optimization model aiming at the representative scene subset, and generating a water resource scheduling scheme and a risk assessment report by fairness constraint projection and causal path analysis. The invention can finely describe the space-time pressure, adaptively regulate and control the extreme requirements, and generate a scheduling scheme which takes robustness and fairness into consideration under the condition of keeping the tail risk characteristics.

title_en: Three-dimensional loading optimization system and method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a three-dimensional loading optimization system and method based on multi-agent reinforcement learning. Aiming at the limitation of the traditional single-agent method in the multi-truck collaborative loading, the invention applies the VDN multi-agent architecture to the 3D multi-truck loading problem for the first time, adopts an original component group-based secondary adjustment cost algorithm, a dynamic constraint strategy and a fair competition mechanism, models each truck as an independent agent, realizes the multi-agent collaborative decision through the VDN, creatively proposes the component group-distributed secondary adjustment cost algorithm, effectively reduces the cross-truck adjustment cost, and remarkably improves the loading efficiency and the decision fairness by adopting a dynamic rotation (not put, vertical and horizontal) constraint strategy and the fair competition mechanism. Experimental results show that compared with the traditional method, the method has obvious improvement in space utilization rate, adjustment cost and decision efficiency.

title_en: Index collection method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous index data fusion
abstract_en: The invention provides an index collection method and system based on multi-source heterogeneous index data fusion, and relates to the technical field of big data processing, wherein the method comprises the steps of collecting a source end index factor data table of multi-source heterogeneous indexes from a source end system; the method comprises the steps of carrying out source layer pasting on source end index factor data in a source end index factor data table to obtain a source layer pasting index factor wide table, carrying out data integration association on the source layer pasting index factor wide table to obtain a shared layer index factor wide table, carrying out operation on the shared layer index factor wide table based on a data analysis algorithm, and generating an analysis layer index factor wide table according to an operation result. According to the invention, heterogeneous assessment index data with different formats and structures are integrated, meanwhile, a full-link closed loop is realized through a data center, and assessment indexes are optimized in an automatic mode to obtain accurate assessment indexes, so that fairness and effectiveness of performance assessment and decision analysis of organization are improved.
assignees: BEIJING GUODIANTONG NETWORK TECHNOLOGY CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Dynamic education resource distribution system and method based on multi-target game
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of education, and discloses a dynamic education resource distribution system and method based on multi-target game, wherein the system comprises a data acquisition module, a multi-target game model module, a dynamic weight adjustment module, a resource distribution decision engine and a real-time feedback and optimization module, the data acquisition module is used for acquiring real-time education demand data and user behavior data, the real-time education demand data covers education resource supply and demand dynamic change information, the user behavior data comprises resource use states and education effect feedback information, and the multi-target game model module is used for constructing a game model of a multi-party participant. By constructing the multi-objective game model and the dynamic weight adjustment mechanism, the inherent contradiction between fairness and efficiency in educational resource allocation is effectively solved. The multi-objective game model takes the minimum of the coefficient of the foundation, the maximum of the resource utilization rate and the minimum of financial investment as core objectives, and ensures the strategy stability by combining with Nash equilibrium theory.

title_en: Unmanned vehicle-machine collaborative scheduling method and system under post-earthquake damaged road
abstract_en: The invention provides a collaborative scheduling method and system for unmanned vehicles and unmanned aerial vehicles under a post-earthquake damaged road, which belong to the technical field of earthquake disaster rescue scheduling. And constructing a comprehensive objective function by taking the shortest total rescue time, the highest rescue material distribution fairness and the highest wounded transferring efficiency as targets. And solving the comprehensive objective function based on the road condition change, the demand data and the carrier state to obtain the rescue material transportation and wounded transportation scheme after the unmanned aerial vehicle and the aircraft are cooperated to shake. Shortens the rescue and robs the time efficiency, realizes the multi-objective collaborative operation of unmanned vehicles and unmanned aerial vehicles, and improves the material delivery efficiency in the gold rescue period.

title_en: Regional water resource allocation dynamic modeling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource balance, in particular to a regional water resource allocation dynamic modeling method and system. The invention discloses a dynamic modeling method for regional water resource allocation, which comprises the following steps of obtaining regional hydrological historical data, dividing water resource partitions according to the regional hydrological historical data, extracting hydrological conditions of the water resource partitions to obtain regional water resource characteristic data, obtaining regional water demand data, constructing a system dynamics model according to the regional water resource characteristic data and the regional water demand data, simulating inter-industry water interactive relations of the system dynamics model to obtain system dynamic balance data of regional water resources, and establishing a water flow network topological structure according to the system dynamic balance data. According to the invention, by considering the water demand, the supply capacity and the mutual influence of different industries, the water resource demand among the industries can be reasonably balanced, the resource allocation is optimized, the water contradiction is reduced, and the fairness and the efficiency of the water resource allocation are improved.
assignees: PEARL RIVER HYDRAULIC COMPREHENSIVE TECH CENTER PEARL RIVER WATER RESOURCES COMMISSION OF MINISTRY O

title_en: Dangerous goods multi-mode intermodal transportation scheduling method based on branch delimitation and simulated annealing
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dangerous goods multi-mode intermodal scheduling method based on branch delimitation and simulated annealing, which relates to the technical field of dangerous goods logistics safety and intelligent decision, and comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer integer linear programming model with minimized total transportation risk at an upper layer and minimized multi-mode intermodal cost at a lower layer, respectively designing a branch delimitation algorithm B & B and a simulated annealing algorithm SA according to network scale, quantitatively evaluating potential risks and operation costs of transportation road sections and transportation nodes on population, property and environment, creatively adopting an absolute difference method to measure the risk space distribution fairness, constructing a double-layer optimization framework for balancing transportation safety and economic benefits, remarkably reducing the overall transportation safety risk, relieving the problem of excessive concentration of local regional risks, optimizing logistics cost, and overcoming the limitation that the traditional mode or single-target optimization is difficult to consider the safety and the economic efficiency.

title_en: Remote sensing task fair scheduling method and device based on multistage feedback queue
abstract_en: The invention provides a remote sensing task fair scheduling method and device based on a multi-stage feedback queue, which relate to the technical field of satellite remote sensing, and the method comprises the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining satellite remote sensing tasks to be scheduled, analyzing to obtain corresponding structured task parameters, further calculating multidimensional scores of the satellite remote sensing tasks on user side fairness, task type fairness and space demand fairness, distributing real-time task resources to the satellite remote sensing tasks, determining scheduling priorities of the satellite remote sensing tasks in a multistage feedback queue according to the real-time task resources and task execution windows of the satellite remote sensing tasks, and finally selecting an optimally matched remote sensing platform according to the scheduling priorities and executing the satellite remote sensing tasks. The method and the device are used for solving the problems of low response efficiency of task processing caused by unreasonable scheduling and resource allocation of the satellite remote sensing task in the prior art.
assignees: BEIJING SHIJI NONGFENG LAND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Carbon responsibility distribution and distributed scheduling method based on cross-electric power traffic system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of responsibility allocation, in particular to a carbon responsibility allocation and distributed scheduling method based on a cross-electric power traffic system. The technical scheme includes that electric power and traffic basic data are collected, node time-varying carbon intensity is calculated, a feasible path and a time window are screened, traffic flow time sequence constraint is constructed, an energy and battery charge state feasible domain is constructed, carbon responsibility density is updated, upper carbon excitation and lower carbon excitation are combined and optimized, and after convergence, attribution carbon responsibility and total CER of the system of each vehicle are output. The invention realizes continuous CER tracking and verifiable decomposition of the electric automobile in a bidirectional and space-time-crossing scene, improves accounting accuracy and fairness, eliminates confusion of carbon attributes of electric quantity of different sources through a responsibility density mechanism, avoids high-carbon responsibility pseudo-low-carbon reinjection, and ensures approaching of a CER target of a system under the condition of not disclosing a fine-granularity track through a distributed iteration signal. The method is suitable for carbon responsibility allocation and scheduling.

title_en: Shared logistics network optimization method based on double-layer planning
abstract_en: The invention relates to a shared logistics network optimization method based on double-layer planning. The method comprises the steps of constructing an upper-layer planning model, generating and outputting a logistics center set and a resource distribution matrix, constructing a lower-layer planning model, carrying out multi-industry collaborative vehicle path optimization of the lower-layer planning model based on the logistics center set and the resource distribution matrix, obtaining actual resource consumption data and time window violation number statistical data, feeding back the actual resource consumption data to the upper-layer planning model, feeding back the time window violation number statistical data to the upper-layer planning model, verifying and evaluating fairness of resource allocation by the upper-layer planning model based on fairness constraint, adaptively adjusting the logistics center set position in subsequent iteration according to the fairness constraint, and adaptively adjusting the resource distribution matrix in the subsequent iteration based on updated credit score. The method can efficiently share and comprehensively schedule the logistics resources in a large range, can obviously reduce the total cost of the whole link system, and improves the operation economic benefit.

title_en: Irrigation area resource priority allocation method, system, equipment and medium based on peasant household credit score
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method, a system, equipment and a medium for preferentially distributing irrigation district resources based on credit scores of farmers, which belong to the technical field of irrigation district resource distribution and comprise the steps of acquiring dynamic information reflecting water consumption and related behaviors of the farmers through a multisource information acquisition means; the method comprises the steps of establishing a peasant household credit scoring model based on the acquired dynamic information, constructing a multi-factor scoring structure according to the behavior compliance, the responsiveness, the water saving level and the dimensionality of the payment record, obtaining comprehensive credit scores through weighted calculation, sequencing peasant households according to the comprehensive credit scores, collecting and analyzing the behavior information of the peasant households in the executing process through a feedback and updating mechanism, dynamically correcting the credit scoring result, and realizing the periodic optimization of a water resource allocation strategy. The invention realizes the transition from average water supply to credit drive dispatch, enhances the fairness, the diversity and the incentive guidance of the dispatch, reduces the management burden, automatically identifies deviation and default behavior by means of a feedback mechanism, and improves the execution force and constraint force of a dispatch plan.
assignees: NANJING HEHAI NANZI HYDROPOWER AUTOMATION CO LTD

title_en: Computing Fairness
abstract_en: Estimated and actual processor runtimes improve computer functioning in fairly sharing computing resources. Today's computers and cloud-based services serve many users and many software applications sharing CPU resources. An operating system thus implements a scheduling policy that fairly allocates CPU time. A scheduler thread implements the scheduling policy based on estimated processor runtimes, and actual processor runtimes, associated with tasks. The operating system may maintain running tallies or totals for a user/group/organization based on credits (e.g., the estimated processor runtimes) and/or on penalties (e.g., the actual processor runtimes). The scheduler thread may select tasks for worker threads based on the credits and/or the penalties, thus ensuring that no user/group/organization unfairly consumes CPU time.

title_en: Provincial domain carbon emission prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition
abstract_en: The application discloses a provincial carbon emission prediction method, device, equipment and medium based on self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition, relating to the technical field of air prediction, comprising the following steps: the method comprises the steps of obtaining and standardizing carbon emission data of each city in a province, inputting a preset carbon emission prediction model formed by a multi-head attention-encoder-decoder generator and a time sequence convolution discriminator, outputting predicted values of each city, summarizing the predicted values into a province domain result, adopting self-adaptive multi-scale decomposition and space-time feature fusion in a model training stage, and carrying out joint optimization by means of the fair loss of a day-month coefficient, so as to realize regional differentiation, fairness and high-precision carbon emission prediction, and provide credible and interpretable data support for provincial carbon quota scientific allocation and emission reduction responsibility division.

title_en: Inter-provincial power spot market operation evaluation method and related device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an inter-provincial power spot market operation evaluation method and a related device, wherein a multi-dimensional and multi-main evaluation index system is designed, dynamic self-adaptive evaluation is carried out on inter-provincial power spot market operation based on the multi-dimensional and multi-main evaluation index system to obtain an evaluation result, and optimization suggestion is carried out based on the evaluation result. The invention comprehensively improves the evaluation result, has more accurate evaluation accuracy, meets the fairness requirement, can improve the income-saving satisfaction degree of the sending end and the electricity-saving purchase cost of the receiving end, and greatly shortens the response time.
assignees: CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RES INST CO LTD;STATE GRID CORP CHINA

title_en: Urban group space toughness collaborative planning method, system, terminal equipment and medium based on collaborative game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative game-based urban mass space toughness collaborative planning method, a system, terminal equipment and a medium, and relates to the technical field of urban planning. The method comprises the steps of obtaining city group basic data, dividing the city group basic data into space unit sets with unified assignment according to attributes, constructing a multi-disaster scene set and quantifying risk loss parameters of each unit, defining candidate land utilization states and planning constraint condition sets for each unit, constructing a comprehensive benefit function of a corresponding city based on the candidate land utilization states of the units, constructing a cooperative game by taking the city as a participant, solving an optimal strategy in the planning configuration set meeting the constraint with the aim of maximizing the benefit of the city group, calculating marginal contributions of each city to the benefit of the city group under the optimal strategy, and distributing the cooperative benefit based on the marginal contributions. The invention provides an improved mechanism in the aspect of multi-disaster prevention and regional collaborative optimization, is beneficial to improving the toughness level of urban mass space planning and ensures the fairness and stability of regional collaboration.

title_en: Construction method of unified scheduling universal model of load side response resources of virtual power plant
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power systems and energy management, and discloses a universal model construction method for unified scheduling of load side response resources of a virtual power plant. The method comprises the steps of firstly collecting and standardizing multi-source heterogeneous data such as industrial loads, commercial buildings, residential electricity, vehicle network interaction, controllable air conditioners and heat pumps, distributed energy storage, distributed new energy sources and the like, then generating a counterfactual load track and rebound risk priori under different excitation and constraint conditions based on causal structure learning, realizing micro description of multidimensional adjustable power and uncertainty by constructing response form tensors and flexible envelope surfaces, completing cross-main body representation alignment of privacy protection under a federal learning framework, and injecting proving type safety constraints of power grid safety, user comfort and market rules. The method can realize unified modeling and flexible scheduling of the load side response resources on the premise of ensuring the safety of the power grid and the user experience, and has the comprehensive advantages of privacy protection, economy, fairness, compliance and the like.
assignees: BEIJING JINGNENG DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Robot scheduling and safety verification system for disaster relief material intelligent bin
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of disaster relief material dispatching, and particularly discloses a robot dispatching and safety checking system of an intelligent disaster relief material bin, which comprises a robot main body, a dispatching module and a safety checking module, wherein a plurality of rollers are arranged at the bottom of the robot main body, an electric rotating shaft is arranged on the robot main body, a rotating plate is fixedly connected to the electric rotating shaft, a two-stage vibration reduction structure of a pressing spring and a damping rod is adopted, when the robot main body moves to generate jolt, the clamping plate drives a lug to move in a chute, the pressing spring is firstly pushed by a swinging arm to push a driving piece to compress the pressing spring, most vibration energy is absorbed by utilizing the elastic deformation of the pressing spring, meanwhile, the damping rod generates damping force along with the downward movement of the lug to secondarily damp the disaster relief material, the vibration energy is prevented from being transmitted to clamped fragile materials, the fragile materials such as precision medical equipment are prevented from being damaged in the dispatching process, and the sound rate of the disaster relief material is remarkably improved.

title_en: Evaluation method, device and system based on multi-benefit body
abstract_en: The application discloses an evaluation method, device and system based on multiple benefit subjects, the method comprises the steps of constructing an economic, ecological and social multidimensional evaluation index system, calculating subjective weights of all benefit subjects by an AHP method, synthesizing the weights of all the parties by a Shapley value game theory model to obtain comprehensive subjective weights, calculating objective weights by an entropy weight method, combining the subjective and objective weights by a convex optimization model to obtain final weights, and sequencing and optimizing schemes based on a TOPSIS method and the final weights. According to the application, the benefits of multiple parties are balanced through the game theory, and the subjective and objective weighting method is combined, so that the scientific decision problem under the conflict of multiple benefits and main bodies is solved, and the scientificity and the fairness of evaluation of complex engineering schemes such as water conservancy junctions are improved.
assignees: CHINA RAILWAY WATER CONSERVANCY AND HYDROPOWER PLANNING AND DESIGN GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Retail user green electricity consumption measuring method and system based on electricity consumption scale and performance consistency
abstract_en: The invention relates to a retail user green electricity consumption measuring method and system based on consistency of electricity consumption scale and performance, which are used for solving the problems that the existing green electricity distribution mechanism excessively depends on contract electricity quantity, multiple iterative redistribution risks exist, and actual consumption contribution of users is difficult to fairly embody. According to the method, firstly, an index for calculating the green electricity consumption capability of the user is formed from two key dimensions of the planned electricity consumption scale and the contract performance consistency. Further, an initial allocation proportion is determined according to the green electricity consumption capability index, a minimized allocation deviation optimization model is introduced, constraint conditions such as practical upper power limit of a user, green electricity consumption capability sequencing consistency and the like are considered, and one-time fair and efficient allocation of green electricity resources is realized. The method overcomes the limitation that the traditional method relies on physical tide tracking or single contract electric quantity distribution, fully considers the actual influence of the electricity consumption behavior of the user on green electricity consumption, has fairness, excitation and engineering feasibility, and has good practical value.

title_en: ETC traffic data-based adaptive game regulation and control method and system
abstract_en: The invention discloses an ETC (electronic toll collection) passing data-based self-adaptive game regulation and control method and system, which comprise the steps of generating a toll station space coordinate set, generating a user province card collection schedule, counting the passing frequency, the passing mileage and the trans-province behaviors of a user in a preset time window, writing a user liveness model into a user file, setting trigger thresholds for the passing card-punching behaviors and the social sharing behaviors respectively, generating card objects and writing the card objects into the user province card collection schedule when the corresponding thresholds are met, analyzing the user province card collection schedule in real time, tracking the single number state of a logistics until signing is completed and a user seal warehouse is updated, and recording the reflux access quantity and writing the user fissile value table when a reflux monitoring module detects an access event. The invention obviously improves the application depth of the data and the fairness of the user interaction.
assignees: JIEYOU DIGITAL TECH NANJING CO LTD

title_en: Method, equipment and medium for mutual identification and distribution of green power and national verification voluntary emission reduction
abstract_en: The invention relates to a mutual identification and distribution method, equipment and medium for green electric power and national nuclear voluntary emission reduction, wherein the method comprises the steps of S1, constructing a park-type virtual power plant, conducting intermediate agency on user bodies with different emission reduction characteristic differences, S2, deducting new energy generating capacity from total electric quantity to revise an original electric power factor, S3, conducting mutual identification on the national nuclear voluntary emission reduction CCER and green electric power according to a revised electric power factor based on an environment rights uniqueness principle and a pollutant payment principle, S4, conducting claim on the national nuclear voluntary emission reduction by the park-type virtual power plant agency in a unified mode, and S5, distributing the national nuclear voluntary emission reduction by adopting a multi-weight shape method. Compared with the prior art, the invention ensures the fairness and effectiveness of the voluntary emission reduction distribution of the national evidence, is beneficial to promoting the low-carbon transformation of the power system and stimulating the users to actively participate in the renewable energy consumption.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Integrated optimization method based on urban rail transit operation ending period timetable and skip stop plan under abnormal state
abstract_en: The invention discloses an integrated optimization method based on an urban rail transit operation ending time period timetable and a skip stop plan under abnormal conditions, which comprises the steps of obtaining passenger demand data and train operation parameters in the operation ending time period; the method comprises the steps of constructing a mixed integer multi-target optimization model according to passenger demand data and train operation parameters, solving the mixed integer multi-target optimization model by adopting a multi-target whale optimization algorithm to obtain a pareto optimal solution set, and outputting the pareto optimal solution set to generate a timetable and a skip stop plan of an operation ending period. The method and the system have the advantages that the overall waiting time of passengers is obviously reduced in the operation ending period by integrating the optimized timetable and the skip stop plan, meanwhile, the number of the passengers which are not served due to skip stop is effectively reduced, the overall operation efficiency and the service fairness are improved, and multiple optimization schemes can be flexibly generated by the method, so that decision basis is provided for operation enterprises.

title_en: Identification method for high-carbon power nodes
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for identifying high-carbon nodes of electric power, which relates to the technical field of carbon emission distribution and aims to solve the problem that the carbon emission of a novel electric power system is unfavorable for the quantitative analysis of the low-carbon characteristics and carbon emission responsibility of the electric power system, and comprises the steps of carrying out carbon flow analysis and calculation on the whole electric power system based on a carbon emission flow theory to obtain key parameters of each node; the method comprises the steps of calculating carbon emission quantity at a load side according to an output result of key parameters, calculating carbon emission responsibility allocation quantity at a system load side according to a tide and carbon flow calculation result, constructing a responsibility allocation quantity critical value according to a carbon emission responsibility allocation result and a fairness theory, and identifying high-carbon nodes according to the allocation quantity critical value. The method can make key records on the nodes with higher carbon emission responsibility or exceeding the average value, and judge the nodes as high-carbon nodes, so that a reference basis is provided for the subsequent proposal of the carbon reduction strategy, and the method is favorable for the quantitative analysis of the low-carbon characteristics and the carbon emission responsibility of the electric power system.
assignees: HUZHOU POWER SUPPLY COMPANY OF STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Hierarchical collaborative optimization and settlement method for large-scale industrial demand response
