abstract_en: The application provides a hierarchical collaborative optimization and settlement method of a large-scale industrial demand response, which relates to the technical field of electric power systems and comprises the steps of dividing a large-scale industrial demand response resource into a plurality of levels and constructing an optimization model, decomposing a global optimization problem into local sub-problems, defining a consistency variable constraint global consistency, generating a dispatching instruction through iterative computation, responding to the dispatching instruction to acquire actual response data, performing hash operation and digital signature processing on the actual response data to generate a signature abstract, verifying the signature abstract by using an intelligent contract, performing real-time settlement after verification to obtain real-time settlement data, and summarizing the real-time settlement data to obtain periodic settlement data, calculating a performance index according to the dispatching instruction and the actual response data, and performing numerical correction on the real-time settlement data and the periodic settlement data by using the performance index to obtain adjusted settlement data. The application realizes the rapid scheduling and convergence of large-scale resources, and effectively improves the enthusiasm and fairness of users for participating in scheduling.
assignees: STATE GRID ZHEJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD NINGBO POWER SUPPLY CO

title_en: Two-stage toughness improvement method and device for power distribution network, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a two-stage toughness improving method, a device, computer equipment and a storage medium for a power distribution network, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a pre-disaster fault scene and various known conditions required by calculation; according to various known conditions, a power distribution network operation model is established, optimization solution is carried out by taking the minimum load reduction weighted value as an objective function to obtain a minimum load reduction weighted value, the minimum load reduction weighted value is taken as the upper limit of the load reduction weighted value, new constraint is added in the power distribution network operation model, any fairness principle is used as the objective function to carry out optimization solution, and an optimal strategy meeting minimum coincidence reduction and meeting fairness reduction of general load is obtained. The invention has the advantages of ensuring that important nodes recover preferentially and the load of non-important nodes is reduced fairly on the premise of ensuring that the load reduction weighted value is minimum.

title_en: Dynamic adjustment method, device, equipment and medium for health industry management
abstract_en: The application relates to a dynamic adjustment method, a device, equipment and a medium for health industry management. The method comprises the steps of obtaining multi-level resource demand data, carrying out standardized processing on the resource demand data to obtain standard resource demand data, carrying out dynamic priority assessment on each level of demand based on the standard resource demand data to generate priority scores of each level of demand, wherein the priority scores are used for representing the emergency degree of health demands of different levels, obtaining an initial resource allocation scheme according to the priority scores by combining a preset multi-objective optimization model, wherein the initial resource allocation scheme is used for representing the resource allocation proportion and the resource allocation quantity of each level of demand, and carrying out dynamic adjustment on the initial resource allocation scheme to generate the resource allocation scheme. By adopting the method, the inclination of the resources to the single demand can be avoided, the fairness of demand response is ensured, and the dynamic allocation of the healthy resources is realized.
assignees: SHIZHEN COLLEGE OF GUIZHOU UNIV OF TRADITIONAL CHINESE MEDICINE

title_en: Material cooperative distribution method based on integral excitation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a material cooperative distribution method based on integral excitation, and belongs to the field of emergency logistics and blockchain technology intersection. The method aims to solve the problems that the existing disaster relief material distribution mode is low in efficiency, insufficient in excitation and easy to cheat. The method comprises the steps of quantizing physical contribution and social evaluation of users through Internet of things equipment and feedback of a receiver to generate comprehensive scores, forming a double-track incentive system based on non-transferable honor points and negligable emergency points of blockchain casting, automatically triggering expansion of an emergency integral pool and docking with an enterprise tax deduction system to construct a public benefit-business closed loop when disaster reaches a specific level through intelligent contracts, setting up daily and emergency double-channel exchange modes, and introducing a dynamic weight adjustment mechanism based on abnormal behavior detection to prevent cheating. The invention realizes the high efficiency, fairness and sustainability of material distribution, and remarkably improves the emergency response efficiency and the enterprise participation.

title_en: Multi-objective optimized water resource allocation scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-objective optimized water resource allocation scheduling method, which combines an LSTM-Prophet mixed prediction model with an attention mechanism, synchronously captures the characteristics of climate periodicity, policy regulation sensitivity and industry development trend in water demand prediction, and improves the water demand prediction precision through a genetic algorithm. The improved NSGA-III algorithm and PSO collaborative optimization mechanism is combined with the chaotic mapping technology, so that the convergence problem of a high-dimensional target space is effectively solved, and the multi-target optimization efficiency is improved by 40% by matching with a dynamic weight adjustment strategy of deep reinforcement learning. The multi-scenario simulation verification of the scheduling scheme is realized by utilizing the deep coupling of the digital twin system and the three-dimensional GIS, and the real-time feedback correction mechanism of the Markov decision process is further utilized. The finally constructed entropy weight-TOPSIS multidimensional evaluation system combines AR visualization and intelligent contract tracing technology, and provides a pareto optimal solution which gives consideration to social fairness, economic benefit and ecological integrity for decision makers.
assignees: YELLOW RIVER ENGINEERING CONSULTING CO LTD

title_en: Pumped storage capacity cost allocation system and method for beneficiary object
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of economic dispatch of power systems and discloses a pumped storage capacity cost allocation system and method for benefiting objects, wherein the system comprises a benefit quantification module, a power system time sequence production simulation module and a power system time sequence analysis module, wherein the benefit quantification module is used for comparing and quantifying various benefits of a pumped storage power station; the inter-plant cost primary allocation module is used for dividing the cost between the power generation and the power grid side to generate the total allocation cost of the power grid side by utilizing the benefit, the inter-plant allocation weight determining module is used for determining the allocation weight of each provincial power grid through an entropy weight method according to a preset index system, and the inter-plant cost final allocation module is used for calculating the final allocation cost of each province by combining the total cost of the power grid side and the allocation weight and applying a TOPSIS method. The invention constructs a two-stage allocation model through benefit quantization and entropy weight and TOPSIS method, scientifically and equitably solves the problem of allocation of pumped storage capacity cost among multiple subjects.
assignees: STATE GRID JIBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Material distribution method and device and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The disclosure relates to a material distribution method and device and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining the types of materials to be distributed and the corresponding quantity of the materials to be distributed, determining the target step length of the materials to be distributed in the material distribution sequence based on the quantity of the materials to be distributed and the length of the material distribution sequence for any type of target materials to be distributed, distributing one target material to be distributed at the idle position of the material which is not distributed in each target step length interval from the beginning of the material distribution sequence, and carrying out material distribution in sequence based on the corresponding relation between the position in the material distribution sequence and the material after the materials to be distributed of all types are distributed in the material distribution sequence. By uniformly inserting and distributing the materials to be distributed of different types according to the length of the material distribution sequence, the centralized stacking of the materials of the same type is avoided, and the uniformity of overall distribution of the materials can be remarkably improved, so that the fairness of material distribution is improved.
assignees: WEIMENG CHUANGKE NETWORK TECH CHINA CO LTD

title_en: Bid evaluation integrated with bid and bid tendering Bidding system and method of (2)
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of electronic commerce and business process management, and discloses a bidding system and a bidding method integrating bidding evaluation, wherein the system and the method comprise a characteristic decoupling module for automatically disassembling each bidding document into anonymous characteristic fragments separated from the identity of the bidding person, and synchronously establishing a background internal mapping table to encrypt the tracing relation of the recording fragments; the distributed comparison module pushes anonymous feature segment pairs which come from different bidders and aim at the same bid evaluation factor to bid evaluation experts to collect binary judgment data and criterion labels, and the consensus ranking module aggregates the binary judgment data of all the experts, calculates a quality score reflecting group consensus through a probability model and combines weights to generate a preliminary total ranking. The invention realizes the closed loop of deep anonymity, objective sequencing and logic verification of the evaluation, and remarkably improves the fairness, objectivity and accuracy of the evaluation.
assignees: ZHONGCHENG ZHIXIN ENG CONSULTING GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Urban update section boundary dividing method and system based on cadastre data
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban cadastral data analysis, and discloses a cadastral data-based urban updating zone boundary dividing method and system, which are characterized in that cadastral data are associated by collecting the dividing of an updating zone of a target city, an improved DTW algorithm is adopted, the method comprises the steps of screening current situation boundary address effective points and newly added candidate points with history continuity from current situation actual measurement data, extracting spatial features and ownership features, fusing the spatial features and the ownership features, constructing a feature matrix by using fused feature vectors, constructing a spatial ownership dual-constraint graph neural network, predicting a final boundary point set of an updated patch area of a target city, and generating a final land block boundary address boundary. Therefore, the invention realizes the joint optimization of space rationality and equity rationality by utilizing the double-constraint feature fusion while establishing accurate association between history and current situation address data by introducing the improved DTW algorithm and the space equity double-constraint graph neural network, and improves the division precision and division efficiency of the boundary address of the urban update slice area.

title_en: Urban living circle planning method, device, equipment, medium and product
abstract_en: The invention discloses a city life circle planning method, a device, equipment, a medium and a product, belonging to the life circle planning technical field, wherein the method comprises the steps of preprocessing a city data set, wherein the preprocessing comprises weighting city infrastructure and public service facility data of different types by adopting an entropy weight method; the method comprises the steps of carrying out nuclear density search on a preprocessed city data set, determining search radius based on the center theory of the Krigler in the nuclear density search process, respectively determining cores of life circles of different levels based on different nuclear density graphs, and respectively determining the range of the life circle of each level based on the core of the life circle of each level and road data of a first city. The method can accurately divide the urban living circles, and the divided urban living circles can scientifically and reasonably deconstruct the urban space structure, so that the efficiency and fairness of urban resource allocation are improved, and the rationality of urban planning and management is enhanced.

title_en: Blind eye shopping control method and system based on intelligent matching technology
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the commodity purchasing field, and discloses a blind eye purchasing control method and a blind eye purchasing control system based on an intelligent matching technology, wherein only commodity standard library information is displayed through initialization setting so as to hide the identity of a supplier, and the blind eye purchasing is realized; the method comprises the steps of obtaining provider main data, commodity standard library data and real-time purchasing demand data in real time, calculating a provider performance score by utilizing a multi-dimensional weighted scoring model to measure comprehensive performance capability, calculating a cost performance index based on a commodity standard library and real-time demand to evaluate commodity comprehensive value, dynamically generating a sum distribution value of a same group by combining a sum occupancy rate and the performance score, and finally calculating a matching score by the comprehensive performance score, the cost performance index and the sum distribution value, and intelligently screening the provider. The method improves the contract resource allocation efficiency, prevents the limit from overrun or idling, enhances the data safety, reduces the risk of order tampering and historical migration conflict, and integrally optimizes the fairness, reliability and automation level of the purchasing system.
assignees: STATE GRID E COMMERCE TECH CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for evaluating information value of collaborative scheduling excitation and sharing application
abstract_en: The invention provides a method and a system for evaluating and sharing application of information value of collaborative scheduling excitation, which comprise the following steps: the household nodes collect multi-source information such as energy storage, distributed output, electricity consumption and the like, construct quality indexes according to credibility, timeliness and marginal contribution and combine the quality indexes into scheduling characteristics. The centralized control end quantifies the value of each information source based on marginal benefit and improved Shapley contribution metric (layered Monte Carlo sampling approximation), generates value weight and updates node reputation. And embedding the information value weight and the reputation factor into an optimized scheduling model, and adopting a main-auxiliary decoupling solving framework to perform layered iterative solving under the matched information contribution distribution and clearing framework to form and issue an executable control instruction. And converting the benefits into compensation or points according to the contribution degree of the information of each node according to the period to finish settlement. The method systematically excavates the data potential of the user side on the premise of not remarkably increasing hardware investment, and improves the economy, toughness and cooperative fairness of the micro-grid.

title_en: Electric automobile cluster participation income distribution method based on aggregator mode
abstract_en: The invention provides an electric vehicle cluster participation profit distribution method based on an aggregator mode, which comprises the following steps of establishing an electric vehicle user willingness model by evaluating the electric vehicle user willingness, regulating and controlling an EV by an aggregator through a monomer EV charging and discharging model, participating in a frequency modulation market to obtain profits, and distributing the obtained profits to the aggregator and an EV owner based on shapley value theory. The electric vehicle user willingness model solves the problem that electric vehicle users participate in response influence factors, provides EV real-time margin, solves the problems of unreasonable profit allocation among electric vehicle users, unreasonable user contribution, unreasonable profit and the like, considers the energy resource occupation of the EV in energy cost allocation based on shapley value theory, considers the frequency modulation contribution of the EV in frequency modulation profit, and solves the problem of fairness of profit allocation between EVA and EV owners.

title_en: Method and system for distributed distribution of water resources in multiple-agent reinforcement learning watershed based on physical guidance
abstract_en: The invention relates to the crossing field of water management and artificial intelligence, and the disclosed method solves the problems of difficult coordination of multi-main-body benefit conflict, insufficient utilization of a drainage basin space topological structure, physical constraint, splitting in a decision process, limitation of self-adaptation capability and the like in the prior art. The method comprises the steps of abstracting a drainage basin into a directed graph structure, generating node embedded vectors by utilizing a graph attention network guided by physics, explicitly introducing physical constraint factors into an attention mechanism, configuring intelligent agents for each sub-drainage basin to perform distributed strategy learning, performing collaborative training by adopting a multi-intelligent depth deterministic strategy gradient algorithm, guiding fair distribution by using a global reward function in a Nash product form, and combining a local reward function containing nonlinear physical penalty items to ensure physical constraints such as water balance. The invention realizes the distributed, physical consistent and self-adaptive optimal configuration of the water resources in the river basin, and is mainly used for improving the fairness, efficiency and feasibility of water resource allocation.

title_en: Printing order commission and resource allocation linkage method based on multi-channel data collaboration
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of data collaborative analysis, in particular to a printing order commission and resource allocation linkage method based on multichannel data collaboration, which comprises the steps of integrating various key information of an order by constructing an order-resource map to reflect the association of the order and resources; the method comprises the steps of inputting an order-resource map into a map neural network model, extracting map embedded vectors, constructing subgraphs, excavating complex relations between orders and resources, achieving accurate initialization of bisection and resource nodes, sharing local subgraphs through distributed communication, generating a global commission resource map, achieving centralized overall planning of all channels and all resources, guaranteeing that commission and resource allocation decisions are based on the principle of overall optimization, generating a matrix and issuing instructions through linkage operation according to the global map, guaranteeing that orders of all channels obtain corresponding resources and commissions according to the principle of fairness and rationality, executing a node combination state execution algorithm, uploading data, and dynamically optimizing resource allocation paths in real time.

title_en: Multi-park comprehensive energy system optimal operation method considering energy mutual-aid contribution degree
abstract_en: A multi-park comprehensive energy system optimization operation method considering energy mutual contribution degree comprises the steps of establishing a multi-park comprehensive energy system key equipment model, including a cogeneration unit model, other energy conversion equipment models and energy storage equipment models formed by an electric refrigerating unit and an absorption refrigerating unit, establishing a multi-park comprehensive energy system cooperative game optimization model, including an objective function formed by total cost C of a cooperative alliance formed by N parks, constraint conditions formed by alliance energy supply and demand constraint, energy purchasing constraint, equipment power constraint and energy storage equipment constraint, and distributing the total cost C of the cooperative alliance by utilizing an improved shape method. The model for minimizing the total cost of the alliance, which is built by the invention, comprehensively considers the operation constraint of the energy conversion equipment and the energy storage equipment and the energy interaction among parks, effectively realizes the collaborative optimization operation of MCIES, ensures the fairness and the rationality of the alliance benefit distribution, and enhances the stability of the alliance.
assignees: NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Financial transaction risk assessment method, device, equipment and medium based on federal forgetting learning
abstract_en: The application discloses a financial transaction risk assessment method, a device, equipment and a medium based on federal forgetting learning, which relate to the technical field of federal forgetting learning and are applied to a central server, and comprise the steps of determining an original model trained by the central server and a plurality of financial institution clients through federal learning, and remaining financial institution clients corresponding to the federal forgetting learning; and determining a target forgetting model corresponding to federal forgetting learning according to an optimal solution of the function to be optimized, and evaluating financial transaction risks related to a central server and the clients of the rest financial institutions through the target forgetting model. Therefore, the multi-objective optimization function can be constructed by combining the forgetting verification index, the global stability index and the local fairness index, and the objective forgetting model can be obtained by function solving, so that the efficiency and effect of federal forgetting learning can be improved.

title_en: Power grid distribution strategy decision method, computer equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The embodiment of the application discloses a power grid distribution strategy decision method, computer equipment and a computer readable storage medium. The method for deciding the power distribution strategy of the power grid is respectively applied to micro-grids and power distribution network operators, and achieves the purpose of maximizing benefits of all parties in energy trading through limited information exchange on the premise of protecting privacy of all parties by establishing a master multi-slave game model. Therefore, the application can form dynamic game bidding between the micro-grid and the power distribution network operators, and the bidding can be completed only by conveying part of key information. The privacy and fairness among the micro-grids are guaranteed, and meanwhile, the communication burden in the bidding process is reduced. The small amount of information transmission not only meets the fairness of competition, but also improves the response speed of power transaction. The flexible participation enthusiasm of the micro-grid is stimulated, and the energy and asset utilization rate of the power distribution network is improved.
assignees: YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD ELECTRIC POWER RES INST;KUNMING POWER SUPPLY BUREAU YUNNAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Photovoltaic and electro-hydrogen charging station power transaction optimization method considering conditional risk value theory
abstract_en: The invention discloses a photovoltaic and electric hydrogen charging station power transaction optimization method considering a conditional risk value theory, which comprises the steps of firstly establishing a photovoltaic optimization model and an electric hydrogen charging station optimization model, then introducing a dynamic risk penalty factor into a system optimization objective function, constructing a conditional risk value cost photovoltaic objective function, constructing a photovoltaic-electric hydrogen charging station collaborative optimization model according to the electric hydrogen charging station optimization model and the objective function based on the conditional risk value cost photovoltaic, adopting an improved self-adaptive alternating direction multiplier algorithm to distributively solve the transaction electric quantity and the transaction electric price between the photovoltaic and the electric hydrogen charging station, finally determining an initial profit distribution scheme based on the photovoltaic-electric hydrogen charging station collaborative optimization model to obtain an optimal distribution result, and realizing reasonable balance of overall system benefit and individual contribution degree by optimizing the adjustment coefficient to ensure that the distribution result meets the dual objective of collaborative fairness and transaction excitation simultaneously.

title_en: Warehouse logistics-oriented different-speed multi-AGV nerve divide-by-two scheduling method and device
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of path optimization and intelligent decision making, and provides a warehouse logistics-oriented multi-AGV nerve divide-and-conquer scheduling method and device, aiming at the problems of unbalanced multi-agent collaborative heterogeneous scheduling and low efficiency in the prior art, wherein the method is implemented by constructing a MDMTSP-V problem model aiming at minimizing the maximum travel time; the method comprises the steps of designing a neural dividing and controlling framework, decomposing a warehouse logistics problem into two stages of urban allocation and sub-travel business planning and solving, constructing a neural allocation strategy network, fusing spatial characteristics and heterogeneous speed characteristics, realizing efficient and fair urban cluster division, carrying out end-to-end training on the network by adopting a reinforcement learning mechanism, optimizing an allocation strategy, and solving the sub-TSP problem of each agent by adopting a high-efficient precision algorithm. The invention combines the learning ability of the neural network with the accuracy of the classical optimization algorithm, and remarkably improves the fairness and the overall efficiency of the warehouse logistics multi-agent collaborative heterogeneous scheduling scheme.

title_en: Cooperative optimization method and device for urban village property safety and space reconstruction
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cooperative optimization method and device for urban village property safety and space reconstruction, and relates to the technical field of urban updating and space management. The method is used for solving the problems that the conflict stacking of property rights is complex, the extrusion risk of low-income tenants is high, and the space scheme is difficult to integrate. The method comprises the steps of integrating cadastral data, a three-dimensional building model and income distribution information to generate a title conflict distribution diagram, simulating multi-class title disposal paths and space constraint thereof based on the conflict diagram, calculating the release space and volume rate compensation requirement of illegal construction and disassembly, outputting a space decoupling diagram, inputting the decoupling diagram into a risk model, predicting the loss scale of tenants and the fracture risk of social networks to generate a risk early warning diagram, constructing a three-party income distribution model of governments, villagers and developers, dynamically adjusting the proportion of guarantee rooms, and iteratively optimizing an updating scheme to form a collaborative scheme package considering fairness and space efficiency.

title_en: Rights distribution method, device, equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application relates to a rights and interests distributing method, device, equipment and storage medium, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining a payment triggering message of a target user, wherein the payment triggering message carries an ID of the target user; according to the target user ID, a data interface is called to obtain target data and target equity ID related to equity distribution, the target risk level of equity distribution failure of the target user is estimated according to the target data, an equity distribution strategy to be used is determined according to the target risk level, and the target equity corresponding to the target equity ID is distributed to the target user according to the equity distribution strategy. According to the method, based on a mechanism of dynamically matching the rights and interests distribution strategy by the target risk level, distribution holes in a high-risk scene can be avoided in advance, probability of rights and interests distribution failure is reduced from the source, user consultation quantity caused by the distribution failure is further reduced, and response pressure, processing pressure and communication cost of customer service team are effectively reduced.
assignees: BEIJING QIYI CENTURY SCIENCE & TECHNOLOGY CO LTD

title_en: Carbon entropy theory-based power system carbon emission tracing method, system, equipment and medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of carbon emission monitoring and accounting of an electric power system, and discloses a carbon emission tracing method, a system, equipment and a medium of the electric power system based on a carbon entropy theory, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining power data and full life cycle carbon emission data of each equipment and load node in the electric power system; converting the full life cycle carbon emission data of each device into the equivalent carbon intensity of the device, defining a carbon entropy function by combining the principles of energy conservation and thermodynamic entropy increase, constructing a carbon entropy transfer matrix, calculating the equivalent carbon intensity of each load node, and quantitatively evaluating the carbon responsibility allocation fairness of each load node through the load side fairness deviation coefficient. According to the invention, the irreversibility and additivity principles of thermodynamic entropy are introduced into electric power carbon emission modeling, so that unified calculation of energy loss and carbon transmission is realized, physical consistency and statistical fairness of carbon emission allocation are improved, and scientific support is provided for electric power system carbon emission monitoring, carbon asset management and green electric power transaction.

title_en: Improved Shapley virtual power plant multi-layer benefit distribution method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multilayer benefit distribution method for improving a Shapley virtual power plant, and belongs to the technical field of benefit distribution. The method comprises the steps of constructing a multi-layer benefit distribution framework of a virtual power plant, dividing a participating main body into a first layer core main body and a second layer subdivision main body, adopting a shape value method based on cloud center of gravity improvement for first layer distribution with a small number of main bodies, correcting the traditional shape value by introducing three correction factors of resource investment, risk bearing and emission reduction contribution, improving fairness and rationality of distribution, and adopting a hierarchical sampling shape approximation method based on reinforcement learning for second layer distribution or large-scale scenes with a large number of main bodies to perform efficient approximate calculation so as to solve the problem of 'combined explosion'. The invention realizes the fairness and efficiency balance of the benefit distribution of multiple subjects of the virtual power plant, and effectively supports the stable and sustainable development of the virtual power plant alliance.

title_en: User participation auxiliary service sharing method, system, equipment and medium based on dynamic analysis
abstract_en: The invention discloses a sharing and sharing method, a system, equipment and a medium for user participation auxiliary service based on dynamic analysis, which relate to the technical field of electric auxiliary service and comprise the steps of establishing an auxiliary service benefit quantization model of user participation, and quantizing the benefit degree obtained by each user due to participation in the auxiliary service; the method comprises the steps of determining corresponding cost sharing proportion based on the total benefit of users, calculating sharing amount of each user by combining supply cost, operation cost and risk cost of auxiliary service, setting step-type excitation coefficients and influence factors according to the sharing amount, participation frequency and response quality of each user, calculating final excitation amount of the user, establishing a dynamic adjustment and constraint model of mechanism operation, and periodically adjusting each parameter and factor. According to the invention, the user benefit is used as a calculation basis of cost sharing, the participation behavior quality is brought into incentive adjustment, the fairness of auxiliary service cost distribution is improved, and the enthusiasm of user participation and the flexibility of operation are enhanced.

title_en: In-situ examination route generation method, examination component and examination method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an on-site examination route generation method, an examination assembly and an examination method, and relates to the technical field of on-site examination. The method has the advantages of avoiding excessive use of target points and the phenomenon of bundling students by uniformly distributing the initial examination point selection times, using a random arrangement algorithm and a selection counter, improving examination fairness, ensuring that plant types in the same examination route are not repeated by integrating plant type information of the target points, enriching examination contents and avoiding examination point repetition, realizing integrated management of generation, distribution, navigation and result processing of the examination route by combining an on-site examination component and an on-site examination method, and improving convenience and effectiveness of an examination system.

title_en: Multi-channel fund integration method for national digital equity platform in combination with business management scene
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-channel fund integration method of a national digital rights and interests platform in a business management scene, and relates to the technical field of financial data processing. The method realizes unified integration management of multi-source funds such as government funds, commercial income, bank running water and the like by establishing a plurality of independent integrating pools such as a commercial integrating pool, a social management integrating pool and the like. The system employs an event driven architecture to configure a plurality of profit items, each profit item containing a unique code identification, profit calculation formulas, and entry rules. When the user executes the actions of payment, answering questions and the like, the system automatically matches corresponding profit items, determines profit values through a special calculation formula and distributes the profit values to the score pool and the user account according to a preset proportion. The invention solves the problems of the traditional system such as the decentralized management of funds, the rigidity of allocation rules, the insufficient transparency and the like, realizes the intelligent profit allocation based on the user behavior, supports the concurrent processing of ten thousand grades per second, and provides high-efficiency technical support for digital social management and business operation.
assignees: QINGDAO BLUEPRINT THINK TANK INFORMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Garment production automatic time accounting method and system based on Internet of things and provided with offer one's services
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for calculating the working time of offer one's services in clothing production based on the Internet of things, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining production assignment task data of a current sewing machine station, judging whether the current sewing machine station is an effective working station according to the production assignment task data, continuously monitoring and collecting a bottom layer operation parameter sequence of the current sewing machine station through sensing equipment of the Internet of things, judging the bottom layer operation parameter sequence by offer one's services dynamic state based on a predefined effective working time judging logic rule, recording the duration time of entering the effective working state each time by a high-precision timer and accumulating to generate effective working time structured data, and generating a visual report and analysis data for performance management, production efficiency analysis and process optimization based on the effective working time structured data. The automatic calculation based on the real operation data of the equipment can be realized, personal errors and falsification are avoided, and the fairness, the credibility, the objectivity and the accuracy of the data are ensured.
assignees: BEIJING EASTONE HUARUI TECH CO LTD

title_en: Mixed automatic driving sharing travel driver-multiplier matching method based on behavior perception
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of shared taxi taking systems, and discloses a behavior awareness-based hybrid automatic driving shared travel driver-passenger matching method, which comprises the steps of receiving passenger order information through a platform and collecting matchable vehicle information (HV and AV); the method comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer optimization model, generating an order recommendation scheme and commission for the HV which can be used currently, constructing a Markov model based on response behaviors of a human driver, obtaining response behavior probability of the Markov model, and generating a final scheme through the optimization model. According to the method, the selection behavior of a human driver on an order is considered, behavior perception optimization is combined with MDP, a multi-objective decision model at an individual level is built for each HV, a high-value user response is predicted by using a behavior model based on logit, high-value user selection, automatic driving vehicle availability and platform targets are integrated, a final order-vehicle distribution scheme is generated, and the overall dispatching result is guaranteed to have efficiency and fairness.

title_en: Library seat reservation optimization method and system integrating user behaviors and situation awareness
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent libraries, in particular to a library seat reservation optimization method and system integrating user behaviors and situation awareness, wherein the method comprises the steps of firstly constructing a multi-source data fusion frame and integrating historical behavior, real-time situation and seat state data of a user; designing an Att-BiLSTM model, and dynamically predicting the occupied time length and the default probability of the user seat; finally, generating an optimal seat allocation strategy through a deep reinforcement learning decision model, integrating the user behavior and situation awareness, and based on the real desensitization data verification of the universities, the method and the system for optimizing the library seat reservation, disclosed by the invention, have the advantages that the average utilization rate of seats is improved by 18.7%, the user default rate is reduced by 15.3%, the allocation fairness and the user satisfaction are obviously improved, and a reliable technical support is provided for the intelligent management and personalized service of library space resources.

title_en: An optimization device and method for relief supplies distribution based on floating population data and equity
title_ko: 유동인구 데이터 분석 및 에퀴티를 고려한 재난구호물자 물류 최적화 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 유동인구 데이터 분석 및 에퀴티를 고려한 재난구호물자 물류 최적화 모델 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른, 유동인구 데이터 분석 및 에퀴티를 고려한 재난구호물자 물류 최적화 모델 방법은, 유동인구 데이터를 분석하여, 재난취약계층의 위치 데이터를 추정하는 단계; 상기 추정된 위치 데이터를 수요지점으로 하는 재난구호물자의 전달 경로를 설계하는 다수의 물류 솔루션을 구축하는 단계; 및 상기 다수의 물류 솔루션 중에서, 재난취약계층 Equity 관련 지표(Slack) 및 재난구호물자 물류에 필요한 비용(Cost)을 고려하여, 최적 솔루션을 도출하는 단계를 포함 할 수 있다.
assignees: ULSAN NAT INST SCIENCE & TECH UNIST

title_en: System software joint member business mode realization system supporting cross-platform account intercommunication
abstract_en: The invention provides a system software joint member business mode realization system supporting cross-platform account intercommunication, and relates to the technical field of computer software. The system solves the problems of isolated account number, loose member rights and interests management, low merchant cooperation efficiency and insufficient user awareness of the existing cross-platform software through an account intercommunication module, a joint member management module, a data linkage module, a merchant cooperation module, a user interaction module, a newly added rights and interests monitoring sub-module and a rights and interests adjustment notification sub-module. The method and the system have the core that the cross-platform intercommunication of account numbers is realized by means of unified identity authentication, and a dynamic equity combination, real-time equity monitoring, intelligent benefit splitting and active notification mechanism are combined to provide a combined member service of 'one account is communicated, equity is cleared and notification is accurate' for users, meanwhile, accurate operation of merchants is facilitated, risks are reduced, and finally, three-party value optimization and ecological win-win of multiple platforms, merchants and users are realized.
assignees: SHANDONG LIUXIN NETWORK TECH CO LTD

title_en: Education and evaluation integrated verifiable generation and causal optimization education intelligent system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent system and method for education and evaluation-oriented integrated verifiable generation and causal optimization education. The system comprises a data access and learning image, a knowledge retrieval and knowledge graph, a Verifiable Generation (VGE), consistency/contradiction rate/coverage rate verification, multi-expert agent collaboration and arbitration, causal structure learning and anti-facts optimization, a context protocol and edge-Yun Shuanghuan compliance module. The method comprises the steps of selecting optimal intervention based on a causal objective function, closing a loop, writing back a teaching plan, a calendar and a task list, realizing end-to-end optimization of question, reading, lecture and teaching intervention, improving learning gain and considering fairness and teacher workload.

title_en: Green control parameter combination optimization method, system and storage medium for user demand response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a green control parameter combination optimization method, a system and a storage medium for user demand response, and belongs to the technical field of electric power energy. Relates to the technical field of power distribution automation. The method comprises the steps of obtaining green electricity consumption data, electricity price information and constraint conditions of a user side, constructing a demand decision model of the user under different prices and constraints to obtain a user decision relation set, deriving optimal decisions of the user under different control parameters based on the relation set to obtain a user reaction function, embedding the user reaction function as a subordinate layer equilibrium constraint, constructing a Stackelberg double-layer optimization model with comprehensive performance as an upper layer objective function, and solving the double-layer optimization model to obtain optimal control parameters. The invention is used for solving the problems that the conventional green control parameter setting depends on experience, the user differential response is difficult to be described, and the efficiency and fairness are difficult to be considered.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID ANHUI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Shared energy storage dynamic configuration method and system based on income distribution strategy
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of energy storage analysis, and discloses a shared energy storage dynamic configuration method and system based on a benefit distribution strategy. The method comprises the steps of obtaining electricity demand and photovoltaic data of a user, quantitatively analyzing energy storage utilization contribution degree, establishing a profit distribution parameter, collecting photovoltaic historical data, decomposing uncertainty into three components, establishing a differentiated demand prediction model, constructing a source load matching degree evaluation system, calculating real-time, time period and daily matching degree to obtain a capacity configuration demand matrix, inputting a multi-user collaborative optimization algorithm, obtaining an optimal capacity distribution scheme through profit distribution strategy and benefit maximization, establishing a dynamic adjustment mechanism, monitoring profits in real time, redistributing capacity, and forming a feedback optimization mechanism and an operation configuration report. The application solves the problems of undefined revenue distribution and difficult photovoltaic uncertainty energy storage configuration of multiple investment subjects, and improves the operation efficiency and the revenue distribution fairness of the shared energy storage system.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Transaction generation price intelligence technology and AI method based on agricultural supply chain vector metadata
abstract_en: The invention provides a transaction generation price intelligence technology and an AI method based on agricultural supply chain vector metadata, which relate to the technical field of agricultural product transaction. The artificial intelligent transaction price generation topological structure comprises an input layer neuron, a hidden layer neuron and an output layer neuron, wherein the AI system physical component comprises a feedback and optimization module, a multi-stage transaction support module and a modularized interface. The business body can acquire information transaction data in a second level, the transaction business decision is shortened and graded from the heaven, the transaction time is shortened by more than 30%, the transaction cost is reduced by more than 13-46%, and the settlement cost is shortened from a plurality of days to a plurality of hours. The market fairness is enhanced, quotation and transaction mode innovation are realized, and the method has the advantages of universality and low marginal cost.

title_en: Two-stage collaborative peak shaving method and system for operator-virtual power plant
abstract_en: A two-stage collaborative peak shaving method and system for an operator-virtual power plant comprise the steps of collecting historical multi-source data and preprocessing, constructing a wind-light output fuzzy set based on the preprocessed historical multi-source data, training an LSTM (localized virtual machine) by using the historical multi-source data, performing super-parameter optimization on the LSTM by using an improved PSO (particle swarm optimization) algorithm, obtaining wind-light output predicted values by using the trained LSTM based on real-time multi-source data, constructing an operator bidding model, solving to obtain demand period quotations, report amounts and conditional risk values of each member in a VPP (virtual power plant), calculating Shapley values of each member in the VPP, calculating risk correction weights of each member in the VPP, distributing capacity of each member based on the risk correction weights, outputting collaborative decision instructions, and pushing the collaborative decision instructions to the operator and the virtual power plant execution system. The invention ensures fairness and rationality of profit allocation of operators under the condition of controllable risk under the condition of meeting optimization of objective functions of demand side response and auxiliary service bidding model.
assignees: NANJING POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID INFORMATION & TELECOMMUNICATION CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Local area network and main network global optimal operation method, device, equipment and storage medium based on asymmetric Nash negotiation
abstract_en: The application provides a local area network and main network global optimal operation method, device and equipment based on asymmetric Nash negotiation and a storage medium, and relates to the technical field of power grids. The method comprises the steps of carrying out interaction characteristic analysis of different operation modes of a local area network according to functional characteristics and structural characteristics of different types of local power grids, establishing a model for coordinated and optimized operation of the different types of local power grids and a large power grid, fully considering product quality, yield and demand response characteristics of an electric smelting magnesium enterprise, constructing a model for coordinated and optimized operation of the local power grids and the large power grid, which aims at optimizing the overall operation cost of the system, carrying out transaction on electric energy transmission between the power grids by using respective interaction cost coefficients so as to achieve global optimization of the whole system, constructing a benefit distribution model among multiple main bodies based on Nash negotiation theory, and introducing comprehensive contribution rate to quantify the bargaining capability of each main body, so that contribution of each main body is compensated, and fairness of benefit distribution is improved.

title_en: system
abstract_en: A system is provided.SOLUTION: A system comprising: means for automatically collecting information from social media or other information sources on a network based on a preset keyword when a disaster occurs; means for assessing reliability of the collected information and indicating the reliability in percentage; means for plotting the assessed information on a map and visually displaying a disaster-stricken situation; means for proposing a necessary rescue plan based on the disaster-stricken situation and presenting supplies, human resources, and a transport route necessary for rescue; and means for calculating an optimal physical distribution route based on real-time traffic information and making a transport plan for relief supplies.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Methanol fuel supply risk early warning method and system for ship
abstract_en: The application relates to the field of ships and discloses a methanol fuel supply risk early warning method and a methanol fuel supply risk early warning system for ships, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining real-time environment state information of ships and running state data of methanol fuel supply system equipment, and preprocessing to obtain smoothed running state sequence data; the method comprises the steps of calculating a window boundary value of a replenishment time point, identifying an operation stable section corresponding to a stable environment, determining an initial replenishment time point, monitoring the liquid level change rate of a daily tank for methanol, adjusting conveying parameters to obtain a first conveying parameter set if the liquid level change rate exceeds a threshold value, calculating the strength of a route mutation signal, correcting the replenishment window boundary value if the threshold value exceeds the threshold value, generating fusion data by fusing real-time liquid level fluctuation and the corrected window value, determining a safe conveying reference for the methanol, generating a control instruction set under the reference constraint, and executing methanol supply allocation. By the technical scheme, the suitability of the supply opportunity and the route working condition is improved.

title_en: Emergency multi-airport flight cooperative release method based on dual fairness
abstract_en: The invention is applicable to the technical field of airport regulation and control, and provides an emergency multi-airport flight collaborative release method based on dual fairness, which comprises the following steps of obtaining data; respectively establishing mathematical models which aim at minimizing total delay deduced time of all non-cancelled flights, aim at minimizing total loss of all cancelled flights, aim at maximizing airport fairness of all flight delay deduced time deviation of each airport and aim at maximizing airline fairness of all flight cancelled flight loss deviation of each airline company, converting the four mathematical models into target planning models, and solving problems based on a solver. The invention seeks the coupling relation among the dispatching cost, airport fairness and avionics fairness, improves the cooperative release efficiency of multiple airports, and provides technical support for intelligent emergency release of a plurality of daily related airports.
assignees: SHANGHAI AIRPORT AUTHORITY;CHINA ACADEMY OF CIVIL AVIATION SCIENCE AND TECH CHINA CIVIL AVIATION ADMINISTRATION OF AVIATION SAF

title_en: Power grid emergency material intelligent supply chain dynamic allocation and priority ordering method based on reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, which relates to the technical field of power grid emergency management and intelligent supply chains, in particular to a method for dynamically adjusting and prioritizing an intelligent supply chain of power grid emergency supplies based on reinforcement learning, comprising the steps of constructing a digital twin environment model integrating geographic information, real-time traffic, inventory status and fault prediction; defining a reinforcement learning framework, wherein a state space covers stock, in-transit materials, demand urgency and traffic states, an action space comprises material allocation instructions and task priority ordering, a reward function synthesizes shortage relief, delivery timeliness and cost, and a strategy network capable of outputting optimal dynamic allocation strategies is obtained through training an intelligent agent. The invention realizes intelligent dynamic allocation and priority optimization of emergency materials, and effectively improves the emergency response efficiency and resource utilization rate of the power grid.
assignees: MAT BRANCH OF STATE GRID LIAONING ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Method for constructing and verifying drainage basin water resource comprehensive simulation and configuration model
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method for constructing and verifying a watershed water resource comprehensive simulation and configuration model, and belongs to the technical field of water resource planning and configuration. Based on a natural-social binary water circulation structure, a flow production, confluence and allocation module are coupled, a calculation unit is divided, a topological relation is determined, a model is built by taking minimum water shortage rate and optimal water supply fairness as targets, a multi-source database containing meteorological, land utilization, reservoir and water consumption unit information is built, iteration calibration and verification are carried out on natural water circulation and social water circulation parameters by utilizing historical data, and a model with reliable verification is coupled with underlying surface and climate situation data of the planning year in the future, so that a water resource optimal allocation scheme is operated and output. The invention solves the problems of low coupling degree and poor precision of the existing model, and realizes high-precision simulation and scientific configuration of the water resource system of the flow field.
assignees: CHINA INST WATER RESOURCES & HYDROPOWER RES

title_en: An optimization method and device for humanitarian logistics through truck-drone integration
title_ko: 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법 및 장치
abstract_ko: 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법 및 장치가 개시된다.  본 발명의 일실시예에 따른, 트럭-드론 연계를 통한 재난구호물자 전달 최적화 방법은, 재난이 발생한 피해 지역 내에서, 복수의 노드에 관한 노드 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 상기 피해 지역으로 재난구호물자를 전달하기 위한 전달 수단으로, 하나의 트럭과, 상기 트럭에 장착되는 n개(상기 n은 자연수)의 드론에 관한 스펙 데이터를 수집하는 단계; 상기 노드 데이터와 상기 스펙 데이터를 고려하여, 상기 트럭과 상기 드론과의 연계에 의한 상기 재난구호물자의 전달이 이루어지도록, 상기 복수의 노드의 적어도 일부를 잇는 최적 경로를 채택하는 단계; 및 상기 채택된 최적 경로를 따라, 상기 트럭 또는 상기 드론을 이동시키는 단계를 포함 할 수 있다.
assignees: ULSAN NAT INST SCIENCE & TECH UNIST

title_en: Geolocation Verification of Humanitarian Aid Token Distribution
abstract_en: A blockchain-based smart contract system for decentralized humanitarian aid distribution implementing multi-stage verification protocols, government database integration, and emergency protocol switching capabilities. The Global Positioning Satellite Food (GPSF) Token Protocol comprises specialized hardware and software systems for zone-locked token distribution with geolocation-enforced access controls and adaptive verification algorithms that switch between comprehensive community aid verification and expedited emergency aid verification based on real-time disaster declarations and conflict zone detection. The system establishes multi-layered fraud prevention architecture combining biometric liveness detection, cross-document correlation algorithms, anti-spoofing detection systems, and real-time government database verification to prevent fraudulent aid claims while ensuring legitimate beneficiaries receive assistance within minutes. The protocol implements atomic cross-chain protocols with multi-signature escrow mechanisms and threshold-signature authentication requiring consensus from multiple authorized entities, creating a trustless environment for humanitarian aid across routine aid programs, emergency disaster response, and active conflict zone operations.

title_en: Method for distributing profit of aggregate in consideration of comprehensive contribution in electric-carbon-green evidence market
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of electric power systems, in particular to a method for distributing the profit of an aggregate, which considers comprehensive contribution in the electric-carbon-green evidence market, and comprises the following steps of S1, collecting and preprocessing operation data of an aggregate on external and internal resources, S2, constructing output, cost and carbon emission models of wind power, photovoltaic, gas turbines, energy storage and controllable loads, S3, constructing and solving a profit maximization model considering the profit of the electric-carbon-green evidence market and multiple constraints, S4, distributing the first profit based on a Shapley value method, S5, distributing the second time by combining group contribution degree, responsivity and credibility, and introducing a ladder pumping strategy to optimize the profit of the aggregate. According to the invention, through multi-market collaborative optimization, fair distribution based on Shapley values and an excitation mechanism driven by comprehensive contribution, the collaborative unification of aggregate gain maximization, member gain distribution fairness and response performance excitation is realized.
assignees: INNER MONGOLIA POWER GROUP MENGDIAN ECONOMIC TECH RESEARCH INSTITUTE CO LTD;NORTH CHINA ELECTRIC POWER UNIV BAODING

title_en: Designated driving dispatch method, apparatus, electronic device, computer readable storage medium and program product
abstract_en: The embodiment of the invention provides a designated driving dispatch method, a designated driving dispatch device, electronic equipment, a computer-readable storage medium and a program product, and relates to the technical field of computers. The method comprises the steps of carrying out order receiving judgment by combining customer order information and a system load state, improving the running stability of the system and the rationality of order receiving, screening target suppliers with service capability based on the customer order information after determining the order receiving, obtaining candidate drivers, realizing preliminary matching of the capacity, sorting according to business value data, quality data, driver coverage data and service scores of the target suppliers when the number of the candidate drivers is insufficient, establishing a priority order, expanding a search range of the target suppliers according to the order, dynamically supplementing the candidate drivers, improving the successful order receiving probability in a capacity sparse area, pushing the driving order to all the candidate drivers, sending the driving order to a first receiver, taking efficiency and fairness into consideration, and effectively improving the order receiving success rate and the resource utilization rate.

title_en: Performance management method and system based on rehabilitation technology grading
abstract_en: The invention discloses a performance management method and a performance management system based on rehabilitation technology grading, which relate to the field of medical informatization and hospital performance management, and comprise the following steps of S1, acquiring performance related data of a rehabilitation therapist, wherein the performance related data at least comprises rehabilitation treatment projects executed by the rehabilitation therapist; S2, calculating the personal actual weighted workload of the rehabilitation therapist by utilizing a predefined rehabilitation technology grading model based on the rehabilitation therapy project, determining the workload performance of the rehabilitation therapist according to the proportion of the personal actual weighted workload to the total workload of the department, S3, calculating the basic performance according to basic information of the rehabilitation therapist, calculating the management performance according to management post information of the rehabilitation therapist, and calculating the scientific reward performance and the medical quality performance according to scientific research and service data of the rehabilitation therapist, and S4, integrating the basic performance, the management performance, the scientific reward performance, the medical quality performance and the workload performance to generate the comprehensive performance of the rehabilitation therapist. And fairness and motivation of performance distribution are improved.
assignees: ANHUI PROVINCIAL HOSPITAL THE FIRST AFFILIATED HOSPITAL OF USTC

title_en: Intelligent scheduling method, device and equipment for tobacco leaf vending and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling method, device and equipment for tobacco leaf vending and a storage medium. The method comprises the steps of obtaining target sales information corresponding to each user to be sold and target equipment information corresponding to each tobacco leaf grading equipment, evaluating sales priority of the users to be sold based on the target sales information and the target equipment information, determining target users to be sold, and determining target sales scheduling strategies corresponding to the target users to be sold based on the target equipment information and the target users to be sold, so that the target users to be sold can sell tobacco leaves based on the target sales scheduling strategies. The invention can realize intelligent efficient scheduling of tobacco leaf vending, can meet the dynamic vending demands of large-scale tobacco farmers, improves the overall vending scheduling efficiency of tobacco leaves, reduces the labor cost, ensures the fairness of tobacco leaf vending scheduling, and thereby improves the satisfaction degree of tobacco leaf vending of users.

title_en: Demand management of material requirements planning
abstract_en: Systems and methods are directed toward managing demand, such as for manufacturing in complex supply and/or demand driven environments, including aerospace-industry products and systems, environments with a multitude of stakeholders, and other sophisticated organizations. A production request may be provided with a component identifier for a top-level module component to be produced. Data associated with the component identifier may be determined. The data may include one or more additional component identifiers for sub-components which are to be consumed to produce the top-level module component. Supply allocations for the top-level module component and the sub-components may be generated based at least in part on the data. One or more action signals may be provided to fulfill the production request for the top-level module component according to the supply allocations.

title_en: Multi-stage medical appointment intelligent scheduling optimization method
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the field of medical system optimization technology and computer aided scheduling, and provides a multi-stage medical appointment intelligent scheduling optimization method, which comprises the steps of constructing a multi-stage appointment scheduling model, distinguishing direct and indirect waiting heterogeneity effects, and introducing a virtual scheduling node to adapt discontinuous appointment behaviors; and a logic-based Benders decomposition algorithm and a clustering-based Benders decomposition algorithm are provided, and scheduling evaluation and calculation efficiency are improved through iterative cutting optimization. The invention considers delay tolerance heterogeneity, perception delay heterogeneity and discontinuous reservation constraint simultaneously, effectively optimizes the patient flow, improves inquiry efficiency and reservation fairness, and provides a new direction for medical dynamic resource scheduling.

title_en: system
abstract_en: To provide a system capable of realizing efficient and rapid supply of relief supplies.SOLUTION: A terminal means for inputting necessary items by a user in a chat format or a voice input format, a server means including a means for transmitting input data to a server, a natural language processing means for converting voice data into text data, a necessary item specifying means for analyzing the text data and specifying necessary items and urgency thereof, a means for visualizing necessary items on a map based on an analysis result and geographical information, a disaster data collecting means for collecting disaster data and predicting needs of items, and a prediction model learning means for learning a prediction model; The system includes a machine learning means for improving accuracy, a means for generating an article distribution plan based on an analysis result and a prediction, and a means for notifying the generated distribution plan.SELECTED DRAWING: Figure 1

title_en: Space-time perception and dynamic optimization-based health intelligent collaborative service system and method
abstract_en: The invention discloses a space-time perception and dynamic optimization based health care intelligent cooperative service system and a space-time perception and dynamic optimization based health care intelligent cooperative service method, which belong to the field of aged health care intelligent, and realize the transition of aged health care service from static response to dynamic cooperation by constructing a full-link closed-loop service system of behavior perception, risk early warning, resource scheduling and rights and interests excitation. The accuracy and timeliness of health risk prediction are effectively improved based on ST-GNN (fast Fourier transform-based) behavior map modeling, the service waiting time and the resource empty rate are obviously reduced by a mixed resource cooperative scheduling mechanism, the user viscosity and the platform operation benefit are enhanced by DQN-driven dynamic equity recommendation, and the system has strong consistency and logic closed loop performance as a whole and is suitable for large-scale deployment of urban intelligent health maintenance service platforms.
assignees: BEIJING HEALTHY PENSION GROUP CO LTD

title_en: Public facility layout method and system based on user preference and behavior simulation
abstract_en: The application provides a public facility layout method and a system thereof based on user preference and behavior simulation, wherein the technical key points are that a facility selection preference of a user is obtained through a descriptive preference questionnaire, the influence of each element on the selection behavior is described by utilizing a discrete selection model, and a selection probability prediction model is established by combining overall or crowd-dividing parameters; the method comprises the steps of simulating a facility selection pattern of a demand point by a Monte Carlo method, taking the average utility maximization as a core optimization target, adopting a genetic algorithm to realize iterative search of facility positions to obtain an optimized layout scheme meeting the requirements of efficiency, fairness and multiple dimensions, carrying out index calculation such as matching relation analysis and utility, distance, coverage rate and the like on the result, outputting a visualization scheme, overcoming the defect that a traditional position-allocation model only considers distance, ignores individual differences and relies on candidate points, and providing a scientific and reasonable optimization tool for public service facility planning.

title_en: Intelligent party construction decision optimization method based on multi-source data fusion and virtual simulation
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of party construction and big data analysis, and relates to an intelligent party construction decision optimization method based on multi-source data fusion and virtual simulation, which comprises the steps of constructing a standardized behavior data set by integrating multi-source data such as party identity information, activity records, thought report, party membership dues payment and the like; the method comprises the steps of dynamically distributing data weights by adopting a gradient descent method, improving data quality, combining a space-time similarity algorithm and a track prediction model, realizing accurate division and behavior trend prediction of party groups, introducing a virtual simulation technology to simulate party construction scenes, and optimizing propaganda strategies and resource release. The method realizes decision scientization through data driving, remarkably improves group management efficiency, reduces redundancy cost, enhances adaptability of strategies to regional differences, and ensures fairness and transparency of decision execution. The invention provides technical support for intelligent upgrade of the new times of party construction work, and is suitable for party construction management scenes such as party institutions, enterprises and public institutions and the like.
assignees: INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Cloud control system for electric power material warehousing operation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a cloud control system for electric power material warehousing operations, and relates to the technical field of warehousing operation cloud control. According to the electric power material warehouse operation cloud control system, through integrating the multi-warehouse node cooperative detection module, the material supply distribution module and the material scheduling equipment control module, accurate detection and qualification judgment of multi-warehouse node candidate electric power materials are achieved, the problem that the adaption judgment is on one side only due to the fact that the prior art depends on general attributes is solved, the problem that the allocation priority is disjointed and disordered is solved by determining the adaption fault demand, the efficient warehouse allocation and reliable material allocation sequence in a state through three-dimensional quantitative sequencing, the equipment state and priority are combined to generate a targeted supply allocation list, and an equipment time sequence and path cooperative operation scheme is formulated, so that the problems of confliction of allocation sequence and equipment operation conflict are solved.
assignees: CONSTRUCTION BRANCH HAINAN POWER GRID CO LTD

title_en: Light storage and charging integrated charging pile and shared charging model construction method
abstract_en: The invention discloses an optical storage and charging integrated charging pile and a shared charging model construction method, relates to the technical field of operation optimization of charging piles, and aims to solve the problems of inaccurate data processing, one-sided priority evaluation, stiff resource constraint and the like of the existing shared charging technology. The method is based on space-time associated data of an optical storage and charging system, a user and a power grid, a high-quality dynamic data set is processed and output through a double-index weighting algorithm, a priority sequence is formed by quantifying the charging priority of the user through a three-dimensional coupling algorithm based on the space-time associated data, an energy storage capacity and power grid interaction power constraint model which are dynamically adjusted along with the priority is built by combining the data and the sequence, a multi-objective optimization function of priority self-adaptive weight is built, a charging pile distribution and power scheduling scheme is solved by adopting a self-adaptive particle swarm algorithm, the full-flow coordination of data processing, priority evaluation, resource constraint, optimization targets and dynamic response is achieved, and the high efficiency, fairness and stability of shared charging are improved.
assignees: SUQIAN POWER SUPPLY BRANCH OF STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD;STATE GRID JIANGSU ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD SIHONG COUNTY POWER SUPPLY BRANCH

title_en: Large-area flight recovery energy efficiency optimization method integrating deep learning and genetic algorithm
abstract_en: The invention provides a large-area flight recovery energy efficiency optimization method integrating deep learning and genetic algorithm, belongs to the technical field of intelligent scheduling and optimization, and solves the problem of multi-objective efficient recovery after large-scale flight delay. The technical scheme includes that firstly, standardized dispatching input features and economic loss factors are built by means of real flight data, then, a multi-objective function is designed, total delay, economic loss, serious delay times and dispatching fairness are comprehensively considered, then, a dispatching sample is generated and a training set is constructed based on an evolution strategy, a deep neural network agent model is trained to replace a high-cost evaluation function, and finally, an optimal dispatching scheme is quickly searched in evolution optimization by combining the agent model and an elite screening mechanism. The invention has the beneficial effects of efficiently completing large-scale flight recovery scheduling tasks, taking global efficiency and local fairness into account, helping command departments to quickly formulate recovery strategies, and having stronger practical application value.

title_en: Draft survey case processing progress real-time monitoring and resource rescheduling dispatch system
