abstract_en: The invention discloses a draft survey case processing progress real-time monitoring and resource rescheduling dispatching and dispatching system, which relates to the technical field of draft survey intelligent dispatching and comprises the steps of obtaining draft survey case state information of draft survey cases in a processing link, displaying current state information of each draft survey case in a visual mode on a monitoring platform, generating resource capacity representation capable of being quantitatively evaluated, dispatching and dispatching draft survey case processing with different emergency degrees by adopting a dynamic weight optimization algorithm, and constructing a closed-loop control link. The invention solves the technical problems of state perception lag, rough resource matching, static dispatch strategy, disjoint monitoring and execution and the like in the traditional dispatching mode, improves the response speed, the resource utilization efficiency, the dispatching fairness and the service traceability of draft survey case processing, and provides a highly reliable, quantifiable and extensible technical support for the intellectualization of insurance claims.
assignees: SHAANXI HUIXIANGBAO TECH CONSULTING SERVICE CO LTD

title_en: Dynamic reconfigurable battery network scheduling method and system based on monomer state aggregation in module
abstract_en: A dynamic reconfigurable battery network scheduling method and system based on monomer state polymerization in a module relate to the technical field of electrochemical energy storage systems. The method comprises the steps of acquiring running state parameters of all battery monomers in a battery network, calculating at least one module-level aggregation state index for each battery module based on the state parameters of all the monomers in the battery module, calculating the scheduling urgency of each module according to the module-level aggregation state index, obtaining historical scheduling frequency of each module and calculating the scheduling fairness of each module, fusing the scheduling urgency and the scheduling fairness to obtain comprehensive scheduling priority of each module, and selecting a target module to perform cut-in or cut-out operation according to the comprehensive scheduling priority to finish the reconstruction of the battery network topology. The method is mainly used for dispatching and optimizing the single batteries of the electrochemical energy storage system.
assignees: YUNCHU NEW ENERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Rights resource allocation method, device, equipment, storage medium and product
abstract_en: The application discloses a method, a device, equipment, a storage medium and a product for distributing rights and interests resources, which relate to the technical field of data processing, wherein the method for distributing rights and interests resources comprises the steps of responding to rights and interests resource distribution requests, determining rights and interests resource distribution modes based on the rights and interests resource distribution requests, wherein the rights and interests resource distribution modes comprise manual segmentation, branch office application segmentation and channel end application segmentation; and carrying out the rights and interests allocation according to the rights and interests resource allocation parameters and rights and interests resource allocation strategies. Because the application allocates the equity resources according to the equity resource allocation mode corresponding to the equity resource allocation request, compared with the existing mode of allocating equity resources depending on a fixed organization framework, the mode of the application can allocate equity resources accurately and in multiple dimensions, improves the matching degree of the resources and business requirements and avoids resource mismatch.

title_en: Micro-grid group optimization operation method based on conditional risk value and Nash negotiation
abstract_en: The invention discloses a microgrid group optimization operation method based on conditional risk value and Nash negotiation, which is applied to the technical field of multi-microgrid optimization operation regulation and control. The method comprises the steps of constructing a double-layer energy management bidding model based on a conditional risk value CVaR model and improved Nash negotiation, converting the double-layer energy management bidding model into a single-layer mixed integer linear programming model by adopting a KKT condition and Big-M method, and solving the converted single-layer mixed integer linear programming model by utilizing a CPLEX solver to finish operation optimization of a micro-grid group. The method can improve the order and rationality of energy interaction among the micro-grid groups, and ensure the fairness of benefit distribution while realizing the maximization of social benefit.

title_en: Resident electricity-saving scene carbon benefits method and system based on reference value
abstract_en: The invention discloses a resident electricity-saving scene carbon benefits method and system based on a reference value, and relates to the technical field of carbon benefits. The method comprises the steps of user registration and authorization, multi-source data collection, accounting boundary and scene judgment, emission reduction accurate calculation, data quality control and recording, income distribution and platform support. The system consists of a data aggregation platform module, an accounting model management module and the like. According to the invention, the household population parameter setting differentiated reference value is introduced, the MRV principle is followed for standardized accounting, the fairness and the credibility are improved, the large-scale application is supported, and the problems of unscientific reference setting, irregular accounting and the like in the prior art are effectively solved.
assignees: TIANJIN RICHSOFT ELECTRIC POWER INFORMATION TECH CO LTD;SIJI ZHILIAN TIANJIN INFORMATION COMMUNICATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Multi-district electric automobile cluster scheduling system based on network management
abstract_en: The application discloses a multi-zone electric automobile cluster scheduling system based on network management, which comprises a model execution unit, a cluster management and control unit and a consistency maintenance unit, wherein the model execution unit is used for generating a global Manager, a regional Manager and an Agent model, the Agent is used for describing the charge and discharge states of electric automobiles, the cluster management and control unit is used for carrying out task allocation according to a preset fixed equity queue, a preset competitive equity queue and charging prediction data obtained based on a bidirectional LSTM, calculating the density of an electric automobile cluster and carrying out charging resource allocation according to the density, and the consistency maintenance unit is used for decomposing the global scheduling target of the global Manager into a local decision target of the regional Manager according to an alternate multiplier algorithm, monitoring the execution deviation of the Agent in real time through a deviation correction mechanism and carrying out deviation adjustment based on a dynamic correction instruction. The application can solve the technical problems that the existing model has single function and depends on static rule allocation tasks, and hierarchical decisions are easy to conflict.
assignees: FOSHAN POWER SUPPLY BUREAU GUANGDONG POWER GRID CORP

title_en: BIPV building full life cycle energy benefit and cost allocation method
abstract_en: The invention relates to a full life cycle energy benefit and cost allocation method for a BIPV (building integrated photovoltaic) building, and belongs to the field of building energy management and financial optimization. The technical scheme comprises four modules of data acquisition and modeling, full life cycle financial optimization, intelligent control and income optimization closed loop, block chain multi-party distribution and excitation. The method can break the data island, improve the accuracy of financial evaluation, cooperate with the income target, ensure the fairness of distribution and promote the large-scale development of BIPV industry.

title_en: Medical resource dynamic scheduling method based on deep reinforcement learning
abstract_en: The disclosure provides a medical resource dynamic scheduling method based on deep reinforcement learning, and relates to the technical field of medical resource scheduling. The method comprises the steps of constructing a medical demand state vector according to a multi-source heterogeneous data set, inputting the medical demand state vector into a first-stage reinforcement learning network, outputting an admission demand prediction vector through a prediction agent, combining the demand prediction vector with a resource scheduling environment state, constructing a joint state vector, inputting the joint state vector into a second-stage reinforcement learning network, and outputting resource allocation data indicating configuration actions of various medical resources through the resource scheduling agent, wherein the two networks adopt an asynchronous parallel training mechanism and share part of characteristic coding parameters. The method and the device can improve accuracy of hospital admission demand prediction, response flexibility and scheduling prospective of medical resource allocation, resource utilization rate and patient service fairness, and model training and updating period are shortened.
assignees: The 8th Medical Center Of Chinese Pla General Hospital

title_en: Nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution method and device, storage medium and electronic equipment
abstract_en: The application belongs to the technical field of nuclear power, and particularly relates to a nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution method and device, a computer readable storage medium and electronic equipment. The method comprises the steps of obtaining nuclear power spare part service data of each power plant, constructing a group plant cooperative nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution objective function according to the nuclear power spare part service data, wherein the nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution objective function takes cost minimization and fairness deviation minimization as optimization targets, and carrying out optimization solution on the nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution objective function to obtain a nuclear power spare part inventory parameter distribution result. According to the application, the cost minimization and fairness deviation minimization can be used as optimization targets, the objective function of the inventory parameter distribution of the nuclear power spare parts coordinated by the group factory is constructed, and the obtained inventory parameter distribution result of the nuclear power spare parts can give consideration to the overall cost and fairness, so that the overall management effect is effectively improved.
assignees: CHINA NUCLEAR POWER OPERATIONS CO LTD

title_en: Method and system for distributing rights and interests of park enterprises
abstract_en: The invention discloses a method and a system for distributing rights and interests of a park enterprise, which are applied to the technical field of rights and interests distribution, wherein the method comprises the steps of obtaining data; the method comprises the steps of performing feature extraction processing on photovoltaic power generation data to obtain a photovoltaic power generation curve, performing feature extraction processing on the power utilization data to obtain an enterprise power utilization curve, processing the photovoltaic power generation curve and the enterprise power utilization curve by utilizing a dynamic time warping technology to obtain power utilization curve matching degree, inputting the power utilization curve matching degree, historical green electricity consumption data and acquired green evidence transaction contracts into a constructed equity distribution model to process, obtaining equity distribution indexes of a plurality of enterprises, processing the equity distribution indexes of the enterprises, and performing equity distribution on the enterprises in a target park based on the obtained equity distribution proportion. The method provided by the invention can solve the technical problem of uneven distribution of rights and interests in the park caused by neglecting the intermittence and fluctuation of green electricity, so as to realize the technical effects of equitable and accurate rights and interests distribution.
assignees: ZHEJIANG POWER EXCHANGE CENTER CO LIMITED

title_en: Medical material multi-level warehouse intelligent management system and method based on demand prediction
abstract_en: The invention provides a medical material multi-stage warehouse intelligent management system and method based on demand prediction, wherein the medical material multi-stage warehouse intelligent management system comprises an intelligent identification module, a stock shortage pre-picking module, a demand prediction module, a dynamic priority adjustment module, a multi-target optimization distribution module, a multi-stage warehouse collaborative scheduling module, a real-time monitoring early warning module and an intelligent analysis optimization module, wherein the intelligent identification module is used for realizing quick warehouse-in and warehouse-out operation of medical materials, the stock shortage pre-picking module is used for receiving and recording request applications when the stock is insufficient, the demand prediction module is used for adopting a prediction model with multi-granularity time decomposition, the dynamic priority adjustment module is used for constructing an evaluation system, the multi-target optimization distribution module is used for distributing the materials, the multi-stage warehouse collaborative scheduling module is used for monitoring stock differences of multi-stage warehouses in real time, the real-time monitoring early warning module is used for monitoring warehouses, and the intelligent analysis optimization module is used for generating visual reports. The invention comprehensively improves the intelligent level and the operation efficiency of medical material management. The system can ensure quick response of urgent medical demands, and simultaneously gives consideration to group fairness and resource utilization efficiency, thereby remarkably reducing the risk of shortage and operation cost.

title_en: Grid enterprise carbon quota optimization method, system, equipment and medium based on basketball team algorithm
abstract_en: The invention discloses a grid enterprise carbon quota optimization method, a system, equipment and a medium based on a basketball team algorithm, which relate to the technical field of intelligent optimization and comprise the steps of collecting historical carbon emission data of a grid enterprise, calculating total carbon emission, setting target carbon quota and minimum carbon quota, constructing a multi-dimensional optimization objective function, introducing rewarding and punishing mechanisms, and optimizing and solving the multidimensional optimization objective function by using a group intelligent optimization algorithm to generate a carbon quota allocation scheme, determining whether convergence conditions are met by iteratively updating the position and the speed of each candidate solution, and outputting the carbon quota allocation scheme of the global optimal position as an optimal carbon quota allocation scheme when the convergence conditions are met. The method solves the problems of local optimum and difficult coordination of multiple targets in carbon quota allocation, and remarkably improves fairness, adaptability and execution efficiency of quota allocation while guaranteeing emission reduction targets.

title_en: Multi-main-body operator benefit distribution optimization strategy based on cooperative game
abstract_en: The invention discloses a multi-main-body operator benefit distribution optimization strategy based on cooperative game, and relates to the technical field of micro-energy network park energy distribution. The strategy comprises the steps of constructing IEO, EVA, ACA three-party main body cooperation models, defining objective functions and cooperation constraints of the main bodies, building an improved Shapley value double-weight distribution mechanism based on marginal cost and carbon emission reduction contribution degree, quantifying carbon emission reduction contribution weight through primary distribution and secondary distribution, providing an internal user side commitment-performance secondary distribution model of an aggregator, and realizing reasonable profit distribution by combining a power window, key time period weight and jitter penalty. The method solves the problems of multi-main-body game differentiation, difficulty in quantification of weight distribution and imperfect internal secondary distribution of the micro-energy network park, improves the renewable energy consumption rate and the system flexibility, realizes the unification of distribution fairness, alliance stability and scheduling feasibility, and is suitable for a multi-main-body energy collaborative cooperation scene of the park.

title_en: Intelligent supervision and resource scheduling system for patient ward monitoring state
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of medical informatization and intelligent decision making, and discloses an intelligent supervision and resource scheduling system for monitoring states of patient areas; the method comprises the steps of extracting an association relation between an entity and the entity from acquired patient monitoring data, establishing a semantic knowledge graph, analyzing the semantic knowledge graph based on a constructed semantic prediction model, generating a prediction query response list comprising sign trend prediction and resource demand prediction, deploying multiple agents based on the prediction query response list, interacting the multiple agents with the semantic knowledge graph, acquiring a collaborative scheduling decision vector, generating a supervision instrument panel and an executable task list based on the collaborative scheduling decision vector, performing task execution based on the executable task list by an execution terminal, feeding back an execution effect to update the semantic knowledge graph, and reducing decision-making rigid bureau or sub-optimal allocation in a complex competition scene, so that the overall treatment efficiency and fairness of a disease area are maximized.
assignees: HENAN QINGWO AUTOMATION TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent land mineral management judging method and system based on fairness AI
abstract_en: The invention relates to the AI auxiliary field, in particular to a land mineral management intelligent arbitration method and system based on fairness AI, the method comprises the steps of collecting historical arbitration data, calculating group arbitration result difference to screen out super-threshold attribute, and determining bias factors according to policy text; preprocessing data to construct a bias-removed feature set, taking a gradient lifting tree as a framework, setting bias factors as sensitive attributes, adding statistical uniformity and equal opportunity constraint, enabling a model to depend on a core decision basis through countermeasure training, abutting real-time data after verification and optimization, and outputting decision suggestions and recording. The invention filters historical prejudices from the source, ensures the unification of the fairness and the compliance of AI arbitration, realizes the long-term maintenance of fairness, and finally achieves the unification of intelligent decision and fairness guarantee.
assignees: SHANDONG LIUNIU NETWORK TECH CO LTD;DONGPING COMPREHENSIVE ADMINISTRATIVE LAW ENFORCEMENT BUREAU

title_en: Digital teaching material profit allocation intelligent contract method supporting dynamic weight
abstract_en: The invention discloses a digital teaching material profit distribution intelligent contract method supporting dynamic weights, and belongs to the field of block chain and digital education fusion. The method is deployed in a blockchain network and comprises the core steps of multi-source heterogeneous data acquisition and trusted uplink, multi-dimensional data such as using intensity, user feedback and the like are transmitted to the chain in a trusted mode through a predictor, comprehensive heat indexes are calculated on the chain, the trusted indexes reflecting the value of teaching materials are generated through normalization and weighted aggregation, income weights are dynamically adjusted based on the heat indexes, the updating of the weight in an epoch mode is achieved through various adjustable functions, and the atomization income distribution and full-link audit are automatically completed after sales events are triggered. The invention breaks through the traditional static division mode, realizes precise hook of profit distribution and teaching material dynamic expression, improves distribution fairness and efficiency, reduces trust cost, effectively stimulates high-quality content creation, and provides an intelligent value distribution infrastructure for digital education ecology.

title_en: Intelligent water-saving irrigation area scheduling system based on AI multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intersection of agricultural water conservancy and artificial intelligence, and discloses an intelligent water-saving scheduling system for a pouring area based on AI multi-source data fusion. The system realizes the deep fusion of data driving and physical mechanism by embedding a farmland hydro-thermal balance equation and channel hydrodynamic constraint into PI-STGNN, remarkably improves the accuracy of prediction of water demand and water supply capacity of crops and the robustness under extreme conditions, performs space-time alignment on multi-source heterogeneous data by utilizing dynamic time regularity and Kriging interpolation to generate a standardized characteristic tensor, generates a time-sharing partition gate control instruction which takes the maximization of the yield of grains per unit water amount and the fairness of water distribution into consideration based on reinforcement learning, and outputs natural language scheduling basis comprising growth period, soil moisture content and precipitation probability.

title_en: Virtual power plant optimization method considering multiple uncertainties under electric carbon market cooperation
abstract_en: The virtual power plant optimization method taking multiple uncertainties into consideration under the cooperation of the electric and carbon markets is characterized by establishing a single virtual power plant carbon mechanism model, establishing a plurality of virtual power plant operation optimization models, establishing a plurality of virtual power plant electric and carbon cooperation transaction models, solving, and finally solving the steps. The invention can effectively overcome the influence of the uncertainty of electricity price in the electric market and the uncertainty of new energy output on the optimal scheduling of the virtual power plant, improves the stable operation capability and economic benefit of the system, builds an electric-carbon market collaborative decision mechanism, realizes electric-carbon balance and simultaneously ensures the economic low-carbon operation of the virtual power plant, builds an electric energy sharing contribution degree and carbon quota sharing contribution degree model, realizes profit distribution among members of a alliance of the virtual power plant, improves the fairness and enthusiasm of the members participating in collaborative transaction, improves the ADMM algorithm, improves the convergence speed of the ADMM by dynamically adjusting penalty factors, and reduces the influence of initial selection of penalty parameters on the algorithm performance.
assignees: UNIV SHANGHAI JIAOTONG;STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: New energy transaction settlement deviation compensation method, device, equipment and computer program
abstract_en: The invention discloses a new energy transaction settlement deviation compensation method, device, equipment and computer program, which comprises the steps of determining transaction settlement decision variables of a new energy generator, an electricity selling company and an electric power user, determining settlement deviation variables, constructing an objective function of the generator, an objective function of the electricity selling company and a user objective function, determining compensation coefficient sensitivity indexes of the new energy generator, the electricity selling company and the electric power user, constructing a deviation compensation optimization model based on game balance, constructing a compensation coefficient dynamic adjustment model, solving the deviation compensation optimization model through a particle swarm algorithm combined with chaotic particle swarm and Nash balance guide to obtain an optimal solution of the transaction settlement decision variables, determining an optimal compensation coefficient according to the optimal solution and the compensation coefficient dynamic adjustment model, and further performing new energy transaction settlement deviation compensation. The invention improves the accuracy, fairness and real-time performance of new energy transaction settlement deviation compensation, and can be applied to the technical field of electric power markets.
assignees: INF CT GUANGDONG POWER GRID CO LTD;GUANGDONG ELECTRIC POWER TRANSACTION CENTER CO LTD

title_en: Resident flow-based life circle identification and full-age adaptation facility supply and demand assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban public service facility assessment and space planning, and discloses a life circle identification and full-age adaptation facility supply and demand assessment method based on resident flow. The method is characterized in that actual travel tracks of residents are dynamically captured by utilizing mobile phone signaling data, so that a life circle range highly fitting with actual behaviors is identified, differentiated demands of different age groups such as children, young and strong years, old people and the like on various public service facilities are finely quantized by constructing a two-dimensional demand weight matrix of the age groups and facilities, accurate matching assessment of facility supply and demand services is realized by fusing multi-source data such as population distribution, facility point positions and real-time road networks and the like, the limitation that traditional planning depends on static administrative boundaries is effectively overcome, life circle division is more scientific, and the accuracy and fairness of facility configuration are remarkably improved from an all-age demand assessment view.

title_en: Intelligent city carbon emission panorama management and planning system
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of intelligent city management, in particular to an intelligent city carbon emission panoramic management and planning system, wherein a multi-mode behavior sensing unit collects multi-subject differentiated use behavior data of a central air conditioning system, a shared parking lot and a heating power pipe network in real time through a heterogeneous sensing network deployed on a shared facility, a dynamic emission tracing unit receives the data, a carbon flow tracing algorithm engine carries out space-time coupling calculation on total energy consumption of the shared facility to generate a multi-subject responsible carbon footprint, a responsible weight distribution unit dynamically calculates contribution degrees of all subjects by adopting a Xia Puli value-Bayesian game fusion model based on the carbon footprint, outputs a responsible allocation proportion to a block chain excitation execution unit, and the block chain excitation execution unit automatically triggers a differentiated reward and punishment mechanism according to the responsibility allocation proportion through an intelligent contract, further degrades facility use authority for a behavior abnormal subject, improves accuracy and fairness of carbon emission management and low-carbon development of a power-assisted city.

title_en: Financial incentive method for responding to power demand
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of power demand response and financial incentive, in particular to a power demand response financial incentive method. The method comprises the steps of collecting information from power demand response signals and user response data, generating an incentive distribution list through a multi-dimensional contribution degree calculation model, and further optimizing and generating a final incentive scheme structure. A token prize is then generated from the list and transparent issuance of the prize and tamper-proof data is ensured by smart contract triggering, blockchain techniques. And then, verifying the reward data through the blockchain record, generating a user feedback report, and summarizing the user feedback report into a complete financial incentive report. The method effectively improves fairness and transparency of excitation distribution, achieves automation and instantaneity of prize distribution in the power demand response process, reduces human errors, enhances user trust, and is suitable for complex power grid loads and diversified response scenes.
assignees: BEIJING FEIBO XINDA TECH CO LTD

title_en: Enterprise system integration method based on micro-service architecture
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of enterprise system integration and discloses an enterprise system integration method based on a micro-service architecture, which comprises the steps of executing an overtime office degree assessment strategy, calculating terminal indexes by combining click times and office interfaces, identifying two types of space-time behaviors of staff, weighting and averaging the terminal indexes to obtain the overtime office degree, executing a behavior rationality assessment strategy, comparing a position track with a reference path to assess track deviation degree, executing a consumption authenticity assessment strategy, assessing the authenticity of consumption amount according to per-person meal fees, analyzing a card swiping interval to identify a brushing-over behavior, executing a pseudo overtime behavior scoring strategy, identifying a pseudo overtime behavior according to the position track leaving a restaurant, identifying a secondary overtime behavior, calculating the overtime office degree for calculating a behavior score, executing a task checking overtime identification strategy, identifying the pseudo overtime behavior according to task demand score and behavior score, and improving the fairness and transparency of enterprise welfare distribution.
assignees: JIANGSU JINGSHU INTELLIGENT TECH CO LTD

title_en: Power grid production cost management method and system based on artificial intelligence
abstract_en: The utility model provides a grid production cost management method and system based on artificial intelligence, which collects grid production data in real time, wherein the grid production data comprises power demand, power supply, power price, power quality and equipment operation state, and a data processing and analysis technology based on artificial intelligence is introduced at the rear end to carry out time sequence collaborative analysis on the grid production data, so as to predict short-time grid production cost values, thereby formulating a grid production cost management strategy and optimizing the equipment operation state. Therefore, the dynamic management and optimization of the production cost of the power grid can be realized, so that the operation efficiency and fairness of a power system are improved, more efficient and sustainable power production and supply are realized, and support is provided for the development of the power market and the application of sustainable energy sources.
assignees: NANYANG POWER SUPPLY CO OF STATE GRID HENAN ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: LSTM-based intelligent bus passenger flow prediction and demand response scheduling method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of urban public transportation scheduling and intelligent transportation control, in particular to an LSTM-based intelligent bus passenger flow prediction and demand response scheduling method. The method comprises the steps of 1, cleaning and fusing data such as card swiping records, vehicle positioning, dispatching logs, line stations, weather, holidays and the like to construct passenger flow characteristics, 2, predicting station-level short-time passenger flow by using a long-period memory neural network, 3, generating departure intervals of each period of each line through a dispatching strategy network according to predicted passenger flow, vehicle capacity and the like, 4, estimating average waiting time of the stations and the number of people in the vehicles by using a queue simulation network, 5, constructing a joint loss function considering prediction errors, waiting time, passenger carrying rate and line fairness, 6, jointly training the passenger flow prediction and dispatching strategy network under joint loss constraint, and 7, updating model parameters on line based on operation data collected by rolling to enable the system to adapt to passenger flow change and optimize a dispatching scheme.
assignees: CHINA XIONGAN GROUP TRAFFIC CO LTD

title_en: System for constructing high-precision user behavior portraits by improving federal learning algorithm
abstract_en: The technical scheme of the invention discloses a system for constructing a high-precision user behavior portrait by an improved federal learning algorithm, which is characterized by comprising a multi-source privacy protection data acquisition module, a federal learning modeling module based on dynamic weighting and contribution demonstration, a multi-dimensional user behavior portrait module, a personalized vehicle-network interaction strategy generation module, a dynamic execution and fairness excitation module and a feedback and model self-optimization module. According to the invention, the historical data of the charge and discharge behavior habit of the user can be subjected to deep analysis and portrait construction, a high-precision and high-coverage user behavior portrait model is generated by improving the federal machine learning algorithm, the real-time income of the user is improved, the viscosity of the user is enhanced, and the stability of the power grid and the renewable energy consumption rate are further improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;SHANGHAI ELECTRICAL APPARATUS RESEARCH INST GROUP CO LTD;CHINA ELECTRIC POWER RESEARCH INST CO LTD

title_en: Revenue distribution method, device, electronic equipment and storage medium
abstract_en: The application provides a method, a device, electronic equipment and a storage medium for distributing benefits, relates to the field of digital payment, and can solve the problem of unfair distribution of the benefits. The method comprises the steps of determining a data contribution degree score of a data provider based on the number of sample data and the number of fields of the sample data, determining a calculation contribution degree score of a calculation force provider based on a resource consumption index, determining a model contribution degree score of the model provider based on the number of parameters of the model and the number of model calls, and respectively carrying out profit distribution on the data provider, the calculation force provider and the model provider based on the total profit of tasks, the data contribution degree score, the calculation force contribution degree score and the model contribution degree score to determine the profit of the data provider, the profit of the calculation force provider and the profit of the model provider. The application can realize according to labour values allocation and improve fairness of income allocation.

title_en: Virtual power plant double-layer optimal scheduling method and device based on differentiated quotation
abstract_en: The invention relates to a virtual power plant double-layer optimal scheduling method and device based on differentiated quotation, wherein the method comprises the steps of constructing an upper-layer electricity-carbon combined market model and a lower-layer virtual power plant model; the method comprises the steps of obtaining quotation data of each virtual power plant in each period based on a lower-layer virtual power plant model, inputting the quotation data into an upper-layer electric-carbon combined market model for market clearing, obtaining clear data of each virtual power plant in each period, feeding the clear data back to each virtual power plant and updating the clear data to generate new quotation data, constructing a combined optimal judging index, carrying out multi-round iterative solution on the two models, and outputting optimal results of double-layer optimal scheduling when the two models are converged. According to the invention, the balance of supply and demand and the constraint of carbon of the system are met, meanwhile, the energy purchasing cost of the upper market, the economic benefit of the virtual power plant and the carbon emission reduction benefit are taken into account, the differentiated quotation and double-layer coordination optimization are realized, and the running efficiency and the benefit fairness of the participation of the virtual power plant in the electricity-carbon combined market are improved.
assignees: STATE GRID SHANGHAI MUNICIPAL ELECTRIC POWER CO;UNIV SHANGHAI ELECTRIC POWER

title_en: Regional water resource optimal allocation overall value assessment method
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of water resource value evaluation, and discloses a regional water resource optimal allocation overall value evaluation method which comprises the following steps of S1, calculating water demand, S2, calculating class value, S3, calculating processing cost, S4, calculating maintenance cost, S5, calculating political economy value, S6, overall value evaluation, S7 and outputting a result. The invention constructs an evaluation framework of policy-economy-cost three-dimensional fusion, breaks through the limitation of the traditional water resource value evaluation bias single economic dimension, realizes remarkable innovation in the aspects of policy-oriented quantization, cost accounting refinement and evaluation dynamics, converts abstract policy tendency into a computable weight variable, establishes a linkage mechanism with full chain cost, and ensures that the water resource allocation decision simultaneously meets the efficiency and fairness targets.
assignees: HUNAN INST OF WATER RESOURCES AND HYDROPOWER RESEARCH

title_en: Expressway service area charging pile configuration method and system integrating power allocation and multi-agent system
abstract_en: The application discloses a method and a system for configuring a charging pile of a highway service area by combining power allocation and a multi-agent system. According to the application, the new energy automobile runs on the expressway and the charging behavior is simulated and described through an Agent-based Model (ABM), and the charging pile arrangement scheme is optimized by utilizing a multi-objective optimization algorithm. The application not only considers the charging demand end of the interaction of the vehicle-road-charging pile on the basis of the multi-agent system, but also establishes a power allocation system (charging supply end) of the power grid-service area-charging pile, allocates the power of the service vehicle under the maximum load power of the power grid, establishes a set of allocation rules under the consideration of fairness and integral effect, and optimizes the configuration of the charging pile in the expressway service area by combining the existing optimization algorithm so as to realize the aims of meeting the charging demand of users and optimizing the resource configuration.
assignees: UNIV ZHEJIANG;ZHEJIANG JIAOGONG HONGTU TRAFFIC CONSTRUCTION CO LTD

title_en: Load side carbon emission-oriented comprehensive energy system energy carbon optimization scheduling method and system
abstract_en: The invention relates to a load side carbon emission oriented comprehensive energy system energy carbon optimization scheduling method and system, which are used for constructing a multi-energy subsystem unified model based on operation constraint and energy balance relation of an electric subsystem, a natural gas subsystem and a thermodynamic subsystem, combining the multi-energy subsystem unified model, taking node carbon potential as a decision variable, establishing a cross-subsystem carbon flow equation based on a carbon flow theory and a ladder type carbon emission transaction mechanism, constructing a load side carbon emission responsibility quantification model, calculating load side carbon emission responsibility based on the load side carbon emission responsibility quantification model, acquiring a scheduling scheme, and realizing system establishment by the method. According to the invention, an actual carbon emission model is refined to load side nodes, a linearization framework is constructed, the model is unified into a linear programming problem, the feasibility and the precision of model solving are effectively balanced, a support is provided for a carbon transaction system in a market environment, a node-level carbon settlement mechanism improves the transparency and fairness of carbon accounting, and a new idea is provided for carbon transaction.

title_en: Hierarchical game optimal scheduling and income distribution method oriented to load aggregators
abstract_en: The invention belongs to the technical field of power system dispatching and discloses a hierarchical game optimal dispatching and income distribution method for load aggregators. The method comprises the steps of realizing unified aggregation of 10kV/35kV multi-voltage-class users through standardized modeling, extracting multi-market general bidding parameters, constructing an upper-layer optimization framework covering multiple markets such as electric energy, demand response and the like, adopting a particle swarm algorithm to cooperatively game with a commercial solver for solving, completing lower-layer user scheduling allocation and revenue allocation by taking an upper-layer result as input and combining a voltage class difference and a performance scoring recursion mechanism, and reversely correcting closed-loop cooperation of upper-layer bidding through physical feasibility and budget balance verification and credibility until convergence. The method can reduce the risk of market violations, promote the dispatching robustness and the profit potential, and give consideration to the allocation fairness and the user retention stability, ensure that the scheme can fall to the ground, and comprehensively enhance the market competitiveness and the operation safety of the load aggregator.
assignees: ECONOMIC AND TECHNOLOGICAL RESEARCH INST STATE GRID XINJIANG ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent public health emergency event material scheduling method based on multi-source data fusion
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent scheduling method for public health emergency event materials with multi-source data fusion. The method comprises the steps of collecting a multi-source original data set from a health department database, a warehouse management system, a traffic management platform, a mobile communication operator platform and a meteorological environment monitoring station, carrying out data cleaning and standardization processing on the multi-source original data set, constructing an area diagram based on the preprocessed multi-source data set, carrying out multi-source data fusion by using a graphic neural network to generate a fusion feature vector, inputting the fusion feature vector into a combined model of a long-short-term memory network and a support vector regressor to carry out material demand prediction, adopting an improved particle swarm optimization algorithm combined with a simulated annealing mechanism to generate an optimal material scheduling scheme, and dynamically evaluating and adjusting the material scheduling scheme according to real-time data. According to the invention, through multi-source data depth fusion and intelligent optimization algorithm, accuracy, efficiency and fairness of public health emergency material scheduling are improved.
assignees: CHINESE CENTER FOR DISEASE CONTROL AND PREVENTION

title_en: Multi-star collaborative observation task distributed planning method for emergency response
abstract_en: The application relates to an emergency response-oriented multi-satellite collaborative observation task distributed planning method which comprises the steps of modeling a plurality of satellites as intelligent agents with autonomous decision-making capability, and realizing task broadcasting, bidding and confirmation between a task manager and an executor by adopting an improved contract network protocol. By constructing a multi-factor dynamic evaluation function, the task urgency, the observation feasibility, the resource state and the task conflict probability are comprehensively considered, and the intelligent bidding allocation of the observation subtasks is realized. The task conflict game diagram mechanism is introduced, so that the problem of multi-satellite bidding conflict is effectively solved, and the task scheduling fairness and the resource utilization rate are improved. The application has the functions of communication topology perception and local task re-planning, supports self-adaptive recovery under the condition of node failure or communication interruption, and improves the robustness of the system and the task completion rate. The application has the advantages of fast task response, high scheduling efficiency, strong distributed autonomy and the like, and is suitable for the collaborative planning requirement of the multi-star system in the emergency response.
assignees: XIAN INST OF SPACE RADIO TECHNOLOGY

title_en: User side dynamic carbon responsibility accounting method considering regional fairness and demand response
abstract_en: The invention discloses a user side dynamic carbon responsibility accounting method considering regional fairness and demand response, which comprises the steps of establishing a user side demand response double-layer optimization model, determining various basic parameters of the model, including user side carbon responsibility proportion parameters, cost parameters of a unit, power grid topology parameters and load initial quantity, calculating a starting marginal carbon emission factor as an average marginal carbon emission rate, considering the maximization of electricity cost, carbon transaction cost and electricity income of each load in demand response, solving a user demand response model, outputting a load side demand response plan under the current average marginal carbon emission rate, setting convergence conditions, solving an operator clearing model by taking the minimum electricity generation cost as constraint if the current average marginal carbon emission rate is not converged, obtaining new unit system carbon emission quantity, updating the average marginal carbon emission rate, outputting the new demand response plan, outputting a final load demand response plan if the convergence conditions are met, and accounting a user carbon emission responsibility value.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Standard on-line digital review platform
abstract_en: The invention relates to the field of online review and discloses a standard online digital review platform which comprises a platform application and interaction module, a blockchain and intelligent contract module, an AI analysis engine module, a database module and a platform application and interaction module, wherein the platform application and interaction module is used for providing a unified user interface and processing operation instructions of different roles, the blockchain and intelligent contract module is connected with the platform application and interaction module and used for deploying a preset review process intelligent contract and storing key review operation logs in a non-falsifying mode, and the AI analysis engine module is connected with the blockchain and intelligent contract module and connected with the platform application and interaction module. The invention solves the technical problems that the process data of the existing review system are easy to tamper, objective and quantitative analysis is difficult to carry out, and the analysis model cannot be self-optimized, achieves the effects that key certificates in the review process cannot tamper, and the whole process is traceable, and builds a self-optimized closed loop combining analysis and management and control, thereby improving the fairness and reliability of the review.
assignees: BEIJING QUANKE ON LINE SCIENCE AND TECH CO LTD

title_en: Comprehensive energy multi-microgrid optimal operation method considering shared energy storage capacity configuration
abstract_en: The comprehensive energy multi-microgrid optimizing operation method considering shared energy storage capacity configuration comprises the steps of designing a multi-microgrid comprehensive energy system and a multi-main-body transaction framework of shared energy storage based on a carbon quota and a carbon transaction mechanism, establishing a double-layer optimizing model, coordinating multi-layer cooperation relation between an energy storage operator and the multi-microgrid, converting double-layer Nash negotiation game problems into 3 sub-problems respectively, namely a shared energy storage and multi-microgrid cooperation alliance cost minimization sub-problem P1 and a shared energy storage and multi-microgrid income distribution sub-problem PP1 and a microgrid income distribution sub-problem PP2, solving the sub-problem P1 to obtain the shared energy storage and multi-microgrid cooperation alliance minimum cost, and solving the sub-problem PP1 and the sub-problem PP2 to obtain the total cost of the multi-microgrid and the interactive electricity price of the energy storage and the electric energy sharing price between the microgrids respectively. The method can realize reasonable configuration of energy storage resources and optimal scheduling of the multi-micro-grid system, and ensures fairness of resource utilization benefit maximization and benefit allocation among all the main bodies.
assignees: UNIV CHINA THREE GORGES CTGU;STATE GRID HUBEI ELECTRIC POWER CO LTD EHV CO

title_en: Water right transaction method based on cooperative transaction alliance and storable medium
abstract_en: The invention discloses a water right trading method and a storable medium based on a cooperative trading alliance, and relates to the technical field of water resource allocation. Aiming at the problem that the opposites of the conventional water right trading buyers and sellers and the distribution of the benefits lack scientific basis, the invention establishes a cooperative trading alliance by determining trading participants and registering trading information, adopts a shape value method to calculate objective contribution degree, adopts a Delphi method to obtain subjective contribution degree, combines subjective and objective weights to form a benefit distribution proportion, preferentially compensates the water saving cost of sellers, distributes residual benefits and verifies the cooperative necessity through the net benefits of sub alliances. The invention converts the buyer and the seller into the benefit community, shortens the negotiation period, improves the fairness and the cooperation stability of the income distribution, effectively optimizes the water resource allocation, and is suitable for the scenes of agricultural internal circulation, cross-industry water intake right transaction and the like.

title_en: Novel risk prevention method and device for power system and storage medium
abstract_en: The invention relates to a risk prevention method, a risk prevention device and a storage medium of a novel power system, which are applied to the technical field of power market risk protection, and comprise the steps of constructing a multi-dimensional risk monitoring index system covering economy, society, fairness and the like, driving market optimization according to the system risk monitoring index system, realizing the crossing from single price limitation to systematic risk active management, improving the capability of the market to cope with complex uncertainty, smoothening the relationship among markets by designing cooperative constraints of electric energy, capacity, auxiliary service and green electricity markets, promoting the optimal configuration of various resources, improving the overall market efficiency, introducing a dynamic planning and closed-loop feedback mechanism, enabling market parameters (such as price limit, risk weight) and operation strategies to be dynamically adjusted according to real-time states of supply and demand, new energy output and the like, and obviously enhancing the adaptability of the market mechanism to the dynamic characteristics of the novel power system.
assignees: ECONOMIC TECHNOLOGY RESEARCH INSTITUTE OF STATE GRID GANSU ELECTRIC POWER CO

title_en: Method, device and storage medium for evaluating and solving maximum supply capacity of power grid
abstract_en: The invention relates to a method, a device and a storage medium for evaluating and solving the maximum supply capacity of a power grid, which are applied to the technical field of operation optimization of a power system, and comprise the steps of comprehensively considering complex dynamic boundary conditions such as coupling constraint of a power transmission section, reserve capacity constraint and the like in an optimization model, so that an evaluation result is closer to the actual operation characteristic of the power grid, and the accuracy and the reliability of decision making are obviously improved; the three-objective collaborative optimization is adopted, three core elements of power supply capacity, safety margin and standby balance can be balanced, so that the final scheme is not only technically optimal, but also is fairly and reasonably fair in resource allocation, the problem that the conventional single-objective optimization causes is avoided, a series of technically optimal alternatives are generated, multidimensional fairness quantization indexes are innovatively introduced, and a complete, scientific and closed-loop decision framework from 'multi-scheme generation' to 'single-scheme preferred' is provided for a decision maker, so that the decision process is more transparent and reasonable.
assignees: NORTH CHINA BRANCH OF STATE GRID CORP OF CHINA;BEIJING TSINTERGY TECH CO LTD

title_en: Primary sanitary resource allocation method and system for epidemic prevention and control
abstract_en: The invention discloses a primary sanitary resource allocation method and system for epidemic prevention and control, which relate to the technical field of public sanitary epidemic prevention and control and comprise the steps of predicting epidemic trend of communities based on a distributed space resource coupling SEIR model, introducing parameters such as medical resource indexes, constructing a community side preference function and a medical facility side preference function, solving matching relation between communities and medical facilities at all times and isolating resource allocation schemes under an edge cloud cooperative framework. The scheme utilizes the peak value advance, the resource occupation proportion and the trust factor to comprehensively measure the service priority, improves the configuration priority of resource shortage communities through urban and rural compensation items, reduces urban and rural gaps, reduces data transmission quantity by adopting edge preprocessing and encryption uploading sequencing results, improves scheduling timeliness, fairness and safety, and realizes closed loop linkage of epidemic propagation inhibition and resource dynamic scheduling.

title_en: Channel and time slot collaborative optimization method considering preference of airlines
abstract_en: The invention relates to the technical field of air traffic flow management in the aerospace field, and discloses a channel and time slot collaborative optimization method considering the preference of an airline company, which comprises the following steps of obtaining flight information, time slot information and airspace capacity information; determining an objective function as minimum total delay cost of flights and minimum fairness coefficient of airlines according to flight information and time slot information, setting a flight uniqueness constraint, a time slot feasibility constraint, a capacity constraint and a maximum threshold constraint, constructing a complete model for allocating the resources of the routes and the time slots, solving the constructed model for allocating the resources of the routes and the time slots by adopting a genetic algorithm, and outputting a scheme for allocating the resources of the routes and the time slots. The invention takes delay minimization and fairness promotion as dual-core targets, innovates a resource allocation mechanism, effectively reduces the flight delay rate, ensures that the inter-airline resources are acquired fairly, and builds an efficient and fair air traffic management system by assistance.

title_en: Dynamic multi-rule intelligent case dividing platform for poor case of individual credit
abstract_en: The invention discloses a dynamic multi-rule intelligent case division platform for bad asset cases, which belongs to the field of financial bad asset management and data processing and comprises an initialization module, a dynamic rule engine module, a batch verification module, a weight calculation module, an allocation decision module, an execution module and a balancing module, wherein the platform firstly acquires three-dimensional upper limit and load data, calculates a global pressure load index and dynamically determines a rule priority sequence. After distribution, the platform calculates a multidimensional fairness index, and if the multidimensional fairness index is incorrect, the platform triggers a directional fine adjustment operation. The invention adopts dynamic priority adjustment, predictive weight calculation and closed-loop self-learning gradient mechanism, can sense the load of the asset handling executor in real time, accurately constrains complex business, and improves the fairness of case distribution, the self-adaptive capacity of the system and the overall operation efficiency.
assignees: GUANGDONG HENGQIN SHENSHUI YUNKE DIGITAL TECH CO LTD

title_en: Intelligent traffic service processing method based on block chain distributed predictors
abstract_en: The invention discloses an intelligent traffic service processing method based on a block chain distributed prediction machine, which relates to the technical field of intelligent traffic service based on block chains and the distributed prediction machine, and comprises the steps of collecting original traffic data, and sending the original traffic data to a block chain network for encryption storage through the distributed prediction machine network to obtain encrypted traffic data; the method comprises the steps of generating prompt word information according to encrypted traffic data and user demand information, encrypting and storing the prompt word information in a blockchain network to obtain blockchain prompt word data, obtaining the encrypted traffic data and the blockchain prompt word data from the blockchain network, carrying out reasoning calculation by combining the prompt word information after decryption to obtain model reasoning result data, and automatically executing intelligent traffic service according to the model reasoning result data to obtain transaction execution result data. The invention can be used for decentralizing to improve the system stability, enhance the data privacy safety, improve the model output accuracy and ensure the fairness and fairness of transactions through intelligent contracts.
assignees: HUBEI COMMUNICATIONS INVESTMENT SMART TECH CO LTD

title_en: Cabin body and emergency shelter
abstract_en: The application relates to the technical field of emergency rescue equipment, and discloses a cabin body which comprises a base, a top cover, a back plate, a placing rack and two side plates, wherein the top cover and the base are oppositely arranged at intervals, the two side plates are oppositely arranged between the base and the top cover in parallel, two ends of each side plate are respectively detachably connected with the edge of the base and the edge of the top cover, the back plate is arranged between the base and the top cover and is positioned at the same end of the two side plates, the lower end of the back plate is detachably connected with the base, the placing rack is arranged above the base and is positioned at one side of the top cover, two sides of the placing rack are respectively detachably connected with corresponding side edges of the two side plates, one side of the placing rack is detachably connected with the back plate, and one side of the placing rack is detachably connected with the top cover. The integral type water logging shelter body is skillfully decomposed into a plurality of independent components, so that the disassembly and assembly process can be simplified, the dependence on specialized tools is reduced, the time for converting from a transportation state to a use state is obviously shortened, and the emergency allocation efficiency of the water logging shelter is effectively improved.

title_en: A handheld sub terminal and operation method for mountain climbing information
title_ko: 휴대용 등산안내 보조단말기 및 그 운영 방법
abstract_ko:
본 발명은 항법속성 기능을 갖고 있는 산악 전자지도 데이터베이스(DB)를 기반으로 한 휴대용 등산안내 보조 단말기 및 그 운영 방법에 관한 것으로, 보다 상세하게는 산악 전체 영역과 등고선 데이터, 등산로 및 등산 코스 데이터, 주요 산악 시설명칭 등을 하나의 서비스 데이터베이스(DB)화하여 단말기의 저장 장치에 저장시키고, GPS수신기가 내장된 휴대용 등산안내 보조 단말기를 간단한 화면의 터치 조작을 통해 사용자에게 등산로 코스 안내 및 경유지(Way Point), 대피소, 고도 정보 등의 등산 테마 데이터를 2차원 평면도 또는 3D 조감도 형태로 다양한 등산안내 서비스를 제공할 수 있도록 구성되어 있는 휴대용 등산안내 보조 단말기와 그 운영 방법 및 데이터베이스 구축 방법에 관한 것이다. 
     상기와 같은 목적을 달성하기 위하여 본 발명에 따른 휴대용 등산안내 보조단말기는 GPS위성으로부터 사용자의 위치 정보를 수신하는 GPS 수신부; 산악의 배경 형상, 등산 코스 데이터 및 테마 정보 등의 데이터베이스가 격납되어 있는 산악 전자지도 데이터베이스와, 상기 각각의 데이터베이스를 실행 가능하도록 하는 다수의 운영 실행 프로그램이 함께 저장된 산악 전자지도 데이터베이스 저장부; 사용자 조작신호를 발생시켜 등산 전자지도 모드 또는 3D 조감도 모드 중 어느 하나의 선택을 가능하게 하는 키입력부; 및 상기 GPS 수신부에서 수신한 사용자의 위치 정보 또는 키입력부를 통해서 사용자에 의해 선택된 산악 전자지도 모드 또는 3D 조감도 모드 중 어느 하나와 매칭 되는 산악 전자지도 데이터베이스를 산악 전자지도 데이 터베이스 저장부에서 독출하고, 독출된 데이터베이스에 해당하는 운영 실행 프로그램을 실행시키고, 이를 표출부를 이용하여 표출되도록 제어하는 중앙제어부를 포함하여 이루어지는 것을 특징적 구성으로 한다. 
       
     등산, 등고선, 등산로, 등산코스, 3D조감도, 산악, GPS, 네비게이션, 전자지도, DB, DEM, Navigation System

title_en: Shockproof hard disk machine
abstract_en: The utility model relates to a hard disk machine takes precautions against earthquakes, it includes: a casing having a receiving space for receiving a hard disk drive; a printed circuit board, located in the accommodation space, having a controller and a first connector, wherein the controller can be coupled to the hard disk drive to perform signal conversion between the hard disk drive and the first connector, and the first connector can be coupled to a host and exposed out of the housing; and at least one shock absorbing spring plate inserted into one side of the hard disk drive to provide shock absorbing capacity to the hard disk drive.

title_en: Alarm capable of sending out multi-grade earthquake signal to periphery towns
abstract_en: The invention relates to an alarm capable of automatically propagating a plurality of scales of impending earthquake signals toward external cities and towns, which is composed of an alarm cabinet lower chassis and an outer shell, wherein an alarm part device frame, a plurality of pendulum spike shaft bases are arranged on the device frame, a pendulum spike shaft protrudes from each pendulum spike shaft base, and one pendulum spike shaft sleeve is matched, a pendulum inverse proportion rod is connected to the above of the shaft sleeve, a pendulum linkage rod is connected to the below of the shaft sleeve, the lower end of the linkage rod is connected to a pendulum; one annular contact disk is arranged at the top of each pendulum inverse proportion rod, and four bolts displaced by the adjusting contact disk are arranged at the circumference thereof. When the earthquake comes, an alarm circuit is switched off to send alarm and propagate outward. Because the overspreading and propagation velocity of an earthquake wave is much slower than the conduction velocity of electricity, if the automatic propagation alarm can be mounted in all the cities and the towns nationwide, when an earthquake centered on a city or town occurs, the impending earthquake signals are rapidly propagated to the cities, towns and rural areas in eight directions so that people at a far distance can have enough time to evacuate.

title_en: Method of providing emergency temporary housing to natural disaster evacuee
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a system for providing a natural disaster evacuee with emergency temporary housing assigned with a temporary home number so as to allow a relative and acquaintance of the evacuee and a natural disaster prevention center to specify the evacuee's location.  <P>SOLUTION: Based on the system wherein a computer 100 of a natural disaster prevention general center is connected with computers 101 to 107 of organizations involved in natural disaster prevention through Internet network and, moreover, a host server 10 of the natural disaster prevention general center includes various databases including a natural disaster damage prediction database 12, a method of providing emergency temporary housing to a natural disaster evacuee allows the organizations involved in natural disaster prevention to share information and cooperate to support the evacuee so that the evacuee moves into an emergency temporary home.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT

title_en: Method and apparatus for evaluating seismic capacity of building
abstract_en: <P>PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To provide a method and an apparatus for evaluating a seismic capacity of a building, which enable an operator to easily know which portion of the building is lowered in seismic capacity, when the building is acted upon by an external force such as an earthquake and the like.  <P>SOLUTION: The apparatus includes: three-axis acceleration sensors S(S1-S27) each being disposed at a structure material in each virtual block B which is defined by dividing the building 20 into two or more parts; and a measuring/evaluating section which is connected to each three-axis acceleration sensor S and measures a displacement of the structure material in each virtual block B by using a detection signal from each three-axis acceleration sensor S, when the building 20 is displaced by the external force, and which evaluates the seismic capacity of the building 20, based on these measured values and a previously set displacement-allowed value of the structure material in each virtual block B. Therefore, the operator can easily know which portion of the building 20 is lowered in the seismic capacity, when the building is acted upon by the external force such as the earthquake and the like.  <P>COPYRIGHT: (C)2010,JPO&INPIT
assignees: NAT INST OF ADVANCED IND SCIEN;MISAWA HOMES INST OF RES & DEV

title_en: High-altitude fire fighting truck
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a high-altitude fire fighting truck comprising a suspending drive room at the lower part and a fire balloon of a working room fixedly provided with a high pressure hose, wherein the outlet of the hose is connected with a high pressure water gun and fixedly arranged at the working room; the fire balloon is accommodated at the accommodation carriage of the fire balloon, wherein a winding machine is fixed in the carriage, and the fire balloon is fixed on the winding machine through a tractor rope; the surface of the fire balloon is provided with a plurality of buckles along the ball body in latitudes; the drive room is larger than the working room; the accommodation carriage of the fire balloon is provided with a gas-filled tube in which a gas outlet faces to the inflation inlet of the fire balloon; the wall of the accommodation carriage of the fire balloon is provided with a drive room platform and a working room platform matched with the drive room and the working room, and the winding machine is fixed at the bottom; and one end of the tractor rope on the winding machine is fixedly arranged on the fire balloon. Through the high-altitude fire fighting truck, the fire balloon can be ascended and folded quickly, and the fire balloon can be protected.

title_en: Lattice polystyrene template
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a lattice polystyrene template. A vertical surface of the template is symmetrical from top to bottom and from left to right; the upper part and the lower part of the plane center of the vertical surface of the template are cambered; two sides of the plane are symmetrically provided with displaced convex-concave fat edges; and the profile arcs of the template are buckled to form a cavity, and a plurality of cavities are arranged. Through changing the structure form of the polystyrene template, the structure form of the template is improved, and the plate bursting phenomenon existed in the construction process is remarkably reduced, so that the using amount of the concrete is further saved under the condition that the bearing capacity and earthquake resistant behavior of the overall structure do not change. The lattice polystyrene template is feasible in economy, simple in technology, easy to master and convenient for construction, and can be widely applied to the process of post-disaster reconstruction. The lattice polystyrene template effectively solves the defect of the single structure form of the existing lattice polystyrene template in China, and enables the novel wall structure in China to get a larger development.

title_en: Automatic scaling emergency shelter device
abstract_en: The invention discloses an automatic scaling emergency shelter device, which mainly comprises hinge covers (1), connecting rods A (2), connecting rods B (3), motors (4), bolts (5), nuts (6), adjusting sleeves (7), lead screws (8) and self-locking devices (9), wherein a four-bar mechanism multi-layer flat basic structure (21) is formed by the connecting rods A (2), a vertical connecting structure (31) is formed by the connecting rods B (3), and the two structures are connected with each other to form a three-dimensional structural assembly of the device; the motors (4) are connected with the basic structure through the lead screws (8) and are uniformly distributed on the four pairs of hinge covers (1); the self-locking devices (9) are arranged on the relative inner sides of the hinge covers; the device has a compression resistance structure with certain strength and rigidity through the self-locking of the self-locking devices (9). The device can become an emergency shelter for people when a mine disaster occurs or houses collapse in earthquake collapse, and is unique in mechanism design, quick in starting and skilful in overall design concept; and due to selection of a proper material, the equipment has stronger compression resistance capacity, the personal safety can be guaranteed, and the device is easy to operate and low in cost and can become the emergency shelter for the people at a critical moment.

title_en: Living environment simulation experiment apparatus of emergency sheltering equipment
abstract_en: The utility model discloses an environment simulation experiment apparatus, particularly relates to a human living environment-related human metabolism gas and harmful gas simulation experiment apparatus in the emergency sheltering equipment. The environment simulation experiment apparatus comprises a cabinet body and the experimental instruments arranged in the cabinet body, wherein the experimental instruments include a gas control apparatus, a heating apparatus and a humidifying apparatus. The environment simulation experiment apparatus can simulate the human metabolism gas and the harmful gas and provide the environment with different temperature and humidity, and is used for testing whether the environment of the sheltering equipment in the mine meets the technical requirement ruled by the environment standard needed for the refugees within rated protection time. The environment simulation experiment apparatus is small in volume, light in weight and convenient to move, can perform the detection experiment of the sheltering apparatus of which the capacity is 3-24 persons and the protection time is more than 120 hours, and is also suitable for providing detection experiment samples of the living environment in a seabed emergency sheltering cabin.

title_en: Escape capsule gas linkage control device for mine
abstract_en: The invention discloses an escape capsule gas linkage control device for mine. The device comprises an air curtain tube, a spraying tube, a filter, a pressure reducer and a standby gas cylinder, wherein one end of the filter is connected with a compressed air pipeline; the other end of the filter is connected with one end of the pressure reducer through a connecting pipeline; the other end of the pressure reducer is connected with an aeration pipeline; another connecting pipeline is also arranged on the connecting pipeline between the filter and the pressure reducer, and is connected with the spraying pipe and the air curtain pipe; a control valve is arranged on the air curtain pipe, and is electrically connected with a mechanical valve; and the spraying pipe is connected with the standby gas cylinder through the connecting pipeline. At an emergency shelter constructed at a mine shaft at present, after a mine disaster happens, the system is matched with an underground compressed air device (the standby gas cylinder can be used under the condition that the compressed air is absent), the toxic and harmful gas can be isolated and removed while personnel enter the emergency shelter, the harmful gas can be removed more effectively, and thus, a good survival environment is provided for miners encountering the mine disaster.
assignees: Jiangsu dandilong heavy industry co ltd

title_en: Disaster risk area prediction device
abstract_en: PROBLEM TO BE SOLVED: To accurately predict a risk area resulting from local heavy rain and to appropriately guide a person to an emergency shelter on the basis of a prediction.SOLUTION: A disaster risk area prediction device 1, which predicts a degree of risk from disaster due to precipitation in an object area, comprises: FA value calculation means 2 which divides a ground surface of the object area into meshes, assigns altitude data to each mesh, assumes that surface water on a given mesh flows out to one of the surrounding meshes with which the given mesh has a steepest downward slope, and calculates a FA value of the given mesh which is a value obtained by accumulating a number of the meshes from which the surface water thereon flows in the given mesh; FA value logarithmic conversion means 3 which obtains a logarithmic value of the FA value for each mesh; and display means 4 which divides the FA logarithmic values into a plurality of groups in accordance with magnitudes of the FA logarithmic values, and performs a screen display of the meshes to which identification information set for each group is assigned.

title_en: The combined earthquake isolating equipment of the Self-resetting that a kind of vertical bearing capacity is high
abstract_en: The invention discloses the combined earthquake isolating equipment of the high Self-resetting of a kind of vertical bearing capacity, comprise slidable panels, slide mass, elastic rubbery body and gusset piece, slidable panels is positioned at top, for the upper head plate of earthquake isolating equipment, gusset piece is positioned at bottom, for the bottom plate of earthquake isolating equipment, accommodation space is formed between slidable panels and gusset piece, slide mass and elastic rubbery body are positioned at accommodation space, slide mass is positioned at the central region of accommodation space, the top of slide mass contacts with the soffit of slidable panels, bottom and the gusset piece of slide mass are connected, elastic rubbery body is multiple, multiple elastic rubbery body is evenly arranged in the fringe region of accommodation space, be positioned at the periphery of slide mass, each elastic rubbery body upper, lower end is connected with slidable panels and gusset piece respectively, slide mass and multiple elastic rubbery body are that horizontal lattice-like distributes.Use can be inverted when earthquake isolating equipment separately establishes dust guard.Adopt the protected structure of this earthquake isolating equipment can reduce structural response when earthquake.

title_en: Gas coordinated control device of mineral rescue capsule
abstract_en: The utility model discloses a gas coordinated control device of a mineral rescue capsule.
